a.example: I saw a cat in the garden this morning.
a.exampleZh: 今天早上我在花园里看到了一只猫。

abandon.example: They had to abandon the old car by the side of the road.
abandon.exampleZh: 他们不得不把那辆旧车丢弃在路边。

abbreviation.example: TV is a common abbreviation for television.
abbreviation.exampleZh: TV 是 television 的常见缩写形式。

abdomen.example: The doctor pressed gently on my abdomen to check for any pain.
abdomen.exampleZh: 医生轻轻按压我的腹部，检查是否有疼痛。

abide.example: I cannot abide noise while I am reading at home.
abide.exampleZh: 我在家看书时无法忍受噪音。

ability.example: She has the ability to solve difficult problems quickly.
ability.exampleZh: 她有快速解决难题的能力。

abnormal.example: It is abnormal for him to be so quiet in class.
abnormal.exampleZh: 他在课上这么安静是不正常的。

aboard.example: All passengers must be aboard the plane before it leaves.
aboard.exampleZh: 所有乘客必须在飞机起飞前登机。

abolish.example: Many countries want to abolish the old law and make life fairer for everyone.
abolish.exampleZh: 许多国家想要废除这项旧法律，让每个人的生活更公平。

abound.example: Small shops abound in this old part of town.
abound.exampleZh: 小镇的这个老城区里到处都是小商店。

about.example: My brother told me a funny story about his new dog.
about.exampleZh: 我弟弟给我讲了一个关于他的新狗的有趣故事。

above.example: The plane is flying above the clouds right now.
above.exampleZh: 飞机此刻正飞行在云层上方。

abroad.example: Many young people want to study abroad after they finish high school.
abroad.exampleZh: 许多年轻人想在高中毕业后到国外留学。

abrupt.example: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the manager stood up.
abrupt.exampleZh: 经理站起来时，会议突然结束了。

absence.example: Her long absence from class worried all the teachers.
absence.exampleZh: 她长时间缺课让所有老师都很担心。

absent.example: He was absent from school yesterday because of a bad cold.
absent.exampleZh: 他昨天因为重感冒没去上学。

absolute.example: The king had absolute power over everyone in the country.
absolute.exampleZh: 国王对这个国家的所有人拥有绝对的权力。

absorb.example: Plants absorb water and sunlight to grow, and good books absorb your attention completely.
absorb.exampleZh: 植物吸收水分和阳光来生长，而好书会让你全神贯注。

abstract.example: The idea is too abstract, so please give me a simple example.
abstract.exampleZh: 这个概念太抽象了，请给我一个简单的例子。

absurd.example: It is absurd to blame the weather for our own bad plans.
absurd.exampleZh: 把我们自己糟糕的计划归咎于天气是荒谬的。

abundance.example: There is an abundance of fresh fruit in the market this summer.
abundance.exampleZh: 今年夏天市场上新鲜水果非常丰富。

abundant.example: The garden has abundant water and sunlight, so the plants grow very fast.
abundant.exampleZh: 花园里有充足的水和阳光，所以植物长得非常快。

abuse.example: It is wrong to abuse your power at work.
abuse.exampleZh: 在工作中滥用职权是不对的。

academic.example: Her academic work is very strong, and she teaches at a famous university.
academic.exampleZh: 她的学术工作非常出色，她在一所著名大学任教。

academy.example: My sister studies music at a famous academy in the city.
academy.exampleZh: 我姐姐在城里一所著名的学院学习音乐。

accelerate.example: New machines help us accelerate the work and finish it earlier.
accelerate.exampleZh: 新机器帮助我们加快工作进度并更早完成。

accent.example: She speaks English with a strong French accent.
accent.exampleZh: 她说英语带着浓重的法国口音。

accept.example: I accept your kind offer and thank you very much for it.
accept.exampleZh: 我接受你的好意，并为此非常感谢你。

acceptable.example: The food was simple but acceptable to everyone at the table.
acceptable.exampleZh: 饭菜虽然简单，但桌上的每个人都能接受。

access.example: Students can get access to the library computers after six in the evening.
access.exampleZh: 学生下午六点以后可以使用图书馆的电脑。

accessible.example: The library is accessible to everyone in our small town.
accessible.exampleZh: 这家图书馆对我们小镇上的每个人都是可进入的。

accident.example: I had a small accident on my bike yesterday, but I am fine.
accident.exampleZh: 我昨天骑自行车时出了个小意外，不过我没事。

accidental.example: The fire was accidental, not caused by anyone on purpose.
accidental.exampleZh: 这场火灾是意外发生的，不是任何人故意造成的。

accommodate.example: The new hall can accommodate up to five hundred people.
accommodate.exampleZh: 这个新大厅最多能容纳五百人。

accommodation.example: We found cheap accommodation near the station and stayed there for three nights.
accommodation.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近找到了便宜的住所，在那里住了三个晚上。

accompany.example: She asked me to accompany her to the doctor this afternoon.
accompany.exampleZh: 她让我今天下午陪她去看医生。

accomplish.example: She worked hard every day and finally accomplished her goal.
accomplish.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，最终实现了她的目标。

accord.example: They reached an accord after a long and friendly talk about the plan.
accord.exampleZh: 他们就这个计划进行了长时间友好交谈，最终达成了一致。

accordance.example: Everything was done in accordance with the rules of the school.
accordance.exampleZh: 所有事情都是按照学校的规章来做的。

accordingly.example: The plan was too expensive, so we changed it accordingly.
accordingly.exampleZh: 这个计划太贵了，因此我们相应地做了修改。

account.example: She gave a clear account of what happened at the meeting.
account.exampleZh: 她对会上发生的事情做了清楚的说明。

accountant.example: My mother is an accountant and she works with numbers every day.
accountant.exampleZh: 我妈妈是一名会计师，她每天都和数字打交道。

accumulate.example: Over the years, he accumulated a lot of old books in his small room.
accumulate.exampleZh: 多年来，他在自己的小房间里积累了很多旧书。

accuracy.example: The accuracy of this old map is not very good.
accuracy.exampleZh: 这张旧地图的准确度不太好。

accurate.example: Her report gives an accurate picture of what happened last week.
accurate.exampleZh: 她的报告准确地描述了上周发生的事情。

accuse.example: His boss accused him of taking money from the office.
accuse.exampleZh: 他的老板指控他从办公室拿钱。

accustomed.example: She is accustomed to walking to school every morning.
accustomed.exampleZh: 她习惯了每天早上步行去学校。

ache.example: I have a dull ache in my back after sitting all day.
ache.exampleZh: 坐了一整天后，我的背有一种隐隐的疼痛。

achieve.example: She worked hard every day to achieve her goal of becoming a doctor.
achieve.exampleZh: 她每天努力学习，以实现成为医生的目标。

achievement.example: Winning the science prize was a great achievement for our small school.
achievement.exampleZh: 赢得科学奖是我们这所小学校的一项巨大成就。

acid.example: The acid in the lemon makes the tea taste a little sour.
acid.exampleZh: 柠檬里的酸让茶尝起来有点酸。

acknowledge.example: She did not acknowledge my email, so I called her again.
acknowledge.exampleZh: 她没有确认收到我的邮件，所以我又给她打了电话。

acquaint.example: I will acquaint you with the new rules before Monday.
acquaint.exampleZh: 我会在周一之前让你熟悉新规则。

acquaintance.example: She is an old acquaintance of mine from our school days.
acquaintance.exampleZh: 她是我学生时代就认识的一位老熟人。

acquire.example: She worked hard to acquire new skills for her job.
acquire.exampleZh: 她努力工作，为自己的工作学习新技能。

acquisition.example: The acquisition of new skills takes time and a lot of practice.
acquisition.exampleZh: 新技能的习得需要时间和大量练习。

acre.example: The farmer grows corn on ten acres of land near the river.
acre.exampleZh: 这位农民在河边的十英亩土地上种玉米。

across.example: We walked across the bridge to the other side of the river.
across.exampleZh: 我们走过桥来到河的另一边。

act.example: We must act now before the problem gets worse.
act.exampleZh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前采取行动。

action.example: His quick action saved the child from the fire.
action.exampleZh: 他的迅速行动把孩子从火中救了出来。

active.example: She stays active by walking to work and playing tennis every weekend.
active.exampleZh: 她通过步行上班和每周末打网球来保持活跃。

activity.example: My favorite activity after school is playing basketball with my friends.
activity.exampleZh: 我放学后最喜欢的活动是和朋友们打篮球。

actor.example: The actor practiced his lines before the show began.
actor.exampleZh: 演出开始前，那位演员练习了他的台词。

actress.example: The actress in that new film is very famous around the world.
actress.exampleZh: 那部新电影里的女演员在全世界都很有名。

actual.example: The actual cost was much higher than the first estimate.
actual.exampleZh: 实际成本比最初的估算高得多。

adapt.example: It takes time to adapt to a new school and new friends.
adapt.exampleZh: 适应一所新学校和新的朋友需要时间。

adaptation.example: The film is a good adaptation of a famous old novel.
adaptation.exampleZh: 这部电影是一部著名旧小说的出色改编本。

add.example: Please add some milk to my coffee.
add.exampleZh: 请在我的咖啡里加一些牛奶。

addition.example: The addition of a new room made the house much bigger.
addition.exampleZh: 新增一个房间使房子大了很多。

additional.example: There is an additional charge if you want an extra bed.
additional.exampleZh: 如果你想要加一张床，就需要额外付费。

address.example: Please send the letter to my new address before Friday.
address.exampleZh: 请在周五前把信寄到我的新地址。

adequate.example: The room is adequate for two people but not for a whole family.
adequate.exampleZh: 这个房间住两个人足够，但住一大家子就不够了。

adhere.example: The tape will not adhere to a wet or dirty surface.
adhere.exampleZh: 胶带无法黏附在潮湿或脏的表面上。

adjacent.example: The hotel is adjacent to the train station, so it is easy to find.
adjacent.exampleZh: 这家酒店毗邻火车站，所以很容易找到。

adjective.example: In the sentence she is happy, the word happy is an adjective.
adjective.exampleZh: 在句子 she is happy 中，happy 这个词是形容词。

adjust.example: You can adjust the chair height to make your back feel better.
adjust.exampleZh: 你可以调节椅子的高度，让你的背部感觉更舒服。

adjustment.example: This small adjustment made the chair much more comfortable for my back.
adjustment.exampleZh: 这个小小的调整让椅子对我的背部舒服多了。

administration.example: The administration of the new policy was slow and confusing at first.
administration.exampleZh: 新政策的执行起初缓慢且令人困惑。

administrative.example: She has an administrative job in the city office.
administrative.exampleZh: 她在市政府办公室做一份行政工作。

admire.example: I really admire her for working so hard every day.
admire.exampleZh: 我真的很钦佩她每天都这么努力地工作。

admission.example: The museum charges a small admission fee for children under twelve.
admission.exampleZh: 博物馆对十二岁以下儿童收取少量入场费。

admit.example: He did not want to admit that he had made a mistake.
admit.exampleZh: 他不想承认自己犯了错误。

adopt.example: The company decided to adopt a new plan to save money and time.
adopt.exampleZh: 公司决定采用一项新计划来节省资金和时间。

adult.example: Every adult should take care of their own health and money.
adult.exampleZh: 每个成年人都应该照顾好自己的健康和金钱。

advance.example: The team made great advances in the project last year.
advance.exampleZh: 去年团队在这个项目上取得了很大进展。

advanced.example: This school uses advanced technology to help students learn faster.
advanced.exampleZh: 这所学校使用先进技术帮助学生更快地学习。

advantage.example: One big advantage of living here is that the bus stops right outside.
advantage.exampleZh: 住在这里的一大好处是公交车就停在门口。

adventure.example: Our trip to the mountains turned into a real adventure.
adventure.exampleZh: 我们的山间之行变成了一次真正的冒险。

adverb.example: An adverb can tell us how, when, or where something happens.
adverb.exampleZh: 副词可以告诉我们某事是如何、何时或在哪里发生的。

adverse.example: Too much sugar can have an adverse effect on your health.
adverse.exampleZh: 吃太多糖会对你的健康产生不利影响。

advertise.example: They advertise their new phones on TV every night.
advertise.exampleZh: 他们每天晚上在电视上为新手做广告。

advertisement.example: I saw an advertisement for a new phone on TV last night.
advertisement.exampleZh: 昨晚我在电视上看到了一则新手机的广告。

advice.example: My teacher gave me some good advice about how to study English.
advice.exampleZh: 我的老师给了我一些关于如何学英语的好建议。

advisable.example: It is advisable to book your tickets early.

advise.example: I advise you to leave early and take a warm coat.
advise.exampleZh: 我建议你早点出发，并带上一件暖和的外套。

adviser.example: My adviser helped me choose the right classes for next year.
adviser.exampleZh: 我的指导老师帮我挑选了明年的合适课程。

advocate.example: Many teachers advocate reading aloud every day to help students learn faster.
advocate.exampleZh: 许多老师提倡每天朗读，以帮助学生更快地学习。

aerial.example: The pilot took an aerial photo of the small town below.
aerial.exampleZh: 飞行员从空中拍下了下方小镇的照片。

aesthetic.example: The new library has a simple aesthetic design that students really like.
aesthetic.exampleZh: 新图书馆有一个学生们非常喜欢的简约美观设计。

affair.example: The whole affair was a simple mistake that anyone could make.
affair.exampleZh: 整件事不过是一个任何人都可能犯的简单错误。

affect.example: The weather can affect how people feel and what they do.
affect.exampleZh: 天气会影响人们的感受和他们的行为。

affection.example: Her affection for the old dog grew stronger every day.
affection.exampleZh: 她对那只老狗的感情一天比一天深。

affirm.example: She affirmed that the plan was safe and fair.
affirm.exampleZh: 她断言这个计划既安全又公平。

afford.example: We cannot afford a new car this year.

afraid.example: I am afraid of big dogs, so I stay away from them.
afraid.exampleZh: 我害怕大狗，所以我离它们远远的。

after.example: We went home after the movie ended and ate dinner together.
after.exampleZh: 电影结束后我们回家一起吃了晚饭。

afternoon.example: I usually drink a cup of tea in the afternoon.
afternoon.exampleZh: 我通常在下午喝一杯茶。

afterward.example: We ate dinner and afterward went for a walk in the park.
afterward.exampleZh: 我们吃完晚饭，随后去公园散了步。

again.example: Please say your name again so I can write it down.
again.exampleZh: 请再说一遍你的名字，这样我才能写下来。

against.example: Many people voted against the new plan because it seemed unfair.
against.exampleZh: 许多人投票反对这项新计划，因为它似乎不公平。

age.example: She started to learn the piano at the age of ten.

agency.example: She works for a small travel agency in the city center.
agency.exampleZh: 她在市中心一家小型旅行社工作。

agenda.example: The first item on our agenda is the new budget.
agenda.exampleZh: 我们议程上的第一项是新预算。

agent.example: The agent helped us buy the house quickly.
agent.exampleZh: 这位代理人帮我们很快买下了这所房子。

aggravate.example: Lack of sleep can aggravate your health problems.
aggravate.exampleZh: 睡眠不足会加重你的健康问题。

aggressive.example: The company made an aggressive move to win more customers this year.
aggressive.exampleZh: 这家公司今年采取了积极的举措来赢得更多客户。

agony.example: The old man was in agony after he fell and broke his leg.
agony.exampleZh: 那位老人摔倒摔断了腿，痛苦不堪。

agree.example: I agree with you on this plan.
agree.exampleZh: 我同意你对这个计划的看法。

agreeable.example: The weather was agreeable, so we took a long walk by the river.
agreeable.exampleZh: 天气宜人，所以我们沿着河边走了很久。

agreement.example: The two countries finally reached an agreement after weeks of talks.
agreement.exampleZh: 经过数周谈判，两国终于达成了一项协议。

agriculture.example: He studies agriculture because he wants to help farmers grow more food.
agriculture.exampleZh: 他学习农业，因为他想帮助农民种出更多粮食。

ahead.example: Look ahead and plan your work for next week.
ahead.exampleZh: 往前看，规划好你下周的工作。

aid.example: The nurse gave first aid to the boy after he fell down.
aid.exampleZh: 男孩摔倒后，护士对他进行了急救。

aim.example: Our new plan aims to help students learn English faster and with less stress.
aim.exampleZh: 我们的新计划旨在帮助学生更快、更轻松地学英语。

air.example: The air in the room feels fresh after we open the window.
air.exampleZh: 我们打开窗户后，房间里的空气感觉很清新。

aircraft.example: The aircraft landed safely after a long flight over the sea.
aircraft.exampleZh: 这架飞机在海上长途飞行后安全着陆。

airline.example: My father works for an airline and often flies to other countries.
airline.exampleZh: 我父亲在一家航空公司工作，经常飞往其他国家。

airport.example: I will meet my friend at the airport tomorrow morning.
airport.exampleZh: 我明天早上会去机场接我的朋友。

alarm.example: The loud alarm woke everyone up early this morning.
alarm.exampleZh: 响亮的警报声今天早上把大家都吵醒了。

album.example: I put all our holiday photos in a new album.
album.exampleZh: 我把我们所有的度假照片都放进了一本新相册。

alcohol.example: He never drinks alcohol because he wants to stay healthy and keep his mind clear.
alcohol.exampleZh: 他从不喝酒，因为他想保持健康、保持头脑清醒。

alert.example: The guard stayed alert all night and heard the alarm at once.
alert.exampleZh: 守卫整夜保持警觉，立刻听到了警报。

algebra.example: I find algebra difficult, but I enjoy solving the simple equations.
algebra.exampleZh: 我觉得代数很难，但我喜欢解简单的方程。

alien.example: The strange lights in the sky made everyone think an alien was coming.
alien.exampleZh: 天空中奇怪的光让所有人都以为有外星人来了。

alienate.example: His constant criticism began to alienate the people who cared about him.
alienate.exampleZh: 他不断的批评开始疏远那些关心他的人。

align.example: Please align the two tables so they look neat.
align.exampleZh: 请把两张桌子对齐，这样看起来更整齐。

alike.example: The two brothers look very much alike, and they even talk the same way.
alike.exampleZh: 这两兄弟长得很像，连说话方式也一样。

alive.example: The old tree is still alive after the long cold winter.
alive.exampleZh: 经过漫长的寒冬，那棵老树依然活着。

all.example: All my friends came to the party last night.
all.exampleZh: 昨晚我所有的朋友都来参加聚会了。

allege.example: The police allege that he stole money from the company.
allege.exampleZh: 警方指控他从公司偷了钱。

alleviate.example: The doctor gave him some medicine to alleviate the pain in his back.
alleviate.exampleZh: 医生给了他一些药，以减轻他背部的疼痛。

alliance.example: The two countries formed a strong alliance to protect each other.
alliance.exampleZh: 这两个国家结成了牢固的联盟以互相保护。

allocate.example: The school will allocate more money to buy new computers this year.
allocate.exampleZh: 学校今年将拨出更多资金购买新电脑。

allow.example: Please allow me to ask a quick question before we begin.
allow.exampleZh: 请允许我在开始之前问一个简单的问题。

allowance.example: My monthly allowance is small, so I save part of it.
allowance.exampleZh: 我每月的津贴不多，所以我存下一部分。

alloy.example: Steel is an alloy made from iron and a small amount of carbon.
alloy.exampleZh: 钢是由铁和少量碳制成的一种合金。

ally.example: The small country is a close ally of the United States.
ally.exampleZh: 这个小国是美国的亲密盟友。

almost.example: I almost missed the bus this morning because I woke up late.
almost.exampleZh: 今天早上我起晚了，差点没赶上公交车。

alone.example: She lives alone in a small house near the river.
alone.exampleZh: 她独自住在河边的一间小房子里。

along.example: We walked along the river and talked about our plans together.
along.exampleZh: 我们沿着河边散步，一起谈论我们的计划。

alongside.example: She parked her bike alongside the wall and walked into the shop.
alongside.exampleZh: 她把自行车停在墙边，然后走进了商店。

alphabet.example: Children learn the alphabet before they learn to read simple words.
alphabet.exampleZh: 孩子们在学习阅读简单单词之前先学习字母表。

already.example: She has already finished her homework and gone to bed.
already.exampleZh: 她已经做完作业，上床睡觉了。

also.example: She speaks French and she also speaks a little Spanish.
also.exampleZh: 她会说法语，也会说一点西班牙语。

alter.example: We had to alter our plans because of the heavy rain.
alter.exampleZh: 因为大雨，我们不得不改变计划。

alteration.example: The tailor made a small alteration to the length of my coat.
alteration.exampleZh: 裁缝对我的外套长度做了一处小改动。

alternative.example: We have no alternative, so we must leave early today.
alternative.exampleZh: 我们没有别的选择，所以今天必须早点离开。

although.example: Although it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
although.exampleZh: 虽然当时在下雨，我们还是出去散步了。

altitude.example: The plane flew at a high altitude above the mountains.
altitude.exampleZh: 飞机在群山之上以高海拔飞行。

altogether.example: I altogether forgot to bring my keys to the office today.
altogether.exampleZh: 我今天完全忘了把钥匙带到办公室。

aluminium.example: This light box is made of aluminium and is easy to carry.
aluminium.exampleZh: 这个轻便的盒子是用铝制成的，很容易携带。

always.example: My mother always tells me to eat breakfast before school.
always.exampleZh: 我妈妈总是叫我在上学前吃早饭。

amateur.example: He is just an amateur at chess, but he plays with great joy.
amateur.exampleZh: 他只是个国际象棋业余爱好者，但他下得很开心。

amaze.example: The young boy's magic tricks always amaze everyone in the room.
amaze.exampleZh: 那个小男孩的魔术总是让房间里的每个人大为惊奇。

ambassador.example: The ambassador met the president to talk about peace.
ambassador.exampleZh: 大使会见了总统，讨论和平问题。

ambiguous.example: The teacher's answer was ambiguous, so none of us understood what to do next.
ambiguous.exampleZh: 老师的回答含糊不清，所以我们谁也没明白接下来该做什么。

ambition.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help poor children.
ambition.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助贫困儿童。

ambitious.example: She is ambitious and wants to become a doctor one day.
ambitious.exampleZh: 她很有抱负，希望有一天成为一名医生。

ambulance.example: We called an ambulance after the old man fell down on the street.
ambulance.exampleZh: 那位老人在街上摔倒后，我们叫了一辆救护车。

amend.example: The team will amend the plan after the meeting today.
amend.exampleZh: 团队会在今天的会议后修改这个计划。

amendment.example: The new amendment gives workers more time to rest each week.
amendment.exampleZh: 这项新修正案给工人每周更多的休息时间。

amid.example: She smiled amid the noise and confusion of the busy market.
amid.exampleZh: 在繁忙市场的喧闹与混乱之中，她微笑着。

among.example: She found her keys among the papers on the desk.
among.exampleZh: 她在桌上的文件中间找到了她的钥匙。

amount.example: The amount of water in the bottle is very small.

amplify.example: Please amplify the sound so everyone in the room can hear it.
amplify.exampleZh: 请把声音放大，让房间里的每个人都能听见。

amuse.example: The funny clown tried to amuse the children at the birthday party.
amuse.exampleZh: 那个滑稽的小丑在生日聚会上努力逗孩子们开心。

analogy.example: Teachers often use an analogy to explain hard ideas to students.
analogy.exampleZh: 老师常用类比向学生解释难懂的概念。

analyse.example: Scientists analyse the data carefully before they write their final report.
analyse.exampleZh: 科学家在撰写最终报告前会仔细分析数据。

analysis.example: Our teacher asked us to write a short analysis of the story.
analysis.exampleZh: 老师让我们写一篇简短的故事分析。

analyst.example: The analyst studied the sales figures carefully before the meeting.
analyst.exampleZh: 分析师在会议前仔细研究了销售数据。

analytical.example: She has an analytical mind and solves problems quickly.
analytical.exampleZh: 她有一个善于分析的头脑，能很快解决问题。

ancestor.example: My ancestors came from a small village in the south of China.
ancestor.exampleZh: 我的祖先来自中国南方的一个小村庄。

anchor.example: The news anchor stayed calm and steady while reporting the storm.
anchor.exampleZh: 这位新闻主播在报道风暴时保持冷静和沉稳。

ancient.example: This ancient tree is older than our whole town.
ancient.exampleZh: 这棵古老的树比我们整个小镇还要老。

and.example: Tom and Lily like to read books after school.
and.exampleZh: 汤姆和莉莉喜欢放学后读书。

anecdote.example: My grandmother told us a funny anecdote about her first day at school.
anecdote.exampleZh: 我祖母给我们讲了一个关于她第一天上学时的有趣轶事。

angle.example: From this angle, the tall building looks much smaller than before.
angle.exampleZh: 从这个角度看，这栋高楼看起来比以前小多了。

angry.example: My father was very angry when I broke the window yesterday.
angry.exampleZh: 昨天我打破窗户时，我父亲非常生气。

animal.example: The zoo has many kinds of animals, and my favorite animal is the panda.
animal.exampleZh: 动物园里有许多种动物，我最喜欢的动物是熊猫。

ankle.example: I hurt my ankle while playing basketball last weekend.
ankle.exampleZh: 上周末我打篮球时伤了脚踝。

anniversary.example: We had a small party for our parents' fiftieth wedding anniversary last week.
anniversary.exampleZh: 上周我们为父母的金婚纪念日办了一个小型聚会。

announce.example: The school will announce the names of the winners tomorrow morning.
announce.exampleZh: 学校将于明天上午宣布获奖者的名字。

announcement.example: The school made an announcement about the new class schedule.
announcement.exampleZh: 学校发布了一则关于新课程安排的通告。

annoy.example: Please don't make that noise, because it will annoy your sister.
annoy.exampleZh: 请不要发出那种噪音，因为那会惹你妹妹生气。

annual.example: The school holds an annual sports meeting every spring.
annual.exampleZh: 学校每年春天举办一次年度运动会。

another.example: I don't like this one, so please give me another.
another.exampleZh: 我不喜欢这一个，请再给我一个。

answer.example: Please answer my question before you leave the room.
answer.exampleZh: 请在离开房间之前回答我的问题。

anticipate.example: We anticipate a busy week at work after the holiday.
anticipate.exampleZh: 我们预料假期过后工作会忙碌一周。

antique.example: She bought an antique wooden chair at the small shop near her home.
antique.exampleZh: 她在家附近的小店里买了一把古老的木椅。

anxiety.example: She felt a lot of anxiety before her first job interview.
anxiety.exampleZh: 第一次工作面试前，她感到非常焦虑。

anxious.example: She felt anxious about the exam and could not sleep well.
anxious.exampleZh: 她对考试感到焦虑，睡不好觉。

any.example: Do you have any questions about the lesson today?
any.exampleZh: 关于今天的课你有什么问题吗？

anybody.example: Anybody can learn to cook simple meals with a little practice.
anybody.exampleZh: 任何人只要稍加练习都能学会做简单的饭菜。

anyhow.example: It was raining, but anyhow we decided to go for a walk.
anyhow.exampleZh: 当时在下雨，但不管怎样我们还是决定出去散步。

anyone.example: Anyone can join the club if they pay the small fee.
anyone.exampleZh: 只要交一点小费用，任何人都可以加入这个俱乐部。

anything.example: You can buy anything you need at the small shop near my house.
anything.exampleZh: 你可以在我家附近的小商店买到任何你需要的东西。

anyway.example: I was tired, but I went to the party anyway.
anyway.exampleZh: 我虽然累了，但还是去了派对。

anywhere.example: You can sit anywhere you like in this big room.
anywhere.exampleZh: 在这个大房间里，你想坐哪儿都可以。

apart.example: The two houses are far apart, so we seldom visit each other.
apart.exampleZh: 这两栋房子相隔很远，所以我们很少互相拜访。

apartment.example: My apartment is small but very clean and close to the subway.
apartment.exampleZh: 我的公寓很小，但非常干净，而且离地铁很近。

apologize.example: You should apologize to her for being late yesterday.
apologize.exampleZh: 你应该为昨天迟到向她道歉。

apology.example: He said sorry to his friend and gave a sincere apology for being late.
apology.exampleZh: 他向朋友说了对不起，并为迟到真诚地道了歉。

apparatus.example: The doctor cleaned the apparatus before using it on the next patient.
apparatus.exampleZh: 医生在给下一位病人使用前清洁了这台器械。

apparent.example: It was apparent that the little boy was very tired.
apparent.exampleZh: 很明显，这个小男孩非常累了。

apparently.example: She was apparently very tired after the long trip.
apparently.exampleZh: 经过这趟长途旅行，她显然非常疲惫。

appeal.example: The charity made an appeal for money to help the poor children.
appeal.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构呼吁人们捐款帮助贫困儿童。

appear.example: A strange light appeared in the sky late last night.
appear.exampleZh: 昨晚深夜，天空中显现出一道奇怪的光。

appearance.example: His sudden appearance at the party surprised everyone in the room.
appearance.exampleZh: 他突然出现在聚会上，让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

appetite.example: The fresh bread smell gave me a big appetite for lunch.
appetite.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味让我午饭时胃口大开。

applaud.example: The students stood up to applaud the teacher after her wonderful speech.
applaud.exampleZh: 老师精彩的演讲结束后，学生们站起来为她鼓掌。

appliance.example: Our kitchen has many useful appliances, such as a fridge and a microwave.
appliance.exampleZh: 我们的厨房里有许多实用的器具，比如冰箱和微波炉。

applicable.example: This rule is not applicable to students who study at home.
applicable.exampleZh: 这条规则不适用于在家学习的学生。

applicant.example: The applicant waited outside the office for his job interview.
applicant.exampleZh: 这位求职者在办公室外等待他的面试。

application.example: You can send your application to the office before Friday.
application.exampleZh: 你可以在星期五之前把申请书寄到办公室。

apply.example: She wants to apply for a new job in another city.
apply.exampleZh: 她想在另一个城市申请一份新工作。

appoint.example: The manager will appoint a new team leader next week.
appoint.exampleZh: 经理下周将任命一位新的团队负责人。

appointment.example: I have a doctor's appointment at three o'clock this afternoon.
appointment.exampleZh: 我今天下午三点有一个医生的预约。

appraisal.example: The manager gave a fair appraisal of the new employee's work after three months.
appraisal.exampleZh: 经理在三个月后对新员工的工作做出了公正的评价。

appreciate.example: I really appreciate all the help you gave me yesterday.
appreciate.exampleZh: 我真的很感激你昨天给我的所有帮助。

approach.example: As we approach the station, the train slows down.
approach.exampleZh: 当我们接近车站时，火车减速了。

appropriate.example: It is not appropriate to wear shorts to a formal meeting.
appropriate.exampleZh: 穿短裤参加正式会议是不合适的。

approval.example: The manager gave his approval to the new plan yesterday.
approval.exampleZh: 经理昨天对新计划表示了同意。

approve.example: My parents approve of my plan to study English in London.
approve.exampleZh: 我父母赞成的我去伦敦学英语的计划。

approximate.example: The approximate cost of the trip is about two hundred dollars.
approximate.exampleZh: 这次旅行的大约费用是两百美元左右。

approximately.example: The trip takes approximately two hours by train from here.
approximately.exampleZh: 从这里坐火车大约需要两个小时。

apron.example: My mother wears an apron when she cooks dinner in the kitchen.
apron.exampleZh: 我妈妈在厨房做晚饭时会系着围裙。

arbitrary.example: The teacher made an arbitrary decision without asking the students first.
arbitrary.exampleZh: 老师没有先问学生就做出了一个武断的决定。

architect.example: My uncle is a famous architect who designs tall buildings and bridges.
architect.exampleZh: 我叔叔是一位著名的建筑师，专门设计高楼和桥梁。

architecture.example: The old university is famous for its beautiful architecture and quiet gardens.
architecture.exampleZh: 这所古老的大学以其美丽的建筑和宁静的花园而闻名。

arctic.example: They wore thick coats because the arctic wind was very cold.
arctic.exampleZh: 他们穿上厚外套，因为北极的寒风非常冷。

area.example: The area of this room is about twenty square meters.
area.exampleZh: 这个房间的面积大约是二十平方米。

argue.example: They often argue about small things, but they are still good friends.
argue.exampleZh: 他们常为小事争论，但仍然是好朋友。

argument.example: They had a long argument about where to spend the holiday.
argument.exampleZh: 他们为去哪里度假争论了很久。

arise.example: Many problems arise when people do not talk to each other.
arise.exampleZh: 当人们彼此不交流时，许多问题就会出现。

arithmetic.example: My son learns basic arithmetic at school every morning.
arithmetic.exampleZh: 我儿子每天早上在学校学习基础算术。

arm.example: He put his arm around her and told her not to worry.
arm.exampleZh: 他搂住她的手臂，告诉她不要担心。

army.example: My brother joined the army after he finished school last year.
army.exampleZh: 我哥哥去年完成学业后参了军。

around.example: The children sat around the table and shared a big cake.
around.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在桌子旁，分享着一个大蛋糕。

arouse.example: The loud noise aroused the sleeping baby and made her cry.
arouse.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音惊醒了熟睡的婴儿，让她哭了起来。

arrange.example: She will arrange the chairs and tables before the party starts.
arrange.exampleZh: 她会在派对开始前把桌椅摆放好。

arrangement.example: We made an arrangement to meet at the library after school.
arrangement.exampleZh: 我们约定放学后在图书馆见面。

arrest.example: The police arrested the man near the bank and took him away.
arrest.exampleZh: 警察在银行附近逮捕了那名男子并把他带走了。

arrival.example: Her arrival at the airport made everyone very happy.
arrival.exampleZh: 她到达机场让每个人都很高兴。

arrive.example: We arrived at the station early and waited for the train.
arrive.exampleZh: 我们很早就到达了车站，然后等火车。

arrogant.example: He is so arrogant that he never listens to anyone else.
arrogant.exampleZh: 他非常傲慢，从不听别人的话。

arrow.example: The arrow flew straight across the field and hit the target.
arrow.exampleZh: 那支箭笔直地飞过田野，射中了靶子。

art.example: She studies art at school and loves to draw every day.
art.exampleZh: 她在学校学习美术，每天都喜欢画画。

article.example: I read an interesting article about healthy food in the newspaper.
article.exampleZh: 我在报纸上读了一篇关于健康食品的有趣文章。

artificial.example: This juice has no artificial sugar, so it tastes fresh and natural.
artificial.exampleZh: 这种果汁没有添加人造糖，所以尝起来清新自然。

artist.example: The artist painted a beautiful picture of the sea.
artist.exampleZh: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的大海图画。

artistic.example: She has an artistic mind and loves to draw colorful pictures every day.
artistic.exampleZh: 她有艺术头脑，喜欢每天画彩色的画。

ashamed.example: She felt ashamed after she lied to her best friend.
ashamed.exampleZh: 她对最好的朋友撒谎后感到很惭愧。

aside.example: She stepped aside to let the old man pass.
aside.exampleZh: 她退到一边，让那位老人过去。

ask.example: You can ask your teacher for help after class.
ask.exampleZh: 你可以在课后向老师寻求帮助。

asleep.example: The little boy fell asleep on the sofa while watching his favorite cartoon.
asleep.exampleZh: 小男孩在看最喜欢的动画片时在沙发上睡着了。

aspect.example: We must consider every aspect of the problem before making a decision.
aspect.exampleZh: 在做决定之前，我们必须考虑这个问题的每一个方面。

aspiration.example: Her aspiration is to become a doctor and help people in poor villages.
aspiration.exampleZh: 她的志向是成为一名医生，帮助贫困村庄里的人们。

assemble.example: The students assemble in the hall every Monday morning.
assemble.exampleZh: 学生们每周一早上在礼堂集合。

assembly.example: The workers finished the assembly of the new machine before noon.
assembly.exampleZh: 工人们在中午前完成了新机器的装配。

assess.example: Teachers assess students' reading skills at the start of each term.
assess.exampleZh: 老师在每学期开始时评估学生的阅读能力。

assessment.example: The teacher gave a fair assessment of every student's work this term.
assessment.exampleZh: 老师对本学期每个学生的作业给出了公正的评价。

asset.example: Her ability to speak three languages is a great asset to the company.
asset.exampleZh: 她会说三种语言的能力是公司的一大财富。

assign.example: The teacher will assign a new task to each student tomorrow.
assign.exampleZh: 老师明天将给每个学生分配一项新任务。

assignment.example: Our teacher gave us a short writing assignment for the weekend.
assignment.exampleZh: 老师给我们布置了一个简短的周末写作作业。

assist.example: Two nurses helped to assist the old man with his bags.
assist.exampleZh: 两名护士帮忙协助这位老人拿行李。

assistance.example: She asked her teacher for assistance with the difficult homework.
assistance.exampleZh: 她向老师寻求帮助来完成这份困难的作业。

assistant.example: She works as an assistant to the manager in a busy office.
assistant.exampleZh: 她在一个繁忙的办公室里担任经理的助理。

associate.example: People often associate the smell of rain with happy childhood memories.
associate.exampleZh: 人们常把雨的气味与快乐的童年回忆联系在一起。

association.example: She is a member of the local art association.
association.exampleZh: 她是当地艺术协会的一名会员。

assume.example: I assume you will come to the meeting tomorrow morning.
assume.exampleZh: 我假定你明天上午会来参加会议。

assumption.example: We made a wrong assumption about the price of the tickets.
assumption.exampleZh: 我们对票价做出了错误的假设。

assurance.example: She gave me her assurance that the work would be finished on time.
assurance.exampleZh: 她向我保证这项工作会按时完成。

assure.example: I assure you that the work will be finished before Friday.
assure.exampleZh: 我向你保证，这项工作会在周五之前完成。

astonish.example: The magician's final trick astonished everyone in the room.
astonish.exampleZh: 魔术师最后的一个戏法让房间里的每个人都大为惊讶。

astronaut.example: The astronaut waved to us before he got into the spaceship.
astronaut.exampleZh: 那名宇航员在进入飞船前向我们挥手。

astronomy.example: She studies astronomy at a small university near her home town.
astronomy.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所小型大学学习天文学。

at.example: We will meet at the station at nine tomorrow morning.
at.exampleZh: 我们明天早上九点在车站见面。

athlete.example: The athlete runs very fast and wins the race every year.
athlete.exampleZh: 这位运动员跑得很快，每年都赢得这场比赛。

atmosphere.example: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
atmosphere.exampleZh: 这家餐厅有着温暖友好的氛围。

atom.example: An atom is the smallest part of a chemical element.
atom.exampleZh: 原子是化学元素中最小的组成部分。

atomic.example: The atomic bomb is one of the most powerful weapons in the world.
atomic.exampleZh: 原子弹是世界上最强大的武器之一。

attach.example: Please attach this file to the email before you send it.
attach.exampleZh: 请在发送这封邮件之前把这个文件附上。

attack.example: The dog may attack strangers, so please keep the gate closed.
attack.exampleZh: 那只狗可能会攻击陌生人，所以请把大门关好。

attain.example: She worked hard for years to attain her goal of becoming a doctor.
attain.exampleZh: 她努力多年，实现了成为医生的目标。

attempt.example: He made an attempt to fix the old bike himself.
attempt.exampleZh: 他自己尝试修理那辆旧自行车。

attend.example: She will attend the meeting tomorrow morning and then attend to her sick mother.
attend.exampleZh: 她明天上午将出席会议，然后照料她生病的母亲。

attendance.example: Her attendance at every meeting showed how much she cared about the team.
attendance.exampleZh: 她每次都出席会议，说明她很在乎这个团队。

attention.example: Please pay attention to the teacher during the lesson.
attention.exampleZh: 上课时请注意听老师讲课。

attitude.example: Her positive attitude helps her make friends at the new school.
attitude.exampleZh: 她积极的态度帮助她在新学校交到朋友。

attorney.example: The attorney asked the judge for more time to prepare the case.
attorney.exampleZh: 律师请求法官给予更多时间准备案件。

attract.example: The bright colors in the shop window attracted the attention of many children.
attract.exampleZh: 商店橱窗里鲜艳的颜色吸引了许多孩子的注意。

attraction.example: The old castle is a popular attraction for visitors from many countries.
attraction.exampleZh: 这座古堡是吸引许多国家游客的热门景点。

attractive.example: The garden looks very attractive in spring with all its colorful flowers.
attractive.exampleZh: 春天里，花园开满五颜六色的花，看起来非常迷人。

attribute.example: She attributes her success to hard work and a little luck.
attribute.exampleZh: 她把她的成功归因于努力工作和一点运气。

audience.example: The audience clapped loudly after the singer finished her last song.
audience.exampleZh: 歌手唱完最后一首歌后，观众热烈鼓掌。

audio.example: The audio on my new laptop sounds very clear and loud.
audio.exampleZh: 我新笔记本电脑的音频听起来非常清晰响亮。

august.example: My birthday is in August, so we often have a party then.
august.exampleZh: 我的生日在八月，所以我们常常那时候办个聚会。

aunt.example: My aunt lives in a small house near the river.
aunt.exampleZh: 我的姑母住在河边的一所小房子里。

author.example: The author wrote a short book about his life in the countryside.
author.exampleZh: 这位作家写了一本关于他在乡下生活的短书。

authority.example: The local authority is responsible for keeping the city streets clean and safe.
authority.exampleZh: 地方当局负责保持城市街道的清洁和安全。

authorize.example: The manager can authorize small payments without asking the head office.
authorize.exampleZh: 经理可以授权小额付款，无需请示总部。

auto.example: My father drives his auto to work every morning.
auto.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的汽车上班。

automatic.example: The door is automatic, so it opens when you walk near it.
automatic.exampleZh: 这扇门是自动的，所以你走近时它就会打开。

automobile.example: My father drives his automobile to work every morning.
automobile.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的汽车去上班。

autonomy.example: The small island has enjoyed local autonomy for many years.
autonomy.exampleZh: 这个小岛多年来一直享有地方自治权。

autumn.example: The leaves turn red and gold in autumn.
autumn.exampleZh: 秋天，树叶变成红色和金色。

available.example: The book is not available in our school library right now.
available.exampleZh: 这本书目前在我们学校图书馆里借不到。

avenue.example: We walked down a quiet avenue lined with tall trees.
avenue.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条两旁高树成行的安静林荫道散步。

average.example: The average of my three test scores is eighty-five this term.
average.exampleZh: 我这学期三次考试的平均分是八十五分。

avoid.example: You should avoid eating too much sugar if you want to stay healthy.
avoid.exampleZh: 如果你想保持健康，就应该避免吃太多糖。

await.example: We await your reply and hope to hear from you soon.
await.exampleZh: 我们等候您的回复，希望很快收到您的消息。

awake.example: She was still awake when the storm woke everyone else in the house.
awake.exampleZh: 暴风雨把屋里的其他人都吵醒时，她仍然醒着。

award.example: The school gave her an award for her hard work last year.
award.exampleZh: 学校去年因为她努力学习而授予她一个奖项。

aware.example: I was not aware of the new rule until yesterday.
aware.exampleZh: 直到昨天我才知道这条新规定。

awareness.example: Good health awareness helps people choose better food and exercise every day.
awareness.exampleZh: 良好的健康意识有助于人们每天选择更好的食物和进行锻炼。

away.example: She walked away from the noisy crowd and sat down quietly.
away.exampleZh: 她离开喧闹的人群，安静地坐了下来。

awful.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed home all day.
awful.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

awkward.example: There was an awkward silence after he asked the wrong question.
awkward.exampleZh: 他问错问题后，出现了尴尬的沉默。

baby.example: The baby is sleeping quietly in the small bed.
baby.exampleZh: 婴儿正在小床上安静地睡觉。

bachelor.example: My uncle is a happy bachelor who lives alone with his dog.
bachelor.exampleZh: 我的叔叔是个快乐的单身汉，和他的狗独自生活。

back.example: Please put the book back on the shelf after you read it.
back.exampleZh: 读完后请把书放回书架上。

background.example: Her family background helped her get the job at the bank.
background.exampleZh: 她的家庭背景帮助她得到了银行的工作。

backward.example: He took a step backward when he saw the snake.
backward.exampleZh: 他看到那条蛇时向后退了一步。

bacon.example: My father likes to eat bacon and eggs for breakfast every morning.
bacon.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢每天早上吃咸肉和鸡蛋。

bacteria.example: Some bacteria can make people sick, but many are helpful to us.
bacteria.exampleZh: 有些细菌会让人生病，但许多细菌对我们是有益的。

bad.example: He ate some bad food and felt sick all night.
bad.exampleZh: 他吃了一些坏掉的食物，整晚都觉得不舒服。

badly.example: He did badly on the test and felt very sad.
badly.exampleZh: 他这次考试考得很差，感到非常难过。

badminton.example: My sister and I play badminton in the park every Sunday morning.
badminton.exampleZh: 我和妹妹每周日早上都在公园里打羽毛球。

bag.example: She put her books and pens into a big blue bag.
bag.exampleZh: 她把书和笔放进了一个蓝色的大袋子里。

baggage.example: She carried a lot of baggage with her when she moved to a new city.
baggage.exampleZh: 她搬到一个新城市时带了很多行李。

bake.example: My mother likes to bake bread and cakes on Sunday mornings.
bake.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在周日早上烘烤面包和蛋糕。

balance.example: She tries to balance her work and family life every day.
balance.exampleZh: 她每天都努力平衡工作与家庭生活。

balcony.example: We had breakfast on the balcony and watched the sun rise.
balcony.exampleZh: 我们在阳台上吃早餐，看着太阳升起。

ball.example: The children played with a red ball in the park all afternoon.
ball.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在公园里玩一个红色的球。

balloon.example: The red balloon floated high into the blue sky.
balloon.exampleZh: 那个红色的气球高高飘向蓝天。

ballot.example: The workers will use a secret ballot to choose their new leader.
ballot.exampleZh: 工人们将用无记名投票选出他们的新领导。

ban.example: The school bans students from using phones during class.
ban.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

band.example: The band played loud music at the school party last night.
band.exampleZh: 乐队昨晚在学校的聚会上演奏了很响亮的音乐。

bandage.example: The nurse put a clean bandage on the boy's knee.
bandage.exampleZh: 护士在男孩的膝盖上包了一块干净的绷带。

bang.example: The door closed with a loud bang and woke the baby.
bang.exampleZh: 门砰的一声关上，把宝宝吵醒了。

bank.example: I need to go to the bank to get some money.
bank.exampleZh: 我需要去银行取一些钱。

bankrupt.example: The company went bankrupt after a few bad years.
bankrupt.exampleZh: 这家公司经过几年糟糕的经营后破产了。

banner.example: The students made a big banner for the school sports day.
banner.exampleZh: 学生们为学校运动会制作了一面大横幅。

bar.example: The new rule may bar visitors from bringing drinks into the hotel bar.
bar.exampleZh: 新规定可能禁止访客把饮料带进酒店酒吧。

barber.example: The barber cut my hair short before the summer holiday started.
barber.exampleZh: 理发师在暑假开始前把我的头发剪短了。

bare.example: His bare feet made no sound on the cold floor.
bare.exampleZh: 他光着的脚踩在冰冷的地板上，没有发出一点声音。

barely.example: I could barely hear him over the noise.
barely.exampleZh: 在噪音中我几乎听不见他说话。

bargain.example: This coat was a real bargain at half price.
bargain.exampleZh: 这件外套半价买下，真是便宜货。

bark.example: The dog began to bark loudly at the stranger near our gate.
bark.exampleZh: 狗开始对着我们家门口附近的陌生人大声吠叫。

barn.example: The farmer keeps his cows and horses in the old red barn.
barn.exampleZh: 农夫把他的牛和马养在那座古老的红色谷仓里。

barrel.example: He filled the barrel with fresh water from the well.
barrel.exampleZh: 他从井里打来清水，把桶装满了。

barrier.example: Language can be a barrier when two people do not share the same words.
barrier.exampleZh: 当两个人不使用相同的语言时，语言可能成为障碍。

base.example: This small town is a good base for mountain trips.
base.exampleZh: 这座小镇是山区旅行的好基地。

basic.example: Food and water are basic needs for every person.
basic.exampleZh: 食物和水是每个人基本的需求。

basically.example: Basically, the plan is simple and everyone can understand it.
basically.exampleZh: 基本上，这个计划很简单，每个人都能理解。

basin.example: The river flows through a wide basin before it reaches the sea.
basin.exampleZh: 这条河流经一个宽阔的盆地，然后流入大海。

basis.example: Trust is the basis of every good friendship.
basis.exampleZh: 信任是每一段良好友谊的基础。

basket.example: She put the fresh apples into a small basket.
basket.exampleZh: 她把新鲜的苹果放进一个小篮子里。

basketball.example: My brother plays basketball with his friends after school on Fridays.
basketball.exampleZh: 我弟弟每周五放学后和朋友们打篮球。

bat.example: The boy hit the ball hard with his new bat.
bat.exampleZh: 那个男孩用他的新球棒用力击球。

bath.example: I take a warm bath every night before I go to bed.
bath.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会洗个热水澡。

bathe.example: She likes to bathe the baby in warm water every evening.
bathe.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天晚上用温水给宝宝洗澡。

bathroom.example: There is a small bathroom next to my bedroom.
bathroom.exampleZh: 我的卧室旁边有一个小浴室。

battery.example: My phone battery dies quickly when I play games.
battery.exampleZh: 我玩游戏时手机电池耗电很快。

battle.example: The soldiers fought a long battle for their country and won.
battle.exampleZh: 士兵们为他们的国家打了一场漫长的战役并取得了胜利。

bay.example: We parked the car near the bay and watched the small boats.
bay.exampleZh: 我们把车停在海湾附近，看着那些小船。

be.example: I want to be a good teacher in the future.
be.exampleZh: 我将来想成为一名好老师。

beach.example: We walk on the beach and watch the sun go down.
beach.exampleZh: 我们在海滩上散步，看着太阳落下。

beam.example: The lamp broke, and a beam of light hit the wall.
beam.exampleZh: 灯坏了，一道光束照在墙上。

bean.example: My mother puts red beans in the soup and cooks them slowly.
bean.exampleZh: 我妈妈把红豆放进汤里，慢慢煮。

bear.example: I cannot bear the loud noise from the street every night.
bear.exampleZh: 我无法忍受每天晚上街上传来的吵闹声。

beard.example: He has a long white beard and looks like a kind old man.
beard.exampleZh: 他留着长长的白胡须，看起来像一位和善的老人。

beast.example: The beast in the dark forest scared all the children away.
beast.exampleZh: 黑森林里的野兽把所有孩子都吓跑了。

beat.example: Our team beat the stronger side by two goals last night.
beat.exampleZh: 我们队昨晚以两球击败了更强的对手。

beautiful.example: The garden looks very beautiful in spring when all the flowers open.
beautiful.exampleZh: 春天所有花都开放时，这个花园看起来非常美丽。

beauty.example: The beauty of the lake surprised us on that quiet morning.
beauty.exampleZh: 那个安静的早晨，湖边的美景让我们感到惊喜。

because.example: I stayed at home because it was raining all day.
because.exampleZh: 我待在家里，因为一整天都在下雨。

become.example: She wants to become a doctor after she finishes school.
become.exampleZh: 她希望完成学业后成为一名医生。

bed.example: My cat likes to sleep on my bed every afternoon.
bed.exampleZh: 我的猫每天下午都喜欢睡在我的床上。

bedroom.example: My bedroom is small but very clean and bright.
bedroom.exampleZh: 我的卧室很小，但非常干净明亮。

bee.example: The bee is busy flying from flower to flower all day.
bee.exampleZh: 这只蜜蜂整天忙着在花丛间飞来飞去。

beef.example: My mother cooks beef with potatoes for dinner every Sunday.
beef.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚餐都用土豆炖牛肉。

beer.example: My father likes to drink a cold beer after work on Fridays.
beer.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在周五下班后喝一杯冰啤酒。

before.example: Please call me before you leave for the airport tomorrow morning.
before.exampleZh: 你明天早上出发去机场之前，请给我打个电话。

beg.example: The poor man had to beg for food on the street every day.
beg.exampleZh: 那个可怜的男人每天不得不在街上乞讨食物。

begin.example: Let's begin the meeting when everyone is here.
begin.exampleZh: 等大家都到了，我们就开始开会。

beginning.example: The beginning of the story is a little slow.

behalf.example: She spoke on behalf of the whole team at the meeting.
behalf.exampleZh: 她在会上代表整个团队发言。

behave.example: Please behave yourself at the dinner table tonight.
behave.exampleZh: 今晚在餐桌上请你自己检点一点。

behavior.example: His behavior in class was good today, so the teacher praised him.
behavior.exampleZh: 他今天在课堂上的表现很好，所以老师表扬了他。

behind.example: The little boy hid behind the tall tree and waited for his friends.
behind.exampleZh: 那个小男孩躲在高树后面等他的朋友们。

being.example: Every living being needs clean water, fresh air, and a safe place to live.
being.exampleZh: 每一个生物都需要干净的水、新鲜的空气和一个安全的栖身之所。

belief.example: Her belief in herself helped her finish the difficult exam.
belief.exampleZh: 她对自己的信念帮助她完成了这场艰难的考试。

believe.example: I believe he is a good teacher and he helps us a lot.
believe.exampleZh: 我相信他是个好老师，他帮了我们很多。

bell.example: The school bell rings and all the children run to their classrooms.
bell.exampleZh: 学校的铃声响了，所有孩子都跑向教室。

belong.example: These books belong to the school library, not to me.
belong.exampleZh: 这些书属于学校图书馆，不是我的。

beloved.example: She is a beloved teacher who has helped many students over the years.
beloved.exampleZh: 她是一位深受爱戴的老师，多年来帮助过许多学生。

below.example: The temperature dropped below zero last night.
below.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到了零度以下。

belt.example: He wore a brown leather belt with his dark blue trousers.
belt.exampleZh: 他穿着深蓝色裤子，系着一条棕色皮带。

bench.example: The old man sat on a wooden bench in the park.
bench.exampleZh: 那位老人坐在公园里的木制长椅上。

bend.example: The old road will bend to the left after the bridge.
bend.exampleZh: 那座桥过后，这条老路会向左弯曲。

beneath.example: The cat is hiding beneath the table.

beneficial.example: Regular exercise is very beneficial to both your body and your mind.
beneficial.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的身体和心理都非常有益。

benefit.example: Regular exercise can bring great benefits to both your body and your mind.
benefit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的身体和心理都有很大益处。

bent.example: He is bent on finishing the project before Friday.
bent.exampleZh: 他决心在星期五之前完成这个项目。

beside.example: She sat beside me on the bench and read a book.
beside.exampleZh: 她坐在我旁边的长椅上读着一本书。

besides.example: Besides English, she also teaches French and German at our school.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还在我们学校教法语和德语。

best.example: This is the best book I have ever read.
best.exampleZh: 这是我读过的最好的书。

bet.example: I bet he will win the game tomorrow.
bet.exampleZh: 我敢说他明天会赢这场比赛。

betray.example: I will never betray my friends, even when things get hard.
betray.exampleZh: 即使事情变得艰难，我也绝不会背叛我的朋友。

better.example: Practice every day and your English will get better soon.
better.exampleZh: 每天练习，你的英语很快就会变得更好。

between.example: The small shop is between the bank and the post office.
between.exampleZh: 那家小店在银行和邮局之间。

beyond.example: The small village lies beyond those green hills and a wide river.
beyond.exampleZh: 那个小村庄位于那些青山和一条宽阔河流的另一边。

bible.example: The old bible on the shelf was a gift from my grandmother.
bible.exampleZh: 书架上的那本旧《圣经》是我祖母送的礼物。

bicycle.example: My father rides his bicycle to work every morning.
bicycle.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上骑自行车去上班。

bid.example: She bid ten dollars for the old painting at the auction.
bid.exampleZh: 她在拍卖会上为那幅旧画出价十美元。

big.example: This big box is too heavy for me to carry.
big.exampleZh: 这个大箱子太重了，我搬不动。

bike.example: I ride my bike to school every morning.
bike.exampleZh: 我每天早上骑自行车去学校。

bill.example: The waiter brought the bill after we finished dinner at the small restaurant.
bill.exampleZh: 我们在这家小餐馆吃完晚饭后，服务员拿来了账单。

billion.example: The company is worth more than one billion dollars today.
billion.exampleZh: 这家公司如今价值超过十亿美元。

bin.example: Please put the empty bottles in the bin near the door.
bin.exampleZh: 请把空瓶子放进门边的垃圾箱里。

bind.example: They bind the old newspapers together with a strong rope.
bind.exampleZh: 他们用一根结实的绳子把旧报纸捆在一起。

biology.example: She wants to study biology because she loves learning about animals and plants.
biology.exampleZh: 她想学习生物学，因为她喜欢了解动物和植物。

bird.example: A small bird is singing on the tree in our garden.
bird.exampleZh: 一只小鸟正在我们花园的树上唱歌。

birth.example: The birth of her first child was a happy day for the family.
birth.exampleZh: 她第一个孩子的出生对这个家庭来说是幸福的一天。

birthday.example: My birthday is in May, and we always eat cake.
birthday.exampleZh: 我的生日在五月，我们总是吃蛋糕。

biscuit.example: My little sister ate two biscuits with a glass of milk for breakfast.
biscuit.exampleZh: 我妹妹早餐吃了两块饼干，配了一杯牛奶。

bishop.example: The bishop blessed the people in the old church.
bishop.exampleZh: 主教在老教堂里为人们祈福。

bit.example: I need a bit of help with my homework tonight.
bit.exampleZh: 我今晚做作业需要一点帮助。

bite.example: The small dog tried to bite my hand when I touched its food.
bite.exampleZh: 当我碰它的食物时，那只小狗想要咬我的手。

bitter.example: The medicine tasted bitter, but she drank it all.
bitter.exampleZh: 这药尝起来很苦，但她还是全喝完了。

black.example: She wore a black coat and carried a small bag to work.
black.exampleZh: 她穿着一件黑色外套，带着一个小包去上班。

blackboard.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard for us.
blackboard.exampleZh: 老师把新单词写在了黑板上给我们看。

blade.example: The blade of the knife is very sharp.
blade.exampleZh: 这把刀的刀刃非常锋利。

blame.example: Do not blame others when you make a mistake.
blame.exampleZh: 自己犯错时不要责怪别人。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space at the top of the table.
blank.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在表格顶部的空白处。

blanket.example: She wrapped the baby in a warm blanket and sang softly.
blanket.exampleZh: 她用一条温暖的毛毯把婴儿裹起来，轻声唱着歌。

blast.example: The blast of wind blew the door shut.
blast.exampleZh: 一阵狂风把门吹得关上了。

blaze.example: The blaze spread quickly through the old wooden house last night.
blaze.exampleZh: 昨夜大火迅速蔓延到那座老木屋。

bleed.example: The cut on his hand began to bleed, so he washed it quickly.
bleed.exampleZh: 他手上的伤口开始流血，于是他迅速清洗了它。

blend.example: This tea is a blend of green tea and dried flowers.
blend.exampleZh: 这种茶是绿茶和干花的混合。

bless.example: May God bless you and your family with good health.
bless.exampleZh: 愿上帝保佑你和你的家人身体健康。

blind.example: The blind man uses a special stick to walk safely every day.
blind.exampleZh: 那位盲人每天用一根特制的手杖安全地走路。

block.example: A fallen tree blocked the road near my block this morning.
block.exampleZh: 今天早上，一棵倒下的树堵住了我家街区附近的路。

blood.example: The doctor said his blood was fine after the test.
blood.exampleZh: 检查之后，医生说他的血液没问题。

bloody.example: The film was too bloody for young children to watch.
bloody.exampleZh: 这部电影对小孩子来说太血腥了，不适合观看。

bloom.example: In spring the garden is full of beautiful blooms.
bloom.exampleZh: 春天，花园里开满了美丽的花。

blossom.example: The apple trees in our garden blossom every spring.
blossom.exampleZh: 我们花园里的苹果树每年春天都会开花。

blow.example: The strong wind began to blow all night and broke the old tree.
blow.exampleZh: 大风刮了一整夜，把那棵老树吹断了。

blue.example: The sky is blue today, but she still feels a little sad.
blue.exampleZh: 今天天空是蓝色的，但她还是感到有点难过。

blueprint.example: The team wrote a blueprint for the new project.
blueprint.exampleZh: 团队为这个新项目写了一份行动方案。

blur.example: Tears blurred my eyes and the words on the page disappeared.
blur.exampleZh: 泪水模糊了我的眼睛，书页上的字都消失了。

blush.example: She began to blush when everyone looked at her new dress.
blush.exampleZh: 当所有人都看着她的新裙子时，她开始脸红了。

board.example: The board decided to serve meals on the deck.
board.exampleZh: 委员会决定在甲板上供应膳食。

boast.example: He likes to boast about his new car to his friends.
boast.exampleZh: 他喜欢向朋友们夸耀他的新车。

boat.example: We took a small boat across the lake to visit the old village.
boat.exampleZh: 我们乘一条小船穿过湖去参观那个古老的村庄。

body.example: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and your mind clear.
body.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能让你的身体强壮、头脑清晰。

boil.example: Please boil some water for the tea before our guests arrive.
boil.exampleZh: 请在客人到达前烧些水泡茶。

bold.example: She made a bold choice to speak up in front of everyone.
bold.exampleZh: 她做了一个大胆的选择，在所有人面前发言。

bolt.example: He ate his lunch in a hurry and bolted out the door.
bolt.exampleZh: 他匆匆吃完午饭，冲出了门。

bomb.example: The old bomb was found in the field and soldiers moved it away.
bomb.exampleZh: 那颗旧炸弹在田野里被发现，士兵们把它移走了。

bond.example: The two sisters share a strong bond that has lasted for many years.
bond.exampleZh: 两姐妹之间有着一种牢固的纽带，已经持续了很多年。

bone.example: The dog is chewing a bone in the garden.
bone.exampleZh: 那只狗正在花园里啃一根骨头。

bonus.example: The workers got a bonus at the end of the year.
bonus.exampleZh: 工人们在年底拿到了一笔奖金。

book.example: I read a good book every night before I go to sleep.
book.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会读一本好书。

boot.example: He put his boots in the boot of the car.
boot.exampleZh: 他把靴子放进了汽车后备箱。

border.example: The river forms the border between the two small countries.
border.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两个小国之间的边界。

bore.example: The long speech began to bore the students, so some of them fell asleep.
bore.exampleZh: 那场冗长的演讲开始让学生们感到厌烦，所以其中一些人睡着了。

boring.example: The long movie was so boring that I fell asleep twice.
boring.exampleZh: 这部电影太冗长乏味了，以至于我睡着了两次。

born.example: She was born in a small town near the sea.
born.exampleZh: 她出生在海边的一个小镇上。

borrow.example: Can I borrow your pen for a moment, please?
borrow.exampleZh: 我能借用一下你的笔吗？

boss.example: My boss asked me to finish the report before Friday afternoon.
boss.exampleZh: 我的老板让我在周五下午之前完成这份报告。

both.example: Both of my sisters play the piano very well.
both.exampleZh: 我的两个姐妹钢琴都弹得很好。

bother.example: Sorry to bother you, but could you help me for a minute?
bother.exampleZh: 抱歉打扰你，能帮我一下吗？

bottle.example: She put the cold water in a bottle and took it to school.
bottle.exampleZh: 她把冷水装进一个瓶子里，带去了学校。

bottom.example: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.

bounce.example: The ball will bounce high if you throw it at the wall.
bounce.exampleZh: 如果你把球扔向墙壁，它会弹得很高。

bound.example: The train is bound for the city and will arrive soon.
bound.exampleZh: 这列火车开往那座城市，很快就会到达。

boundary.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two countries.
boundary.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两国之间的天然边界。

bow.example: She gave a polite bow to the audience and then left the stage.
bow.exampleZh: 她向观众礼貌地鞠了一躬，然后离开了舞台。

bowl.example: She put the hot soup in a big bowl on the table.
bowl.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上的一个大碗里。

box.example: She put the old books in a box and carried it downstairs.
box.exampleZh: 她把旧书放进一个箱子里，然后把它搬到了楼下。

boxing.example: My brother likes boxing and watches every big match on TV.
boxing.exampleZh: 我哥哥喜欢拳击，每场大型比赛都在电视上看。

boy.example: The little boy is playing football with his father in the park.
boy.exampleZh: 那个小男孩正在公园里和父亲一起踢足球。

boycott.example: Many people decided to boycott the company after they learned about its poor working conditions.
boycott.exampleZh: 许多人在得知该公司恶劣的工作条件后，决定抵制这家公司。

brain.example: Reading books every day is good for your brain.
brain.exampleZh: 每天读书对你的大脑有好处。

brake.example: He hit the brake hard when a dog ran into the road.
brake.exampleZh: 一只狗跑到路上时，他猛踩刹车。

branch.example: The bird sat on a thin branch near my window.
branch.exampleZh: 那只鸟停在我窗边一根细树枝上。

brand.example: This brand of coffee is popular with young people in our city.
brand.exampleZh: 这个品牌的咖啡在我们城市的年轻人中很受欢迎。

brass.example: The old band played music on brass instruments at the town square.
brass.exampleZh: 那支老乐队在镇广场上用铜管乐器演奏音乐。

brave.example: The brave girl saved a small cat from the tree.
brave.exampleZh: 这个勇敢的女孩从树上救下了一只小猫。

breach.example: The company was fined for a serious breach of safety rules.
breach.exampleZh: 这家公司因严重违反安全规定而被罚款。

bread.example: She buys fresh bread from the small shop every morning.
bread.exampleZh: 她每天早上都从那家小店买新鲜面包。

breadth.example: The breadth of the river makes it hard to swim across.
breadth.exampleZh: 这条河的宽度使得游过去很困难。

break.example: Be careful not to break the glass on the table.
break.exampleZh: 小心别打碎桌上的玻璃杯。

breakdown.example: The breakdown of the old machine stopped all work for two days.
breakdown.exampleZh: 那台旧机器的故障使所有工作停顿了两天。

breakfast.example: I eat breakfast with my family every morning before school.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前和家人一起吃早餐。

breath.example: After running up the stairs, she took a deep breath and smiled.
breath.exampleZh: 跑上楼梯后，她深吸了一口气，笑了。

breathe.example: I like to breathe deeply when I walk in the park.
breathe.exampleZh: 在公园散步时，我喜欢深呼吸。

breed.example: Farmers breed cows for milk, and this breed is very common.
breed.exampleZh: 农民养牛取奶，这个品种非常常见。

breeze.example: The light breeze felt cool and fresh on my face.
breeze.exampleZh: 微风拂过我的脸，又凉又清新。

brick.example: The worker carried a heavy brick and put it on the wall.
brick.exampleZh: 工人搬起一块沉重的砖，把它放在墙上。

bridge.example: The old stone bridge across the river is very beautiful.
bridge.exampleZh: 河上那座古老的石桥非常漂亮。

brief.example: The manager gave a brief talk about the new plan.
brief.exampleZh: 经理就新计划做了简短的讲话。

briefly.example: She briefly explained the plan before everyone left the room.
briefly.exampleZh: 在大家离开房间之前，她简短地解释了计划。

bright.example: The bright sun made the whole room warm and cheerful.
bright.exampleZh: 明亮的阳光让整个房间温暖又愉快。

brilliant.example: She is a brilliant student and always helps her classmates.
brilliant.exampleZh: 她是个杰出的学生，总是帮助她的同学。

bring.example: Please bring your book to class tomorrow morning.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天早上把你的书带来上课。

broad.example: The river is very broad here, so the bridge is long.
broad.exampleZh: 这里的河面很宽，所以桥很长。

broadband.example: We need fast broadband at home for work and school.
broadband.exampleZh: 我们在家工作和上学需要快速的宽带。

broadcast.example: The radio station will broadcast the football game live tonight.
broadcast.exampleZh: 广播电台今晚将现场直播这场足球赛。

broaden.example: Reading more books can broaden your mind and help you understand other people.
broaden.exampleZh: 多读书能拓宽你的视野，帮助你理解他人。

broadly.example: The two plans are broadly similar and both should work well.
broadly.exampleZh: 这两个方案大体上相似，都应该效果不错。

broken.example: The broken window let in cold air all night.
broken.exampleZh: 那扇破了的窗户整晚都让冷空气透进来。

broom.example: She used a broom to clean the leaves off the floor.
broom.exampleZh: 她用扫帚把地上的树叶扫干净。

brother.example: My brother and I play football in the park every Sunday.
brother.exampleZh: 我和我的兄弟每个星期天都在公园里踢足球。

brow.example: He wiped the sweat from his brow after the long run.
brow.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他擦去额头上的汗水。

brown.example: She wore a brown coat and carried a brown bag to school.
brown.exampleZh: 她穿着一件棕色外套，背着一个棕色包去上学。

browse.example: I like to browse the internet before bed and look at funny pictures.
browse.exampleZh: 我喜欢睡前浏览网页，看看有趣的图片。

brush.example: Please use this brush to clean the dust off your old wooden desk.
brush.exampleZh: 请用这把刷子清除你那张旧木桌上的灰尘。

bubble.example: A big bubble rose from the water and then popped.
bubble.exampleZh: 一个大泡泡从水中升起，然后破裂了。

bucket.example: She filled the bucket with water from the old well.
bucket.exampleZh: 她从老井里打了一桶水。

bud.example: A small green bud appeared on the tree in early spring.
bud.exampleZh: 早春时树上长出了一个小小的绿色嫩芽。

budget.example: We must plan our monthly budget carefully before we buy a new car.
budget.exampleZh: 在买新车之前，我们必须仔细规划每月的预算。

build.example: They plan to build a new school near the park next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建一所新学校。

building.example: The building on the corner is very tall and has many windows.
building.exampleZh: 拐角处的那栋大楼很高，有许多窗户。

bulb.example: She changed the bulb in the kitchen lamp because it was too dark.
bulb.exampleZh: 她把厨房灯里的灯泡换了，因为太暗了。

bulk.example: The bulk of the work is already done.

bullet.example: The police found a bullet near the broken window last night.
bullet.exampleZh: 警察昨晚在破碎的窗户附近发现了一颗子弹。

bulletin.example: The school put a bulletin on the door to tell students about the new schedule.
bulletin.exampleZh: 学校在门上贴了一张公告，通知学生新的时间安排。

bump.example: Be careful not to bump your head on the low door frame.
bump.exampleZh: 小心别把头撞到低矮的门框上。

bunch.example: She bought a bunch of grapes for the picnic.
bunch.exampleZh: 她为野餐买了一串葡萄。

bundle.example: She tied the old letters into a bundle and put them away.
bundle.exampleZh: 她把旧信件捆成一包，收了起来。

burden.example: He did not want to become a burden to his family.
burden.exampleZh: 他不想成为家人的负担。

bureau.example: The bureau helps small businesses get the permits they need.
bureau.exampleZh: 该局帮助小企业获得他们所需的许可证。

bureaucracy.example: The new manager wants to reduce bureaucracy in the company.
bureaucracy.exampleZh: 新经理想要减少公司里的官僚主义。

burn.example: Be careful not to burn your hand on the hot pan.
burn.exampleZh: 小心别让热锅烫到你的手。

burst.example: The old water pipe burst in the cold night and flooded the street.
burst.exampleZh: 老水管在寒冷的夜里爆裂了，把街道淹了。

bury.example: The dog likes to bury its bone in the garden.
bury.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢把骨头埋在花园里。

bus.example: I take the bus to school every morning at seven.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上七点坐公共汽车去学校。

bush.example: A small bird hid in the bush beside our house.
bush.exampleZh: 一只小鸟躲在我们房子旁边的灌木丛里。

business.example: My father runs a small business in the city center.
business.exampleZh: 我父亲在市中心经营一家小公司。

busy.example: My mother is busy cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正忙着在厨房做晚饭。

but.example: I want to go out, but it is raining hard today.
but.exampleZh: 我想出去，但是今天雨下得很大。

butcher.example: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces for us.
butcher.exampleZh: 屠夫把肉切成小块给我们。

butter.example: She spread some butter on a piece of warm bread.
butter.exampleZh: 她在一块温热的面包上抹了一些黄油。

butterfly.example: The butterfly landed on a red flower in the garden.
butterfly.exampleZh: 那只蝴蝶落在花园里的一朵红花上。

button.example: Press the red button to start the machine, and button your coat before you go out.
button.exampleZh: 按下红色按钮启动机器，出门前把外套扣好。

buy.example: I want to buy a new book for my sister today.
buy.exampleZh: 我今天想给我妹妹买一本新书。

by.example: She goes to work by bus every morning.
by.exampleZh: 她每天早上乘公交车去上班。

cab.example: We took a cab to the airport early this morning.
cab.exampleZh: 我们今天一早坐出租车去了机场。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with rice and eggs for dinner.
cabbage.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚饭用卷心菜配米饭和鸡蛋做菜。

cabin.example: We stayed in a small wooden cabin near the lake last summer.
cabin.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们住在湖边一间小木屋里。

cabinet.example: She keeps the clean cups in the small cabinet near the door.
cabinet.exampleZh: 她把干净的杯子放在门边的小橱柜里。

cable.example: The workers used a long cable to pull the boat to the shore.
cable.exampleZh: 工人们用一根长缆绳把船拉到了岸边。

cafe.example: We met at a small cafe near the station yesterday.
cafe.exampleZh: 昨天我们在车站附近的一家小咖啡馆见面。

cage.example: The bird sang softly inside its small cage by the window.
cage.exampleZh: 那只鸟在窗边的小笼子里轻声歌唱。

cake.example: She made a chocolate cake for her son's birthday party.
cake.exampleZh: 她为儿子的生日派对做了一个巧克力蛋糕。

calculate.example: We need to calculate the total cost before we buy the tickets.
calculate.exampleZh: 我们在买票之前需要计算一下总费用。

calculator.example: I use my calculator to finish the math homework quickly.
calculator.exampleZh: 我用计算器快速完成数学作业。

calendar.example: I write all my meetings on the calendar by my desk.
calendar.exampleZh: 我把所有会议都记在书桌旁的日历上。

call.example: Please call me when you get home, and I will call you back.
call.exampleZh: 你到家后请给我打电话，我会给你回电话。

calm.example: She took a deep breath to stay calm before the exam started.
calm.exampleZh: 考试开始前，她深吸一口气以保持平静。

camel.example: The camel walked slowly across the hot sand with a heavy load.
camel.exampleZh: 骆驼驮着重物，慢慢地走过滚烫的沙地。

camera.example: I want to buy a new camera for my trip next week.
camera.exampleZh: 我想为下周的旅行买一台新相机。

camp.example: We made a camp near the river and slept there last night.
camp.exampleZh: 我们在河边扎营，昨晚就睡在那里。

campaign.example: The students started a campaign to save the old library.
campaign.exampleZh: 学生们发起了一场拯救旧图书馆的运动。

campus.example: There are many trees and a big library on our campus.
campus.exampleZh: 我们校园里有很多树和一个大图书馆。

can.example: She can open the metal can with a simple tool.
can.exampleZh: 她能用一件简单的工具打开这个金属罐。

canal.example: The small boat moved slowly through the narrow canal towards the old town.
canal.exampleZh: 小船缓缓穿过狭窄的运河，驶向老城区。

cancel.example: The airline had to cancel our flight because of the heavy snow.
cancel.exampleZh: 由于大雪，航空公司不得不取消我们的航班。

cancer.example: Smoking can cause cancer, so it is important to stay away from cigarettes.
cancer.exampleZh: 吸烟会致癌，所以远离香烟很重要。

candidate.example: Each candidate must answer three simple questions before the interview begins.
candidate.exampleZh: 每位候选人在面试开始前必须回答三个简单问题。

candle.example: She lit a candle on the table and turned off the light.
candle.exampleZh: 她点燃了桌上的蜡烛，然后关掉了灯。

candy.example: The little boy ate too much candy and felt sick.
candy.exampleZh: 那个小男孩吃了太多糖果，感到不舒服。

cannon.example: The old ship carried ten cannon on its lower deck.
cannon.exampleZh: 那艘旧船的下层甲板上载有十门大炮。

canteen.example: We eat lunch in the school canteen every day at noon.
canteen.exampleZh: 我们每天中午都在学校食堂吃午饭。

canvas.example: The artist spread the canvas on the floor before starting to paint.
canvas.exampleZh: 画家在开始作画之前把画布铺在地板上。

cap.example: Put the cap back on the bottle after you drink.
cap.exampleZh: 喝完水后把瓶盖重新盖上。

capable.example: She is capable of doing this job well.
capable.exampleZh: 她有能力做好这份工作。

capacity.example: This room has the capacity to hold fifty people.
capacity.exampleZh: 这个房间能容纳五十人。

capital.example: Beijing is the capital of China and a very important city.
capital.exampleZh: 北京是中国的首都，也是一座非常重要的城市。

captain.example: The captain of the ship told the crew to stay calm.
captain.exampleZh: 船长吩咐船员保持镇定。

capture.example: The police used a camera to capture the thief near the busy market.
capture.exampleZh: 警察在繁忙的市场附近用摄像机拍下了小偷。

car.example: My father drives his car to work every morning.
car.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的车去上班。

carbon.example: Carbon is a very important element in all living things.
carbon.exampleZh: 碳是所有生物体内一种非常重要的元素。

card.example: I sent my mother a birthday card with a small gift inside.
card.exampleZh: 我给妈妈寄了一张生日贺卡，里面还附了一份小礼物。

care.example: She takes good care of her little brother every day.
care.exampleZh: 她每天悉心照顾她的弟弟。

career.example: She wants a career in medicine after she finishes school.
career.exampleZh: 她完成学业后想从事医学方面的职业。

careful.example: Please be careful when you cross this busy street with your children.
careful.exampleZh: 你和孩子过这条繁忙的马路时，请小心。

careless.example: He is a careless driver and often makes small mistakes.
careless.exampleZh: 他是个粗心的司机，经常犯小错误。

cargo.example: The ship carried a heavy cargo of rice across the sea.
cargo.exampleZh: 这艘船载着沉重的大米货物横渡大海。

carpenter.example: The carpenter built a small wooden table for our kitchen.
carpenter.exampleZh: 木匠为我们的厨房做了一张小木桌。

carpet.example: We put a soft carpet in the living room.
carpet.exampleZh: 我们在客厅里铺了一块柔软的地毯。

carrier.example: The airline is a major carrier of passengers between the two cities.
carrier.exampleZh: 这家航空公司是两座城市之间的主要客运承运商。

carrot.example: The rabbit ate a carrot from the garden and then ran away.
carrot.exampleZh: 兔子吃了花园里的一根胡萝卜，然后跑开了。

carry.example: I always carry an umbrella in my bag because the weather changes quickly.
carry.exampleZh: 我总在包里带一把伞，因为天气变化很快。

cart.example: The farmer put the bags of corn into a wooden cart.
cart.exampleZh: 农民把一袋袋玉米放进了木制大车里。

cartoon.example: My little sister watches a funny cartoon every morning before school.
cartoon.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上上学前都会看一部有趣的动画片。

case.example: This is a very difficult case for the young doctor.
case.exampleZh: 对这个年轻医生来说，这是一个非常棘手的情况。

cash.example: I paid for the book in cash at the store.
cash.exampleZh: 我在商店里用现金付了这本书的钱。

cashier.example: The cashier at the supermarket gave me the wrong change.
cashier.exampleZh: 超市的收银员找错了钱给我。

cassette.example: I found an old cassette with my favorite songs in the drawer.
cassette.exampleZh: 我在抽屉里找到了一盒录着我最喜欢的歌的旧磁带。

cast.example: The director cast a young actor in the lead role.
cast.exampleZh: 导演让一位年轻演员出演主角。

castle.example: The old castle stands on a hill above the quiet town.
castle.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡矗立在安静小镇上方的小山上。

casual.example: He wore casual clothes to the party and felt relaxed all evening.
casual.exampleZh: 他穿着休闲的衣服去参加聚会，整晚都感到很放松。

cat.example: The black cat sleeps on the warm sofa all afternoon.
cat.exampleZh: 那只黑猫整个下午都在温暖的沙发上睡觉。

catalog.example: The library keeps a catalog of all its books and magazines.
catalog.exampleZh: 图书馆保存着所有书籍和杂志的目录。

catch.example: If you run fast, you can catch the last bus home.
catch.exampleZh: 如果你跑得快，就能赶上回家的末班公交车。

category.example: This book belongs to a different category from the others.
category.exampleZh: 这本书属于与其它书不同的类别。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps many cattle on his small farm in the country.
cattle.exampleZh: 那个农民在乡下的一个小农场里养了许多牛。

cause.example: Careless driving can cause serious accidents on busy city roads.
cause.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶会在繁忙的城市道路上造成严重事故。

caution.example: Please use caution when you cross this busy street.
caution.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的街道时请小心。

cautious.example: She is very cautious when she crosses the busy street.
cautious.exampleZh: 她过繁忙的街道时十分小心。

cave.example: The children found a dark cave near the river and went inside.
cave.exampleZh: 孩子们在河边发现了一个黑暗的山洞，然后走了进去。

cease.example: The rain will cease soon, so we can go out.
cease.exampleZh: 雨很快就会停，所以我们可以出去。

ceiling.example: The ceiling in this old room is very high.
ceiling.exampleZh: 这个旧房间的天花板很高。

celebrate.example: We celebrate my mother's birthday with a big cake every year.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们每年都用一个大蛋糕庆祝我妈妈的生日。

celebration.example: The whole family had a big celebration after my sister's wedding.
celebration.exampleZh: 我姐姐婚礼后，全家人举行了一场盛大的庆祝活动。

celebrity.example: Many celebrities came to the party, and everyone wanted to take a photo with them.
celebrity.exampleZh: 许多名人来参加聚会，大家都想和他们合影。

cell.example: Each cell in the human body has a special job to do.
cell.exampleZh: 人体中的每个细胞都有专门的工作要做。

cellar.example: My grandfather keeps old wine and potatoes in the cold cellar.
cellar.exampleZh: 我祖父把陈年葡萄酒和土豆存放在寒冷的地窖里。

cement.example: Trust and honest talk can cement a good friendship over many years.
cement.exampleZh: 信任和坦诚的交流能在许多年里巩固一段美好的友谊。

cent.example: This pencil costs fifty cents, so I will buy two.
cent.exampleZh: 这支铅笔五十分钱，所以我要买两支。

center.example: The new library stands in the center of our small town.
center.exampleZh: 新图书馆坐落在我们小镇的中心。

centigrade.example: Water boils at one hundred degrees centigrade at sea level.
centigrade.exampleZh: 在海平面，水在摄氏一百度时沸腾。

centimetre.example: The line is about ten centimetres long and very easy to draw.
centimetre.exampleZh: 这条线大约十厘米长，很容易画。

central.example: The library is a central place for students to study and meet friends.
central.exampleZh: 图书馆是学生学习和交友的中心场所。

century.example: This old tree is more than a century old.
century.exampleZh: 这棵老树已有一百多年了。

cereal.example: I eat cereal with milk and fruit every morning before school.
cereal.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃麦片配牛奶和水果。

ceremony.example: The wedding ceremony was short and very beautiful.
ceremony.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式简短而非常美好。

certain.example: I am certain that she will come to the party tonight.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定她今晚会来参加聚会。

certainly.example: I will certainly help you with your homework after dinner.
certainly.exampleZh: 晚饭后我一定会帮你做作业。

certainty.example: There is no certainty that the weather will be good tomorrow.
certainty.exampleZh: 明天天气会好并没有把握。

certificate.example: You need a certificate to show that you finished the class.
certificate.exampleZh: 你需要一份证书来证明你完成了这门课程。

certify.example: The doctor can certify that he is healthy enough to work.
certify.exampleZh: 医生可以证明他的健康状况足以胜任工作。

chain.example: She keeps her keys on a small chain.
chain.exampleZh: 她把钥匙挂在一条小链子上。

chair.example: She is the new chair of the English department.
chair.exampleZh: 她是英语系的新任主席。

chairman.example: The chairman opened the meeting and asked everyone to speak clearly.
chairman.exampleZh: 主席宣布会议开始，并请每个人清楚地发言。

chalk.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the board with a piece of chalk.
chalk.exampleZh: 老师用一支粉笔把新单词写在黑板上。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge, but she never gives up.
challenge.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是一项巨大的挑战，但她从不放弃。

chamber.example: The judge walked into the chamber and asked everyone to stand and wait for the trial.
chamber.exampleZh: 法官走进审判室，让所有人都站起来，等候开庭。

champion.example: She became the world champion after years of hard training.
champion.exampleZh: 经过多年刻苦训练，她成为了世界冠军。

chance.example: This is a good chance for you to learn something new.
chance.exampleZh: 这是一个让你学习新东西的好机会。

change.example: I need to change my wet clothes and then catch the next train.
change.exampleZh: 我需要换掉湿衣服，然后赶下一班火车。

channel.example: This TV channel shows news from many countries every day.
channel.exampleZh: 这个电视频道每天播放来自许多国家的新闻。

chaos.example: The party turned into chaos when the lights went out.
chaos.exampleZh: 灯一灭，聚会就陷入了混乱。

chap.example: That young chap at the door is waiting for his friend.
chap.exampleZh: 门口那个小伙子正在等他的朋友。

chapter.example: The first chapter of this book is about a new era.
chapter.exampleZh: 这本书的第一章讲述了一个新的时代。

character.example: Her kind character makes everyone in the class feel welcome.
character.exampleZh: 她善良的性格让班上每个人都感到受欢迎。

characteristic.example: Kindness is a good characteristic that makes people trust and like you.
characteristic.exampleZh: 善良是一种让人信任并喜欢你的好品质。

characterize.example: Heavy rain and strong winds characterize the weather in this small town.
characterize.exampleZh: 大雨和强风是这个小镇天气的特征。

charge.example: The hotel will charge us extra for breakfast and wifi.
charge.exampleZh: 酒店会因早餐和无线网络向我们额外收费。

charity.example: She gives money to charity every year to help poor children.
charity.exampleZh: 她每年都捐钱给慈善机构，帮助贫穷的孩子。

charm.example: Her warm smile and kind words have a special charm that everyone enjoys.
charm.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑和亲切的话语有一种人人都喜欢的特殊魅力。

chart.example: The chart on the wall shows how the temperature changes each month.
chart.exampleZh: 墙上的图表显示了每个月气温的变化。

chase.example: The dog likes to chase the ball across the wet grass.
chase.exampleZh: 那只狗喜欢在湿漉漉的草地上追逐那个球。

chat.example: We sat in the kitchen and had a long chat about our plans.
chat.exampleZh: 我们坐在厨房里，聊了很久我们的计划。

cheap.example: This cheap bag broke after only two days of use.
cheap.exampleZh: 这个廉价的包只用了两天就坏了。

cheat.example: She tried to cheat on the test but the teacher saw her.
cheat.exampleZh: 她考试时想作弊，但被老师发现了。

check.example: Please check your answers before you hand in the test paper.
check.exampleZh: 交试卷之前请检查你的答案。

cheek.example: Her cheeks turned red when the teacher called her name.
cheek.exampleZh: 老师叫到她的名字时，她的脸颊红了。

cheer.example: The fans began to cheer loudly when their team scored a goal.
cheer.exampleZh: 当他们的球队进球时，球迷开始大声欢呼。

cheerful.example: She is always cheerful in the morning and says hello to everyone.
cheerful.exampleZh: 她早上总是很快乐，见到每个人都打招呼。

cheese.example: I like to put some cheese on my bread for breakfast.
cheese.exampleZh: 我早餐喜欢在面包上放一些奶酪。

chemical.example: Many farmers use chemicals to protect their crops from insects.
chemical.exampleZh: 许多农民用化学品保护庄稼免受害虫侵害。

chemist.example: The chemist made a new medicine in his small lab.
chemist.exampleZh: 这位化学家在他的小实验室里研制出一种新药。

chemistry.example: She studies chemistry at school and loves doing simple experiments with her friends.
chemistry.exampleZh: 她在学校学化学，喜欢和朋友们一起做简单的实验。

cheque.example: I wrote a cheque to pay for the new table.
cheque.exampleZh: 我写了一张支票来支付新桌子的费用。

cherry.example: The little girl picked a red cherry from the tree and smiled.
cherry.exampleZh: 小女孩从树上摘下一颗红樱桃，笑了。

chess.example: My brother and I play chess every Sunday afternoon at home.
chess.exampleZh: 我和哥哥每个星期天下午都在家下国际象棋。

chest.example: She put her hand on her chest and took a deep breath.
chest.exampleZh: 她把手放在胸口，深吸了一口气。

chew.example: Please chew your food slowly and carefully before you swallow it.
chew.exampleZh: 请慢慢仔细地咀嚼食物，然后再咽下去。

chicken.example: My mother cooks chicken with rice for dinner every Sunday.
chicken.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期日都做鸡肉配米饭当晚餐。

chief.example: The chief reason he left was the long hours.
chief.exampleZh: 他离开的主要原因是工作时间太长。

child.example: Every child in the class got a small book from the teacher.
child.exampleZh: 班上的每个孩子都从老师那里得到了一本小书。

childhood.example: My happiest childhood memories are the summer days I spent at my grandmother's house.
childhood.exampleZh: 我最快乐的童年回忆是在祖母家度过的夏日时光。

chill.example: There is a chill in the air tonight, so wear a warm coat.
chill.exampleZh: 今晚空气中有股寒意，所以穿件暖和外衣吧。

chimney.example: Smoke from the chimney rose slowly into the cold winter sky.
chimney.exampleZh: 烟囱里冒出的烟缓缓升入寒冷的冬日天空。

chin.example: She rested her chin on her hand and looked out the window.
chin.exampleZh: 她用手托着下巴，望着窗外。

china.example: She keeps her tea cups in a glass case because they are fine china.
china.exampleZh: 她把茶杯放在玻璃柜里，因为它们是精美的瓷器。

chip.example: The glass fell and broke into small chips on the floor.
chip.exampleZh: 玻璃杯掉下来，在地板上摔成了小碎片。

chocolate.example: I bought a box of chocolate for my sister's birthday.
chocolate.exampleZh: 我买了一盒巧克力作为我姐姐的生日礼物。

choice.example: It was a hard choice, but I chose the cheaper one.
choice.exampleZh: 这是一个艰难的选择，但我选了更便宜的那个。

choke.example: The thick smoke made her choke and she ran outside quickly.
choke.exampleZh: 浓烟让她窒息，她迅速跑了出去。

choose.example: It is hard to choose a gift for my mother.
choose.exampleZh: 给我妈妈挑选一份礼物很难。

chop.example: She used a sharp knife to chop the onions into small pieces.
chop.exampleZh: 她用一把锋利的刀把洋葱剁成小块。

chord.example: She played a soft chord on the guitar and sang along.
chord.exampleZh: 她在吉他上轻轻弹了一个和弦，跟着唱了起来。

christ.example: Many people learn about Christ by reading stories in the Bible.
christ.exampleZh: 许多人通过阅读圣经中的故事来了解基督。

christian.example: My neighbor is a Christian and he goes to church every Sunday.
christian.exampleZh: 我的邻居是个基督教徒，他每个星期天都去教堂。

christmas.example: We always visit our grandparents at Christmas and eat a big dinner together.
christmas.exampleZh: 圣诞节时我们总是去看望祖父母，并一起吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

church.example: The old stone church stands at the end of our street.
church.exampleZh: 那座古老的石砌教堂矗立在我们街道的尽头。

cigar.example: He sat on the porch and smoked a cigar after dinner.
cigar.exampleZh: 晚饭后，他坐在门廊上抽了一支雪茄烟。

cigarette.example: He went outside to smoke a cigarette after dinner.
cigarette.exampleZh: 晚饭后他到外面去抽了一支烟。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema last night to see a new film.
cinema.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去电影院看了一部新电影。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle and sang songs together after lunch.
circle.exampleZh: 午饭后，孩子们围坐成一个圆圈，一起唱歌。

circuit.example: The electrical circuit broke, so the lights in the room went out.
circuit.exampleZh: 电路断了，所以房间里的灯熄灭了。

circular.example: The children sat in a circular group on the floor.
circular.exampleZh: 孩子们在地板上围坐成一个圆圈。

circulate.example: Blood circulates through the body and carries oxygen to every cell.
circulate.exampleZh: 血液在全身循环，把氧气输送到每一个细胞。

circulation.example: Regular exercise is good for blood circulation in the body.
circulation.exampleZh: 规律运动有益于身体内的血液循环。

circumstance.example: Her family lives in difficult circumstances and needs help from the community.
