circumstance.exampleZh: 她的家庭生活在困难的环境中，需要社区的帮助。

cite.example: The teacher asked us to cite two books in our report.
cite.exampleZh: 老师要求我们在报告中引用两本书。

citizen.example: Every citizen in this city can vote in the local election.
citizen.exampleZh: 这座城市里的每一位公民都可以在地方选举中投票。

city.example: My sister moved to a big city for her new job.
city.exampleZh: 我姐姐为了新工作搬到了一座大城市。

civil.example: Every citizen should know their civil rights and duties.
civil.exampleZh: 每个公民都应该了解自己的民事权利和义务。

civilian.example: The soldiers helped the civilians leave the city before the fighting started.
civilian.exampleZh: 战斗开始前，士兵们帮助平民离开了城市。

civilization.example: Ancient Egypt is famous for its long and rich civilization.
civilization.exampleZh: 古埃及以其悠久而丰富的文明而闻名。

civilize.example: The old teacher tried to civilize the wild boy with books and kindness.
civilize.exampleZh: 那位老教师试图用书本和善意来教化这个野性的男孩。

claim.example: She claims that the letter arrived yesterday, but nobody saw it.
claim.exampleZh: 她声称那封信昨天就到了，但没有人看到过。

clap.example: The audience began to clap loudly when the singer finished her song.
clap.exampleZh: 歌手唱完歌后，观众开始大声鼓掌。

clarify.example: Please clarify your question so everyone in the room can understand it.
clarify.exampleZh: 请澄清你的问题，以便房间里的每个人都能理解。

clarity.example: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand the difficult lesson.
clarity.exampleZh: 她讲解的清晰程度帮助每个人都理解了这节难课。

clash.example: The two plans clash, so we must change one of them.
clash.exampleZh: 这两个计划相互冲突，所以我们必须改动其中一个。

class.example: Our class has twenty students and we all like our English teacher.
class.exampleZh: 我们班有二十名学生，我们都喜欢我们的英语老师。

classic.example: This old film is a classic story about love and family.
classic.exampleZh: 这部老电影是一个关于爱情和家庭的经典故事。

classical.example: She likes classical music, so she often listens to it after dinner.
classical.exampleZh: 她喜欢古典音乐，所以常在晚饭后听。

classification.example: The classification of these animals is based on their size and color.
classification.exampleZh: 这些动物的分类是根据它们的体型和颜色来进行的。

classify.example: We can classify these books by subject and reading level.
classify.exampleZh: 我们可以按学科和阅读难度给这些书分类。

classmate.example: My classmate sits next to me in math class every day.
classmate.exampleZh: 我的同班同学每天数学课都坐在我旁边。

classroom.example: Our classroom is big and bright, and we read books there every day.
classroom.exampleZh: 我们的教室又大又明亮，我们每天在那里读书。

clause.example: This contract has a special clause about working hours.
clause.exampleZh: 这份合同有一条关于工作时间的特别条款。

claw.example: The cat hurt its claw while climbing the tall tree.
claw.exampleZh: 那只猫爬高树时伤到了爪子。

clay.example: The children made small animals out of clay in the art class.
clay.exampleZh: 孩子们在美术课上用黏土捏了小动物。

clean.example: Please keep your room clean and tidy, and clean the desk after you finish your work.
clean.exampleZh: 请保持你的房间干净整洁，做完事情后把书桌清理一下。

clear.example: The sky is clear today, so we can see the far mountains.
clear.exampleZh: 今天天空晴朗，所以我们可以看到远处的群山。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk gave me a new room key.
clerk.exampleZh: 前台的职员给了我一把新的房间钥匙。

clever.example: She is a clever girl and always finds quick answers.
clever.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的女孩，总能很快找到答案。

click.example: When you click the mouse, the small button makes a soft sound.
click.exampleZh: 当你点击鼠标时，这个小按钮会发出轻柔的声音。

client.example: The lawyer met her client in the office this morning.
client.exampleZh: 律师今天上午在办公室会见了她的委托人。

cliff.example: We stood at the top of the cliff and watched the sea below.
cliff.exampleZh: 我们站在悬崖顶上，看着下方的大海。

climate.example: The climate in this city is warm and wet all year.
climate.exampleZh: 这座城市的气候全年温暖湿润。

climb.example: We decided to climb the small hill behind our house after lunch.
climb.exampleZh: 我们决定午饭后去爬屋后那座小山。

cling.example: The little boy would always cling to his mother when they walked into a crowded room.
cling.exampleZh: 每当他们走进拥挤的房间时，这个小男孩总会紧紧抓住他的母亲。

clinic.example: My mother took me to the clinic near our home yesterday morning.
clinic.exampleZh: 昨天早上我妈妈带我去了家附近的诊所。

clinical.example: The doctor gave a clinical report on the patient's condition.
clinical.exampleZh: 医生就病人的状况给出了一份临床报告。

clock.example: I looked at the clock and saw it was almost eight.
clock.exampleZh: 我看了看时钟，发现快八点了。

close.example: Please close the door because the baby is close to sleep.
close.exampleZh: 请关上门，因为宝宝快睡着了。

cloth.example: She wiped the table with a clean cloth after dinner.
cloth.exampleZh: 晚饭后她用一块干净的布擦桌子。

clothes.example: I wash my clothes every Sunday morning at home.
clothes.exampleZh: 我每个星期天早上在家洗衣服。

clothing.example: She buys warm clothing for her children every winter.
clothing.exampleZh: 她每年冬天都给孩子们买保暖的衣服。

cloud.example: Dark clouds covered the sky before the storm came.
cloud.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云遮住了天空。

cloudy.example: The sky is cloudy today, so we will not go to the beach.
cloudy.exampleZh: 今天天空多云，所以我们不去海滩了。

club.example: My brother joined a chess club at school last year.
club.exampleZh: 我弟弟去年在学校加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。

clue.example: The police found an important clue near the old house.
clue.exampleZh: 警方在那座老房子附近发现了一条重要线索。

clumsy.example: His clumsy hands knocked the cup off the table again.
clumsy.exampleZh: 他笨拙的手又把杯子从桌上碰掉了。

cluster.example: A cluster of stars shone brightly in the night sky.
cluster.exampleZh: 一团星星在夜空中闪耀。

clutch.example: She had to clutch the rail tightly while the bus turned the corner.
clutch.exampleZh: 公交车转弯时，她不得不紧紧抓住扶手。

coach.example: We took a coach to the city and the driver was very friendly.
coach.exampleZh: 我们坐长途汽车去城里，司机非常友好。

coal.example: The old train burns coal to make the steam that moves it.
coal.exampleZh: 那列老式火车烧煤来产生驱动它前进的蒸汽。

coarse.example: The coarse cloth felt rough against her skin.
coarse.exampleZh: 那块粗糙的布贴在她皮肤上感觉很扎人。

coast.example: We drove along the coast and watched the waves hit the rocks.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸开车，看着海浪拍打岩石。

coat.example: She put on a warm coat before going out in the cold wind.
coat.exampleZh: 她在刺骨的寒风中出门前穿上了一件暖和的外套。

cock.example: The old farmer keeps a black cock and ten hens in the yard.
cock.exampleZh: 那位老农在院子里养了一只黑色公鸡和十只母鸡。

code.example: The school has a strict code of conduct for all new students.
code.exampleZh: 这所学校对所有新生都有严格的行为准则。

coffee.example: I drink a hot cup of coffee every morning before work.
coffee.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都喝一杯热咖啡。

coil.example: The snake can coil around a tree and the wire forms a small coil.
coil.exampleZh: 蛇能盘绕在树上，而金属丝则形成一个小的线圈。

coin.example: He put a coin into the machine and bought a drink.
coin.exampleZh: 他把一枚硬币放进机器，买了一瓶饮料。

coincide.example: Our holiday dates coincide this year, so we can travel together.
coincide.exampleZh: 今年我们的假期时间正好重合，所以我们可以一起旅行。

coincidence.example: It was just a coincidence that we both wore the same shirt today.
coincidence.exampleZh: 我们今天都穿了同一件衬衫，这只是巧合。

cold.example: It is very cold outside today, so wear a warm coat.
cold.exampleZh: 今天外面很冷，所以穿件暖和的外套。

collaborate.example: The two teams will collaborate on the new project next month.
collaborate.exampleZh: 这两个团队下个月将在这个新项目上合作。

collapse.example: The old bridge collapsed suddenly and many cars fell into the river below.
collapse.exampleZh: 那座旧桥突然倒塌，许多汽车掉进了下面的河里。

collar.example: The dog has a red collar around its neck.
collar.exampleZh: 那只狗的脖子上有一个红色项圈。

colleague.example: I often eat lunch with a colleague from the sales team.
colleague.exampleZh: 我经常和销售部的一位同事一起吃午饭。

collect.example: She likes to collect old coins from different countries.
collect.exampleZh: 她喜欢收集来自不同国家的旧硬币。

collection.example: My brother has a large collection of old coins from many countries.
collection.exampleZh: 我哥哥收藏了大量来自许多国家的旧硬币。

collective.example: The team made a collective decision to finish the project early.
collective.exampleZh: 团队做出了集体决定，要提前完成这个项目。

college.example: My brother studies music at a small college near our home.
college.exampleZh: 我哥哥在家附近的一所小学院里学习音乐。

collide.example: The two cars collided at the corner because the driver did not see the red light.
collide.exampleZh: 两辆车在拐角处相撞，因为那位司机没有看到红灯。

collision.example: The two cars slowed down but still had a small collision at the corner.
collision.exampleZh: 两辆车减速了，但还是在拐角处发生了一次轻微的碰撞。

colonial.example: The country was under colonial rule for more than a hundred years.
colonial.exampleZh: 这个国家被殖民统治了一百多年。

colony.example: Ants live together in a large colony under the ground.
colony.exampleZh: 蚂蚁一起生活在地下的大群体里。

color.example: The walls of my room are a warm yellow color.
color.exampleZh: 我房间的墙壁是温暖的黄色。

column.example: The teacher asked us to read the first column of the table.
column.exampleZh: 老师让我们读表格的第一列。

comb.example: She used a comb to fix her hair before the meeting.
comb.exampleZh: 开会前她用梳子整理了一下头发。

combat.example: The new law aims to combat pollution in our city.
combat.exampleZh: 这项新法律旨在防止我们城市的污染。

combination.example: The combination of rain and wind made the trip difficult.
combination.exampleZh: 风雨交加使得这次旅行很艰难。

combine.example: This job combines computer skills with good communication.
combine.exampleZh: 这份工作兼备计算机技能与良好的沟通能力。

come.example: Please come to my house after school today.

comedy.example: I like watching comedy shows because they always make me laugh.
comedy.exampleZh: 我喜欢看喜剧节目，因为它们总能让我笑。

comfort.example: Her kind words gave him great comfort after the loss.
comfort.exampleZh: 在她失去亲人后，她温暖的话语给了他很大的安慰。

comfortable.example: This chair is very comfortable, so I can sit here all day.
comfortable.exampleZh: 这把椅子很舒服，所以我能在这儿坐一整天。

command.example: The general can command his soldiers to move quickly and stay calm.
command.exampleZh: 将军能命令他的士兵快速行动并保持冷静。

commander.example: The commander told his soldiers to stay calm and wait for new orders.
commander.exampleZh: 指挥官让士兵们保持冷静，等待新的命令。

commemorate.example: Every year the whole town gathers here to commemorate the brave soldiers.
commemorate.exampleZh: 每年全镇的人都会聚集在这里纪念那些勇敢的士兵。

comment.example: Please leave a comment below the article if you have any questions.
comment.exampleZh: 如果你有任何问题，请在文章下方留下评论。

commentary.example: The radio commentary on the football match was exciting to listen to.
commentary.exampleZh: 那场足球比赛的电台解说着实让人听得兴奋。

commerce.example: Online commerce has grown very fast in the past ten years.
commerce.exampleZh: 网络商业在过去十年里发展得非常快。

commercial.example: The city has a large commercial area with many shops and offices.
commercial.exampleZh: 这座城市有一个大型商业区，里面有许多商店和办公楼。

commission.example: The government set up a commission to study the problem of air pollution.
commission.exampleZh: 政府成立了一个委员会来研究空气污染问题。

commit.example: He did not want to commit himself to such a difficult job.
commit.exampleZh: 他不想让自己承担这么难的工作。

commitment.example: She made a strong commitment to finish the project on time.
commitment.exampleZh: 她坚定地承诺要按时完成这个项目。

committee.example: The committee will meet on Monday to discuss the new plan.
committee.exampleZh: 委员会将于周一开会讨论这个新计划。

commodity.example: Clean water is a valuable commodity in many dry parts of the world.
commodity.exampleZh: 在世界许多干旱地区，清洁的水是一种宝贵的商品。

common.example: It is a common problem for many young people today.
common.exampleZh: 这是如今许多年轻人常见的问题。

communicate.example: We use email every day to communicate with our team.
communicate.exampleZh: 我们每天使用电子邮件与团队沟通。

communication.example: Good communication between parents and teachers helps children do better in school.
communication.exampleZh: 家长和老师之间良好的沟通有助于孩子在学校表现得更好。

community.example: The library is an important place for our community to meet and learn.
community.exampleZh: 图书馆是我们社区聚会和学习的重要场所。

commute.example: She commutes to work by train every morning.
commute.exampleZh: 她每天早上乘火车通勤上班。

compact.example: This compact camera is easy to carry on trips.
compact.exampleZh: 这款小巧的相机在旅行时便于携带。

companion.example: My dog is my best companion on long walks.
companion.exampleZh: 在长途散步时，我的狗是我最好的伙伴。

company.example: My father works for a small company in the city.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在城里一家小公司工作。

comparable.example: The two phones are similar in size, so their prices are comparable.
comparable.exampleZh: 这两部手机大小相近，所以它们的价格也差不多。

comparative.example: This study makes a comparative analysis of the two languages and their grammar.
comparative.exampleZh: 这项研究对这两种语言及其语法进行了比较分析。

compare.example: If you compare the two pictures, you will see a small difference.
compare.exampleZh: 如果你把这两张图片比较一下，就会看出一个细微的差别。

comparison.example: The comparison between the two cars shows that the red one is cheaper.
comparison.exampleZh: 这两辆车的对比表明红色的那辆更便宜。

compass.example: Without a compass, it is easy to get lost in the forest.
compass.exampleZh: 没有指南针，在森林里很容易迷路。

compel.example: The heavy rain compelled us to stay at home all day.
compel.exampleZh: 大雨迫使我们一整天都待在家里。

compensate.example: The company agreed to compensate the workers for their lost wages.
compensate.exampleZh: 公司同意补偿工人们损失的工资。

compensation.example: The company paid him compensation for the loss of his job.
compensation.exampleZh: 公司因他失去工作而向他支付了补偿金。

compete.example: Small shops find it hard to compete with big supermarkets on price.
compete.exampleZh: 小商店发现在价格上很难与大型超市竞争。

competent.example: She is a competent teacher who explains every lesson clearly.
competent.exampleZh: 她是一位能胜任的老师，每节课都讲解得很清楚。

competition.example: The competition between the two teams was very close this year.
competition.exampleZh: 今年这两支队伍之间的竞争非常激烈。

competitive.example: The job market is very competitive for young people today.
competitive.exampleZh: 如今的就业市场对年轻人来说竞争非常激烈。

competitor.example: Our biggest competitor just opened a new store near our office.
competitor.exampleZh: 我们最大的竞争对手刚在我们办公室附近开了一家新店。

complain.example: Many people complain about the noise from the new road at night.
complain.exampleZh: 很多人抱怨这条新路夜间的噪音。

complaint.example: She made a complaint about the noise from the street.

complement.example: A good dessert can complement a simple meal very well.
complement.exampleZh: 一道好的甜点能很好地补充一顿简单的饭菜。

complete.example: Please complete the form and hand it back to me.
complete.exampleZh: 请填完这张表格然后交还给我。

complex.example: The new hospital is a large complex with many buildings and gardens.
complex.exampleZh: 新医院是一个带有很多建筑和花园的大型建筑群。

complexity.example: The complexity of the new software makes it hard to learn.
complexity.exampleZh: 这个新软件的复杂性使它很难学会。

complicate.example: Adding more rules will only complicate the process for everyone.
complicate.exampleZh: 增加更多规则只会让每个人的流程变得更加复杂。

complicated.example: This math problem is too complicated for most of the students.
complicated.exampleZh: 这道数学题对大多数学生来说太复杂了。

complication.example: A sudden complication made the simple plan much harder to finish.
complication.exampleZh: 一个突然出现的复杂情况让这个简单的计划变得更难完成。

compliment.example: She gave me a nice compliment about my new haircut.
compliment.exampleZh: 她对我的新发型称赞了一番。

comply.example: All staff must comply with the new safety rules at work.
comply.exampleZh: 所有员工在工作中都必须遵守新的安全规定。

component.example: Each component of the machine is small and easy to replace.
component.exampleZh: 这台机器的每个部件都很小，容易更换。

compose.example: The team is composed of five students and two teachers.
compose.exampleZh: 这个团队由五名学生和两名老师组成。

composer.example: The composer wrote a beautiful song for the school concert.
composer.exampleZh: 这位作曲家为学校音乐会写了一首优美的歌曲。

composition.example: Her composition about her family won first prize at school.
composition.exampleZh: 她写的那篇关于家人的作文在学校获得了一等奖。

compound.example: Water is a simple compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
compound.exampleZh: 水是一种简单的氢和氧的化合物。

comprehension.example: Reading every day can improve your comprehension of long English texts.
comprehension.exampleZh: 每天阅读可以提高你对长篇英语文章的理解力。

comprehensive.example: The book gives a comprehensive view of modern art in simple words.
comprehensive.exampleZh: 这本书用简单的语言全面地介绍了现代艺术。

compress.example: You can compress the files to make them easier to send.
compress.exampleZh: 你可以压缩这些文件，让它们更容易发送。

comprise.example: The team comprises five students and two teachers.
comprise.exampleZh: 这个团队由五名学生和两名教师组成。

compromise.example: After a long talk, both sides agreed to a compromise.
compromise.exampleZh: 经过长时间交谈，双方同意妥协。

compulsory.example: In many countries, school attendance is compulsory for children under sixteen.
compulsory.exampleZh: 在许多国家，十六岁以下儿童必须上学。

compute.example: We can compute the total cost with a simple formula.
compute.exampleZh: 我们可以用一个简单的公式计算总成本。

computer.example: I use my computer every day to check email and do my homework.
computer.exampleZh: 我每天用电脑查邮件和做作业。

comrade.example: My father often talks about his old comrade from the small village school.
comrade.exampleZh: 我父亲经常谈起他在那所乡村小学时的老同志。

conceal.example: She tried to conceal her true feelings from everyone at the party.
conceal.exampleZh: 她试图在聚会上向所有人隐瞒自己的真实感受。

concede.example: He finally conceded that he had made a serious mistake.
concede.exampleZh: 他最终承认自己犯了一个严重的错误。

conceive.example: She could not conceive of a life without her family.
conceive.exampleZh: 她无法想象没有家人的生活。

concentrate.example: I can't concentrate on my homework when the TV is on.
concentrate.exampleZh: 电视开着的时候我没法专心做作业。

concentration.example: Good concentration helps you finish your homework faster and make fewer mistakes.
concentration.exampleZh: 良好的专注力能帮你更快完成作业，并减少错误。

concept.example: The concept of freedom is important to many young people today.
concept.exampleZh: 自由这个概念对今天的许多年轻人来说很重要。

concern.example: This new rule will concern everyone who works in our company.
concern.exampleZh: 这条新规定将涉及我们公司里每一位员工。

concerning.example: I have a question concerning the new class schedule.
concerning.exampleZh: 我有一个关于新课程表的问题。

concert.example: My friends and I went to a concert last night.
concert.exampleZh: 昨晚我和朋友们去听了一场音乐会。

concession.example: The union made a small concession on working hours to reach a deal.
concession.exampleZh: 工会在工作时间上做出了小小的让步，以达成协议。

concise.example: Her report is clear and concise, so everyone understands it easily.
concise.exampleZh: 她的报告清晰简明，所以每个人都容易理解。

conclude.example: From the evidence, we can conclude that he was telling the truth.
conclude.exampleZh: 从证据来看，我们可以断定他说的是实话。

conclusion.example: After a long talk, we finally reached a clear conclusion about the plan.
conclusion.exampleZh: 经过长时间的讨论，我们终于就这个计划得出了一个明确的结论。

concrete.example: The workers poured concrete for the new floor of the building.
concrete.exampleZh: 工人们为这栋楼的新地板浇筑了混凝土。

condemn.example: Many people condemned the new law as unfair to poor families.
condemn.exampleZh: 许多人谴责这项新法律对贫困家庭不公平。

condense.example: Please condense your report into one short page for the meeting.
condense.exampleZh: 请把你的报告压缩成一页简短的内容供会议使用。

condition.example: The house is old, but its condition is still very good.
condition.exampleZh: 这房子虽旧，但状况仍然很好。

conduct.example: The teacher praised the students for their good conduct during the trip.
conduct.exampleZh: 老师表扬了学生们在旅行中的良好行为。

conductor.example: The conductor raised his hands and the whole orchestra became quiet.
conductor.exampleZh: 指挥举起双手，整个管弦乐队便安静下来。

confer.example: The doctors will confer with the family before they decide on the treatment.
confer.exampleZh: 医生们会先与家属商议，然后再决定治疗方案。

conference.example: She met her teacher at the conference last week.
conference.exampleZh: 她上周在会议上见到了她的老师。

confess.example: She confessed that she had broken the window yesterday afternoon.
confess.exampleZh: 她承认昨天下午打破了窗户。

confidence.example: She has great confidence in her own ability to solve problems.
confidence.exampleZh: 她对自己解决问题的能力很有信心。

confident.example: She feels confident about the test because she studied hard.
confident.exampleZh: 她对这次考试感到自信，因为她努力学习。

confidential.example: Please keep this confidential because it is important to our whole team.
confidential.exampleZh: 请对这个保密，因为它对我们整个团队都很重要。

confine.example: The doctor asked him to confine his questions to the topic.
confine.exampleZh: 医生请他把问题限定在这个话题内。

confirm.example: The doctor will confirm the test results with you tomorrow morning.
confirm.exampleZh: 医生明天早上会和你确认检查结果。

conflict.example: There is a serious conflict between the two teams about the new plan.
conflict.exampleZh: 两个团队之间关于新计划存在严重的冲突。

conform.example: All new students must conform to the school rules from the first day.
conform.exampleZh: 所有新生从第一天起就必须遵守校规。

confront.example: Every day she must confront many difficult problems at work.
confront.exampleZh: 她每天在工作中都必须面对许多棘手的问题。

confuse.example: The long instructions confuse most new users of this app.
confuse.exampleZh: 这些冗长的说明让这款应用的大多数新用户感到困惑。

confusion.example: There was some confusion about the new rules at school today.
confusion.exampleZh: 今天学校里的新规定让大家有些困惑。

congress.example: The congress meets every year to discuss important laws and national problems.
congress.exampleZh: 代表大会每年召开一次，讨论重要的法律和国家问题。

conjunction.example: The conjunction of hard work and good luck helped her win the prize.
conjunction.exampleZh: 努力与好运的结合帮助她赢得了奖项。

connect.example: You can connect your phone to the computer with this cable.
connect.exampleZh: 你可以用这根线把手机连接到电脑上。

connection.example: There is a strong connection between exercise and good health.
connection.exampleZh: 运动与健康之间有着密切的联系。

conquer.example: She worked hard to conquer her fear of speaking in public.
conquer.exampleZh: 她努力克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

conquest.example: The king's conquest of the city brought great wealth to his people.
conquest.exampleZh: 国王对这座城市的征服给他的子民带来了巨大的财富。

conscience.example: His conscience would not let him lie to his best friend.
conscience.exampleZh: 他的良心不允许他对最好的朋友撒谎。

conscious.example: She was conscious of every sound in the dark room.
conscious.exampleZh: 她对黑暗房间里每一个声音都有所察觉。

consciousness.example: After the accident, he slowly regained consciousness and asked where he was.
consciousness.exampleZh: 事故之后，他慢慢恢复了知觉，并问自己在哪儿。

consensus.example: The group finally reached a consensus after a long and friendly discussion.
consensus.exampleZh: 经过长时间的友好讨论，这个小组终于达成了一致意见。

consent.example: Her parents finally gave their consent to the trip after a long talk.
consent.exampleZh: 经过长谈之后，她的父母终于同意了她这次旅行。

consequence.example: He did not think about the consequences of his careless decision.
consequence.exampleZh: 他没有考虑自己草率决定的后果。

consequently.example: It rained hard, and consequently the game was put off.
consequently.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛被推迟了。

conservation.example: Water conservation is important for every family in this dry region.
conservation.exampleZh: 在这个干旱地区，节约用水对每个家庭都很重要。

conservative.example: My conservative father does not like change and keeps the same old habits.
conservative.exampleZh: 我保守的父亲不喜欢变化，一直保持着同样的旧习惯。

conserve.example: We should conserve water and turn off the lights when we leave.
conserve.exampleZh: 我们应该节约用水，离开时关灯。

consider.example: We must consider all the options before we make a final decision.
consider.exampleZh: 在做最终决定之前，我们必须考虑所有的选择。

considerable.example: The new project took a considerable amount of time and money.
considerable.exampleZh: 这个新项目花费了相当多的时间和金钱。

considerate.example: My roommate is very considerate and always keeps the kitchen clean.
considerate.exampleZh: 我的室友很体贴，总是把厨房保持得很干净。

consideration.example: After careful consideration, she decided to take the job.
consideration.exampleZh: 经过仔细考虑，她决定接受这份工作。

consist.example: The team consists of five students and two teachers.
consist.exampleZh: 这个团队由五名学生和两名教师组成。

consistent.example: Her work is always consistent and very easy to trust.
consistent.exampleZh: 她的工作始终如一，让人很容易信任。

console.example: She tried to console her friend after the bad news about the job.
console.exampleZh: 听到工作上那个坏消息后，她试着安慰她的朋友。

constant.example: The baby needs constant care from her parents day and night.
constant.exampleZh: 这个婴儿日夜都需要父母不断的照料。

constitute.example: These twelve small states together constitute the whole country.
constitute.exampleZh: 这十二个小州共同构成了整个国家。

constitution.example: A good constitution protects the rights of all the people.
constitution.exampleZh: 一部好的宪法保护全体人民的权利。

construct.example: The workers will construct a new bridge across the river next year.
construct.exampleZh: 工人们明年将在河上建造一座新桥。

construction.example: The new bridge is still under construction and will open next year.
construction.exampleZh: 这座新桥仍在建设中，将于明年开放。

consult.example: You should consult your teacher before you choose these difficult courses.
consult.exampleZh: 在选择这些难度较大的课程之前，你应该先请教你的老师。

consultant.example: The company hired a consultant to help improve its sales.
consultant.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来帮助提高销售额。

consume.example: Big cars consume much more gas than small cars do.
consume.exampleZh: 大车比小车消耗的汽油多得多。

consumer.example: The consumer wants safe food at a fair price.
consumer.exampleZh: 消费者想要价格合理的安全食品。

consumption.example: This car has low fuel consumption and is cheap to run.
consumption.exampleZh: 这辆车油耗低，开起来很省钱。

contact.example: Please contact me by phone if you have any questions about the plan.
contact.exampleZh: 如果你对这个计划有任何问题，请打电话联系我。

contain.example: This box contains old books and some letters from my family.
contain.exampleZh: 这个盒子里装着旧书和我家人的一些信件。

container.example: Please put the fresh fruit in this clean container and close it well.
container.exampleZh: 请把新鲜水果放进这个干净的容器里，并把它盖好。

contemporary.example: This museum shows contemporary art from many young artists.
contemporary.exampleZh: 这家博物馆展出许多年轻艺术家的当代艺术作品。

contend.example: Many small shops must contend with rising costs and strong competition.
contend.exampleZh: 许多小商店不得不应付不断上涨的成本和激烈的竞争。

content.example: She looked at the table of contents and felt content with her book.
content.exampleZh: 她看了看目录，对自己的书感到满意。

contest.example: She won the singing contest last year and will compete again.
contest.exampleZh: 她去年赢得了歌唱比赛，今年会再次参赛。

context.example: You can guess the word's meaning from the context of the sentence.
context.exampleZh: 你可以从句子上下文中猜出这个单词的意思。

continent.example: Africa is the second largest continent in the world.
continent.exampleZh: 非洲是世界上第二大的洲。

continual.example: The continual noise from the street makes it hard to sleep at night.
continual.exampleZh: 街上不断的噪音让人晚上很难入睡。

continue.example: We will continue to work on this project next week.
continue.exampleZh: 我们下周将继续做这个项目。

continuous.example: The machine makes a continuous noise all day long.
continuous.exampleZh: 这台机器整天发出连续不断的噪音。

contract.example: The company signed a new contract with a small local factory last week.
contract.exampleZh: 公司上周与一家当地小工厂签订了一份新合同。

contradict.example: His latest report seems to contradict what he told us last week.
contradict.exampleZh: 他最新的报告似乎与他上周告诉我们的内容相矛盾。

contradiction.example: There is a clear contradiction between what he says and what he does.
contradiction.exampleZh: 他说的和做之间存在明显的矛盾。

contrast.example: The contrast between the two pictures is easy to see.
contrast.exampleZh: 这两幅图之间的对比很容易看出来。

contribute.example: Many people contribute money to help poor children go to school.
contribute.exampleZh: 许多人捐钱帮助贫困儿童上学。

contribution.example: Everyone thanked her for her big contribution to the school.
contribution.exampleZh: 大家都感谢她对学校做出的巨大贡献。

control.example: The teacher could not control the noisy class for very long.
control.exampleZh: 老师很长时间都无法控制住这个吵闹的班级。

controversial.example: The new law is controversial because many people disagree with it.
controversial.exampleZh: 这项新法律很有争议，因为很多人不同意它。

controversy.example: The new school rules caused a lot of controversy among parents.
controversy.exampleZh: 新的校规在家长中引起了很多争论。

convenience.example: Please reply at your convenience, and thank you for your patience.
convenience.exampleZh: 请在您方便的时候回复，感谢您的耐心等待。

convenient.example: This small shop is very convenient for people who live nearby.
convenient.exampleZh: 这家小店对住在附近的人来说非常方便。

convention.example: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone new.
convention.exampleZh: 与人初次见面时握手是一种惯例。

conventional.example: She prefers conventional methods even when new tools are available.
conventional.exampleZh: 即使有新的工具可用，她还是更喜欢传统的方法。

conversation.example: I had a long conversation with my teacher after class today.
conversation.exampleZh: 今天下课后我和老师进行了一次长谈。

conversion.example: The old factory was closed for conversion into a modern art museum.
conversion.exampleZh: 那座旧工厂已关闭，将被改造成一座现代艺术博物馆。

convert.example: They plan to convert the old factory into a small library.
convert.exampleZh: 他们计划把这座旧工厂改造成一个小型图书馆。

convey.example: Her smile can convey more than a thousand words.
convey.exampleZh: 她的微笑能传达胜过千言万语的意思。

convict.example: The judge will convict him of theft and send him to prison.
convict.exampleZh: 法官将宣判他犯有盗窃罪并送他进监狱。

conviction.example: She spoke with great conviction about the need for change.
conviction.exampleZh: 她满怀坚定信念地谈到变革的必要性。

convince.example: He tried to convince me that the plan was safe.
convince.exampleZh: 他试图让我相信这个计划是安全的。

cook.example: My father likes to cook dinner for the family on Sundays, and he is a very good cook.
cook.exampleZh: 我爸爸喜欢在周日为家人做晚饭，他是一位很棒的厨师。

cookie.example: My little sister likes to eat a cookie with milk after school.
cookie.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢放学后一边喝牛奶一边吃饼干。

cool.example: The cool evening air made us feel calm and happy.
cool.exampleZh: 傍晚凉爽的空气让我们感到平静又愉快。

cooperate.example: We must cooperate with each other to finish this work on time.
cooperate.exampleZh: 我们必须互相合作，才能按时完成这项工作。

cooperation.example: Good cooperation between the two teams made the project much easier.
cooperation.exampleZh: 两个团队之间的良好合作让这个项目容易了很多。

cooperative.example: The two companies were very cooperative and finished the project together.
cooperative.exampleZh: 两家公司非常配合，一起完成了这个项目。

coordinate.example: She helped coordinate the team's work and shared the coordinates with everyone.
coordinate.exampleZh: 她帮助统筹团队的工作，并把坐标分享给了大家。

cop.example: The cop helped the lost child find his mother.
cop.exampleZh: 警察帮助走失的孩子找到了他的母亲。

cope.example: She finds it hard to cope with all the noise.
cope.exampleZh: 她觉得很难应付所有这些噪音。

copper.example: The old coin is made of copper and feels quite heavy.
copper.exampleZh: 这枚旧硬币是铜做的，摸起来相当重。

copy.example: Please make a copy of this page and give it to him.
copy.exampleZh: 请把这一页复印一份，然后交给他。

copyright.example: The writer owns the copyright to all of her books.
copyright.exampleZh: 这位作家拥有她所有书籍的版权。

cord.example: He tied the box with a strong cord and carried it home.
cord.exampleZh: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子捆好，然后搬回家。

core.example: The core of the problem is a lack of trust between the two teams.
core.exampleZh: 问题的核心是两支团队之间缺乏信任。

corn.example: The farmer grows corn and wheat in his fields every year.
corn.exampleZh: 这位农民每年都在田里种植玉米和小麦。

corner.example: There is a small shop at the corner of the street.

corporate.example: She works in a large corporate office in the city.
corporate.exampleZh: 她在城里一家大型公司办公室工作。

corporation.example: My father works for a large corporation that makes computer parts.
corporation.exampleZh: 我父亲在一家生产电脑零件的大公司工作。

correct.example: Please correct your answers before you give the paper to the teacher.
correct.exampleZh: 请把答案改正过来，再把试卷交给老师。

correction.example: The teacher made a small correction to my spelling test.
correction.exampleZh: 老师对我的拼写测试做了一处小修改。

correspond.example: Your words should correspond with your actions if you want people to trust you.
correspond.exampleZh: 如果你想让别人信任你，你的言语就应与行动一致。

correspondence.example: There is a close correspondence between what he says and what he does.
correspondence.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间有着密切的一致性。

corridor.example: She walked down the long corridor to reach her office.
corridor.exampleZh: 她沿着长长的走廊走到她的办公室。

corrupt.example: Bad friends can corrupt a young man and make him forget his dreams.
corrupt.exampleZh: 坏朋友会腐蚀一个年轻人，使他忘记自己的梦想。

corruption.example: The police caught the official and charged him with corruption.
corruption.exampleZh: 警方逮捕了这名官员，并指控他犯有贪污罪。

cost.example: The cost of the repair was higher than we expected.
cost.exampleZh: 这次维修的费用比我们预期的要高。

costly.example: That mistake was costly for the whole team last year.
costly.exampleZh: 那个错误去年让整个团队付出了很大代价。

costume.example: She wore a beautiful costume in the school play last night.
costume.exampleZh: 她昨晚在学校的话剧里穿了一套漂亮的戏服。

cottage.example: My grandmother lives in a small cottage near the lake.
cottage.exampleZh: 我奶奶住在湖边的一间小屋里。

cotton.example: This shirt is made of soft cotton and it feels very comfortable.
cotton.exampleZh: 这件衬衫是柔软棉布做的，穿着很舒服。

cough.example: He has a bad cough and needs to rest at home today.
cough.exampleZh: 他咳得很厉害，今天需要在家休息。

could.example: She said she could help us with the work tomorrow morning.
could.exampleZh: 她说她明天上午能帮我们做这项工作。

council.example: The city council voted to build a new park near our school.
council.exampleZh: 市议会投票决定在我们学校附近建一座新公园。

count.example: Please count the books on the desk and tell me the total number.
count.exampleZh: 请数一下桌子上的书，然后告诉我总数。

counter.example: She put the bag on the counter and paid for it.
counter.exampleZh: 她把包放在柜台上，然后付了钱。

counterpart.example: The minister met her counterpart from Japan to discuss trade.
counterpart.exampleZh: 这位部长会见了她的日本同行，讨论贸易问题。

country.example: My country is very big and has many kind people.
country.exampleZh: 我的国家很大，有很多善良的人。

countryside.example: My grandparents live in the countryside and grow their own vegetables.
countryside.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在乡下，自己种蔬菜。

county.example: She lives in a small county near the river and teaches at the local school.
county.exampleZh: 她住在河边的一个小县里，在当地学校教书。

couple.example: A young couple walked into the store and bought a pair of shoes.
couple.exampleZh: 一对年轻夫妇走进商店，买了一双鞋。

courage.example: She showed great courage when she spoke the truth in front of everyone.
courage.exampleZh: 她在众人面前说出真相时表现出了极大的勇气。

course.example: This course teaches students how to write simple English stories.
course.exampleZh: 这门课程教学生如何写简单的英语故事。

court.example: The young man went to court to ask the judge for help.
court.exampleZh: 那个年轻人去法院请求法官的帮助。

courtyard.example: The children are playing games in the courtyard behind the old house.
courtyard.exampleZh: 孩子们正在老房子后面的庭院里玩游戏。

cousin.example: My cousin lives in another city and visits us every summer.
cousin.exampleZh: 我的表弟住在另一个城市，每年夏天都来看我们。

cover.example: The reporter will cover the story and write a cover article.
cover.exampleZh: 记者将报道这件事并撰写一篇封面文章。

coverage.example: The reporter's coverage of the flood helped many people understand the danger.
coverage.exampleZh: 记者对洪灾的报道帮助很多人了解了危险。

cow.example: The farmer milks his cow every morning before the sun rises.
cow.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上在太阳升起前给母牛挤奶。

coward.example: Everyone called him a coward because he ran away from the fight.
coward.exampleZh: 大家都叫他懦夫，因为他从打斗中逃跑了。

crack.example: The cup fell and cracked on the hard floor.
crack.exampleZh: 杯子掉下来，在硬地板上裂开了。

craft.example: She learned the craft from her father and now makes beautiful wooden chairs.
craft.exampleZh: 她从父亲那里学会了这门手艺，现在制作漂亮的木椅。

crane.example: The crane lifted the heavy box onto the truck.
crane.exampleZh: 起重机把那个沉重的箱子吊到了卡车上。

crash.example: The old truck crashed into a tree near our small town last night.
crash.exampleZh: 昨晚那辆旧卡车在我们小镇附近撞上了一棵树。

crass.example: His crass joke made everyone at the dinner table uncomfortable.
crass.exampleZh: 他那粗鲁的玩笑让餐桌上的每个人都感到不自在。

crazy.example: My crazy neighbor sings loudly on his roof every morning.
crazy.exampleZh: 我那古怪的邻居每天早上都在屋顶上大声唱歌。

cream.example: She likes to put fresh cream in her morning coffee.
cream.exampleZh: 她喜欢在早晨的咖啡里加新鲜奶油。

create.example: She wants to create a small garden behind her new house.
create.exampleZh: 她想在自己的新房子后面建一个小花园。

creation.example: The creation of this beautiful garden took many years of hard work.
creation.exampleZh: 这座美丽花园的创造花了许多年的辛勤劳动。

creative.example: She has a creative mind and often finds new ways to solve problems.
creative.exampleZh: 她有一个富有创造力的头脑，常常能找到解决问题的新方法。

creature.example: This small creature lives in the water and eats tiny plants.
creature.exampleZh: 这种小生物生活在水里，吃微小的植物。

credit.example: The bank gave him credit for his honesty and hard work.
credit.exampleZh: 银行因为他的诚实和勤奋而给予他信用。

creep.example: The cat began to creep slowly toward the bird.
creep.exampleZh: 那只猫开始慢慢向那只鸟爬去。

crew.example: The whole crew worked together to keep the ship safe during the storm.
crew.exampleZh: 全体船员齐心协力，在暴风雨中保障了船只的安全。

cricket.example: The children played cricket in the park after school yesterday.
cricket.exampleZh: 孩子们昨天放学后在公园里打板球。

crime.example: The police are working hard to stop crime in this city.
crime.exampleZh: 警方正在努力阻止这座城市的犯罪。

criminal.example: The police caught the criminal near the bank last night.
criminal.exampleZh: 警方昨晚在银行附近抓住了那名罪犯。

crisis.example: The company is in a serious crisis and needs help now.
crisis.exampleZh: 这家公司正处于严重的危机之中，现在需要帮助。

critic.example: The critic wrote a short review of the new film.
critic.exampleZh: 这位评论家为这部新电影写了一篇简短的评论。

critical.example: This is a critical moment for our small team.
critical.exampleZh: 对我们这个小组来说，这是一个关键时刻。

criticism.example: The new plan received harsh criticism from local teachers.
criticism.exampleZh: 这项新计划受到了当地教师的严厉批评。

criticize.example: My teacher criticized my essay but also showed me how to improve it.
criticize.exampleZh: 老师批评了我的作文，但也告诉我该如何改进。

crop.example: The farmer grows a different crop in this field every year.
crop.exampleZh: 这位农民每年都在这块地里种不同的作物。

cross.example: Look both ways before you cross the busy street near your school.
cross.exampleZh: 在你学校附近穿过那条繁忙的街道之前，要先朝两边看。

crowd.example: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the street performers.
crowd.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看街头艺人的表演。

crown.example: The queen wore a beautiful gold crown on her head.
crown.exampleZh: 女王头上戴着一顶美丽的金王冠。

crucial.example: Getting enough sleep is crucial for students before a big exam.
crucial.exampleZh: 大考前，充足睡眠对学生至关重要。

crude.example: The table was made of crude wood and looked very rough.
crude.exampleZh: 这张桌子是用未加工的木头做的，看起来很粗糙。

cruel.example: It was cruel of him to laugh at the crying child.
cruel.exampleZh: 他嘲笑那个哭泣的孩子，真是太残忍了。

cruise.example: We plan to cruise along the river next summer.
cruise.exampleZh: 我们打算明年夏天乘船沿河游览。

crush.example: The old machine can crush rocks into small pieces in seconds.
crush.exampleZh: 这台旧机器能在几秒钟内把石头压碎成小块。

crust.example: The bread was soft inside but had a hard crust outside.
crust.exampleZh: 这块面包里面很软，但外面有一层硬皮。

cry.example: The little girl began to cry when her toy fell on the floor.
cry.exampleZh: 小女孩的玩具掉到地上时，她开始哭了起来。

crystal.example: She keeps a small crystal on her desk because it looks beautiful.
crystal.exampleZh: 她在书桌上放着一个小水晶，因为它看起来很漂亮。

cube.example: The teacher asked us to draw a cube on the paper.
cube.exampleZh: 老师让我们在纸上画一个立方体。

cue.example: Her quiet smile was a cue for the actors to begin the scene.
cue.exampleZh: 她安静的微笑是演员们开始这场戏的提示。

cultivate.example: Farmers cultivate rice in these fields every spring.
cultivate.exampleZh: 农民每年春天在这些田里种植水稻。

cultural.example: She enjoys learning about cultural differences between countries.
cultural.exampleZh: 她喜欢了解各国之间的文化差异。

culture.example: Learning a new language helps you understand another culture.
culture.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言有助于你了解另一种文化。

cup.example: She poured a cup of hot tea for her guest.
cup.exampleZh: 她给客人倒了一杯热茶。

cupboard.example: The cups and plates are in the cupboard next to the door.
cupboard.exampleZh: 杯子和盘子在门边的橱柜里。

cure.example: The new doctor hopes to cure her bad cough soon.
cure.exampleZh: 这位新医生希望很快治好她的严重咳嗽。

curiosity.example: Her curiosity about the old house made her open the door.
curiosity.exampleZh: 她对那栋老房子的好奇心促使她打开了门。

curious.example: The curious child asked many questions about the stars.
curious.exampleZh: 那个好奇的孩子问了很多关于星星的问题。

currency.example: The currency of this small country is strong this year.
currency.exampleZh: 这个小国的货币今年很坚挺。

current.example: The current plan is simple, and the whole team agrees with it.
current.exampleZh: 当前的计划很简单，整个团队都同意。

curriculum.example: The school has a new curriculum for all students this year.
curriculum.exampleZh: 学校今年为所有学生制定了新的课程。

curse.example: He was so angry that he began to curse loudly at everyone.
curse.exampleZh: 他非常生气，开始对大家大声咒骂。

curtain.example: She opened the curtain to let the morning sun into the room.
curtain.exampleZh: 她拉开窗帘，让早晨的阳光照进房间。

curve.example: The road curves gently to the left after the small bridge.
curve.exampleZh: 过了那座小桥后，道路缓缓向左弯曲。

cushion.example: She put a soft cushion behind her back before reading.
cushion.exampleZh: 她看书之前在背后放了一个软靠垫。

custom.example: It is a custom to give gifts at Chinese New Year.
custom.exampleZh: 在中国新年送礼是一种习俗。

customer.example: The customer asked the shop owner for a cheaper price.
customer.exampleZh: 这位顾客向店主询问能否便宜一点。

cut.example: Please cut the cake into small pieces for the children.
cut.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕切成小块给孩子们。

cycle.example: The water cycle brings rain to the land again and again.
cycle.exampleZh: 水循环一次又一次地把雨水带到陆地上。

dairy.example: We buy milk and cheese at the dairy near our house.
dairy.exampleZh: 我们在家附近的乳品店买牛奶和奶酪。

dam.example: They built a dam across the river to store water for the dry season.
dam.exampleZh: 他们在河上筑了一座水坝，蓄水以备旱季之用。

damage.example: The storm caused serious damage to many houses in the small town.
damage.exampleZh: 这场风暴给小城里的许多房屋造成了严重损坏。

damn.example: I do not give a damn about what he said yesterday.
damn.exampleZh: 我一点也不在乎他昨天说了什么。

damp.example: The walls of the old room felt damp after the rain.
damp.exampleZh: 雨后那个旧房间的墙壁摸起来很潮湿。

dance.example: She likes to dance with her friends at the party.
dance.exampleZh: 她喜欢在聚会上和朋友们跳舞。

danger.example: The sign warns people of danger near the deep water.
danger.exampleZh: 这个标志提醒人们注意深水附近的危险。

dare.example: He did not dare to tell his parents about the bad grade.
dare.exampleZh: 他不敢把糟糕的成绩告诉父母。

dark.example: The room is dark, so please turn on the light.

darling.example: She is the darling of the whole family and everyone loves her.
darling.exampleZh: 她是全家的心肝宝贝，每个人都爱她。

dash.example: She made a dash for the bus and got there just in time.
dash.exampleZh: 她向公交车猛冲过去，刚好及时赶到。

data.example: The scientists looked at the data and found a clear pattern.
data.exampleZh: 科学家们查看了数据，发现了一个清晰的规律。

database.example: The company keeps all customer records in a large database.
database.exampleZh: 公司把所有客户记录保存在一个大型数据库中。

date.example: Please write the date on your paper, and we can plan a date this Friday.
date.exampleZh: 请在试卷上写上日期，我们可以约这个星期五见个面。

dawn.example: The new day began at dawn with birds singing outside my window.
dawn.exampleZh: 新的一天随着窗外的鸟鸣在黎明时分开始了。

daylight.example: The room is bright because daylight comes in through the big window.
daylight.exampleZh: 房间很明亮，因为日光从大窗户照进来。

dazzle.example: The bright lights of the city dazzle him every time he visits.
dazzle.exampleZh: 每次到访，城市的明亮灯光都让他目眩。

dead.example: The old tree in our garden is dead, so we will cut it down.
dead.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树已经死了，所以我们要把它砍掉。

deadline.example: Please finish the report before the deadline on Friday.
deadline.exampleZh: 请在周五的截止日期前完成这份报告。

deadly.example: This snake has a deadly bite, so stay away from it.
deadly.exampleZh: 这条蛇的咬伤是致命的，所以要远离它。

deaf.example: The old man is deaf, so we write notes to talk with him.
deaf.exampleZh: 那位老人耳朵聋了，所以我们写字条和他交流。

deal.example: We need to deal with this problem before the meeting starts.
deal.exampleZh: 我们需要在会议开始前处理这个问题。

dealer.example: The dealer sells used cars at a fair price.
dealer.exampleZh: 这位经销商以公道的价格出售二手车。

dean.example: The dean of our college gave a short speech to all the new students.
dean.exampleZh: 我们学院的院长向所有新生作了简短的讲话。

dear.example: Oh dear, that is a very expensive bag, my dear friend.
dear.exampleZh: 哎呀，那是一个很昂贵的包，我亲爱的朋友。

death.example: His death made everyone in the small village very sad.
death.exampleZh: 他的死让这个小村庄里的每个人都十分悲伤。

debate.example: The two students had a long debate about their school rules.
debate.exampleZh: 两名学生就校规展开了长时间的辩论。

debt.example: He worked two jobs to pay off his debt.
debt.exampleZh: 他打两份工来还清他的债务。

debut.example: Her debut on the big stage made her family very proud.
debut.exampleZh: 她在大舞台上的首次亮相让家人非常自豪。

decade.example: The town has changed a lot over the past decade.
decade.exampleZh: 过去十年里，这个小镇发生了很大变化。

decay.example: Without water, the old fruit will decay quickly and start to smell bad.
decay.exampleZh: 没有水，旧水果会很快腐烂并开始发出难闻的气味。

deceive.example: He tried to deceive his friends about the broken window.
deceive.exampleZh: 他试图就打破窗户的事欺骗朋友们。

decent.example: He is a decent man who always helps his friends.
decent.exampleZh: 他是一个体面的人，总是帮助他的朋友。

decide.example: We must decide where to go for the summer holiday.
decide.exampleZh: 我们必须决定暑假去哪里。

decimal.example: The teacher told us to write the answer as a decimal and not a fraction.
decimal.exampleZh: 老师让我们把答案写成小数而不是分数。

decision.example: She made a quick decision to leave the party early.
decision.exampleZh: 她很快决定提前离开聚会。

decisive.example: Her decisive answer ended the long discussion and everyone agreed with her.
decisive.exampleZh: 她果断的回答结束了漫长的讨论，大家都同意她的意见。

declaration.example: The two countries signed a joint declaration to protect the river.
declaration.exampleZh: 两国签署了一份联合宣言，以保护这条河流。

declare.example: The company will declare its earnings next week.
declare.exampleZh: 公司将在下周公布其收益。

decline.example: Sales began to decline slowly after the summer, so the shop cut its prices.
decline.exampleZh: 夏天过后销量开始缓慢下降，所以这家店降低了价格。

decorate.example: We will decorate the classroom with colorful paper flowers for the party.
decorate.exampleZh: 我们会用彩色的纸花装饰教室，为聚会做准备。

decorative.example: The decorative pillows on the bed make the room look warm.
decorative.exampleZh: 床上那些装饰性的抱枕让房间看起来很温馨。

decrease.example: The number of students in our class began to decrease last year.
decrease.exampleZh: 我们班的学生人数去年开始减少。

dedicate.example: She decided to dedicate her free time to helping the poor children.
dedicate.exampleZh: 她决定把空闲时间奉献给帮助那些贫困的孩子。

deduce.example: From these clues we can deduce what happened last night.
deduce.exampleZh: 根据这些线索，我们可以推断出昨晚发生了什么。

deduct.example: The company will deduct the tax from your monthly pay.
deduct.exampleZh: 公司会从你的月薪中扣除税款。

deed.example: His kind deed helped the old man get home safely.
deed.exampleZh: 他的善举帮助那位老人安全回到了家。

deem.example: Many people deem this book a classic of modern literature.
deem.exampleZh: 许多人认为这本书是现代文学的经典之作。

deep.example: The lake is very deep, so we cannot see the bottom.
deep.exampleZh: 这个湖很深，所以我们看不到湖底。

deer.example: We saw a young deer drinking water by the quiet river.
deer.exampleZh: 我们看到一只小鹿在安静的河边喝水。

default.example: He lost the game by default because he did not show up.
default.exampleZh: 他因为没到场而默认输掉了比赛。

defeat.example: Our team worked hard and defeat the strong rival in the final game.
defeat.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，在决赛中击败了强大的对手。

defect.example: He found a small defect in the new phone and decided not to buy it.
defect.exampleZh: 他在新手机里发现了一个小缺点，于是决定不买了。

defective.example: This old phone is defective and cannot be used at all.
defective.exampleZh: 这部旧手机有缺陷，根本不能用。

defend.example: The soldiers fought bravely to defend their city from the enemy.
defend.exampleZh: 士兵们英勇作战，保卫他们的城市免受敌人侵犯。

defendant.example: The defendant stood quietly in court while the judge read the charges.
defendant.exampleZh: 法官宣读指控时，被告安静地站在法庭上。

defense.example: The team built a strong defense before the big game.
defense.exampleZh: 球队在重要比赛前建立了强有力的防御。

defer.example: We will defer the meeting until next week.
defer.exampleZh: 我们将把会议推迟到下周。

defiance.example: His quiet defiance surprised everyone at the meeting.
defiance.exampleZh: 他默默的违抗让会上的每个人都很惊讶。

deficiency.example: A deficiency of vitamin C can make you feel tired and weak.
deficiency.exampleZh: 缺乏维生素C会让你感到疲倦和虚弱。

deficient.example: The soil here is deficient in nitrogen, so plants grow very slowly.
deficient.exampleZh: 这里的土壤缺乏氮元素，所以植物生长得非常缓慢。

deficit.example: The country has a large trade deficit this year.
deficit.exampleZh: 该国今年的贸易逆差很大。

define.example: The teacher asked us to define the new word in our own words.
define.exampleZh: 老师让我们用自己的话定义这个新单词。

definite.example: We need a definite answer before we make the final plan.
definite.exampleZh: 在制定最终计划之前，我们需要一个明确的答复。

definitely.example: I will definitely come to your party on Saturday night.
definitely.exampleZh: 我星期六晚上一定会来参加你的聚会。

definition.example: The teacher gave a clear definition of the new word for us.
definition.exampleZh: 老师为我们清楚地解释了这个新词的定义。

definitive.example: This book is the definitive guide to modern English grammar.
definitive.exampleZh: 这本书是现代英语语法的权威指南。

deform.example: The strong wind began to deform the thin metal roof.
deform.exampleZh: 强风开始使薄金属屋顶变形。

defy.example: The boy chose to defy his parents and stay out late.
defy.exampleZh: 那个男孩选择违抗父母，在外面待到很晚。

degrade.example: Plastic bags can degrade slowly in the soil over many years.
degrade.exampleZh: 塑料袋在土壤中需要很多年才能慢慢降解。

degree.example: The degree of damage to the old house was not very serious.
degree.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的损坏程度并不十分严重。

delay.example: The heavy rain may delay our flight by two hours.
delay.exampleZh: 大雨可能会使我们的航班延误两个小时。

delegate.example: The manager will delegate the task to a team member.
delegate.exampleZh: 经理会把这项任务委派给一名团队成员。

delegation.example: The manager sent a small delegation to the meeting in Tokyo.
delegation.exampleZh: 经理派了一个小型代表团去东京参加会议。

delete.example: Please delete the old files before you save the new ones.
delete.exampleZh: 请在保存新文件之前删除旧文件。

deliberate.example: The mistake was not an accident but a deliberate choice.
deliberate.exampleZh: 这个错误不是意外，而是蓄意的选择。

deliberately.example: She deliberately left the window open before she went to work.
deliberately.exampleZh: 她故意在去上班前把窗户开着。

delicate.example: The delicate glass vase broke when it fell off the table.
delicate.exampleZh: 那个精致的玻璃花瓶从桌上掉下来时摔碎了。

delicious.example: This soup is delicious and my whole family loves it.
delicious.exampleZh: 这汤很美味，我们全家都喜欢。

delight.example: It is a great delight to see my old friends again.
delight.exampleZh: 再次见到我的老朋友们真是一件非常高兴的事。

deliver.example: The doctor will deliver the baby early tomorrow morning.
deliver.exampleZh: 医生明天一早会接生这个婴儿。

delivery.example: The delivery of the package arrived early this morning.
delivery.exampleZh: 包裹的递送今天一早到达了。

demand.example: Many customers demand better service and lower prices from this small shop.
demand.exampleZh: 许多顾客要求这家小店铺提供更好的服务和更低的价格。

democracy.example: In a democracy, people can choose their leaders by voting.
democracy.exampleZh: 在民主制度下，人们可以通过投票来选择领导人。

democratic.example: The country held a democratic election and everyone voted freely.
democratic.exampleZh: 这个国家举行了民主选举，每个人都自由投票。

demolish.example: They plan to demolish the old building next to our school.
demolish.exampleZh: 他们计划拆除我们学校旁边的那栋旧楼。

demonstrate.example: The teacher will demonstrate the experiment to the whole class.
demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师将向全班演示这个实验。

denial.example: His denial of the mistake made everyone even more angry.
denial.exampleZh: 他否认犯错，这让大家更加生气。

dense.example: The forest is very dense, so few animals can walk through it easily.
dense.exampleZh: 这片森林非常密集，所以很少有动物能轻松穿过。

density.example: The density of this wood is low, so it floats easily.
density.exampleZh: 这种木头的密度很低，所以很容易浮起来。

dental.example: I have a dental appointment tomorrow morning at the clinic near my house.
dental.exampleZh: 我明天上午在我家附近的诊所有一个牙科预约。

deny.example: She did not deny the mistake and said sorry to us.
deny.exampleZh: 她没有否认这个错误，并向我们道了歉。

depart.example: We depart for the airport at six tomorrow morning.
depart.exampleZh: 我们明天早上六点出发去机场。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a small company.
department.exampleZh: 她在一家小公司的销售部门工作。

departure.example: His sudden departure from the meeting surprised everyone in the room.
departure.exampleZh: 他突然离开会议，让房间里所有人都感到惊讶。

depend.example: Many small shops depend on local customers for their daily sales.
depend.exampleZh: 许多小商店的日常销售依靠当地顾客。

dependent.example: Young children are dependent on their parents for food and care.
dependent.exampleZh: 幼儿在食物和照料上依赖父母。

depict.example: The painting depicts a small village beside a quiet river.
depict.exampleZh: 这幅画描绘了一个安静河边的小村庄。

deplore.example: Many people deplore the waste of food in rich countries.
deplore.exampleZh: 许多人谴责富裕国家浪费食物的行为。

deploy.example: The company will deploy new software next week.
deploy.exampleZh: 公司下周将部署新软件。

deposit.example: You need to pay a deposit before you can move into the apartment.
deposit.exampleZh: 你需要先付一笔押金，然后才能搬进这间公寓。

deprecate.example: Many teachers deprecate the use of phones during class.
deprecate.exampleZh: 许多老师不赞成在课堂上使用手机。

depress.example: The rainy weather and bad news began to depress everyone in the small office.
depress.exampleZh: 阴雨的天气和坏消息开始让小办公室里的每个人都感到沮丧。

depression.example: He stayed home for months because of his depression.
depression.exampleZh: 因为抑郁，他在家待了好几个月。

deprive.example: The new law may deprive many poor families of their homes.
deprive.exampleZh: 新法律可能会剥夺许多贫困家庭的住房。

depth.example: The depth of the lake surprised the children on the boat.
depth.exampleZh: 湖水的深度让船上的孩子们感到惊讶。

deputy.example: The manager sent his deputy to the meeting in his place.
deputy.exampleZh: 经理派他的副手代替他去参加会议。

derivative.example: This painting is a derivative of an older famous work.
derivative.exampleZh: 这幅画是一幅较早著名作品的派生作品。

derive.example: Many English words derive from Latin and Greek.
derive.exampleZh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和希腊语。

descend.example: The plane will descend slowly before it lands on the runway.
descend.exampleZh: 飞机在跑道上降落前会缓慢下降。

descendant.example: She is a direct descendant of a famous king.
descendant.exampleZh: 她是一位著名国王的直系后裔。

describe.example: Can you describe the man you saw last night?
describe.exampleZh: 你能描述一下你昨晚看到的那个男人吗？

description.example: This book gives a clear description of life in a small town.
description.exampleZh: 这本书清楚地描述了一个小镇上的生活。

desert.example: Long ago, he deserted his small village and walked into the hot desert alone.
desert.exampleZh: 很久以前，他抛弃了自己的小村庄，独自走进了炎热的沙漠。

deserve.example: Good teachers deserve respect from all their students.
deserve.exampleZh: 好老师值得所有学生的尊重。

design.example: She will design a small garden for her new house.
design.exampleZh: 她将为她的新房子设计一个小花园。

designate.example: The teacher will designate one student to lead the group today.
designate.exampleZh: 老师今天会指定一名学生来带领小组。

desirable.example: A quiet room is desirable when you need to study for an exam.
desirable.exampleZh: 当你需要为考试复习时，安静的房间是可取的。

desire.example: She has a strong desire to learn English well and travel the world.
desire.exampleZh: 她有一个强烈的愿望，就是学好英语并环游世界。

desk.example: There are some books and a lamp on my desk.
desk.exampleZh: 我的书桌上有一些书和一盏台灯。

desperate.example: The lost dog was desperate to find its way home.
desperate.exampleZh: 那只迷路的狗拼命想找到回家的路。

despise.example: I despise people who are rude to waiters and cleaners.
despise.exampleZh: 我鄙视那些对服务员和清洁工粗鲁无礼的人。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, the children played outside all afternoon.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，孩子们还是在外面玩了一整个下午。

dessert.example: We had ice cream for dessert after dinner last night.
dessert.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

destination.example: We finally reached our destination after a long bus ride.
destination.exampleZh: 经过长途巴士旅程，我们终于到达了目的地。

destined.example: She was destined to become a great teacher one day.
destined.exampleZh: 她注定有一天会成为一位伟大的老师。

destiny.example: She believed her destiny was to become a doctor and help others.
destiny.exampleZh: 她相信自己的命运是成为一名医生并帮助他人。

destroy.example: The fire destroyed the old house in just one hour.
destroy.exampleZh: 大火仅用一个小时就烧毁了那座老房子。

destruction.example: The storm caused great destruction in the small town near the sea.
destruction.exampleZh: 这场风暴给海边的小镇造成了巨大的破坏。

destructive.example: The storm was very destructive and damaged many houses in the small town.
destructive.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨破坏性很强，损坏了小镇上的许多房屋。

detach.example: Please detach the old page from the book and give it to me.
detach.exampleZh: 请把那页旧纸从书上撕下来，然后交给我。

detail.example: Please give me more detail about the plan for next week.
detail.exampleZh: 请多告诉我一些关于下周计划的细节。

detect.example: She could detect a strange smell coming from the old kitchen.
detect.exampleZh: 她能察觉到从旧厨房里传来的一股怪味。

detection.example: Early detection of the disease can save many lives.
detection.exampleZh: 及早察觉这种疾病可以挽救许多生命。

detective.example: The detective looked carefully at the old house and found a clue.
detective.exampleZh: 侦探仔细查看了那座老房子，并找到了一条线索。

deteriorate.example: Without clean water, people's health can deteriorate very quickly.
deteriorate.exampleZh: 如果没有干净的水，人们的健康会很快恶化。

determination.example: Her determination helped her finish the difficult race.
determination.exampleZh: 她的决心帮助她完成了那场艰难的比赛。

determine.example: We need to determine the cause of the problem before we fix it.
determine.exampleZh: 在解决问题之前，我们需要查明原因。

develop.example: The small town has developed into a busy city over the years.
develop.exampleZh: 这个小镇多年来已经发展成了一座繁忙的城市。

development.example: The development of this small town has brought many new jobs.
development.exampleZh: 这个小镇的发展带来了许多新的工作机会。

deviate.example: Small changes can make a plane deviate from its planned route.
deviate.exampleZh: 微小的变化就可能让飞机偏离计划航线。

device.example: This device helps me turn on the lights with my voice.
device.exampleZh: 这个装置可以让我用声音开灯。

devise.example: The team devised a simple plan to finish the work on time.
devise.exampleZh: 团队想出了一个简单的计划，以便按时完成工作。

devote.example: She devotes much time to helping students learn English well.
devote.exampleZh: 她把大量时间投入到帮助学生学好英语上。

devotion.example: Her devotion to her family is strong and never changes.
devotion.exampleZh: 她对家庭的奉献很坚定，从未改变。

devour.example: The hungry boy devoured his dinner in five minutes.
devour.exampleZh: 那个饥饿的男孩五分钟就吞下了他的晚饭。

diagnose.example: The doctor could not diagnose the cause of her pain.
diagnose.exampleZh: 医生无法诊断出她疼痛的原因。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram to show how water moves through plants.
diagram.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的示意图，展示水是如何在植物中流动的。

dial.example: He turned the dial to start the washing machine.
dial.exampleZh: 他转动旋钮来启动洗衣机。

diameter.example: The circle has a diameter of ten centimeters.
diameter.exampleZh: 这个圆的直径是十厘米。

diamond.example: She wore a small diamond ring on her finger at the party.
diamond.exampleZh: 她在聚会上手指上戴着一枚小钻石戒指。

diary.example: I write in my diary every night before I go to bed.
diary.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会写日记。

dictate.example: The teacher dictated the new words to the class this morning.
dictate.exampleZh: 老师今天早上给全班口授了新单词。

dictation.example: Our teacher gives us a short dictation every Friday morning.
dictation.exampleZh: 我们老师每周五早上给我们做一次短听写。

dictionary.example: I always use a dictionary when I find a new word.
dictionary.exampleZh: 当我遇到一个新单词时，我总是用词典。

die.example: He did not want to die young, so he saw a doctor.
die.exampleZh: 他不想英年早逝，所以去看了医生。

diet.example: A healthy diet with fresh vegetables helps you stay strong and full of energy.
diet.exampleZh: 含有新鲜蔬菜的健康饮食能帮助你保持强壮和精力充沛。

differ.example: My answer may differ from yours, but we can still be friends.
differ.exampleZh: 我的答案可能和你的不同，但我们仍然可以做朋友。

difference.example: There is a big difference between the two answers.
difference.exampleZh: 这两个答案之间有很大的差异。

different.example: My brother and I have different hobbies, but we still play together every day.
different.exampleZh: 我弟弟和我有不同的爱好，但我们仍然每天一起玩。

differentiate.example: Teachers help students differentiate between facts and opinions in class.
differentiate.exampleZh: 老师在课堂上帮助学生区分事实和观点。

difficult.example: This math problem is difficult, but I will not give up today.
difficult.exampleZh: 这道数学题很难，但今天我也不会放弃。

difficulty.example: She had great difficulty finding the right answer to that simple question.
difficulty.exampleZh: 她费了很大劲才为那个简单的问题找到正确答案。

dig.example: They dig a hole in the garden to plant a small tree.
dig.exampleZh: 他们在花园里挖了一个坑来种一棵小树。

digest.example: It takes time to digest this long article about healthy food.
digest.exampleZh: 理解这篇关于健康食物的长文章需要时间。

digital.example: Many students use digital books instead of paper books in class now.
digital.exampleZh: 现在许多学生在课堂上使用数字书籍而不是纸质书。

dignity.example: She kept her dignity even when life became very hard.
dignity.exampleZh: 即使生活变得非常艰难，她依然保持着尊严。

dilemma.example: She faced a dilemma when both job offers arrived on the same day.
dilemma.exampleZh: 当两个工作邀请在同一天到来时，她陷入了进退两难的困境。

diligent.example: She is a diligent student who always finishes her homework before dinner.
diligent.exampleZh: 她是个勤奋的学生，总是在晚饭前完成作业。

dilute.example: Please dilute the juice with water so it is not too sweet for children.
dilute.exampleZh: 请用水把果汁稀释一下，这样对孩子来说就不会太甜了。

dim.example: The room was dim, so we turned on a light.
dim.exampleZh: 房间很昏暗，所以我们打开了一盏灯。

dimension.example: This problem has another dimension that we have not discussed yet.
dimension.exampleZh: 这个问题还有一个我们尚未讨论的方面。

diminish.example: The noise began to diminish after the last train left the station.
diminish.exampleZh: 最后一班火车离站后，噪音开始减弱。

dip.example: The bird dipped its beak into the water and drank quickly.
dip.exampleZh: 那只鸟把喙浸入水中，很快喝起水来。

diplomatic.example: She gave a diplomatic answer so that nobody in the room felt upset.
diplomatic.exampleZh: 她给出了一个圆滑的回答，让房间里没有人感到不快。

direct.example: She gave me a direct answer to my simple question.
direct.exampleZh: 她对我简单的问题给出了直接的回答。

direction.example: Please read the directions on the box before you take the medicine.
direction.exampleZh: 请先阅读盒子上的用法说明，然后再服药。

directly.example: The train goes directly to the airport, so we will arrive quickly.
directly.exampleZh: 这趟火车直达机场，所以我们会很快到达。

director.example: The director of the film spoke to the students after the show.
director.exampleZh: 电影导演在演出结束后和学生们讲话。

directory.example: I found his phone number in the school directory.
directory.exampleZh: 我在学校名录里找到了他的电话号码。

dirt.example: After the long walk, my shoes were covered with dirt and mud.
dirt.exampleZh: 走了很长的路之后，我的鞋上沾满了污物和泥。

dirty.example: His dirty shoes made the whole floor look bad.
dirty.exampleZh: 他脏兮兮的鞋子让整个地板都显得很糟。

disable.example: A bad accident can disable a person for life.
disable.exampleZh: 一场严重的事故可能使人终身丧失能力。

disadvantage.example: One big disadvantage of this old phone is its very short battery life.
disadvantage.exampleZh: 这部旧手机的一大缺点是电池续航时间很短。

disagree.example: I often disagree with my brother about which movie to watch.
disagree.exampleZh: 我经常和弟弟在看哪部电影上意见不一致。

disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds and the sky turned dark.
disappear.exampleZh: 太阳消失在云层后面，天空变暗了。

disappoint.example: I hope my bad grade does not disappoint my parents too much.
disappoint.exampleZh: 我希望我的糟糕成绩不会让父母太失望。

disaster.example: The flood was a terrible disaster for everyone in the small village.
disaster.exampleZh: 这场洪水对这个小村庄的每个人来说都是一场可怕的灾难。

disastrous.example: The heavy rain had a disastrous effect on our small farm.
disastrous.exampleZh: 这场大雨对我们的小农场造成了灾难性的影响。

discard.example: Please discard the old newspapers and keep the new magazines.
discard.exampleZh: 请丢弃旧报纸，保留新杂志。

discern.example: It is hard to discern the truth from all these conflicting stories.
discern.exampleZh: 很难从这些互相矛盾的说法中辨别出真相。

discharge.example: The factory must not discharge dirty water into the river.
discharge.exampleZh: 工厂不得将污水排放到河里。

discipline.example: Good discipline helps students learn better in every school subject.
discipline.exampleZh: 良好的纪律有助于学生在每门学科中学得更好。

disclose.example: The company refused to disclose the names of its new investors.
disclose.exampleZh: 公司拒绝透露新投资者的姓名。

discount.example: The store gives a small discount to students on every book.
discount.exampleZh: 这家书店每本书都给学生们一点小折扣。

discourage.example: Bad weather may discourage some students from going to school.
discourage.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气可能会使一些学生不愿意去上学。

discourse.example: Her discourse on climate change was clear and easy to follow.
discourse.exampleZh: 她关于气候变化的论述清晰易懂。

discover.example: We discover new things when we read books and ask questions.
discover.exampleZh: 当我们读书和提问时，我们会发现新事物。

discovery.example: This discovery changed the way we think about the stars.
discovery.exampleZh: 这一发现改变了我们对恒星的看法。

discreet.example: Please be discreet about this private matter and do not tell others.
discreet.exampleZh: 请对这件私事谨慎一些，不要告诉其他人。

discrepancy.example: There is a big discrepancy between the two reports.
discrepancy.exampleZh: 这两份报告之间存在很大的差异。

discriminate.example: We must not discriminate against people because of their skin color.
discriminate.exampleZh: 我们不能因为肤色而歧视他人。

discuss.example: We often discuss our weekend plans at lunch.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们经常在午餐时讨论周末的计划。

disease.example: The doctor said his disease is serious, so he must stay in the hospital.
disease.exampleZh: 医生说他的病很严重，所以他必须住院。

disgrace.example: His rude behavior in the meeting brought disgrace to the whole team.
disgrace.exampleZh: 他在会议上的粗鲁行为让整个团队蒙羞。

disguise.example: He tried to disguise his voice on the phone, but I knew him.
disguise.exampleZh: 他在电话里试图伪装自己的声音，但我认出了他。

disgust.example: The smell of old food filled her with disgust.
disgust.exampleZh: 陈旧食物的气味让她充满厌恶。

dish.example: She put the hot dish on the table and smiled at us.
dish.exampleZh: 她把热菜放在桌上，冲我们笑了笑。

dishonest.example: The dishonest man lied about the money he took.
dishonest.exampleZh: 那个不诚实的男人对他拿走的钱撒了谎。

disk.example: He saved all the photos on a small disk.
disk.exampleZh: 他把所有照片都保存在一张小磁盘上。

dislike.example: I really dislike getting up early on cold winter mornings.
dislike.exampleZh: 我真的很不喜欢在寒冷的冬日清晨早起。

dismiss.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers because the factory was losing money.
dismiss.exampleZh: 经理决定解雇两名工人，因为工厂正在亏损。

disorder.example: The heavy rain caused a lot of disorder in the small town.
disorder.exampleZh: 大雨给这个小镇造成了许多混乱。

dispatch.example: The company will dispatch the package to your office tomorrow morning.
dispatch.exampleZh: 公司明天上午会把包裹发送到你的办公室。

disperse.example: The wind began to disperse the thick clouds before noon.
disperse.exampleZh: 风在中午前开始驱散厚厚的云层。

displace.example: The new system will displace the old one next year.
displace.exampleZh: 新系统明年将取代旧系统。

display.example: The store will display the new phones in the window tomorrow.
display.exampleZh: 这家商店明天会在橱窗里展示新手机。

disposal.example: The safe disposal of waste is important for every city.
disposal.exampleZh: 安全处理垃圾对每个城市都很重要。

dispose.example: She disposed of the old newspapers in the box.
dispose.exampleZh: 她把盒子里的旧报纸处理掉了。

disposition.example: Her cheerful disposition makes her easy to work with.
disposition.exampleZh: 她开朗的性情让她很容易相处。

dispute.example: There is a dispute between the two sides over the new rules.
dispute.exampleZh: 双方就新规定存在争议。

disregard.example: He chose to disregard the warning and went out in the storm.
disregard.exampleZh: 他选择无视警告，冲进了暴风雨中。

disrupt.example: Heavy snow can disrupt train service across the whole country.
disrupt.exampleZh: 大雪可能会扰乱全国的火车运行。

dissipate.example: The morning fog will slowly dissipate as the sun rises higher.
dissipate.exampleZh: 随着太阳升得更高，晨雾会慢慢消散。

dissolve.example: Stir the sugar into the water and it will dissolve quickly.
dissolve.exampleZh: 把糖搅入水中，它很快就会溶解。

distance.example: The distance between the two cities is about one hundred kilometers.
distance.exampleZh: 这两座城市之间的距离大约是一百公里。

distant.example: My old school is distant from my new home.
distant.exampleZh: 我的旧学校离我的新家很远。

distinct.example: There is a distinct difference between the two plans.
distinct.exampleZh: 这两个计划之间有明显的区别。

distinction.example: There is a clear distinction between the two plans.
distinction.exampleZh: 这两个方案之间有着明显的区别。

distinguish.example: It is hard to distinguish the twins because they look the same.
distinguish.exampleZh: 很难区分这对双胞胎，因为他们看起来一模一样。

distort.example: The bad mirror distorts my face and makes me look strange.
distort.exampleZh: 这面坏镜子把我的脸扭曲了，让我看起来很怪。

distract.example: Don't let your phone distract you while you are studying for the exam.
distract.exampleZh: 你为考试复习时，别让手机使你分心。

distress.example: The sad news caused her great distress, and it distressed her family too.
distress.exampleZh: 这个悲伤的消息让她非常痛苦，也让她的家人感到悲伤。

distribute.example: They distribute food and water to poor families after the storm.
distribute.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，他们向贫困家庭分发食物和水。

distribution.example: The distribution of free food to the students starts at noon.
distribution.exampleZh: 向学生分发免费食物的活动中午开始。

district.example: This district is very quiet at night and people like walking here.
district.exampleZh: 这个地区晚上很安静，人们喜欢在这里散步。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb me while I am studying in my room.
disturb.exampleZh: 我在房间里学习的时候，请不要打扰我。

disturbance.example: The loud music caused a disturbance late at night.
disturbance.exampleZh: 响亮的音乐在深夜引起了骚乱。

ditch.example: The farmer dug a deep ditch to carry water to his field.
ditch.exampleZh: 农民挖了一条深沟，把水引到他的田里。

dive.example: He likes to dive into the pool on hot summer days.
dive.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏天，他喜欢跳进泳池里。

diverse.example: Our school has students from diverse countries and cultures.
diverse.exampleZh: 我们学校有来自不同国家和文化的学生。

diversion.example: The road work made a diversion so cars could avoid the flooded street.
diversion.exampleZh: 道路施工设置了一条绕行路线，让汽车避开被淹的街道。

divert.example: The police diverted traffic to another road during the parade.
divert.exampleZh: 游行期间，警察将车辆改道至另一条路。

divide.example: Please divide the cake into eight equal pieces for the children.
divide.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕分成八块大小相同的给孩子们。

divine.example: The old temple is a divine place for many people.
divine.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙对许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

division.example: The company has a new division for small business customers.
division.exampleZh: 公司为小企业客户设立了一个新部门。

divorce.example: After the divorce, she moved to a small town with her son.
divorce.exampleZh: 离婚后，她带着儿子搬到了一个小镇。

dizzy.example: I felt dizzy after spinning around in circles for a minute.
dizzy.exampleZh: 我转圈转了一分钟后感到眩晕。

do.example: I do my homework every day after school.

doctor.example: My doctor told me to drink more water and get some rest.
doctor.exampleZh: 我的医生告诉我多喝水并好好休息。

doctrine.example: The church teaches this doctrine to all its members.
doctrine.exampleZh: 教会向所有成员传授这一教义。

document.example: I saved the document on my computer before I left the office.
document.exampleZh: 我离开办公室前把文件保存在了电脑上。

documentary.example: We watched a documentary about wild animals in Africa last night.
documentary.exampleZh: 昨晚我们看了一部关于非洲野生动物的纪录片。

dog.example: My dog likes to run in the park every morning.
dog.exampleZh: 我的狗喜欢每天早上在公园里奔跑。

doll.example: The little girl sleeps with her favorite doll every night.
doll.exampleZh: 小女孩每天晚上都抱着她最喜欢的玩偶睡觉。

domain.example: He is a well-known expert in the domain of computer science.
domain.exampleZh: 他是计算机科学领域的一位知名专家。

domestic.example: The government wants to sell more domestic products to other countries.
domestic.exampleZh: 政府希望向其他国家销售更多的国内产品。

dominant.example: She plays a dominant role in our small team.
dominant.exampleZh: 她在我们的小团队中起主导作用。

dominate.example: From the top of the hill, the old castle dominates the whole town.
dominate.exampleZh: 从山顶上，这座古老的城堡俯瞰着整个小镇。

donate.example: Every year our school students donate old books and clothes to poor families.
donate.exampleZh: 每年我们学校的学生都会向贫困家庭捐赠旧书和旧衣服。

donation.example: She made a small donation to the school to help buy new books.
donation.exampleZh: 她向学校捐了一小笔钱，用来帮助购买新书。

doom.example: Bad luck seemed to doom the whole plan from the start.
doom.exampleZh: 坏运气似乎从一开始就注定了整个计划要失败。

door.example: Please close the door when you leave the room.
door.exampleZh: 你离开房间时请把门关上。

dormitory.example: My dormitory is on the third floor and has four beds.
dormitory.exampleZh: 我的宿舍在三楼，有四张床。

dose.example: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine after lunch.
dose.exampleZh: 午饭后医生给他服了一小剂药。

dot.example: She put a red dot on the map to mark the small village.
dot.exampleZh: 她在地图上点了一个红点来标记那个小村庄。

double.example: The company will double its sales if the new plan works.
double.exampleZh: 如果新计划奏效，公司的销售额将翻一番。

doubt.example: I doubt his story because the facts do not match.
doubt.exampleZh: 我怀疑他的说法，因为事实对不上。

doubtful.example: I am doubtful about his plan to travel alone.
doubtful.exampleZh: 我对他独自旅行的计划表示怀疑。

doubtless.example: He will doubtless come to the party with his friends.
doubtless.exampleZh: 他无疑会和朋友们一起来参加聚会。

down.example: She walked down the stairs slowly to answer the door.
down.exampleZh: 她慢慢走下楼梯去开门。

downstairs.example: I left my bag downstairs by the front door this morning.
downstairs.exampleZh: 今天早上我把包落在楼下的前门旁边了。

downward.example: The ball rolled downward on the hill and stopped near the tree.
downward.exampleZh: 球沿着山坡向下滚动，最后停在树附近。

doze.example: I often doze on the sofa after lunch on quiet Sunday afternoons.
doze.exampleZh: 安静的周日下午，我常常在午饭后于沙发上打盹。

draft.example: She wrote the first draft of her report and revised it twice.
draft.exampleZh: 她写了报告的第一稿，并修改了两次。

drag.example: He had to drag the heavy box across the floor.
drag.exampleZh: 他不得不把那个沉重的箱子拖过地板。

dragon.example: The dragon in the old story can fly and breathe fire.
dragon.exampleZh: 那个古老故事里的龙会飞，还会喷火。

drain.example: The old pipes drain the rainwater away from the roof very slowly.
drain.exampleZh: 那些旧管道把屋顶的雨水排走，速度非常慢。

drainage.example: The old house has poor drainage, so the garden floods after heavy rain.
drainage.exampleZh: 这栋老房子排水很差，所以大雨后花园会积水。

drama.example: The drama at school today was very exciting for everyone.
drama.exampleZh: 今天学校里的戏剧性事件让大家都很兴奋。

dramatic.example: The movie had a dramatic ending that surprised everyone in the theater.
dramatic.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个戏剧性的结局，让影院里的每个人都感到惊讶。

drastic.example: The company made a drastic change to its plan last week.
drastic.exampleZh: 公司上周对计划做了重大改动。

draw.example: She likes to draw pictures of animals in her notebook.
draw.exampleZh: 她喜欢在笔记本上画动物的图片。

drawback.example: The only drawback of this plan is that it costs too much money.
drawback.exampleZh: 这个计划唯一的缺点就是花费太多钱。

drawer.example: She put the old letters in the top drawer of her desk.
drawer.exampleZh: 她把旧信件放进了书桌最上面的抽屉里。

drawing.example: She sat by the window and made a drawing of the old tree.
drawing.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，画了一幅那棵老树的素描。

dream.example: Every child has a dream, and mine is to travel around the world.
dream.exampleZh: 每个孩子都有一个梦想，而我的梦想是环游世界。

dress.example: She will dress quickly and then wear a blue dress to the party.
dress.exampleZh: 她会很快穿好衣服，然后穿一条蓝色连衣裙去参加聚会。

drift.example: The boat began to drift slowly down the river toward the sea.
drift.exampleZh: 小船开始顺着河流慢慢漂向大海。

drill.example: The class did a fire drill and learned to leave the building quickly.
drill.exampleZh: 班级进行了一次消防演习，学会了快速离开大楼。

drink.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before work.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前喝一杯水。

drip.example: Water began to drip from the old pipe onto the floor.
drip.exampleZh: 水开始从旧管子上滴到地板上。

drive.example: His drive to learn new things helps him finish every hard task.
drive.exampleZh: 他学习新事物的干劲帮助他完成每一项艰难的任务。

drop.example: A drop of rain fell on my hand, so I went inside.
drop.exampleZh: 一滴雨落在我手上，于是我走进了屋里。

drought.example: The long drought killed most of the crops on our small farm.
drought.exampleZh: 长期的干旱毁掉了我们小农场的大部分庄稼。

drown.example: The heavy rain drowned the small garden and all the flowers.
drown.exampleZh: 大雨淹没了小花园和所有的花。

drug.example: The doctor gave me a drug to help with my headache.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给了我一种药来缓解我的头痛。

drum.example: She played the drum in the school band every Friday.
drum.exampleZh: 她每周五在学校乐队里打鼓。

dry.example: Please keep your shoes dry when you walk in the rain.
dry.exampleZh: 下雨天走路时请保持鞋子干燥。

dual.example: This phone has a dual purpose: it works as a camera and a music player.
dual.exampleZh: 这款手机有双重用途：它既能当相机，也能当音乐播放器。

duck.example: The duck is swimming in the pond with her baby ducks.
duck.exampleZh: 那只鸭子正带着她的小鸭子们在池塘里游泳。

due.example: The rent is due at the end of each month.

dull.example: The lecture was so dull that half the students fell asleep.
dull.exampleZh: 那场讲座太枯燥了，一半的学生都睡着了。

dumb.example: He was too dumb to speak after hearing the bad news.
dumb.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息后，他哑口无言。

dump.example: Please do not dump your old furniture near the river.
dump.exampleZh: 请不要把你的旧家具倾倒到河边附近。

durable.example: This bag is durable and will last for many years.
durable.exampleZh: 这个包很耐用，能用很多年。

duration.example: The duration of the film is about two hours.
duration.exampleZh: 这部电影的持续时间大约是两个小时。

during.example: I read two books during the summer holiday last year.
during.exampleZh: 去年暑假期间我读了两本书。

dusk.example: The children went home when dusk came and the sky turned dark.
dusk.exampleZh: 黄昏降临、天色变暗时，孩子们回家了。

dust.example: There is a lot of dust on the old books in the room.
dust.exampleZh: 房间里旧书上有许多灰尘。

duty.example: It is my duty to help my parents at home.
duty.exampleZh: 在家帮助父母是我的责任。

dwarf.example: The dwarf in the story is small but very strong and clever.
dwarf.exampleZh: 故事里的那个矮子个子很小，但非常强壮又聪明。

dwell.example: They dwell in a small house near the river.
dwell.exampleZh: 他们住在河边的一所小房子里。

dwelling.example: Their old dwelling was small but very warm in winter.
dwelling.exampleZh: 他们的旧住所很小，但冬天非常暖和。

dye.example: She used a natural dye to color the old white dress.
dye.exampleZh: 她用一种天然染料把那条旧白裙子染上了颜色。

dynamic.example: The city has a dynamic music scene that attracts many young people.
dynamic.exampleZh: 这座城市有着充满活力的音乐氛围，吸引了许多年轻人。

dynasty.example: The Han dynasty ruled China for more than four hundred years.
dynasty.exampleZh: 汉朝统治中国四百多年。

each.example: Each student in the class has a small book on the desk.
each.exampleZh: 班上的每个学生桌上都有一本小书。

eager.example: The children are eager to open their gifts on Christmas morning.
eager.exampleZh: 孩子们渴望在圣诞节的早晨打开他们的礼物。

eagle.example: The eagle flew high above the mountains and looked for food.
eagle.exampleZh: 那只鹰飞到高高的山峦上方，寻找食物。

ear.example: My little sister put her hands over her ears during the loud part.
ear.exampleZh: 在声音很大的那一段，我妹妹用双手捂住了耳朵。

early.example: I get up early every morning to catch the school bus.
early.exampleZh: 我每天早上很早起床去赶校车。

earn.example: He works hard every day to earn money for his family.
earn.exampleZh: 他每天努力工作，为家人挣钱。

earnest.example: She gave an earnest answer to every question the teacher asked.
earnest.exampleZh: 她对老师提出的每一个问题都作了认真的回答。

earth.example: The earth is wet after the rain, so the plants grow well.

effort.exampleZh: 她努力在晚饭前完成作业。

egg.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃一个鸡蛋和一些面包。

either.example: Either answer is fine, but you must pick one of them today.

elaborate.exampleZh: 她详细解释了这台新机器是如何运作的。

elastic.example: Our plans are elastic, so we can change them at any time.

elbow.example: She hurt her elbow when she fell off the bike yesterday.
elbow.exampleZh: 她昨天从自行车上摔下来时伤了手肘。

elder.example: My elder brother often helps me with my homework after school.
elder.exampleZh: 我哥哥经常在放学后帮我做作业。

elderly.example: The elderly man walks slowly with a stick in the park.
elderly.exampleZh: 那位年长的男人在公园里拄着拐杖慢慢走。

elect.exampleZh: 学生们下周将选举一位新的班长。

electric.example: We bought an electric car last year and it is very quiet.
electric.exampleZh: 我们去年买了一辆电动汽车，它非常安静。

elegant.example: She wore an elegant dress to the party last night.

element.example: Water is an important element of life on this planet.

elementary.exampleZh: 这节初级课程教学生如何做简单的加法。

elevator.exampleZh: 我们坐电梯到了十楼，因为走楼梯太慢了。

embrace.exampleZh: 她学会了在日常生活中接受变化和新想法。

emerge.example: New problems often emerge when a small team grows very fast.
emerge.exampleZh: 当一个小团队快速成长时，新问题常常会出现。

emergency.exampleZh: 遇到紧急情况，立刻报警。

emission.exampleZh: 这项新法律旨在减少汽车和工厂的碳排放。

emotion.example: She could not hide her emotion when she heard the good news.

emotional.exampleZh: 她发表了一段关于家人的动情演讲。

emperor.exampleZh: 皇帝和他的家人住在一座大宫殿里。

emphasis.example: Our teacher puts great emphasis on reading every day.
emphasis.exampleZh: 我们的老师非常强调每天阅读。

emphasize.example: Teachers often emphasize the importance of reading every day.
emphasize.exampleZh: 老师经常强调每天阅读的重要性。

empire.example: The old empire was very large and had many people.
empire.exampleZh: 这个古老的帝国非常庞大，人口众多。

employee.exampleZh: 公司给每位雇员配了一台新电脑用于工作。

employer.exampleZh: 她的雇主允许她每周在家工作两天。

employment.exampleZh: 他正在离家不远的一个小镇上找工作。

empty.example: Please empty the box before you put the new books in it.

encounter.example: We had a short encounter with a deer on the road.
encounter.exampleZh: 我们在路上短暂地遇到了一只鹿。

encourage.exampleZh: 父母总是鼓励我尝试新事物。

endeavor.exampleZh: 他学习英语的努力最终得到了回报。

ending.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个让大家都笑了的幸福结局。

endless.exampleZh: 婴儿无休止的哭声让全家人整夜未眠。

endorse.exampleZh: 许多著名运动员在电视上为运动饮料代言。

endow.exampleZh: 这位富人决定捐赠给这所小学校一座新图书馆。

endurance.exampleZh: 长跑既考验你的身体耐力，也考验你的心理素质。

endure.exampleZh: 她能忍受寒冷的天气，因为她穿着暖和的衣服。

enemy.exampleZh: 士兵们在寒冷的山区勇敢地与强大的敌人作战。

energetic.exampleZh: 这些精力充沛的孩子整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。

enhance.exampleZh: 经常练习能在短时间内提高你的英语水平。

enjoy.example: I enjoy reading books in the park on sunny days.
