enormous.exampleZh: 大象是一种长着长鼻子的巨大动物。

enrich.example: Reading good books can enrich your mind and make your life more interesting.
enrich.exampleZh: 读好书能丰富你的头脑，让你的生活更有趣。

enroll.exampleZh: 我姐姐下个月将在一所新学校注册入学。

enthusiasm.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热情让班上每个人都想学一门乐器。

enthusiastic.exampleZh: 她对学习英语非常热情，每天都练习。

entitle.exampleZh: 这张票让你有权在演出时免费领取一杯饮料。

envelope.exampleZh: 我把信装进一个白色信封，昨天寄了出去。

environmental.exampleZh: 我们都应该帮助保护我们城市的环境健康。

equality.example: We believe in equality at school and at work.
equality.exampleZh: 我们相信在学校和工作中都应享有平等。

equip.exampleZh: 我们为每位新生配备一台笔记本电脑和一本学习指南。

equipment.exampleZh: 工人们今天早上把沉重的设备搬进了新大楼。

erase.exampleZh: 请在开始上课前擦掉白板上的旧字。

essay.exampleZh: 她写了一篇关于她去海滩的夏日旅行的短文。

exception.example: There is one exception to this rule, so please remember it.
exception.exampleZh: 这条规则有一个例外，请记住它。

excess.example: Too much sugar in drinks can lead to an excess of calories.
excess.exampleZh: 饮料中过多的糖会导致热量超标。

excessive.example: The teacher said that excessive noise in class makes learning very hard.
excessive.exampleZh: 老师说课堂上过度的噪音会让学习变得非常困难。

exchange.example: We can exchange our books if you want to read this one.
exchange.exampleZh: 如果你想读这本书，我们可以交换一下书。

excite.example: The good news will excite all the children in our class.
excite.exampleZh: 这个好消息会让我们班所有的孩子都很兴奋。

excitement.example: The children jumped with excitement when they saw the new puppy.
excitement.exampleZh: 孩子们看到新来的小狗时兴奋地跳了起来。

exciting.example: The soccer game was very exciting for all the young players.
exciting.exampleZh: 这场足球比赛对所有年轻球员来说都非常令人兴奋。

exclaim.example: She exclaimed with joy when she saw the beautiful gift.
exclaim.exampleZh: 她看到那份漂亮的礼物时高兴地叫了起来。

exclude.example: We should exclude junk food from our daily meals.
exclude.exampleZh: 我们应该把垃圾食品排除在日常饮食之外。

exclusive.example: This club is exclusive, so only a few people can join it.
exclusive.exampleZh: 这个俱乐部是排他的，所以只有少数人能加入。

excuse.example: Please excuse me for being late, but that is not a good excuse.
excuse.exampleZh: 请原谅我迟到了，但那不是一个好借口。

execute.example: The team will execute the new plan next week.
execute.exampleZh: 团队将在下周执行这个新计划。

executive.example: The executive made a quick decision about the new project.
executive.exampleZh: 这位执行官对新项目做出了快速的决定。

exercise.example: Daily exercise keeps your body strong and helps you sleep better at night.
exercise.exampleZh: 每天锻炼能让你的身体强壮，还能帮助你在晚上睡得更好。

exert.example: Teachers exert a strong influence on the students they teach every day.
exert.exampleZh: 老师每天都对他们所教的学生施加强烈的影响。

exhaust.example: The long walk exhausted the children, so they slept in the car.
exhaust.exampleZh: 长途步行使孩子们筋疲力尽，所以他们在车里睡着了。

exhibit.example: The museum will exhibit many old paintings from China next month.
exhibit.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将展出许多来自中国的古老画作。

exhibition.example: We went to an art exhibition in the city last Sunday.
exhibition.exampleZh: 上周日我们去了城里的一场艺术展览。

exile.example: He lived in exile for ten years before returning home.
exile.exampleZh: 他在流亡中度过了十年才回到家乡。

exist.example: Many people believe that life may exist on other planets in space.
exist.exampleZh: 许多人相信太空中其他星球上可能存在生命。

existence.example: Scientists still question the existence of life on other planets.
existence.exampleZh: 科学家们仍然质疑其他星球上是否存在生命。

exit.example: Please use the back exit if you want to leave the building.
exit.exampleZh: 如果你想离开大楼，请使用后面的出口。

exotic.example: The garden was full of exotic flowers from faraway countries.
exotic.exampleZh: 花园里开满了来自遥远国度的奇异花朵。

expand.example: The company plans to expand its business into two new countries next year.
expand.exampleZh: 公司计划明年将业务扩展到两个新的国家。

expansion.example: The company's rapid expansion created many new jobs in the city.
expansion.exampleZh: 公司的快速扩张在城市里创造了许多新工作岗位。

expect.example: We expect the train to arrive around six this evening.
expect.exampleZh: 我们预计火车今晚六点左右到达。

expectation.example: Her expectation of a quick reply made the long wait feel much harder.
expectation.exampleZh: 她期待能很快得到回复，这让漫长的等待变得更加难熬。

expense.example: The trip was expensive, so we shared the expense with friends.
expense.exampleZh: 这次旅行很贵，所以我们和朋友分摊了费用。

expensive.example: This car is too expensive for most young people to buy.
expensive.exampleZh: 这辆车对大多数年轻人来说太贵了，买不起。

experience.example: She has much experience in teaching young children to read.
experience.exampleZh: 她在教幼儿阅读方面很有经验。

experiment.example: We did a simple experiment in class to see how plants grow.
experiment.exampleZh: 我们在课堂上做了一个简单的实验，观察植物如何生长。

experimental.example: The scientists are doing an experimental test with a new kind of medicine.
experimental.exampleZh: 科学家们正在用一种新药做实验性测试。

expert.example: She is an expert in Chinese history and often gives talks.
expert.exampleZh: 她是一位中国历史专家，经常做讲座。

expertise.example: Her expertise in math helped the whole team solve the problem quickly.
expertise.exampleZh: 她在数学方面的专长帮助整个团队快速解决了这个问题。

explain.example: Can you explain this word to me in simple English?
explain.exampleZh: 你能用简单的英语给我解释一下这个词吗？

explanation.example: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the difficult math problem.
explanation.exampleZh: 老师对这道难题给出了清晰的解释。

explode.example: The old car's engine exploded on the highway yesterday morning.
explode.exampleZh: 那辆旧车的引擎昨天早上在高速公路上爆炸了。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit cheap labor to make more money.
exploit.exampleZh: 一些公司剥削廉价劳动力来赚更多的钱。

exploration.example: Space exploration helps us learn more about the planets and stars.
exploration.exampleZh: 太空探索帮助我们更多地了解行星和恒星。

explore.example: We plan to explore the old forest behind our town this weekend.
explore.exampleZh: 我们计划这个周末去探索我们镇后面的那片古老森林。

explosion.example: The explosion broke every window in the old building.
explosion.exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了那栋老建筑的所有窗户。

explosive.example: The police found explosive materials in the old house yesterday.
explosive.exampleZh: 警方昨天在那座旧房子里发现了爆炸性材料。

export.example: Our country exports rice and tea to many countries every year.
export.exampleZh: 我们国家每年向许多国家出口大米和茶叶。

expose.example: The report exposed serious problems in the local water supply.
expose.exampleZh: 该报告揭露了当地供水中的严重问题。

exposure.example: Too much exposure to the sun can harm your skin.
exposure.exampleZh: 过多暴露在阳光下会伤害你的皮肤。

express.example: I can express my ideas better with simple words, and I like the express train.
express.exampleZh: 用简单的词我能更好地表达自己的想法，而且我喜欢那趟特快列车。

expression.example: Her facial expression showed that she was very happy with the news.
expression.exampleZh: 她的面部表情表明她对这个消息非常满意。

extend.example: We plan to extend the meeting by one hour tomorrow.
extend.exampleZh: 我们计划明天把会议延长一个小时。

extension.example: I called your office, but the operator gave me a different extension.
extension.exampleZh: 我打电话到你办公室，但接线员给了我另一个分机号。

extensive.example: The school has extensive sports programs for all students.
extensive.exampleZh: 这所学校为所有学生提供了广泛的体育项目。

extent.example: To some extent, I agree with your plan.
extent.exampleZh: 在某种程度上，我同意你的计划。

external.example: The company hired an external expert to check its safety rules.
external.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位外部专家来检查其安全规则。

extra.example: I need some extra time to finish my homework tonight.
extra.exampleZh: 我今晚需要一些额外的时间来完成作业。

extraordinary.example: Her singing voice is truly extraordinary and everyone stops to listen.
extraordinary.exampleZh: 她的歌声确实非同凡响，每个人都会停下来倾听。

extreme.example: The desert has extreme heat in the day and cold at night.
extreme.exampleZh: 沙漠白天极热，夜晚极冷。

extremely.example: The math problem was extremely hard, so I asked my teacher for help.
extremely.exampleZh: 这道数学题极其难，所以我向老师求助。

fable.example: My grandmother told me a fable about a clever fox and a proud lion.
fable.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我讲了一个关于聪明的狐狸和骄傲的狮子的寓言。

fabric.example: The soft fabric of this dress feels nice against my skin.
fabric.exampleZh: 这条裙子柔软的面料贴在我的皮肤上感觉很舒服。

fabricate.example: He tried to fabricate a story about the missing money.
fabricate.exampleZh: 他试图编造一个关于那笔丢失的钱的故事。

face.example: She washed her face and went out to face the cold wind.
face.exampleZh: 她洗了脸，然后出门面对寒风。

facet.example: The report looks at every facet of the problem in clear detail.
facet.exampleZh: 这份报告清晰细致地审视了问题的每一个方面。

facilitate.example: Good roads help facilitate trade between small towns and big cities.
facilitate.exampleZh: 良好的道路有助于促进小城镇与大城之间的贸易。

facility.example: The new sports facility is open to all students after school.
facility.exampleZh: 这个新的体育设施在放学后向所有学生开放。

fact.example: The fact that he passed the exam surprised all his teachers.
fact.exampleZh: 他通过考试这一事实让他所有的老师都感到惊讶。

factor.example: Cost is an important factor when we choose a new car.
factor.exampleZh: 当我们选择新车时，价格是一个重要因素。

factory.example: My father works in a shoe factory near our home.
factory.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们家附近的一家鞋厂工作。

faculty.example: She has a rare faculty for making difficult ideas seem simple.
faculty.exampleZh: 她有一种难得的才能，能让复杂的想法显得简单。

fade.example: The bright colors of my old shirt slowly began to fade in the sun.
fade.exampleZh: 我那件旧衬衫上鲜艳的颜色在阳光下慢慢开始褪去。

fahrenheit.example: The weather report said it would be ninety degrees Fahrenheit this afternoon.
fahrenheit.exampleZh: 天气预报说今天下午会达到华氏九十度。

fail.example: If you do not study, you will fail the test.
fail.exampleZh: 如果你不学习，考试就会不及格。

failure.example: His first attempt ended in failure, but he learned a lot from it.
failure.exampleZh: 他的第一次尝试以失败告终，但他从中获益良多。

faint.example: The light was faint, and she felt dizzy and almost fainted.
faint.exampleZh: 灯光很微弱，她感到头晕，差点晕倒。

fair.example: It is not fair to blame the child for that mistake.
fair.exampleZh: 因为那个错误而责怪这个孩子是不公平的。

fairly.example: The teacher treats all her students fairly and listens to their ideas.
fairly.exampleZh: 老师公平地对待她所有的学生，并倾听他们的想法。

fairy.example: The little girl said a fairy lived in the garden.
fairy.exampleZh: 小女孩说花园里住着一位仙女。

faith.example: She has great faith in her friends and her family.
faith.exampleZh: 她非常信任她的朋友和家人。

faithful.example: My dog is faithful and waits for me at the door every day.
faithful.exampleZh: 我的狗很忠实，每天都会在门口等我。

fake.example: The bag looks real, but it is actually a cheap fake.
fake.exampleZh: 这个包看起来是真的，但它实际上是个廉价赝品。

fall.example: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn and cover the ground.
fall.exampleZh: 秋天树叶从树上落下，覆盖了地面。

false.example: The answer he gave was false, so the teacher asked again.
false.exampleZh: 他给出的答案是错误的，所以老师又问了一遍。

fame.example: She did not want fame, but her songs made her famous all over the world.
fame.exampleZh: 她并不想要名声，但她的歌让她在全世界出了名。

familiar.example: The streets of this small town look very familiar to me.
familiar.exampleZh: 这个小镇的街道对我来说看起来很熟悉。

family.example: My family likes to eat dinner together every evening.
family.exampleZh: 我的家人喜欢每天晚上一起吃晚饭。

famine.example: Many people died during the famine because there was no food.
famine.exampleZh: 许多人因为食物短缺在那场饥荒中死去。

famous.example: This city is famous for its beautiful old bridges and parks.
famous.exampleZh: 这座城市以其美丽的古老桥梁和公园而闻名。

fan.example: She waved a paper fan to stay cool on the hot bus.
fan.exampleZh: 在炎热的公交车上，她挥动一把纸扇让自己凉快些。

fancy.example: She likes to wear a fancy dress to the party every year.
fancy.exampleZh: 她喜欢每年都穿一条花哨的连衣裙去参加聚会。

fantastic.example: The view from the top of the hill was fantastic.
fantastic.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色美极了。

fantasy.example: She lives in a fantasy world where everything is always perfect and easy.
fantasy.exampleZh: 她生活在一个一切总是完美而轻松的幻想世界里。

far.example: My school is far from my home, so I take the bus.
far.exampleZh: 我的学校离家很远，所以我坐公交车。

fare.example: The bus fare to the city is only two dollars.
fare.exampleZh: 到市区的公交车费只要两美元。

farewell.example: We had a small farewell party for her before she moved away.
farewell.exampleZh: 她搬走之前，我们为她办了一个小型的告别聚会。

farm.example: My uncle grows vegetables and keeps some cows on his farm.
farm.exampleZh: 我叔叔在他的农场上种蔬菜，还养了几头奶牛。

farmer.example: The farmer gets up early every morning to feed his cows.
farmer.exampleZh: 这位农民每天早上早起去喂他的奶牛。

farther.example: The farther shop is cheaper, so we walked there together yesterday.
farther.exampleZh: 更远的那家店更便宜，所以我们昨天一起走到那里去了。

fascinating.example: The history of this old city is fascinating to many young visitors.
fascinating.exampleZh: 这座古城的历史对许多年轻游客来说很迷人。

fashion.example: She always wears clothes that are in fashion this year.
fashion.exampleZh: 她总是穿今年流行的衣服。

fashionable.example: She always wears fashionable clothes to work.
fashionable.exampleZh: 她上班总是穿时髦的衣服。

fast.example: The fast train takes us to the city in twenty minutes.
fast.exampleZh: 这趟快车二十分钟就能把我们送到城里。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane starts to move.
fasten.exampleZh: 飞机开始移动前，请系好安全带。

fat.example: The fat cat sleeps on the warm sofa all day.
fat.exampleZh: 那只胖猫整天睡在温暖的沙发上。

fatal.example: The driver made one fatal mistake and the car hit the tree.
fatal.exampleZh: 司机犯了一个致命的错误，汽车撞到了树上。

fate.example: She believed that fate brought them together on that rainy day.
fate.exampleZh: 她相信是命运在那个雨天把他们带到了一起。

father.example: My father taught me how to ride a bike last summer.
father.exampleZh: 去年夏天，我父亲教我如何骑自行车。

fatigue.example: After the long trip, she felt a deep fatigue in her legs and arms.
fatigue.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，她感到腿和胳膊有一种深深的疲劳。

fault.example: The fault was mine, so I said sorry to her.
fault.exampleZh: 过错在我，所以我向她道了歉。

faulty.example: The faulty machine stopped working after only two days.
faulty.exampleZh: 那台有故障的机器仅用了两天就停止工作了。

favor.example: She did me a big favor, so I owe her my thanks.
favor.exampleZh: 她帮了我一个大忙，所以我欠她一声感谢。

favorable.example: The weather was favorable for our trip to the beach.
favorable.exampleZh: 天气对我们的海滩之旅很有利。

favorite.example: My favorite food is noodles with fresh vegetables.
favorite.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的食物是加新鲜蔬菜的面条。

fear.example: Many children have a fear of the dark, but they can learn to feel safe.
fear.exampleZh: 许多孩子害怕黑暗，但他们可以学会感到安全。

feasible.example: This plan is simple and feasible for our small team.
feasible.exampleZh: 这个方案对我们的小团队来说简单可行。

feast.example: The whole village came together for a great feast last night.
feast.exampleZh: 昨晚整个村子聚在一起享用了一顿盛大的宴席。

feat.example: Climbing that mountain alone was a great feat for the young boy.
feat.exampleZh: 独自爬上那座山对这个小男孩来说是一项伟大的壮举。

feature.example: Her best feature is her warm smile, and the film features a young singer.
feature.exampleZh: 她最好看的特征是温暖的笑容，这部电影由一位年轻歌手主演。

february.example: My birthday is in February, and we usually have a small family dinner.
february.exampleZh: 我的生日在二月，我们通常会举行一次小型家庭聚餐。

federal.example: The federal government makes laws that all states must follow.
federal.exampleZh: 联邦政府制定的法律所有州都必须遵守。

fee.example: The school fee is not very high for students in this small town.
fee.exampleZh: 对这个小城镇的学生来说，学费不算很高。

feeble.example: The old man was too feeble to walk up the stairs alone.
feeble.exampleZh: 那位老人太虚弱了，无法独自走上楼梯。

feed.example: She feeds her two cats every morning before she goes to work.
feed.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前给两只猫喂食。

feedback.example: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my English essay.
feedback.exampleZh: 老师对我的英语作文给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I feel cold when the wind blows at night.
feel.exampleZh: 夜里刮风时，我感觉很冷。

feeling.example: I have a good feeling about this new job.
feeling.exampleZh: 我对这份新工作有一种好的感觉。

fellow.example: He is a friendly fellow who works with me every day.
fellow.exampleZh: 他是个每天和我一起工作的友好家伙。

fellowship.example: The university gave her a fellowship to study abroad for one year.
fellowship.exampleZh: 这所大学给她提供了一笔奖学金，让她出国学习一年。

female.example: The female doctor helped the sick child feel better.
female.exampleZh: 这位女医生帮助生病的孩子感觉好一些。

feminine.example: Her feminine voice is soft and calm.
feminine.exampleZh: 她女性的嗓音柔和而平静。

fence.example: My dog jumped over the fence to chase a bird.
fence.exampleZh: 我的狗跳过栅栏去追一只鸟。

fertile.example: The soil near the river is very fertile and good for growing vegetables.
fertile.exampleZh: 河边的土壤非常肥沃，适合种植蔬菜。

fertilizer.example: The farmer puts fertilizer on his field to help the crops grow.
fertilizer.exampleZh: 农民在田里施肥，帮助庄稼生长。

festival.example: Our family always gets together to celebrate the festival with a big dinner.
festival.exampleZh: 我们一家人总会聚在一起，用一顿丰盛的晚餐来庆祝这个节日。

fetch.example: She went to fetch some water for the old man.
fetch.exampleZh: 她去给那位老人取了些水。

fever.example: The little boy has a high fever and must stay in bed today.
fever.exampleZh: 小男孩发高烧，今天必须卧床休息。

few.example: Few students came to class today because of the heavy rain.
few.exampleZh: 由于大雨，今天来上课的学生很少。

fiber.example: This cloth has a soft fiber that feels good on the skin.
fiber.exampleZh: 这种布料的纤维很柔软，接触皮肤时感觉很好。

fiction.example: I like to read fiction before I go to sleep.

field.example: The children are playing football in the green field behind our school.
field.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们学校后面的绿色田野上踢足球。

fierce.example: The fierce dog barked loudly at the stranger near the gate.
fierce.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗对着大门附近的陌生人狂吠。

fifteen.example: My little sister is fifteen and she loves playing basketball after school.
fifteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十五岁，她喜欢放学后打篮球。

fifth.example: Our team won the fifth prize in the school singing contest.
fifth.exampleZh: 我们队在学校歌唱比赛中获得了第五名。

fifty.example: My grandmother will be fifty years old next month.
fifty.exampleZh: 我奶奶下个月就五十岁了。

fight.example: The two boys started to fight over a toy in the school yard.
fight.exampleZh: 两个男孩在学校操场上因为一个玩具打了起来。

figure.example: His figure is on page ten, and I figure he is right.
figure.exampleZh: 他的数字在第十页上，我认为他是对的。

file.example: Please put the report in the file on my desk before noon.
file.exampleZh: 请在中午之前把报告放进我桌上的文件夹里。

fill.example: She will fill the glass with water and then sit down.
fill.exampleZh: 她会把杯子装满水，然后坐下。

film.example: We watched a funny film about a family trip last night.
film.exampleZh: 昨晚我们看了一部关于家庭旅行的有趣电影。

filter.example: Please use this filter to clean the water before you drink it.
filter.exampleZh: 请用这个过滤器在你喝水前把水过滤干净。

final.example: This is my final answer, and the game ends today.
final.exampleZh: 这是我最终的答案，比赛今天结束。

finally.example: After a long delay, the train finally arrived at the station.
finally.exampleZh: 经过长时间延误，火车终于到站了。

finance.example: The city will finance the new school with money from the state.
finance.exampleZh: 市政府将用州里的资金为这所新学校提供经费。

financial.example: The company has financial problems and may close next year.
financial.exampleZh: 这家公司有财务问题，明年可能会倒闭。

find.example: I cannot find my keys anywhere in this room.
find.exampleZh: 我在这个房间里到处都找不到我的钥匙。

finding.example: The new finding may help doctors treat this common disease.
finding.exampleZh: 这一新发现可能有助于医生治疗这种常见疾病。

fine.example: The coffee is fine, but the fine powder on the table is a problem.
fine.exampleZh: 咖啡挺好的，但桌上的细粉是个问题。

finger.example: She cut her finger while cooking dinner last night.
finger.exampleZh: 昨晚做晚饭时她切到了手指。

finish.example: I need to finish my homework before I can play with my friends.
finish.exampleZh: 我得先完成作业，然后才能和朋友们一起玩。

fire.example: The fire in the kitchen was out, so we cooked outside.
fire.exampleZh: 厨房里的火灭了，所以我们在外面做饭。

firm.example: She works for a small firm and is firm about her goals.
firm.exampleZh: 她在一家小公司工作，并且对自己的目标很坚定。

first.example: This is my first day at the new school.
first.exampleZh: 这是我在新学校的第一天。

fiscal.example: The government announced a new fiscal plan to help small businesses.
fiscal.exampleZh: 政府公布了一项新的财政计划来帮助小企业。

fish.example: My father likes to fish in the small river near our house.
fish.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在我们家附近的小河里钓鱼。

fisherman.example: The old fisherman goes to the sea early every morning.
fisherman.exampleZh: 那位老渔民每天清晨都出海。

fit.example: This job is a good fit for me because I like working with people.
fit.exampleZh: 这份工作很适合我，因为我喜欢和人打交道。

fitness.example: Regular exercise is important for your fitness and your health.
fitness.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的体能和健康都很重要。

five.example: My little sister is five years old and starts school this year.
five.exampleZh: 我妹妹五岁了，今年开始上学。

fix.example: I need to fix my bike before I ride to school.
fix.exampleZh: 我需要在骑车上学前把自行车修好。

fixed.example: The price of the ticket is fixed and cannot be changed.
fixed.exampleZh: 票价是固定的，不能更改。

fixture.example: The old lamp was a fixture on the wall for many years.
fixture.exampleZh: 那盏旧灯多年来一直是墙上的固定装置。

flag.example: The flag is red and white and flies above the school.
flag.exampleZh: 这面旗是红白相间的，飘扬在学校上方。

flame.example: The flame of the campfire kept us warm all night.
flame.exampleZh: 篝火的火焰让我们整夜都很温暖。

flash.example: A bright flash of light appeared in the dark sky last night.
flash.exampleZh: 昨晚黑暗的天空中出现了一道明亮的闪光。

flat.example: The land near the river is flat, and we rented a small flat there.
flat.exampleZh: 河边的土地很平坦，我们在那里租了一间小公寓。

flatter.example: The photographer knows how to flatter people with soft light and good angles.
flatter.exampleZh: 这位摄影师懂得用柔和的光线和好的角度让人显得好看。

flavor.example: This soup has a rich flavor that everyone in my family loves.
flavor.exampleZh: 这汤味道浓郁，我家每个人都喜欢。

flaw.example: The flaw in the old wall let cold air into the room.
flaw.exampleZh: 旧墙上的裂缝让冷空气进入了房间。

flea.example: My dog keeps scratching because a flea is biting his skin.
flea.exampleZh: 我的狗一直挠痒，因为有一只跳蚤在咬它的皮肤。

flee.example: The thief tried to flee when he saw the police coming.
flee.exampleZh: 小偷看到警察过来时试图逃跑。

flexible.example: Her flexible schedule lets her pick up the kids from school every day.
flexible.exampleZh: 她灵活的日程安排让她每天都能去学校接孩子。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing was delayed for two hours yesterday.
flight.exampleZh: 我们昨天飞往北京的航班延误了两个小时。

fling.example: She decided to fling the old ball across the yard.
fling.exampleZh: 她决定把旧球猛地扔过院子。

float.example: The small boat floats on the calm water near the beach.
float.exampleZh: 小船漂浮在海滩附近平静的水面上。

flock.example: A flock of birds flew over the quiet lake at sunset.
flock.exampleZh: 一群鸟在日落时飞过安静的湖面。

flood.example: The heavy rain caused a flood that covered the whole village.
flood.exampleZh: 大雨引发了一场洪水，淹没了整个村庄。

floor.example: She put her bag on the floor near the door.
floor.exampleZh: 她把包放在门附近的地板上。

flour.example: She bought a bag of flour to make bread for her family.
flour.exampleZh: 她买了一袋面粉，为家人做面包。

flourish.example: Small shops flourish when the streets stay clean and safe.
flourish.exampleZh: 当街道保持干净和安全时，小店铺就会繁荣起来。

flow.example: Traffic flow is slow this morning because of an accident on the main road.
flow.exampleZh: 今天早上由于主干道上发生事故，车流很慢。

flower.example: She put a beautiful red flower in a glass of water.
flower.exampleZh: 她把一朵美丽的红花放进一杯水里。

flu.example: My brother had the flu last week and stayed home from school.
flu.exampleZh: 我弟弟上周得了流感，待在家里没去上学。

fluctuate.example: Prices often fluctuate during the holiday season.
fluctuate.exampleZh: 价格在假期期间经常波动。

fluent.example: She is fluent in English and often helps her friends with homework.
fluent.exampleZh: 她英语说得很流利，经常帮朋友们做作业。

fluid.example: Water is a fluid that flows easily through small pipes.
fluid.exampleZh: 水是一种能轻易流过细管道的流体。

flush.example: Her face began to flush when the teacher said her name.
flush.exampleZh: 老师叫到她的名字时，她的脸开始红了。

fly.example: Birds can fly high in the sky when the weather is good.
fly.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，鸟儿能在天空中飞得很高。

focus.example: She needs to focus on her homework and stop watching TV.
focus.exampleZh: 她需要把注意力集中在作业上，别再看电视了。

fog.example: The fog was so thick that we could not see the road.
fog.exampleZh: 雾太浓了，我们看不见路。

fold.example: Please fold the paper in half and put it in the box.
fold.exampleZh: 请把纸对折，然后放进盒子里。

folk.example: Folk in our small town still sing these old songs.
folk.exampleZh: 我们小镇上的人们仍然在唱这些老歌。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way.
follow.exampleZh: 请跟着我，我会给你指路。

following.example: The following day, we went back to school and saw our friends.
following.exampleZh: 第二天，我们回到学校，见到了朋友们。

fond.example: She is very fond of her little dog and walks it every day.
fond.exampleZh: 她非常喜欢她的小狗，每天都带它去散步。

food.example: I always bring enough food and water when I go hiking.
food.exampleZh: 我去徒步时总是带足够的食物和水。

fool.example: Don't be a fool and let him fool you again.
fool.exampleZh: 别当傻瓜，别再让他愚弄你了。

foolish.example: It was foolish of him to go out in the heavy rain.
foolish.exampleZh: 他在大雨中外出真是太愚蠢了。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk home.
foot.exampleZh: 走了很长的路回家后，我的左脚疼。

football.example: My brother plays football with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
football.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六下午都和朋友们踢足球。

footnote.example: Please read the footnote at the bottom of this page carefully.
footnote.exampleZh: 请仔细阅读本页底部的脚注。

for.example: I bought a gift for my mother because it is her birthday.
for.exampleZh: 我给妈妈买了一份礼物，因为今天是她的生日。

forbid.example: My parents forbid us to play near the busy road.
forbid.exampleZh: 我父母禁止我们在繁忙的马路附近玩耍。

force.example: The police had to use force to stop the angry crowd.
force.exampleZh: 警察不得不使用武力来阻止愤怒的人群。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
forecast.exampleZh: 天气预报说明天会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

forehead.example: She put her hand on his forehead to check for a fever.
forehead.exampleZh: 她把手放在他的前额上，检查他是否发烧。

foreign.example: My friend is learning a foreign language at school this year.
foreign.exampleZh: 我的朋友今年在学校学习一门外语。

foreigner.example: The foreigner asked me for directions to the train station.
foreigner.exampleZh: 这位外国人向我问去火车站的路。

foremost.example: She is one of the foremost experts on climate change today.
foremost.exampleZh: 她是当今气候变化领域最重要的专家之一。

forest.example: Many wild animals live in this large green forest.
forest.exampleZh: 许多野生动物生活在这片大片绿色森林里。

forever.example: I will always remember my first teacher and be thankful forever.
forever.exampleZh: 我会永远记得我的第一位老师，并永远感恩。

forge.example: The workers forge steel in a hot fire every morning.
forge.exampleZh: 工人们每天早上在烈火中锻造钢铁。

forget.example: I often forget where I put my keys when I am in a hurry.
forget.exampleZh: 我赶时间的时候经常忘记把钥匙放在哪里了。

forgive.example: I hope you can forgive me for being late to your party.
forgive.exampleZh: 我希望你能原谅我参加你的聚会迟到了。

fork.example: At the fork in the road, turn left and follow the river.
fork.exampleZh: 在岔路口向左转，沿着河走。

form.example: Please fill in this form and give it to the teacher.
form.exampleZh: 请填写这张表格，然后交给老师。

formal.example: We need to wear formal clothes to the meeting tomorrow.
formal.exampleZh: 明天开会我们需要穿正式的衣服。

format.example: Please change the format of this file before you send it.
format.exampleZh: 发送前请更改此文件的格式。

formation.example: The formation of the new team took only two weeks.
formation.exampleZh: 新团队的组建只用了两周时间。

former.example: My former teacher now works in a big library.
former.exampleZh: 我以前的老师现在在一家大图书馆工作。

formula.example: The scientist wrote a simple formula on the board for the students.
formula.exampleZh: 科学家在黑板上为学生们写了一个简单的公式。

formulate.example: The team will formulate a simple plan for the new project.
formulate.exampleZh: 团队将为新项目系统阐述一个简单的计划。

forsake.example: He would never forsake his old friends, even after he became rich.
forsake.exampleZh: 即使变得富有，他也绝不会抛弃老朋友。

forth.example: He stepped forth from the crowd and spoke to the king.
forth.exampleZh: 他从人群中向前走出，对国王说话。

fortunate.example: I feel very fortunate to have such kind and helpful friends.
fortunate.exampleZh: 能有这样善良又乐于助人的朋友，我感到非常幸运。

fortune.example: He made a big fortune and then lost it all.
fortune.exampleZh: 他赚到了一大笔财富，后来又全都失去了。

forty.example: There are forty students in my class this year.
forty.exampleZh: 今年我们班有四十名学生。

forum.example: The school forum lets students share ideas about their classes.
forum.exampleZh: 学校的论坛让学生们分享关于课程的想法。

forward.example: Please move forward slowly and look at the front door.
forward.exampleZh: 请慢慢向前移动，看看前门。

fossil.example: Scientists found a fossil of a small fish in the rock.
fossil.exampleZh: 科学家在岩石中发现了一条小鱼的化石。

foster.example: They foster two children and try to foster good habits in them.
foster.exampleZh: 他们收养了两个孩子，并努力培养他们养成良好的习惯。

found.example: They founded a small school for the poor children in their town.
found.exampleZh: 他们在自己的镇上为穷苦的孩子们创办了一所小学校。

foundation.example: Trust is the foundation of every good friendship.
foundation.exampleZh: 信任是每一段良好友谊的基础。

founder.example: The founder of our school is a kind woman.
founder.exampleZh: 我们学校的创始人是一位善良的女性。

four.example: There are four people in my family, and we live together.
four.exampleZh: 我家有四口人，我们住在一起。

fourth.example: Her office is on the fourth floor, next to the stairs.
fourth.exampleZh: 她的办公室在四楼，紧挨着楼梯。

fox.example: The quick brown fox ran across the field and into the woods.
fox.exampleZh: 那只敏捷的棕色狐狸跑过田野，钻进了树林。

fraction.example: Only a small fraction of the students came to the meeting today.
fraction.exampleZh: 今天只有一小部分学生来参加会议。

fracture.example: The doctor said the fracture in his arm will heal in six weeks.
fracture.exampleZh: 医生说他的手臂骨折将在六周内愈合。

fragile.example: This glass is very fragile, so please hold it with both hands.
fragile.exampleZh: 这个玻璃杯非常易碎，所以请用双手拿稳。

fragment.example: A small fragment of glass was still stuck in his foot.
fragment.exampleZh: 一小块玻璃碎片还扎在他的脚上。

frame.example: He framed the old photo and hung it on the wall.
frame.exampleZh: 他把这张旧照片装进相框，挂在了墙上。

framework.example: The new framework helps us organize our work more clearly.
framework.exampleZh: 新的框架帮助我们更有条理地组织工作。

franchise.example: The small restaurant owner bought a franchise from a large company last year.
franchise.exampleZh: 这位小餐馆老板去年从一家大公司购买了一项特许经营权。

free.example: The museum is free for students, so we can visit it today.
free.exampleZh: 博物馆对学生免费，所以我们今天可以去参观。

freedom.example: Everyone should have the freedom to choose their own path in life.
freedom.exampleZh: 每个人都应该有选择自己人生道路的自由。

freeze.example: The water in the small pond will freeze when the weather gets very cold.
freeze.exampleZh: 天气变得很冷时，小池塘里的水就会结冰。

freight.example: The freight was too heavy for the small truck to carry.
freight.exampleZh: 这批货物太重了，那辆小卡车运不了。

frequency.example: The frequency of buses on this route is very high.
frequency.exampleZh: 这条线路上公交车的频率很高。

frequent.example: She makes frequent trips to the store near her home.
frequent.exampleZh: 她频繁地去她家附近的商店。

fresh.example: I bought some fresh fruit and vegetables at the market this morning.
fresh.exampleZh: 今天早上我在市场买了一些新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

friction.example: There was some friction between the two teams during the meeting.
friction.exampleZh: 会议期间，两个团队之间出现了一些摩擦。

friday.example: We will have a math test next Friday morning.
friday.exampleZh: 我们下星期五上午将有一场数学考试。

friend.example: My best friend lives in the same city and we play basketball together.
friend.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友住在同一个城市，我们一起打篮球。

friendly.example: The new teacher is very friendly to all the students in her class.
friendly.exampleZh: 新来的老师对她班上的所有学生都很友好。

friendship.example: True friendship grows when friends help each other in difficult times.
friendship.exampleZh: 真正的友谊在朋友困难时互相帮助中成长。

frighten.example: Loud noises at night can frighten small children and even some pets.
frighten.exampleZh: 夜里的巨响会吓到小孩子，甚至一些宠物。

frog.example: A green frog jumped into the small pond behind our house.
frog.exampleZh: 一只绿色的青蛙跳进了我们家后面的小池塘里。

from.example: I walk to school from my home every morning.
from.exampleZh: 我每天早上从家走路去学校。

front.example: The soldiers are fighting on the front and need more help.
front.exampleZh: 士兵们正在前线作战，需要更多支援。

frontier.example: Space is the final frontier for humans to explore and learn about.
frontier.exampleZh: 太空是人类探索和了解的最后边疆。

frost.example: The grass was white with frost this morning.
frost.exampleZh: 今天早晨草地上覆着一层白霜。

frown.example: She frowned when she saw the mess in the kitchen.
frown.exampleZh: 她看到厨房里一团糟时皱起了眉头。

frozen.example: The lake is frozen, so we can walk on it.
frozen.exampleZh: 湖面结冰了，我们可以走在上面。

fruit.example: Eating fresh fruit every day is a good habit for children.
fruit.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜水果是孩子们的好习惯。

frustrate.example: Long delays often frustrate people who are waiting for a bus.
frustrate.exampleZh: 长时间的延误常常让等公交车的人感到沮丧。

fry.example: Mom will fry two eggs for breakfast this morning.
fry.exampleZh: 今天早上妈妈会煎两个鸡蛋当早餐。

fuel.example: Cheaper fuel is needed to lower costs and fuel the growth of small businesses.
fuel.exampleZh: 需要更便宜的燃料来降低成本，并刺激小企业的发展。

fulfill.example: She worked hard every day to fulfill her dream of becoming a doctor.
fulfill.exampleZh: 她每天努力，为了实现成为医生的梦想。

full.example: The glass is full of cold water, so please drink it slowly.
full.exampleZh: 杯子里装满了冷水，所以请慢慢喝。

fun.example: We had a lot of fun at the beach last weekend.
fun.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海滩上玩得很开心。

function.example: This button has a special function that helps you save your work quickly.
function.exampleZh: 这个按钮有一个特殊功能，可以帮助你快速保存工作。

fund.example: The school used the fund to buy new books for the library.
fund.exampleZh: 学校用这笔资金为图书馆买了新书。

fundamental.example: Reading and writing are fundamental skills that every student needs at school.
fundamental.exampleZh: 阅读和写作是每个学生在学校都需要的基本技能。

funeral.example: Many people came to the funeral to say goodbye to their old friend.
funeral.exampleZh: 许多人来参加葬礼，向他们的老朋友告别。

funny.example: The funny little dog likes to run after its own tail.
funny.exampleZh: 那只古怪的小狗喜欢追着自己的尾巴跑。

fur.example: The cat has soft fur and likes to sleep on my bed.
fur.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的毛皮，喜欢睡在我的床上。

furious.example: My father was furious when he saw the broken window.
furious.exampleZh: 我父亲看到破窗户时非常愤怒。

furnish.example: They will furnish the new apartment with a table and two chairs.
furnish.exampleZh: 他们会用一张桌子和两把椅子来布置新公寓。

furnishings.example: The apartment comes with modern furnishings and a small kitchen.
furnishings.exampleZh: 这套公寓配有现代家具与陈设，还有一个小厨房。

furniture.example: We bought new furniture for our small living room last week.
furniture.exampleZh: 我们上周为小客厅买了新家具。

further.example: We need to talk further about this plan before we start.
further.exampleZh: 在开始之前，我们需要进一步讨论这个计划。

furthermore.example: The room is clean and quiet; furthermore, it costs very little.
furthermore.exampleZh: 这个房间干净又安静，而且花费很少。

fuse.example: The old wires may fuse together and cause a fire.
fuse.exampleZh: 旧电线可能会熔合在一起，引发火灾。

fuss.example: There is no need to make such a fuss about a small mistake.
fuss.exampleZh: 没必要为一个小错误这么大惊小怪。

future.example: In the future, I want to travel and see more of the world.
future.exampleZh: 未来，我想去旅行，看看世界上更多的地方。

gadget.example: My father bought a small gadget that helps him open jars easily.
gadget.exampleZh: 我爸爸买了一个小器具，能帮他轻松打开罐子。

gaiety.example: The music and dancing filled the whole room with gaiety.
gaiety.exampleZh: 音乐和舞蹈让整个房间充满了欢乐。

gain.example: You can gain useful skills from a part-time job.
gain.exampleZh: 你可以从兼职工作中获得有用的技能。

galaxy.example: Our galaxy has many stars, and scientists study them every night.
galaxy.exampleZh: 我们的星系有许多恒星，科学家们每晚都在研究它们。

gallery.example: We walked through the art gallery and looked at many old paintings.
gallery.exampleZh: 我们穿过艺术画廊，看了许多古老的画作。

gallop.example: The horse began to gallop across the open field.
gallop.exampleZh: 那匹马开始在开阔的田野上飞奔。

gamble.example: He likes to gamble with his friends on weekend nights.
gamble.exampleZh: 他喜欢在周末晚上和朋友们赌博。

game.example: The children play a fun game in the park after school.
game.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们在公园里玩一个有趣的游戏。

gang.example: A gang of boys was playing football in the street.
gang.exampleZh: 一帮男孩在街上踢足球。

gap.example: There is a big gap between rich and poor families here.
gap.exampleZh: 这里的富裕家庭和贫困家庭之间存在很大的差距。

garage.example: My father keeps his old car in the garage behind our house.
garage.exampleZh: 我父亲把他的旧车停在我们家后面的车库里。

garbage.example: Please put the garbage in the bin outside the kitchen door.
garbage.exampleZh: 请把垃圾放到厨房门外的垃圾桶里。

garden.example: There are many beautiful flowers in our small garden.
garden.exampleZh: 我们的小花园里有很多美丽的花。

garlic.example: My mother puts fresh garlic in almost every dish she cooks.
garlic.exampleZh: 我妈妈做的几乎每道菜里都会放大蒜。

garment.example: She wore a warm garment over her dress because the morning was cold.
garment.exampleZh: 因为早上很冷，她在连衣裙外面穿了一件暖和的外衣。

gas.example: Please turn off the gas before you leave the house tonight.
gas.exampleZh: 今晚离开房子前请把煤气关掉。

gasoline.example: We need to buy gasoline before we drive to the mountains.
gasoline.exampleZh: 我们开车去山里之前需要买汽油。

gate.example: The gate to the garden is open, so please close it.
gate.exampleZh: 花园的大门开着，请把它关上。

gather.example: People gather in the park every weekend to enjoy the sun.
gather.exampleZh: 每个周末人们都聚集在公园里享受阳光。

gauge.example: Teachers use tests to gauge how much students learn in class.
gauge.exampleZh: 老师用考试来估计学生在课堂上学到了多少。

gay.example: Everyone was gay and cheerful at the family party last night.
gay.exampleZh: 昨晚的家庭聚会上，大家都很开心快乐。

gaze.example: She gazed at the stars for a long time last night.
gaze.exampleZh: 昨晚她久久地凝视着星星。

gear.example: He changed gears on his bike before riding up the steep hill.
gear.exampleZh: 他在骑上陡坡之前换了自行车的挡位。

gender.example: Please write your name, age and gender on this form.
gender.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

gene.example: Each gene in your body helps decide how you grow and look.
gene.exampleZh: 你身体里的每个基因都帮助决定你如何生长和外表如何。

general.example: This is a general rule for all new workers here.
general.exampleZh: 这是这里所有新员工的一般规则。

generally.example: People generally sleep better when they go to bed at the same time every night.
generally.exampleZh: 人们通常在每个晚上同一时间上床睡觉时睡得更好。

generate.example: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight on bright days.
generate.exampleZh: 太阳能电池板在晴朗的日子里利用阳光发电。

generation.example: This new generation of students learns quickly with computers.
generation.exampleZh: 这新一代学生用电脑学得很快。

generator.example: The generator in our building keeps the lights on during a power cut.
generator.exampleZh: 我们楼里的发电机在停电时能让灯继续亮着。

generous.example: My generous friend always shares his lunch with me at school.
generous.exampleZh: 我慷慨的朋友总是在学校和我分享他的午餐。

genetic.example: Genetic tests can tell you about some health risks before you get sick.
genetic.exampleZh: 基因检测可以在你生病之前告诉你一些健康风险。

genius.example: She is a genius at solving hard math problems quickly.
genius.exampleZh: 她是个能快速解决数学难题的天才。

genre.example: This book is my favorite genre because it has many exciting stories.
genre.exampleZh: 这本书是我最喜欢的体裁，因为里面有很多精彩的故事。

gentle.example: The nurse spoke in a gentle voice to the small child.
gentle.exampleZh: 护士用温和的声音对那个小孩说话。

gentleman.example: The old gentleman opened the door for us and smiled kindly.
gentleman.exampleZh: 那位老先生为我们开门，并和蔼地笑了笑。

genuine.example: Her smile was genuine, and everyone in the room felt it.
genuine.exampleZh: 她的微笑是真诚的，房间里的每个人都感受到了。

geography.example: I like geography because I want to learn about different countries and maps.
geography.exampleZh: 我喜欢地理，因为我想了解不同的国家和地图。

geometry.example: I like geometry because shapes and angles are easy to draw.
geometry.exampleZh: 我喜欢几何，因为图形和角度都容易画。

gesture.example: She made a friendly gesture with her hand to say hello.
gesture.exampleZh: 她用手做了一个友好的手势来打招呼。

ghost.example: The children say they saw a ghost in the old house last night.
ghost.exampleZh: 孩子们说他们昨晚在那栋老房子里看见了一个鬼。

giant.example: A giant tree stands in the middle of our small garden.
giant.exampleZh: 一棵巨大的树矗立在我们小花园的中央。

gift.example: My sister gave me a small gift on my birthday.
gift.exampleZh: 我生日那天姐姐送了我一份小礼物。

gigantic.example: They found a gigantic tree in the middle of the forest.
gigantic.exampleZh: 他们在森林中央发现了一棵巨大的树。

girl.example: The little girl is playing with her new red ball.
girl.exampleZh: 这个小女孩正在玩她的新红球。

give.example: Please give this book to your sister when you go home.
give.exampleZh: 你回家时请把这本书给你的妹妹。

glad.example: I am glad to see you here today.
glad.exampleZh: 今天在这里见到你，我很高兴。

glance.example: She gave the paper a quick glance and then smiled at me.
glance.exampleZh: 她快速瞥了一眼那张纸，然后对我笑了笑。

glare.example: The sun's glare on the wet road made it hard to drive.
glare.exampleZh: 湿滑路面上的阳光刺眼，让开车变得困难。

glass.example: Please put the glass on the table next to my glasses.
glass.exampleZh: 请把玻璃杯放到桌上我的眼镜旁边。

glimpse.example: I caught a quick glimpse of the sea through the trees.
glimpse.exampleZh: 我透过树木快速瞥见了大海。

global.example: Global trade has grown quickly over the past twenty years.
global.exampleZh: 过去二十年里，全球贸易增长迅速。

globe.example: She looked at the globe and found the country where her friend lives.
globe.exampleZh: 她看着地球仪，找到了她朋友居住的国家。

gloomy.example: The room felt gloomy because the curtains were closed all day.
gloomy.exampleZh: 房间显得阴暗，因为窗帘整天都关着。

glory.example: The soldiers fought for the glory of their country.
glory.exampleZh: 士兵们为国家的光荣而战。

glove.example: I lost one of my gloves on the way to school yesterday.
glove.exampleZh: 昨天上学路上我丢了一只手套。

glow.example: Her face began to glow with joy when she saw the good news.
glow.exampleZh: 当她看到这个好消息时，她的脸上开始泛起喜悦的红晕。

glue.example: I used glue to stick the two pieces of paper together.
glue.exampleZh: 我用胶水把两张纸粘在一起。

go.example: I go to school by bus every morning.
go.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐公交车去学校。

goal.example: My goal is to learn English well this year.
goal.exampleZh: 我的目标是今年把英语学好。

god.example: Many people pray to God when they feel afraid or alone.
god.exampleZh: 许多人在感到害怕或孤独时会向上帝祈祷。

gold.example: She wore a beautiful gold ring on her finger.
gold.exampleZh: 她手指上戴着一枚漂亮的金戒指。

golden.example: The leaves turn golden in the autumn sun.
golden.exampleZh: 秋日的阳光下，树叶变成了金黄色。

good.example: She is a good teacher and always helps her students after class.
good.exampleZh: 她是一位好老师，课后总是帮助她的学生。

goods.example: The goods were delivered to the store early this morning.
goods.exampleZh: 这批货物今天一早被送到了商店。

goose.example: The white goose swims across the pond with her three babies.
goose.exampleZh: 那只白鹅带着她的三只小鹅游过池塘。

govern.example: Strong laws govern how people treat each other in a fair society.
govern.exampleZh: 在公平的社会中，强有力的法律支配着人们如何对待彼此。

government.example: The government is working to make our city safer for everyone.
government.exampleZh: 政府正在努力让我们的城市对每个人都更安全。

governor.example: The governor visited our school and spoke to the students today.
governor.exampleZh: 州长今天参观了我们的学校并与学生们交谈。

gown.example: She wore a long white gown to the party last night.
gown.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一件白色长袍去参加聚会。

grab.example: He tried to grab the last seat on the crowded bus.
grab.exampleZh: 他试着在拥挤的公交车上抢占最后一个座位。

grace.example: She moved across the room with great grace and a warm smile.
grace.exampleZh: 她带着极大的优雅和温暖的微笑走过房间。

graceful.example: The dancer made a graceful turn and smiled at the crowd.
graceful.exampleZh: 那位舞者优雅地转了个身，朝人群微笑。

gradual.example: The weather is getting warmer with a gradual change over the past few weeks.
gradual.exampleZh: 过去几周里，天气随着逐渐的变化而变暖了。

gradually.example: The weather gradually got warmer as spring arrived.
gradually.exampleZh: 随着春天的到来，天气逐渐变暖了。

graduate.example: She will graduate from high school next year and then go to college.
graduate.exampleZh: 她明年将从高中毕业，然后去上大学。

grain.example: The farmer stores his grain in a large wooden box.
grain.exampleZh: 农民把谷物储存在一个大木箱里。

grand.example: The old hotel has a grand entrance with tall white doors.
grand.exampleZh: 这家老酒店有一个宏伟的入口，配有高高的白色大门。

grant.example: The school gave him a grant to study abroad for one year.
grant.exampleZh: 学校给了他一项拨款，让他出国学习一年。

grape.example: She bought some fresh grapes at the market and shared them with her friends.
grape.exampleZh: 她在市场上买了些新鲜葡萄，并和朋友们一起分享。

graph.example: The teacher showed us a graph of the test scores.
graph.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了一张考试成绩的图表。

graphic.example: The report uses a graphic chart to show yearly sales.
graphic.exampleZh: 这份报告用一张图表展示年度销售额。

grasp.example: She quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson.
grasp.exampleZh: 她很快理解这节课的主要意思。

grass.example: The children are playing on the green grass in front of our house.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们房子前面的绿色草地上玩耍。

grateful.example: I am very grateful for your help with my homework today.
grateful.exampleZh: 我非常感激你今天帮我做作业。

gravity.example: The gravity of the situation made everyone quiet and serious.
gravity.exampleZh: 形势的严重性让每个人都安静下来并变得严肃。

gray.example: The sky looks gray and cold today, so we stay home.
gray.exampleZh: 今天天空阴沉又寒冷，所以我们待在家里。

great.example: She is a great teacher, and all her students love her class.
great.exampleZh: 她是一位伟大的老师，她所有的学生都喜欢她的课。

greedy.example: The greedy boy ate all the cookies and left none for his sister.
greedy.exampleZh: 那个贪婪的男孩吃光了所有饼干，一点也没给妹妹留。

green.example: The young green apples on the tree are not sweet yet.
green.exampleZh: 树上那些绿色的嫩苹果还不甜。

greet.example: I always greet my neighbors when I see them in the morning.
greet.exampleZh: 我早上看到邻居时总会向他们问好。

grief.example: She could not hide her grief when her old dog died.
grief.exampleZh: 她的老狗去世时，她无法掩饰自己的悲伤。

grim.example: The old house looked grim in the dark stormy night.
grim.exampleZh: 那栋老房子在黑暗的风雨夜里显得阴森可怖。

grin.example: She grinned at me when she heard the good news.
grin.exampleZh: 她听到这个好消息时冲我露齿一笑。

grind.example: She used a small machine to grind the coffee beans every morning.
grind.exampleZh: 她每天早上用一台小机器磨咖啡豆。

grip.example: She had to grip the railing tightly as the bus turned the corner.
grip.exampleZh: 公交车转弯时，她不得不紧紧抓住栏杆。

groan.example: He groaned with pain when he tried to stand up.
groan.exampleZh: 当他试图站起来时，他疼得呻吟起来。

grocery.example: I need to stop at the grocery store to buy milk and bread.
grocery.exampleZh: 我得在食品杂货店停一下，买些牛奶和面包。

gross.example: The company's gross income was much higher than we expected last year.
gross.exampleZh: 公司去年的总收入远高于我们的预期。

ground.example: The children are playing on the ground near the school.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们正在学校附近的地面上玩耍。

group.example: Our teacher put us in a small group to finish the science project together.
group.exampleZh: 老师把我们分成一个小组，一起完成科学项目。

grove.example: We walked through the quiet grove behind the old farm house.
grove.exampleZh: 我们穿过那座旧农舍后面安静的小树林。

grow.example: Many trees grow very quickly in warm and rainy places.
grow.exampleZh: 许多树在温暖多雨的地方生长得很快。

growth.example: Good food and enough water help the growth of young plants.
growth.exampleZh: 充足的食物和水有助于幼苗的生长。

guarantee.example: I cannot guarantee that the train will arrive on time today.
guarantee.exampleZh: 我无法保证火车今天会准时到达。

guard.example: Two soldiers guard the gate at night and watch for danger.
guard.exampleZh: 两名士兵夜里守卫大门，警惕危险。

guess.example: I guess she will come to the party tonight.
guess.exampleZh: 我猜她今晚会来参加聚会。

guest.example: We have a guest from another city staying with us this week.
guest.exampleZh: 本周有一位来自另一个城市的客人住在我们家里。

guidance.example: Our teacher gave us clear guidance on how to finish the project.
guidance.exampleZh: 老师就如何完成这个项目给了我们明确的指导。

guide.example: Our guide showed us the way through the old city.
guide.exampleZh: 我们的向导带我们穿过老城区。

guideline.example: The new guidelines tell us how to use the computers safely.
guideline.exampleZh: 新的指导方针告诉我们如何安全使用电脑。

guilt.example: He felt a deep sense of guilt after he lied to his mother.
guilt.exampleZh: 他对母亲撒谎后感到深深的内疚。

guilty.example: He felt guilty about forgetting his sister's birthday last week.
guilty.exampleZh: 他因为忘了妹妹上周的生日而感到内疚。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after he finishes his homework.
guitar.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天晚上写完作业后都会弹吉他。

gulf.example: There is a wide gulf between the two countries on this issue.
gulf.exampleZh: 两国在这个问题上存在巨大鸿沟。

gum.example: My dentist said chewing gum every day is bad for my gums.
gum.exampleZh: 我的牙医说每天嚼口香糖对我的牙龈不好。

gun.example: The police found a gun hidden under the bed in the empty room.
gun.exampleZh: 警方在空房间的床下发现了一把藏起来的枪。

gut.example: He trusted his gut and said no to the dangerous deal.
gut.exampleZh: 他相信自己的直觉，拒绝了那笔危险的交易。

guy.example: That guy over there is my best friend from high school.
guy.exampleZh: 那边那个家伙是我高中时最好的朋友。

gym.example: I go to the gym after work to exercise with my friends.
gym.exampleZh: 我下班后去健身房和朋友们一起锻炼。

habit.example: Reading before bed has become a good habit for me.
habit.exampleZh: 睡前阅读已经成为我的一个好习惯。

habitat.example: The forest is a good habitat for many birds and small animals.
habitat.exampleZh: 这片森林是许多鸟类和小型动物的良好栖息地。

hail.example: The crowd began to hail the young singer with loud cheers.
hail.exampleZh: 人群开始用响亮的欢呼声欢迎这位年轻歌手。

hair.example: She has long black hair and a big smile.
hair.exampleZh: 她有一头长长的黑发和灿烂的笑容。

half.example: Half of the cake was eaten by the children after lunch.
half.exampleZh: 午饭后，孩子们吃掉了一半的蛋糕。

hall.example: We waited in the hall for our teacher to arrive.
hall.exampleZh: 我们在门厅里等老师到来。

halt.example: The driver halted the car at the red light.
halt.exampleZh: 司机在红灯前停下了车。

hammer.example: He used a heavy hammer to fix the wooden chair.
hammer.exampleZh: 他用一把重锤子修好了那把木椅。

hamper.example: Heavy rain hampered our plans, so we stayed at home with a large hamper of food.
hamper.exampleZh: 大雨妨碍了我们的计划，于是我们带着一大篮食物待在家里。

hand.example: Please hand the book to your teacher before you leave the classroom.
hand.exampleZh: 离开教室前，请把书交给你的老师。

handbook.example: This handbook gives useful advice to all new students.
handbook.exampleZh: 这本手册为所有新生提供了有用的建议。

handful.example: Only a handful of students came to the meeting today.
handful.exampleZh: 今天只有少数几个学生来参加会议。

handicap.example: His poor eyesight is a handicap when he plays ball games.
handicap.exampleZh: 他视力不好，这在他打球时是一个不利条件。

handkerchief.example: He wiped his face with a clean handkerchief after the long run.
handkerchief.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他用一块干净的手帕擦了擦脸。

handle.example: She can handle this difficult problem by herself.
handle.exampleZh: 她能够独自处理这个难题。

handsome.example: Her handsome brother gave a generous gift to the poor family.
handsome.exampleZh: 她英俊的哥哥给那个贫困家庭送了一份慷慨的礼物。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is small and neat, so her notes are easy to read.
handwriting.exampleZh: 她的字迹又小又工整，所以她的笔记读起来很方便。

handy.example: This small tool is handy when you need to fix things at home.
handy.exampleZh: 当你需要在家修理东西时，这个小工具很方便。

hang.example: She likes to hang her wet clothes outside on the balcony.
hang.exampleZh: 她喜欢把湿衣服挂在阳台外面。

happen.example: Bad things happen when people do not plan their work carefully.
happen.exampleZh: 当人们不仔细规划工作时，糟糕的事情就会发生。

happiness.example: True happiness comes from good friends and a peaceful heart.
happiness.exampleZh: 真正的幸福来自好朋友和一颗平静的心。

happy.example: The children were very happy to see the snow this morning.
happy.exampleZh: 孩子们今天早上看到雪非常开心。

harassment.example: She reported the harassment at work and asked her manager for help.
harassment.exampleZh: 她举报了工作中的骚扰行为，并向经理寻求帮助。

harbor.example: The small boat stayed in the harbor until the storm passed.
harbor.exampleZh: 小船一直停在港湾里，直到暴风雨过去。

hard.example: This bread is very hard, so it is difficult to eat.
hard.exampleZh: 这个面包很硬，所以很难吃。

harden.example: The cold air made the wet ground harden quickly overnight.
harden.exampleZh: 冷空气使潮湿的地面在一夜之间迅速变硬。

hardly.example: I could hardly hear him because the room was very noisy.
hardly.exampleZh: 房间里很吵，我几乎听不见他说话。

hardship.example: She faced many hardships after losing her job last year.
hardship.exampleZh: 去年失业后，她面临了许多艰难困苦。

hardware.example: The store sells tools and other hardware for your home.
hardware.exampleZh: 这家商店出售工具和其他家用五金器具。

hardy.example: These hardy farmers work outside all winter and rarely get sick.
hardy.exampleZh: 这些强壮的农民整个冬天都在户外劳作，很少生病。

harm.example: Too much sugar can do real harm to your health.
harm.exampleZh: 吃太多糖会对你的健康造成真正的伤害。

harmony.example: The two families lived together in peace and harmony for many years.
harmony.exampleZh: 两家人多年来和睦相处，平安融洽。

harness.example: We can harness the power of the sun to make clean electricity.
harness.exampleZh: 我们可以利用太阳能来产生清洁电力。

harsh.example: The teacher's harsh words made the young boy feel very sad.
harsh.exampleZh: 老师严厉的话语让那个小男孩感到非常难过。

harvest.example: The farmers harvest the rice in autumn every year.
harvest.exampleZh: 农民们每年秋天收割稻子。

haste.example: In her haste to leave, she forgot her keys on the table.
haste.exampleZh: 她匆忙离开，把钥匙忘在了桌子上。

hasty.example: Don't be hasty about this decision; take more time to think.
hasty.exampleZh: 不要草率做这个决定，多花点时间想想。

hatch.example: The thieves hatched a plan to steal the old car.
hatch.exampleZh: 小偷们策划了一个偷走那辆旧车的计划。

hate.example: I hate waiting for the bus in the cold rain.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌在寒冷的雨中等公交车。

hatred.example: His deep hatred for the enemy made him cold and silent.
hatred.exampleZh: 他对敌人的深切仇恨使他变得冷酷而沉默。

haul.example: They had to haul the heavy boxes up the stairs.
haul.exampleZh: 他们不得不把那些沉重的箱子拖上楼梯。

haunt.example: The old song still haunts me, and I often visit that quiet place.
haunt.exampleZh: 那首老歌仍萦绕于我的心头，我也常去那个安静的地方。

have.example: I have two brothers and we all have lunch together every Sunday.
have.exampleZh: 我有两个兄弟，我们每个星期天都一起吃午饭。

hazard.example: Smoking is a serious hazard to your health.
hazard.exampleZh: 吸烟对健康是严重的危害。

he.example: He is my best friend at school.
he.exampleZh: 他是我在学校最好的朋友。

head.example: She turned her head and led the team toward the door.
head.exampleZh: 她转过头，带领团队朝门口走去。

heading.example: The heading of the article tells readers what the topic is.
heading.exampleZh: 文章的标题告诉读者话题是什么。

headline.example: The headline in today's newspaper was very big and easy to read.
headline.exampleZh: 今天报纸上的标题很大，很容易看清。

headquarters.example: The company moved its headquarters to a bigger city last year.
headquarters.exampleZh: 公司去年把总部搬到了一座更大的城市。

heal.example: Time can heal a broken heart and help people forgive each other.
heal.exampleZh: 时间可以治愈受伤的心，也能帮助人们彼此宽恕。

health.example: Regular exercise and good food are important for your health.
health.exampleZh: 规律的锻炼和良好的饮食对你的健康很重要。

heap.example: There is a heap of old books in the corner of my room.
heap.exampleZh: 我房间的角落里有一堆旧书。

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能听见窗外鸟儿在唱歌。

hearing.example: His hearing was damaged after years of working in the noisy factory.
hearing.exampleZh: 在嘈杂的工厂工作多年后，他的听力受到了损伤。

heart.example: She put her hand on his heart and felt it beating fast.
heart.exampleZh: 她把手放在他的胸口上，感觉到他的心跳得很快。

heat.example: The heat from the sun makes the room warm in the afternoon.
heat.exampleZh: 阳光的热度让房间在下午变得温暖。

heave.example: He heaved the heavy box onto the truck and then felt sick.
heave.exampleZh: 他把那个沉重的箱子用力搬上卡车，然后感到恶心。

heaven.example: She believes her kind grandmother is now in heaven.
heaven.exampleZh: 她相信她善良的祖母现在在天堂。

heavy.example: This old box is too heavy for me to carry.
heavy.exampleZh: 这个旧箱子太重了，我搬不动。

hedge.example: The farmer planted a hedge around his garden to keep animals out.
hedge.exampleZh: 农民在花园周围种了一道树篱，防止动物进入。

heel.example: My new shoes hurt my heel when I walk too far.
heel.exampleZh: 我走路太远时，新鞋会磨我的脚后跟。

height.example: The height of the wall is about three meters.
height.exampleZh: 这堵墙的高度大约是三米。

heir.example: The old man gave his house to his only heir.
heir.exampleZh: 那位老人把房子给了他唯一的继承人。

helicopter.example: A helicopter landed on the roof of the tall building this morning.
helicopter.exampleZh: 今天早上，一架直升机降落在这栋高楼的楼顶上。

hell.example: He said the noisy city felt like hell to him.
hell.exampleZh: 他说这座喧闹的城市对他来说就像地狱。

hello.example: Hello, nice to meet you and welcome to our small English class.
hello.exampleZh: 你好，很高兴认识你，欢迎来到我们的小英语课堂。

help.example: Can you help me carry these books to the library?
help.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些书搬到图书馆吗？

helpful.example: My teacher is very helpful when I have questions about math.
helpful.exampleZh: 当我数学有问题时，我的老师非常乐于助人。

hemisphere.example: The sun shines more directly on the southern hemisphere in December.
hemisphere.exampleZh: 十二月，阳光更直接地照射在南半球。

hen.example: The hen laid three eggs in the nest this morning.
hen.exampleZh: 这只母鸡今天早上在窝里下了三个蛋。

hence.example: It was raining hard, hence we stayed at home all day.
hence.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此我们整天待在家里。

her.example: I gave her a small gift for her birthday.
her.exampleZh: 我送了她一份小礼物作为生日礼物。

herb.example: My mother puts fresh herb leaves in the soup.
herb.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放新鲜的香草叶。

herd.example: The farmer led his herd of cows across the wide green field.
herd.exampleZh: 农夫带着他的牛群穿过宽阔的绿色田野。

here.example: Please sit here and wait for your name to be called.
here.exampleZh: 请坐在这里，等着叫到你的名字。

heritage.example: The old town is an important part of our cultural heritage.
heritage.exampleZh: 这座古镇是我们文化遗产的重要组成部分。

hero.example: The young firefighter became a hero after saving two children from the fire.
hero.exampleZh: 那名年轻的消防员从火灾中救出两个孩子后成为了英雄。

hesitate.example: I hesitate to answer because I am not sure.
hesitate.exampleZh: 我犹豫着不敢回答，因为我不确定。

hide.example: The cat likes to hide under the bed when it is scared.
hide.exampleZh: 那只猫害怕时喜欢躲在床底下。

hierarchy.example: The company has a clear hierarchy of managers and workers.
hierarchy.exampleZh: 公司有着明确的经理与员工的等级制度。

high.example: The tall tree is very high, but the wall is higher.
high.exampleZh: 那棵大树很高，但那堵墙更高。

highlight.example: The teacher used a red pen to highlight the important words in my essay.
highlight.exampleZh: 老师用红笔标出了我作文里的重要词语。

highly.example: My teacher thinks highly of my work and says I am improving.
highly.exampleZh: 老师非常赞许我的作业，说我正在进步。

highway.example: We drove along the new highway to reach the city.
highway.exampleZh: 我们沿着新建的公路开车前往那座城市。

hike.example: We plan to hike in the mountains this weekend if the weather stays nice.
hike.exampleZh: 如果天气一直不错，我们打算这个周末去山里远足。

hill.example: There is a small house at the top of the hill.

him.example: I gave him a book for his birthday last week.
him.exampleZh: 上周他生日时我给了他一本书。

hinder.example: Heavy rain may hinder our plans to hike in the mountains tomorrow.
hinder.exampleZh: 大雨可能会妨碍我们明天去山里徒步的计划。

hint.example: He gave me a hint about the answer, but I still did not understand.
hint.exampleZh: 他给了我一个关于答案的提示，但我还是没明白。

hip.example: My grandmother fell and broke her hip last winter.
hip.exampleZh: 我奶奶去年冬天摔倒，摔断了髋部。

hire.example: We will hire a car for two days in the city.
hire.exampleZh: 我们将在城里租一辆车用两天。

his.example: His bag is on the table near the door.
his.exampleZh: 他的包在门附近的桌子上。

historian.example: The historian wrote a short book about life in ancient China.
historian.exampleZh: 这位历史学家写了一本关于中国古代生活的小书。

historic.example: This is a historic day for our small town and its people.
historic.exampleZh: 对我们的小镇和镇上的人们来说，这是具有历史意义的一天。

historical.example: We visited a historical museum to learn about life in the past.
historical.exampleZh: 我们参观了一座历史博物馆，了解了过去的生活。

history.example: She studied history at college and later became a teacher.
history.exampleZh: 她在大学学习历史，后来成为一名教师。

hit.example: The ball hit the window and broke the glass.
hit.exampleZh: 球击中了窗户，打碎了玻璃。

hitherto.example: The old factory has hitherto kept its doors closed to visitors.
hitherto.exampleZh: 这家老工厂迄今一直对访客紧闭大门。

hobby.example: My favorite hobby is reading books in the park on sunny days.
hobby.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的业余爱好是在晴朗的日子里在公园读书。

hold.example: She will hold a small meeting in her office tomorrow morning.
hold.exampleZh: 她明天上午将在办公室举行一个小型会议。

hole.example: The rabbit ran into a deep hole under the old tree.
hole.exampleZh: 兔子跑进了老树下那个深洞里。

holiday.example: We will take a long holiday after the busy school year ends.
holiday.exampleZh: 繁忙的学年结束后，我们将度一个长假。

hollow.example: The old tree in the garden looks strong, but it is hollow inside.
hollow.exampleZh: 花园里那棵老树看起来很强壮，但里面是空心的。

holy.example: This old church is a holy place for many people.
holy.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂对许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

home.example: After a long trip, I was happy to go home and rest.
home.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，我很高兴回家休息。

homework.example: I always finish my homework before I watch TV.
homework.exampleZh: 我总是在看电视之前完成家庭作业。

homogeneous.example: The mixture should be homogeneous, with no lumps or separate layers.
homogeneous.exampleZh: 这种混合物应当是均匀的，没有结块，也没有分层。

honest.example: She is an honest girl and always tells the truth to her friends.
honest.exampleZh: 她是个诚实的女孩，总是对朋友说真话。

honesty.example: Her honesty made everyone trust her more.
honesty.exampleZh: 她的诚实让大家更加信任她。

honey.example: My little girl likes to put honey in her warm tea.
honey.exampleZh: 我女儿喜欢在热茶里加蜂蜜。

honor.example: It is a great honor to meet you today.
honor.exampleZh: 今天见到您是我的莫大荣幸。

hook.example: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
hook.exampleZh: 请把你的外套挂在门边的挂钩上。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party next week.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你下周能来参加我的生日聚会。

horizon.example: The sun went down below the horizon and the sky turned dark.
horizon.exampleZh: 太阳落到地平线以下，天空变暗了。

horizontal.example: The books are arranged in a horizontal line on the shelf.
horizontal.exampleZh: 这些书在书架上排成一条水平线。

horn.example: The old car's horn made a loud noise in the street.
horn.exampleZh: 那辆旧汽车的喇叭在街上发出了很大的响声。

horror.example: She watched the horror movie with her hands over her eyes.
horror.exampleZh: 她双手捂住眼睛看那部恐怖电影。

horse.example: She rides a brown horse every morning before school.
horse.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前骑一匹棕色的马。

hospital.example: My mother works at a big hospital in the city center.
hospital.exampleZh: 我妈妈在市中心的一家大医院工作。

hospitality.example: The hospitality of the local family made our trip very pleasant.
hospitality.exampleZh: 当地家庭的殷勤好客让我们的旅行非常愉快。

host.example: Our host made us dinner and then hosted a small party.
host.exampleZh: 我们的主人给我们做了晚饭，然后举办了一个小型聚会。

hostage.example: The police worked all night to free the hostage safely.
hostage.exampleZh: 警察通宵工作，以安全解救人质。

hostess.example: The hostess welcomed us at the door and showed us to our table.
hostess.exampleZh: 女主人站在门口迎接我们，并带我们到餐桌前。

hostile.example: The hostile crowd shouted at the players as they left the field.
hostile.exampleZh: 敌对的人群在球员们离场时对他们大声喊叫。

hot.example: This soup is too hot to eat right now.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤太烫了，现在没法喝。

hotel.example: We stayed at a small hotel near the train station last night.
hotel.exampleZh: 昨晚我们住在火车站附近一家小旅馆里。

hour.example: I study English for one hour every evening after dinner.
hour.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后学一小时英语。

house.example: They bought a small house near the river last year.
house.exampleZh: 他们去年在河边买了一栋小房子。

household.example: This household uses less water than most families on our street.
household.exampleZh: 这户人家的用水量比我们街上大多数家庭都少。

housewife.example: My mother was a housewife who cooked and cleaned for us.
housewife.exampleZh: 我母亲是一位家庭主妇，为我们做饭和打扫。

housing.example: The city needs more housing for young families.
housing.exampleZh: 这座城市需要为年轻家庭提供更多住房。

hover.example: A helicopter hovered above the building while people waited on the street below.
hover.exampleZh: 一架直升机在大楼上空盘旋，人们在下方的街道上等待。

how.example: How do you get to the train station from here?

however.example: I wanted to go out, however the heavy rain kept me at home.
however.exampleZh: 我本想出门，可是大雨把我困在了家里。

hug.example: She gave her mother a warm hug at the door.
hug.exampleZh: 她在门口给了妈妈一个温暖的拥抱。

huge.example: The new shopping mall is huge and has many small shops inside.
huge.exampleZh: 这个新购物中心非常巨大，里面有很多小商店。

human.example: Human needs for food and water are the same everywhere.
human.exampleZh: 人对食物和水的需求在任何地方都是一样的。

humanity.example: The teacher said that humanity must work together to protect the earth.
humanity.exampleZh: 老师说人类必须共同努力保护地球。

humble.example: He is humble about his success and always helps others.
humble.exampleZh: 他对自己的成功很谦逊，并且总是帮助别人。

humid.example: The air in the room is very humid and warm today.
humid.exampleZh: 今天房间里的空气又潮湿又闷热。

humidity.example: The humidity in the room is very high today, so please open the window.
humidity.exampleZh: 今天房间里的湿度很高，请打开窗户。

humor.example: His sense of humor makes every meeting easier and more fun.
humor.exampleZh: 他的幽默感让每次会议都更轻松、更有趣。

hundred.example: There are one hundred students in the big school hall today.
hundred.exampleZh: 今天那个大礼堂里有一百名学生。

hunger.example: After the long hike, his hunger made even plain bread taste wonderful.
hunger.exampleZh: 长途徒步之后，他的饥饿让连普通的面包都尝起来很美味。

hungry.example: The hungry children ate all the bread on the table.
hungry.exampleZh: 那些饥饿的孩子们把桌上的面包都吃光了。

hunt.example: Every winter my uncle hunts in the quiet forest near his small village.
hunt.exampleZh: 每年冬天，我叔叔都会在他小村庄附近安静的森林里打猎。

hurry.example: Please hurry, or we will miss the last bus home.
hurry.exampleZh: 请快点，否则我们会错过回家的末班车。

hurt.example: Be careful with that knife, or you will hurt your hand.
hurt.exampleZh: 小心那把刀，否则你会伤到自己的手。

husband.example: My husband cooks dinner for our family every evening.
husband.exampleZh: 我丈夫每天晚上为我们一家做晚饭。

hut.example: The old farmer lives in a small hut near the river.
hut.exampleZh: 那位老农夫住在河边的一间小屋里。

hydrogen.example: Hydrogen is the lightest gas and is used as clean fuel.
hydrogen.exampleZh: 氢是最轻的气体，被用作清洁燃料。

hypocrisy.example: His kindness was pure hypocrisy, and everyone in the office knew it.
hypocrisy.exampleZh: 他的善意纯粹是伪善，办公室里的每个人都知道。

hypothesis.example: Our teacher asked us to test this simple hypothesis in class.
hypothesis.exampleZh: 老师让我们在课堂上验证这个简单的假设。

hysterical.example: She became hysterical when she saw the broken window in her room.
hysterical.exampleZh: 她看到房间里的窗户被打破时，变得歇斯底里。

ice.example: Please put some ice in my glass before you pour the juice.
ice.exampleZh: 在你倒果汁之前，请先往我的杯子里放一些冰块。

idea.example: I have a good idea for our class trip this year.
idea.exampleZh: 对于今年的班级旅行，我有个好主意。

ideal.example: This small town is an ideal place to raise a family.
ideal.exampleZh: 这个小镇是养家糊口的理想之地。

identical.example: The two sisters wore identical dresses to the party last night.
identical.exampleZh: 这对姐妹昨晚穿着一模一样的连衣裙去参加聚会。

identification.example: The police need your identification before they can let you enter the building.
identification.exampleZh: 警察需要你的身份证明才能让你进入大楼。

identify.example: The teacher asked me to identify the plant in the picture.
identify.exampleZh: 老师让我辨认图片中的植物。

identity.example: Her identity as a teacher shapes the way she talks to people.
identity.exampleZh: 她作为教师的身份影响了她与人交谈的方式。

ideology.example: The party's ideology shaped every part of daily life in the country.
ideology.exampleZh: 该政党的意识形态塑造了这个国家日常生活的方方面面。

idiom.example: This idiom is hard to understand for learners of English.
idiom.exampleZh: 这个习语对英语学习者来说很难理解。

idiot.example: Tom is a kind man, but sometimes he acts like an idiot.
idiot.exampleZh: 汤姆是个善良的人，但有时他表现得像个白痴。

idle.example: He idled away the whole afternoon instead of doing his homework.
idle.exampleZh: 他把整个下午都虚度了，没有去做作业。

idol.example: The young singer became an idol for thousands of students across the country.
idol.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手成了全国成千上万学生的偶像。

if.example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
if.exampleZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

ignite.example: A single spark can ignite the dry grass in seconds.
ignite.exampleZh: 一颗火星就能在几秒内点燃干草。

ignorance.example: His ignorance of the local rules caused him a lot of trouble.
ignorance.exampleZh: 他对当地规则的无知给他带来了很多麻烦。

ignorant.example: He was ignorant of the new rules and made a small mistake.
ignorant.exampleZh: 他对新规定一无所知，犯了一个小错误。

ignore.example: You should not ignore the warning signs on the road.
ignore.exampleZh: 你不应该忽视路上的警告标志。

ill.example: He is very ill and must stay in bed today.
ill.exampleZh: 他病得很重，今天必须卧床休息。

illegal.example: It is illegal to park your car here.

illness.example: His illness kept him at home for two weeks.
illness.exampleZh: 他的病使他在家待了两周。

illuminate.example: The new streetlights will illuminate the whole road at night.
illuminate.exampleZh: 新的路灯将在夜间照亮整条道路。

illustrate.example: The teacher used a simple drawing to illustrate how water moves through plants.
illustrate.exampleZh: 老师用一张简单的图来说明水是如何在植物中流动的。

illustration.example: The book has a nice illustration on every page.
illustration.exampleZh: 这本书每一页都有一幅漂亮的插图。

image.example: Her public image changed a lot after the interview last week.
image.exampleZh: 上周那次采访之后，她的公众形象改变了很多。

imagery.example: The poem uses strong imagery to describe the sea at night.
imagery.exampleZh: 这首诗用强烈的意象来描写夜晚的大海。

imaginary.example: The dragon in her story is imaginary, not a real animal.
imaginary.exampleZh: 她故事里的那条龙是虚构的，并非真实的动物。

imagination.example: Children use their imagination to build a big world of their own.
imagination.exampleZh: 孩子们用想象力建构一个属于自己的大世界。

imaginative.example: She is an imaginative child who loves to draw strange animals.
imaginative.exampleZh: 她是个富有想象力的孩子，喜欢画奇怪的动物。

imitate.example: Children often imitate the way their parents talk at home.
imitate.exampleZh: 孩子们常常模仿父母在家里的说话方式。

imitation.example: Children learn to speak by imitation of the people around them.
imitation.exampleZh: 孩子们通过模仿周围的人学会说话。

immediate.example: Please give me an immediate answer to my question about the plan.
immediate.exampleZh: 请立即就我关于这个计划的问题给我答复。

immense.example: The immense stone bridge helps people cross the wide river safely.
immense.exampleZh: 这座巨大的石桥帮助人们安全地跨越宽阔的河流。

immigrant.example: The immigrant worked hard to learn the local language and find a job.
immigrant.exampleZh: 这位移民努力学习当地语言并寻找工作。

immigrate.example: Many people immigrate to Canada to find better jobs and a peaceful life.
immigrate.exampleZh: 许多人移居加拿大，为了找到更好的工作和安宁的生活。

immigration.example: My family went through immigration at the airport before we could leave.
immigration.exampleZh: 我们离开前，全家在机场办理了移民手续。

immune.example: People who get the vaccine are immune to this serious disease.
immune.exampleZh: 接种疫苗的人对这种严重疾病具有免疫力。

impact.example: The new road will have a big impact on traffic in our town.
impact.exampleZh: 这条新路将对我们镇的交通产生很大影响。

impair.example: Lack of sleep can impair your memory and slow your thinking.
impair.exampleZh: 睡眠不足会损害记忆，并让思维变慢。

imperial.example: The imperial palace in Beijing is very big and old.
imperial.exampleZh: 北京的皇宫非常宏伟而且古老。

imperialism.example: Many countries in Africa suffered under imperialism in the past.
imperialism.exampleZh: 非洲的许多国家过去都遭受过帝国主义的压迫。

implement.example: The team will implement the new plan next week with simple tools.
implement.exampleZh: 团队将在下周用简单的工具实施这个新计划。

implication.example: The implication of his silence was that he did not agree.
implication.exampleZh: 他沉默的含意是他不同意。

implicit.example: Her silence was an implicit sign that she did not agree.
implicit.exampleZh: 她的沉默是一种含蓄的暗示，表示她并不同意。

imply.example: His silence seemed to imply that he did not agree with us.
imply.exampleZh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他不同意我们的看法。

import.example: The country imports most of its oil from other nations.
import.exampleZh: 这个国家的大部分石油都是从其他国家进口的。

importance.example: Many people do not understand the importance of a good night's sleep.
importance.exampleZh: 许多人不理解一夜好眠的重要性。

important.example: It is important to drink water every day.

impose.example: The city imposed a new tax on all foreign cars.
impose.exampleZh: 该市对所有外国汽车征收了一项新税。

impossible.example: It is impossible to finish this work in one day.
impossible.exampleZh: 一天之内完成这项工作是不可能的。

impress.example: The young teacher tried hard to impress her new students on the first day.
impress.exampleZh: 这位年轻的老师努力在第一天就给新学生留下深刻印象。

impression.example: My first impression of the new teacher was very good.
impression.exampleZh: 我对新老师的第一印象非常好。

impressive.example: Her speech about helping others was very impressive and made us think.
impressive.exampleZh: 她关于帮助他人的演讲非常感人，让我们深思。

improve.example: We need to improve our English before the exam next month.
improve.exampleZh: 我们需要在下个月的考试前提高我们的英语水平。

improvement.example: There is a big improvement in her English after three months of practice.
improvement.exampleZh: 经过三个月的练习，她的英语有了很大的进步。

impulse.example: She had a sudden impulse to buy the red dress.
impulse.exampleZh: 她突然有一种冲动，想买下那条红裙子。

in.example: She is in the kitchen now, and her keys are in her bag.
in.exampleZh: 她现在在厨房里，她的钥匙在她的包里。

incentive.example: The company offers a cash incentive to workers who finish the project early.
incentive.exampleZh: 公司向提前完成项目的员工提供现金奖励。

inch.example: The table is six inches wide and three inches tall.
inch.exampleZh: 这张桌子宽六英寸，高三英寸。

incidence.example: The incidence of the disease is higher in older people.
incidence.exampleZh: 这种疾病在老年人中的发病率更高。

incident.example: The police are looking into the incident that happened last night.
incident.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨晚发生的那起事件。

incline.example: The path begins to incline gently as we walk toward the hill.
incline.exampleZh: 当我们朝山上走时，小路开始缓缓倾斜。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free internet in every room.
include.exampleZh: 这个价格包括早餐和每个房间的免费网络。

inclusive.example: The price is inclusive of breakfast and free wifi.
inclusive.exampleZh: 这个价格包含早餐和免费无线网络。

income.example: Her monthly income is not enough to pay all the bills.
income.exampleZh: 她的月收入不足以支付所有的账单。

incorporate.example: We will incorporate your ideas into the new plan next week.
incorporate.exampleZh: 我们会在下周把你的想法纳入新计划中。

increase.example: Our sales increase every year because more people buy our new products.
increase.exampleZh: 我们的销售额每年都在增长，因为更多人购买我们的新产品。

increasingly.example: People increasingly use their phones to pay for things.
increasingly.exampleZh: 人们越来越多地使用手机来付款。

incredible.example: The view from the mountain was incredible, and we took many photos.
incredible.exampleZh: 山上的景色令人难以置信，我们拍了很多照片。

independence.example: Learning to cook for yourself is an important step toward independence.
independence.exampleZh: 学会自己做饭是迈向独立的重要一步。

independent.example: She became independent after she moved to a new city for work.
independent.exampleZh: 她搬到新城市工作后变得独立了。

index.example: The teacher asked us to index all the names in the book.
index.exampleZh: 老师让我们把书里所有的名字编入索引。

indicate.example: These dark clouds indicate that a heavy rain is coming soon.
indicate.exampleZh: 这些乌云表明一场大雨即将来临。

indication.example: A high fever is often an indication that the body is fighting an infection.
indication.exampleZh: 高烧常常是身体正在抵抗感染的迹象。

indifferent.example: He stayed indifferent to the noise and kept reading his book.
indifferent.exampleZh: 他对噪音漠不关心，继续看他的书。

indignant.example: She was indignant when she found out that someone had read her private letters.
indignant.exampleZh: 当她发现有人看过她的私人信件时，她感到十分愤慨。

indispensable.example: Clean water is indispensable for keeping our family healthy and strong.
indispensable.exampleZh: 干净的水对保持我们家人健康强壮是不可缺少的。

individual.example: Each individual student gets a small desk and a chair.
individual.exampleZh: 每个个别学生都得到一张小课桌和一把椅子。

indoor.example: We play indoor games on rainy days because the weather is bad.
indoor.exampleZh: 下雨天天气不好时，我们就在室内玩游戏。

induce.example: Too much stress can induce serious health problems over time.
induce.exampleZh: 压力过大会随着时间引起严重的健康问题。

indulge.example: He often indulges in sweet food when he feels tired.
indulge.exampleZh: 他感到累的时候常常沉溺于甜食。

industrial.example: This city is a large industrial area with many factories.
industrial.exampleZh: 这座城市是一个拥有许多工厂的大型工业区。

industrialize.example: Many small countries began to industrialize quickly after the war ended.
industrialize.exampleZh: 战争结束后，许多小国开始迅速实现工业化。

industry.example: The car industry is very important in this city.
industry.exampleZh: 汽车工业在这座城市非常重要。

inevitable.example: Change is inevitable, so we should learn to accept it.
inevitable.exampleZh: 变化是不可避免的，所以我们应该学会接受它。

infant.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms all afternoon.
infant.exampleZh: 那个婴儿整个下午都在母亲怀里安静地睡着。

infect.example: The sick boy can infect others with the virus very easily.
infect.exampleZh: 这个生病的男孩很容易把病毒传染给别人。

infection.example: Wash your hands often to stop infection from spreading to other people.
infection.exampleZh: 经常洗手，以防感染传播给其他人。

infectious.example: Her laughter is so infectious that everyone in the room starts smiling.
infectious.exampleZh: 她的笑声很有感染力，房间里的每个人都开始微笑。

infer.example: We can infer from these facts that the plan will work.
infer.exampleZh: 我们可以从这些事实推断出这个计划会奏效。

inference.example: Her inference from the data was correct.
inference.exampleZh: 她从数据中得出的推论是正确的。

inferior.example: This old phone is inferior to my new one in every way.
inferior.exampleZh: 这部旧手机在各方面都比我的新手机差。

infinite.example: The night sky seems to have an infinite number of stars.
infinite.exampleZh: 夜空似乎有无数颗星星。

inflation.example: High inflation makes everyday food and fuel much more expensive for ordinary families.
inflation.exampleZh: 高通货膨胀使日常食品和燃料对普通家庭来说昂贵得多。

influence.example: Parents have a strong influence on how their children behave at school.
influence.exampleZh: 父母对孩子在学校的表现有很大影响。

influential.example: She is one of the most influential writers in modern history.
influential.exampleZh: 她是现代历史上最有影响力的作家之一。

inform.example: Please inform your teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow.
inform.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

informal.example: We had an informal talk about the new plan after lunch.
informal.exampleZh: 午饭后我们非正式地聊了聊这个新计划。

information.example: I need more information about this job before I apply.
information.exampleZh: 申请这份工作之前，我需要更多相关信息。

infrastructure.example: The city spent a lot of money on new infrastructure last year.
infrastructure.exampleZh: 这座城市去年在新基础设施上花了很多钱。

ingredient.example: Flour is the main ingredient in bread and cakes.
ingredient.exampleZh: 面粉是面包和蛋糕的主要原料。

inhabit.example: Many rare birds inhabit the forests on this small island.
inhabit.exampleZh: 许多稀有鸟类栖息在这座小岛的森林里。

inhabitant.example: Every inhabitant of the small island knows the old fisherman well.
inhabitant.exampleZh: 这个小岛上的每一位居民都很熟悉那位老渔夫。

inherit.example: She inherited her mother's blue eyes and her father's love of music.
inherit.exampleZh: 她遗传了母亲的蓝眼睛和父亲对音乐的热爱。

initial.example: Please write your initial ideas on the first page.
initial.exampleZh: 请把你的最初想法写在第一页上。

initiative.example: She took the initiative to help the new student feel welcome.
initiative.exampleZh: 她主动帮助新同学感受到欢迎。

inject.example: Doctors often inject medicine into patients to help them feel better quickly.
inject.exampleZh: 医生经常给病人注射药物，帮助他们更快地感觉好起来。

injection.example: The nurse gave the patient an injection before the operation.
injection.exampleZh: 护士在手术前给病人打了一针。

injury.example: He missed two games because of a knee injury.
injury.exampleZh: 他因为膝盖受伤错过了两场比赛。

injustice.example: She felt the injustice of being treated unfairly at work.
injustice.exampleZh: 她感到在工作中受到不公正对待的不公正。

inner.example: She kept her inner thoughts hidden from everyone at work.
inner.exampleZh: 她把内心的想法对工作中的每个人都隐藏起来。

innocent.example: The judge said the young man was innocent of the crime.
innocent.exampleZh: 法官说这个年轻人在这起案件中是清白的。

input.example: Please input your password here before you start the computer.
input.exampleZh: 开始使用电脑前，请在这里输入你的密码。

inquiry.example: She made an inquiry about the train times at the front desk.
inquiry.exampleZh: 她到前台询问了火车的时刻。

inside.example: The cat is sleeping inside the warm box.
inside.exampleZh: 那只猫正在温暖的箱子里面睡觉。

insight.example: Her insight into the problem helped the whole team find a simple solution.
insight.exampleZh: 她对这个问题的洞察力帮助整个团队找到了一个简单的解决办法。

insist.example: She insists that we should eat dinner together every Sunday.
insist.exampleZh: 她坚持我们每周日应该一起吃饭。

inspect.example: The teacher came to inspect our classroom this morning.
inspect.exampleZh: 老师今天上午来检查了我们的教室。

inspection.example: The teacher did a quick inspection of our homework before class.
inspection.exampleZh: 老师在上课前快速检查了我们的作业。

inspire.example: Her kind words inspired me to try again.
inspire.exampleZh: 她亲切的话语鼓舞了我再试一次。

install.example: My father will install a new lamp in the kitchen tomorrow.
install.exampleZh: 我爸爸明天会在厨房里安装一盏新灯。

installation.example: The installation of the new machine took two hours.
installation.exampleZh: 新机器的安装花了两个小时。

instance.example: This is a clear instance of how small changes can save money.
instance.exampleZh: 这是一个明显的例子，说明小改动如何节省开支。

instant.example: The instant noodles are ready, so we can eat in a minute.
instant.exampleZh: 方便面好了，我们一分钟内就能吃。

instead.example: I drank tea instead of coffee this morning.
instead.exampleZh: 今天早上我喝了茶，而不是咖啡。

instinct.example: When she heard the baby cry, her mother's instinct told her to help.
instinct.exampleZh: 听到婴儿哭声时，她的母亲本能告诉她要去帮忙。

institute.example: The institute is famous for its research on clean energy.
institute.exampleZh: 这个研究所因其清洁能源研究而闻名。

institution.example: The bank is a strong institution that helps many people save money.
institution.exampleZh: 这家银行是一个强有力的机构，帮助许多人存钱。

instruct.example: The teacher instructed us to read the book before class.
instruct.exampleZh: 老师指导我们在课前读这本书。

instruction.example: The teacher gave us clear instructions before the test started.
instruction.exampleZh: 考试开始前，老师给了我们明确的指示。

instructor.example: Our driving instructor is very patient with new students.
instructor.exampleZh: 我们的驾驶教练对新生非常有耐心。

instrument.example: The doctor uses a small instrument to check my heart.
instrument.exampleZh: 医生用一种小仪器检查我的心脏。

insult.example: He did not mean to insult you with that simple question.
insult.exampleZh: 他问那个简单的问题并不是想侮辱你。

insurance.example: My father pays for car insurance every month.
insurance.exampleZh: 我爸爸每个月都付汽车保险费。
