insure.example: You should insure your new car before you drive it on the road.
insure.exampleZh: 你应该在开新车上路之前给它投保。

intact.example: The old bridge is still intact after the strong storm.
intact.exampleZh: 那座旧桥在强风暴过后仍然完整无损。

integrate.example: We need to integrate these small tools into one simple system.
integrate.exampleZh: 我们需要把这些小工具整合成一个简单的系统。

integration.example: The integration of these two teams made the whole project much faster.
integration.exampleZh: 这两个团队的整合让整个项目推进快了很多。

integrity.example: Her integrity made everyone trust her with the truth.
integrity.exampleZh: 她的正直让每个人都愿意把真话托付给她。

intellectual.example: She enjoys intellectual talks with her friends about books and ideas.
intellectual.exampleZh: 她喜欢和朋友们就书籍和思想进行智力上的交流。

intelligence.example: She has high intelligence and learns new things very quickly.
intelligence.exampleZh: 她智力很高，学新东西非常快。

intelligent.example: She is an intelligent student who always asks good questions in class.
intelligent.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的学生，总在课堂上提出好问题。

intend.example: I intend to finish my work before dinner today.
intend.exampleZh: 我打算今天在晚饭前完成工作。

intense.example: The race was so intense that all the runners felt very tired.
intense.exampleZh: 比赛如此激烈，所有跑者都感到非常疲惫。

intensity.example: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone in the small coastal town.
intensity.exampleZh: 这场风暴的强度让这个沿海小镇上的每个人都很吃惊。

intensive.example: The city offers an intensive English course for new students each summer.
intensive.exampleZh: 这座城市每年夏天为新学生开设密集英语课程。

intention.example: I have no intention of changing my mind about this plan.
intention.exampleZh: 我没有改变对这个计划想法的意图。

interact.example: Children learn to interact with each other when they play games together.
interact.exampleZh: 孩子们一起玩游戏时学会相互交流。

interaction.example: Good interaction between teachers and students makes learning more fun.
interaction.exampleZh: 老师与学生之间良好的互动让学习更有趣。

interest.example: The bank pays interest on the money in your savings account.
interest.exampleZh: 银行会为你储蓄账户里的钱支付利息。

interesting.example: This book is very interesting, and I want to read it again.
interesting.exampleZh: 这本书很有趣，我想再读一遍。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere with my work when I am busy.
interfere.exampleZh: 我忙的时候请不要干涉我的工作。

interference.example: The heavy rain caused interference with the radio signal during the game.
interference.exampleZh: 大雨在比赛期间干扰了无线电信号。

interior.example: The interior of the old house was dark and quiet.
interior.exampleZh: 这座老房子的内部又暗又安静。

internal.example: The company keeps its internal rules simple so everyone can follow them.
internal.exampleZh: 公司把内部规定定得很简单，好让每个人都能遵守。

international.example: She works for an international company and often travels to other countries.
international.exampleZh: 她在一家国际公司工作，经常去其他国家出差。

internet.example: I use the internet every day to read news and send emails.
internet.exampleZh: 我每天用互联网看新闻和发邮件。

interpret.example: Can you interpret what the teacher said in simple words?
interpret.exampleZh: 你能用简单的话解释一下老师说了什么吗？

interpretation.example: Her interpretation of the poem was quite different from mine.
interpretation.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的解读与我的相当不同。

interpreter.example: The interpreter helped the two leaders talk during the meeting.
interpreter.exampleZh: 口译员在会议期间帮助两位领导人交谈。

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am talking to my teacher.
interrupt.exampleZh: 我和老师说话的时候，请不要打断我。

interval.example: There is a short interval between the two classes.
interval.exampleZh: 两节课之间有一段短暂的间隔。

intervene.example: The teacher had to intervene when the two students started fighting in class.
intervene.exampleZh: 当两个学生在课堂上开始打架时，老师不得不介入。

interview.example: She has an interview for a new job tomorrow morning.
interview.exampleZh: 她明天上午有一份新工作的面试。

intimate.example: She is my intimate friend and often shares her private thoughts with me.
intimate.exampleZh: 她是我的亲密朋友，经常和我分享她的私人想法。

into.example: The children ran into the garden and played there all afternoon.
into.exampleZh: 孩子们跑进花园，在那里玩了一下午。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my new teacher.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把你介绍给我的新老师。

introduction.example: This book has a short introduction at the beginning.
introduction.exampleZh: 这本书的开头有一篇简短的引言。

invade.example: The soldiers tried to invade the small country but failed.
invade.exampleZh: 士兵们试图入侵这个小国，但失败了。

invasion.example: The invasion of the small country caused a long and terrible war.
invasion.exampleZh: 对这个小国的入侵引发了一场漫长而可怕的战争。

invent.example: Scientists invent new machines to help people work faster.
invent.exampleZh: 科学家发明新机器来帮助人们更快地工作。

invention.example: The invention of the telephone changed the way people talk to each other.
invention.exampleZh: 电话的发明改变了人们彼此交谈的方式。

inventor.example: The inventor made a small machine that helps clean the house.
inventor.exampleZh: 这位发明家造了一台帮助打扫房子的小机器。

invest.example: She wants to invest her money in a small local business.
invest.exampleZh: 她想把钱投资到当地一家小企业。

investigate.example: The police will investigate the case and find out the truth.
investigate.exampleZh: 警方将调查此案并查明真相。

investigation.example: The police started an investigation into the cause of the fire.
investigation.exampleZh: 警方开始调查这场火灾的起因。

investment.example: She made a small investment in the local bakery last year.
investment.exampleZh: 她去年在当地那家面包店做了一笔小额投资。

investor.example: The investor put his money into a small company last year.
investor.exampleZh: 这位投资者去年把钱投进了一家小公司。

invisible.example: The small bug is invisible to the human eye.
invisible.exampleZh: 这只小虫子是人眼看不见的。

invitation.example: I got an invitation to my friend's birthday party.
invitation.exampleZh: 我收到了朋友生日聚会的邀请。

invite.example: I want to invite my friends to my birthday party this Saturday.
invite.exampleZh: 我想邀请我的朋友们来参加这周六的生日聚会。

involve.example: The job involves a lot of travel and meeting new people.
involve.exampleZh: 这份工作涉及大量出差和结识新朋友。

inward.example: She turned her inward thoughts into a simple song for her friends.
inward.exampleZh: 她把内心的想法变成了一首简单的歌，唱给朋友们听。

iron.example: The iron is hot, so please iron my shirt now.
iron.exampleZh: 熨斗已经热了，所以请现在熨我的衬衫。

island.example: The small island is quiet and only a few people live there.
island.exampleZh: 这个小岛很安静，只有少数人住在那里。

isolate.example: Doctors isolate sick people to stop the virus from spreading.
isolate.exampleZh: 医生隔离病人以阻止病毒传播。

isolated.example: The small farm is isolated from the nearest town by miles of empty fields.
isolated.exampleZh: 这个小农场与最近的城镇之间隔着数英里的空旷田野，十分孤立。

issue.example: The new plan raises an important issue about how we use water.
issue.exampleZh: 这项新计划提出了一个关于我们如何使用水资源的重要问题。

it.example: It is very cold outside, so please wear your warm coat.
it.exampleZh: 外面很冷，所以请穿上你的暖外套。

item.example: I bought a small item for my mother at the store yesterday.
item.exampleZh: 我昨天在商店给妈妈买了一件小商品。

its.example: The dog wagged its tail when it saw its owner.
its.exampleZh: 那只狗看到主人时摇了摇它的尾巴。

itself.example: The little robot can clean the whole room by itself.
itself.exampleZh: 这个小机器人能自己打扫整个房间。

jacket.example: He wore a warm blue jacket to school today.
jacket.exampleZh: 他今天穿了一件暖和的蓝色夹克衫去学校。

jail.example: The man was sent to jail for two years after the robbery.
jail.exampleZh: 那名男子因抢劫被判入狱两年。

jam.example: He spread strawberry jam on his bread and then got stuck in a traffic jam.
jam.exampleZh: 他在面包上涂了草莓果酱，然后遇上了交通堵塞。

january.example: The new school term starts in January and ends in early June.
january.exampleZh: 新学年一月开始，六月初结束。

jar.example: The glass jar fell off the shelf and broke.
jar.exampleZh: 玻璃罐从架子上掉下来摔碎了。

jaw.example: He hurt his jaw while playing football with his friends.
jaw.exampleZh: 他和朋友们踢足球时伤到了下巴。

jazz.example: My father likes to listen to jazz when he drives to work.
jazz.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在开车上班时听爵士乐。

jealous.example: She felt jealous when her best friend got a new bike.

limit.exampleZh: 这条路上所有汽车都有限速。

limitation.example: One big limitation of this plan is its high cost.
limitation.exampleZh: 这个计划的一大局限是成本很高。

limited.example: We have only a limited amount of time to finish this work.
limited.exampleZh: 我们只有有限的时间来完成这项工作。

line.example: Please stand in line and wait for your turn to buy the ticket.
line.exampleZh: 请排队等候，轮到你时再买票。

link.example: This bridge links the two small towns across the wide river.
link.exampleZh: 这座桥连接着宽阔河流两岸的两个小镇。

linked.example: The two computers are linked by a long cable.
linked.exampleZh: 这两台电脑通过一根长电缆连接。

lion.example: The lion sleeps under a big tree in the afternoon.
lion.exampleZh: 下午，狮子在一棵大树下睡觉。

lip.example: She put some red color on her lips before the party.
lip.exampleZh: 她在聚会前往嘴唇上涂了些红色。

liquid.example: Water is a liquid that flows easily at room temperature.
liquid.exampleZh: 水是一种在室温下容易流动的液体。

list.example: Please list all the items on the table before you leave.
list.exampleZh: 离开前请把桌上的所有物品列成一张表。

listen.example: Please listen carefully to your teacher in class every day.
listen.exampleZh: 请每天在课堂上认真听老师讲课。

literacy.example: Basic literacy is important for every child in the world.
literacy.exampleZh: 基本的读写能力对世界上的每个孩子都很重要。

literal.example: He gave a literal translation of the sentence, word for word.
literal.exampleZh: 他对这句话做了字面的翻译，逐字逐句。

literary.example: She has a strong literary style in her short stories.
literary.exampleZh: 她的短篇小说有很强的文学风格。

literature.example: I enjoy reading English literature because it helps me understand different cultures.
literature.exampleZh: 我喜欢阅读英国文学，因为它帮助我了解不同的文化。

litre.example: We bought two litres of milk at the shop this morning.
litre.exampleZh: 我们今天早上在商店买了两升牛奶。

litter.example: Please do not litter in the park; put your trash in the bin.
litter.exampleZh: 请不要在公园里乱丢垃圾，把垃圾放进垃圾桶里。

little.example: There is little water left in the bottle, so we must buy more.
little.exampleZh: 瓶子里剩下的水很少，所以我们必须再买一些。

live.example: We live in a small house near the river, and we love our quiet life.
live.exampleZh: 我们住在河边的一间小房子里，我们喜欢我们安静的生活。

lively.example: The children are lively and full of fun at the party.
lively.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上很活泼，充满乐趣。

liver.example: The doctor said my liver is healthy after the checkup last week.
liver.exampleZh: 医生说上周检查后我的肝脏很健康。

livestock.example: The farmer keeps livestock on his small farm in the countryside.
livestock.exampleZh: 这位农民在乡下的小农场里饲养家畜。

living.example: The cost of living is high in this big city.
living.exampleZh: 在这个大城市里生活成本很高。

load.example: The truck can carry a heavy load of boxes.
load.exampleZh: 这辆卡车能装载一车沉重的箱子。

loan.example: The bank gave me a loan to buy a small house.
loan.exampleZh: 银行给了我一笔贷款，用来买一栋小房子。

local.example: The local food is fresh and cheap, so many people eat here every day.
local.exampleZh: 当地的食物新鲜又便宜，所以很多人每天都来这里吃。

locate.example: The police quickly located the missing car near the old bridge.
locate.exampleZh: 警方很快在老桥附近找到了那辆失踪的汽车。

location.example: The location of the new school is near the park.
location.exampleZh: 新学校的位置在公园附近。

lock.example: Please lock the front door before you leave the house.
lock.exampleZh: 你离开家之前请锁上前门。

logic.example: There is no logic in his plan, so nobody wants to join it.
logic.exampleZh: 他的计划毫无逻辑，所以没有人愿意加入。

logical.example: It is logical to check the facts before you make a decision.
logical.exampleZh: 在做决定之前先核实事实，这是合乎逻辑的。

loneliness.example: Her loneliness grew stronger after she moved to a new city alone.
loneliness.exampleZh: 她独自搬到一座新城市后，孤独感变得更强了。

lonely.example: He lives alone and often feels lonely in his small old house.
lonely.exampleZh: 他独自住在那座小旧房子里，常常感到孤独。

long.example: She has long hair and longs to see her family soon.
long.exampleZh: 她留着长发，渴望很快见到家人。

look.example: You look tired today, so please take a short rest.
look.exampleZh: 你今天看起来很累，所以请短暂休息一下。

loop.example: The rope formed a large loop around the old tree.
loop.exampleZh: 绳子在那棵老树周围形成了一个大圈。

loose.example: Her loose shirt is very comfortable on hot summer days.
loose.exampleZh: 她那件宽松的衬衫在炎热的夏天穿着非常舒服。

loosen.example: Please loosen the small screw on the left side of the box.
loosen.exampleZh: 请松开盒子左侧的那颗小螺丝。

lord.example: The old lord ruled the land with a fair and steady hand.
lord.exampleZh: 这位年迈的领主以公正而稳健的方式统治着这片土地。

lose.example: Be careful with your keys, or you will lose them again.
lose.exampleZh: 小心你的钥匙，不然你又会把它们弄丢。

loss.example: The loss of his old dog made him very sad.
loss.exampleZh: 失去那只老狗让他非常伤心。

lost.example: The lost child was crying near the busy street.
lost.exampleZh: 那个迷路的孩子在繁忙的街道旁哭着。

lot.example: We bought a lot of fresh fruit at the market this morning.
lot.exampleZh: 今天早上我们在市场买了很多新鲜水果。

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太响了，请把它调小。

love.example: I love reading books with my sister every night before bed.
love.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天晚上睡前和妹妹一起读书。

lovely.example: She has a lovely garden with many small flowers.
lovely.exampleZh: 她有一个可爱的花园，里面开着许多小花。

lover.example: My brother is a great lover of music and plays the guitar every day.
lover.exampleZh: 我弟弟是个音乐爱好者，每天都弹吉他。

low.example: The sun is low and the birds are singing quietly.
low.exampleZh: 太阳低垂，鸟儿在低声歌唱。

lower.example: Please lower the window because the sun is too bright.
lower.exampleZh: 请把窗户放低一点，因为阳光太亮了。

loyal.example: A loyal friend will always stand by you when times are hard.
loyal.exampleZh: 一个忠诚的朋友在困难时期总会站在你身边。

loyalty.example: True loyalty means standing by your friends when things get hard.
loyalty.exampleZh: 真正的忠诚意味着在困难时刻依然支持你的朋友。

luck.example: Good luck with your exam tomorrow, and try not to worry too much.
luck.exampleZh: 祝你明天考试好运，别太担心。

lucky.example: You are lucky to have such a kind friend.
lucky.exampleZh: 你很幸运，有这样一位善良的朋友。

luggage.example: I put my luggage in the taxi and went to the airport.
luggage.exampleZh: 我把行李放进出租车，然后去了机场。

lump.example: The doctor said the lump on my arm is not dangerous.
lump.exampleZh: 医生说胳膊上的肿块没有危险。

lunar.example: The lunar surface is covered with dust and rocks.
lunar.exampleZh: 月球表面覆盖着尘土和岩石。

lunch.example: I eat lunch with my friends at school every day.
lunch.exampleZh: 我每天在学校和朋友一起吃午饭。

luxurious.example: They stayed in a luxurious hotel near the beach for two nights.
luxurious.exampleZh: 他们在海边一家豪华的酒店住了两晚。

luxury.example: She saved money for years to buy one small luxury for herself.
luxury.exampleZh: 她存了好几年的钱，只为给自己买一件小小的奢侈品。

machine.example: The machine in the factory makes small metal parts every day.
machine.exampleZh: 工厂里的这台机器每天生产小金属零件。

machinery.example: The factory has bought new machinery to make its work faster.
machinery.exampleZh: 工厂购买了新机器，以提高工作效率。

mad.example: My brother is mad about football and watches every match on TV.
mad.exampleZh: 我弟弟对足球很狂热，每场比赛都在电视上看。

madam.example: Good morning, madam, would you like a cup of tea?
madam.exampleZh: 早上好，女士，您想来一杯茶吗？

magazine.example: She reads a popular magazine about science every month at home.
magazine.exampleZh: 她每个月在家读一本受欢迎的科普杂志。

magic.example: The children believe that magic can make all their dreams come true.
magic.exampleZh: 孩子们相信魔法能让他们所有的梦想成真。

magnet.example: This toy uses a small magnet to hold the two parts together.
magnet.exampleZh: 这个玩具用一块小磁铁把两部分吸在一起。

magnetic.example: The magnetic toy attracted all the small metal pieces on the table.
magnetic.exampleZh: 这个磁性玩具把桌上所有的小金属片都吸了过来。

magnificent.example: The old church on the hill looks magnificent in the morning light.
magnificent.exampleZh: 山上的那座古老教堂在晨光中显得十分壮丽。

magnify.example: Please magnify the text so that everyone in the room can read it.
magnify.exampleZh: 请把文字放大，让房间里的每个人都能看清。

magnitude.example: The magnitude of the earthquake surprised everyone in the small town.
magnitude.exampleZh: 这场地震的震级让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

mail.example: I will mail the letter to you this afternoon.
mail.exampleZh: 我今天下午会把信寄给你。

main.example: The main road into town was closed this morning.
main.exampleZh: 进城的主要道路今天早上封闭了。

mainland.example: Many people take a train from the mainland to visit our city.
mainland.exampleZh: 许多人从大陆乘火车来我们城市参观。

maintain.example: We must maintain our car well so it can run safely.
maintain.exampleZh: 我们必须好好保养我们的车，这样它才能安全行驶。

maintenance.example: Regular maintenance keeps the old car running well for many years.
maintenance.exampleZh: 定期保养能让这辆旧车多年来一直运转良好。

majesty.example: The majesty of the mountains made everyone stop and stare in silence.
majesty.exampleZh: 群山的雄伟让每个人都停下脚步，默默凝望。

major.example: Her major problem is that she never asks for help.
major.exampleZh: 她的主要问题是从来不求助。

majority.example: The majority of students in our class like playing basketball after school.
majority.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后打篮球。

make.example: My father can make a small table for our new garden.
make.exampleZh: 我爸爸能为我们的新花园做一张小桌子。

male.example: The male bird has bright feathers and sings a loud song.
male.exampleZh: 这只雄鸟羽毛鲜艳，还会大声歌唱。

mall.example: We spent the whole afternoon shopping at the new mall near our house.
mall.exampleZh: 我们在家附近的新购物中心逛了一下午。

manage.example: She manages a small restaurant and still finds time for her family.
manage.exampleZh: 她经营着一家小餐馆，却仍能抽出时间陪伴家人。

management.example: Good management of time helps students finish their work on time.
management.exampleZh: 良好的时间管理能帮助学生按时完成工作。

manager.example: The new manager will start work in our office next Monday.
manager.exampleZh: 新经理将于下周一在我们办公室开始工作。

manifest.example: His anger was manifest in the way he spoke to us.
manifest.exampleZh: 他的愤怒在他对我们说话的方式中表现得十分明显。

manipulate.example: He tried to manipulate the small group for his own benefit.
manipulate.exampleZh: 他试图为了自己的利益操纵这个小团体。

mankind.example: This new medicine may help all mankind in the future.
mankind.exampleZh: 这种新药未来可能会帮助全人类。

manner.example: He always speaks to everyone in a polite and friendly manner.
manner.exampleZh: 他总是以礼貌而友好的方式与每个人说话。

manual.example: Please read the manual before you use the new washing machine at home.
manual.exampleZh: 在家里使用这台新洗衣机之前，请先阅读说明书。

manufacture.example: The company plans to manufacture small electric cars for city use.
manufacture.exampleZh: 这家公司计划制造小型电动汽车供城市使用。

manuscript.example: The writer sent his manuscript to the publisher last week.
manuscript.exampleZh: 这位作家上周把手稿寄给了出版商。

many.example: Many students in our class like to play football after school.
many.exampleZh: 我们班上许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。

map.example: We used a map to plan the long drive to the coast.
map.exampleZh: 我们用一张地图规划了去海边的长途车程。

margin.example: Please leave a wide margin on the page for your notes.
margin.exampleZh: 请在页面上留出宽一点的页边空白，方便做笔记。

marginal.example: The old road is marginal and few cars use it.
marginal.exampleZh: 这条旧路很边缘，很少有车走。

marine.example: The marine animals live in the deep sea near the cold coast.
marine.exampleZh: 这些海洋动物生活在寒冷海岸附近的深海里。

mark.example: There is a dirty mark on your new white shirt.
mark.exampleZh: 你的新白衬衫上有一块脏的痕迹。

market.example: Every Saturday my mother sells fresh vegetables at the busy market near our home.
market.exampleZh: 每个星期六，我妈妈都在家附近热闹的集市上卖新鲜蔬菜。

marriage.example: Their marriage is happy because they talk and laugh together every day.
marriage.exampleZh: 他们的婚姻很幸福，因为他们每天一起聊天、一起欢笑。

married.example: My sister is married and has two young children.
married.exampleZh: 我姐姐已经结婚了，有两个年幼的孩子。

marry.example: She wants to marry him next spring in a small town.
marry.exampleZh: 她想明年春天在一个小镇上嫁给他。

marvelous.example: The view from the top of the hill was simply marvelous.
marvelous.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色简直妙不可言。

masculine.example: His deep voice and strong hands make him seem very masculine.
masculine.exampleZh: 他低沉的嗓音和有力的双手让他显得很有男子气概。

mask.example: She wore a mask on the bus and tried to mask her cough.
mask.exampleZh: 她在公交车上戴着口罩，并试图掩饰自己的咳嗽。

mass.example: A large mass of cold air moved across the country last night.
mass.exampleZh: 一大团冷空气昨夜席卷全国。

massive.example: The old bridge is massive and heavy, so trucks cannot cross it.
massive.exampleZh: 这座旧桥又大又重，所以卡车无法通过。

master.example: She worked hard for years to master the piano and became a respected master.
master.exampleZh: 她多年来刻苦努力，精通了钢琴，成为一位受人尊敬的钢琴大师。

match.example: This old match is too wet to light.
match.exampleZh: 这根旧火柴太湿了，点不着。

mate.example: My mate and I play football every Saturday morning.
mate.exampleZh: 我和我的伙伴每个星期六早上都踢足球。

material.example: This material is strong and cheap, so we use it to build houses.
material.exampleZh: 这种材料又结实又便宜，所以我们用它来盖房子。

mathematics.example: She studies mathematics at school because she wants to become a teacher.
mathematics.exampleZh: 她在学校学习数学，因为她想成为一名教师。

matter.example: It does not matter if we are a little late today.
matter.exampleZh: 我们今天晚一点到也没关系。

mature.example: She is very mature for her age and handles problems well.
mature.exampleZh: 就她的年龄来说，她非常成熟，处理问题也很得当。

maximum.example: The maximum speed of this car is very high.
maximum.exampleZh: 这辆车的最高速度非常高。

may.example: May I use your phone to call my mother?
may.exampleZh: 我可以用你的手机给我妈妈打个电话吗？

maybe.example: Maybe it will rain later, so take an umbrella with you.
maybe.exampleZh: 也许稍后会下雨，所以你带把伞吧。

mayor.example: The mayor opened the new library in our town yesterday.
mayor.exampleZh: 市长昨天为我们镇上新开的图书馆揭幕。

meadow.example: The children ran across the green meadow behind their house.
meadow.exampleZh: 孩子们跑过他们家后面的绿色草地。

meal.example: We had a nice meal together after the long walk home.
meal.exampleZh: 走了很长的路回家后，我们一起吃了一顿不错的饭。

mean.example: I know you did not mean to hurt her feelings yesterday.
mean.exampleZh: 我知道你昨天不是故意伤害她的感情。

meaning.example: Can you explain the meaning of this word to me?
meaning.exampleZh: 你能给我解释一下这个词的意思吗？

means.example: Money is only a means to an end, not the goal itself.
means.exampleZh: 金钱只是达到目的的手段，而不是目标本身。

meantime.example: In the meantime, she made tea and waited for us.
meantime.exampleZh: 与此同时，她泡了茶等我们。

meanwhile.example: She cooked dinner and meanwhile I cleaned the whole living room.
meanwhile.exampleZh: 她做晚饭，与此同时我打扫了整个客厅。

measure.example: We need to measure the length of the table before buying a new cloth.
measure.exampleZh: 买新桌布之前，我们需要测量桌子的长度。

measurement.example: The tailor took my measurements before he made the new suit.
measurement.exampleZh: 裁缝在做新西装之前量了我的尺寸。

meat.example: The main meat of his speech was about saving water.
meat.exampleZh: 他演讲的主要实质内容是关于节约用水。

mechanic.example: The mechanic fixed my car in less than an hour.
mechanic.exampleZh: 这位机修工不到一小时就修好了我的车。

mechanical.example: The old clock makes a mechanical sound every hour.
mechanical.exampleZh: 那座旧钟每小时都会发出机械的声音。

mechanism.example: Scientists are still studying the mechanism behind this strange disease.
mechanism.exampleZh: 科学家仍在研究这种奇怪疾病背后的机制。

medal.example: She won a gold medal in the running race last year.
medal.exampleZh: 她去年在跑步比赛中赢得了一枚金牌。

media.example: The media often plays a big role in shaping public opinion today.
media.exampleZh: 如今，媒体在塑造公众舆论方面常常发挥重要作用。

medical.example: She wants to study medical science at a good university next year.
medical.exampleZh: 她想明年去一所好大学学习医学。

medicine.example: The doctor gave me some medicine for my cough.
medicine.exampleZh: 医生给了我一些治咳嗽的药。

medieval.example: This old town has many medieval buildings near the river.
medieval.exampleZh: 这座古镇在河边有许多中世纪的建筑。

medium.example: The internet is a good medium for sharing news with many people.
medium.exampleZh: 互联网是与许多人分享新闻的好媒介。

meet.example: I am happy to meet my old friends at the station today.
meet.exampleZh: 今天我很高兴在车站遇见我的老朋友们。

meeting.example: I have an important meeting with my teacher this afternoon.
meeting.exampleZh: 今天下午我和老师有一个重要的会议。

melody.example: This song has a beautiful melody that everyone loves to sing.
melody.exampleZh: 这首歌有一段优美的旋律，每个人都爱唱。

melt.example: The snow will melt quickly when the warm sun comes out.
melt.exampleZh: 温暖的太阳出来后，雪很快就会融化。

member.example: Every member of the team must attend the meeting on Friday.
member.exampleZh: 团队的每位成员都必须参加周五的会议。

membership.example: Her membership at the local gym costs thirty dollars each month.
membership.exampleZh: 她在当地健身房的会员资格每月花费三十美元。

memorial.example: They built a memorial in the park to remember the soldiers.
memorial.exampleZh: 他们在公园里建了一座纪念碑来纪念那些士兵。

memorize.example: Students memorize ten new words every day before class.
memorize.exampleZh: 学生们每天上课前记住十个新单词。

memory.example: I have a bad memory for names, so I write them down.
memory.exampleZh: 我对名字记性很差，所以会把它们写下来。

mental.example: Regular exercise is good for both your mental and physical health.
mental.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的心理健康和身体健康都有好处。

mention.example: Did she mention my name when she called you last night?
mention.exampleZh: 她昨晚打电话给你时提到我的名字了吗？

menu.example: She looked at the menu and chose a chicken dish for dinner.
menu.exampleZh: 她看了看菜单，晚饭点了一道鸡肉菜。

merchant.example: The merchant sells fresh fruit and vegetables at the market every morning.
merchant.exampleZh: 这位商人每天早上在市场卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

mercury.example: The thermometer uses mercury to measure the temperature of the human body.
mercury.exampleZh: 这支温度计使用水银来测量人体温度。

mercy.example: The kind judge showed mercy and let the poor man go home.
mercy.exampleZh: 仁慈的法官宽恕了那个可怜的人，让他回家。

mere.example: It was a mere mistake, so please do not worry about it.
mere.exampleZh: 这只不过是个错误，所以请不要担心。

merely.example: She was merely tired, not angry with you.
merely.exampleZh: 她只不过是累了，并不是在生你的气。

merge.example: The two small shops will merge into one big store next year.
merge.exampleZh: 这两家小商店明年将合并成一家大商店。

merit.example: Her hard work has great merit and deserves our respect.
merit.exampleZh: 她的努力工作很有价值，值得我们尊重。

mesh.example: The fish swam through a hole in the mesh of the net.
mesh.exampleZh: 鱼从网眼的孔中游了过去。

mess.example: His room is always a mess, and he never cleans it.
mess.exampleZh: 他的房间总是乱糟糟的，他从来不打扫。

message.example: I got a message from my teacher this morning.
message.exampleZh: 今天早上我收到了老师的一条消息。

metal.example: This box is made of metal and feels very cold.
metal.exampleZh: 这个盒子是用金属做的，摸起来很凉。

metaphor.example: The teacher used a metaphor to explain how hope can grow like a seed.
metaphor.exampleZh: 老师用了一个隐喻来解释希望如何像种子一样生长。

meter.example: The meter on the wall shows how much water we use each month.
meter.exampleZh: 墙上的仪表显示我们每个月用多少水。

method.example: This method is simple and easy for everyone to learn.
method.exampleZh: 这个方法很简单，每个人都容易学会。

methodology.example: The team changed its methodology to make the tests simpler and faster.
methodology.exampleZh: 团队改变了它的方法体系，使测试更简单、更快速。

microphone.example: She spoke into the microphone so everyone in the room could hear her clearly.
microphone.exampleZh: 她对着麦克风说话，让房间里的每个人都能清楚地听到。

microscope.example: The scientist looked at the tiny cells through a microscope.
microscope.exampleZh: 科学家通过显微镜观察这些微小的细胞。

middle.example: There is a small table in the middle of the room.
middle.exampleZh: 房间中间有一张小桌子。

midnight.example: The train leaves at midnight, so we must go to bed early.
midnight.exampleZh: 火车在午夜出发，所以我们必须早点睡觉。

might.example: She might come to the party, and she has great might in the team.
might.exampleZh: 她可能会来参加聚会，她在团队中很有力量。

migrant.example: Every winter, many migrant birds fly south to find warmer weather.
migrant.exampleZh: 每年冬天，许多候鸟飞往南方寻找更温暖的天气。

migrate.example: Many birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
migrate.exampleZh: 天气变冷时，许多鸟会向南方迁徙。

mild.example: The winter here is mild, so we can still walk outside in the evening.
mild.exampleZh: 这里的冬天很温和，所以晚上我们仍然可以在外面散步。

military.example: The country spends a lot of money on military training every year.
military.exampleZh: 这个国家每年在军事训练上花费大量资金。

milk.example: Every morning my mother gives me a glass of warm milk.
milk.exampleZh: 每天早上妈妈都给我一杯温牛奶。

mill.example: The old mill by the river still grinds wheat into flour.
mill.exampleZh: 河边那座老磨坊仍在把小麦磨成面粉。

million.example: Millions of people watched the game on TV last night.
million.exampleZh: 昨晚有数百万人在电视上观看了这场比赛。

mind.example: Please keep this idea in mind when you make your plan.
mind.exampleZh: 制定计划时请把这一点记在心里。

mine.example: This old mine is still full of coal.
mine.exampleZh: 这座老矿里仍然满是煤。

mineral.example: The rocks in this area contain many valuable minerals.
mineral.exampleZh: 这个地区的岩石中含有许多有价值的矿物。

minimum.example: The minimum age for driving a car is eighteen in many countries.
minimum.exampleZh: 在许多国家，开车的最低年龄是十八岁。

minister.example: The minister will visit our school next Monday morning.
minister.exampleZh: 部长将在下周一的上午参观我们学校。

minor.example: The doctor said my injury was minor and I could go home.
minor.exampleZh: 医生说我的伤是轻伤，我可以回家。

minority.example: Only a small minority of students wanted to change the school rules.
minority.exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生想改变校规。

minute.example: Please wait a minute while I find the meeting minutes on my desk.
minute.exampleZh: 请稍等一分钟，我找一下桌上的会议记录。

miracle.example: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt in the car accident.
miracle.exampleZh: 车祸中没有人受伤，真是个奇迹。

mirror.example: The lake is a mirror that reflects the mountains and the sky.
mirror.exampleZh: 湖面是一面镜子，映出群山和天空。

miserable.example: The cold rain made everyone feel miserable during the long walk home.
miserable.exampleZh: 在漫长的回家路上，冰冷的雨让每个人都感到痛苦。

mislead.example: Do not let false ads mislead you into buying useless things.
mislead.exampleZh: 不要让虚假广告误导你去买没用的东西。

miss.example: I miss my old friends, so I often call them after school.
miss.exampleZh: 我想念我的老朋友，所以放学后经常给他们打电话。

missile.example: The missile flew across the sky and hit an old building.
missile.exampleZh: 那枚导弹飞过天空，击中了一座旧建筑。

mission.example: Her mission is to help young children learn to read.
mission.exampleZh: 她的使命是帮助年幼的孩子学会阅读。

missionary.example: The missionary traveled to a small village to teach children and share his faith.
missionary.exampleZh: 这位传教士前往一个小村庄教孩子们读书并分享他的信仰。

mistake.example: Everyone can make a mistake, so please do not be afraid to try.
mistake.exampleZh: 每个人都可能犯错，所以请不要害怕尝试。

misunderstand.example: Please do not misunderstand me when I say I need more time.
misunderstand.exampleZh: 我说我需要更多时间的时候，请不要误会我的意思。

mix.example: Mix the flour and water in a bowl, then add two eggs.
mix.exampleZh: 把面粉和水在碗里混合，然后加入两个鸡蛋。

mixture.example: The cake is a mixture of flour, sugar, and eggs.
mixture.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕是面粉、糖和鸡蛋的混合物。

moan.example: She gave a low moan and turned over in bed.
moan.exampleZh: 她发出一声低沉的呻吟，在床上翻了个身。

mobile.example: This mobile desk is easy to move to any room.
mobile.exampleZh: 这张可移动的书桌很容易搬到任何房间。

mode.example: The phone has a new mode that saves battery power.
mode.exampleZh: 这款手机有一个节省电量的新模式。

model.example: She is a model for a famous clothing company.
model.exampleZh: 她是一家著名服装公司的模特。

moderate.example: His doctor told him to do moderate exercise every day.
moderate.exampleZh: 他的医生让他每天做适度的运动。

modern.example: Modern phones are small, fast, and easy to use.
modern.exampleZh: 现代手机小巧、快速且易于使用。

modest.example: She is very modest about her success, and everyone likes her.
modest.exampleZh: 她对自己的成功非常谦虚，大家都很喜欢她。

modify.example: You can modify the settings if the screen is too bright.
modify.exampleZh: 如果屏幕太亮，你可以修改设置。

moist.example: Her hands felt moist after she washed them with warm water.
moist.exampleZh: 她用温水洗手后，双手感觉湿润。

moisture.example: The air in the room feels cold and full of moisture.
moisture.exampleZh: 房间里的空气感觉寒冷，而且充满了湿气。

molecule.example: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.exampleZh: 一个水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find your file.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我帮你找一下文件。

momentum.example: The team's early success gave them the momentum to finish the project.
momentum.exampleZh: 团队早期的成功给了他们完成这个项目的动力。

monarch.example: The old monarch ruled the country for over forty years.
monarch.exampleZh: 这位年迈的君主统治这个国家四十多年。

money.example: I need more money to buy a new bike this weekend.
money.exampleZh: 这个周末我需要更多的钱来买一辆新自行车。

monitor.example: The class monitor often helps our teacher check the homework.
monitor.exampleZh: 班长经常帮老师检查作业。

monkey.example: The little monkey climbed the tall tree and ate a banana.
monkey.exampleZh: 那只小猴子爬上高高的树，吃了一根香蕉。

month.example: We will visit our grandparents next month during the summer holiday.
month.exampleZh: 我们下个月暑假期间会去看望祖父母。

mood.example: Her mood improved after she talked with her best friend.
mood.exampleZh: 她和最好的朋友聊过之后，心情好了起来。

moon.example: The moon looks very bright in the sky tonight.
moon.exampleZh: 今晚月亮在天空中看起来非常明亮。

moral.example: The story has a clear moral about being kind to others.
moral.exampleZh: 这个故事有一个关于善待他人的明确寓意。

more.example: I need more time to finish this book today.
more.exampleZh: 我今天需要更多时间来完成这本书。

moreover.example: The room is small and quiet; moreover, it is close to the station.
moreover.exampleZh: 这个房间又小又安静，而且离车站很近。

morning.example: I get up at six every morning and run in the park.
morning.exampleZh: 我每天早上六点起床，然后在公园里跑步。

mortal.example: All mortals must face death, but mortals can still live with hope.
mortal.exampleZh: 所有凡人终将面对死亡，但凡人仍可怀着希望生活。

mortgage.example: They took out a mortgage to buy their first house last year.
mortgage.exampleZh: 他们去年办了抵押贷款，买下了他们的第一套房子。

most.example: Most students in our class like to play football after school.
most.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后踢足球。

mostly.example: The people here are mostly friendly and easy to talk to.
mostly.exampleZh: 这里的人大多很友好，也很容易交谈。

mother.example: My mother always cooks dinner for the family on Sunday.
mother.exampleZh: 我母亲总是在星期天为全家做晚饭。

motion.example: The motion of the boat made me feel a little sick.
motion.exampleZh: 船的晃动让我有点不舒服。

motivate.example: Good teachers motivate their students to work hard every day.
motivate.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生每天努力学习。

motive.example: The police could not find a clear motive for the crime.
motive.exampleZh: 警方无法找到这起犯罪的明确动机。

motor.example: My father is fixing the small motor in our old car.
motor.exampleZh: 我父亲正在修理我们旧车里那台小发动机。

mount.example: The pressure on the team is mounting, and the mountain seems too hard to climb.
mount.exampleZh: 团队面临的压力正在增加，那座山似乎太难攀登了。

mountain.example: There is a very high mountain behind our small village.
mountain.exampleZh: 我们的小村庄后面有一座很高的山。

mourn.example: We mourn the loss of our old friend.
mourn.exampleZh: 我们为失去这位老朋友而哀悼。

mouse.example: I saw a small mouse run under the table in the kitchen.
mouse.exampleZh: 我看见一只小老鼠在厨房里跑到桌子底下。

mouth.example: The river's mouth opens into the sea near our small town.
mouth.exampleZh: 这条河的河口在我们小镇附近汇入大海。

move.example: Please move your chair a little closer to the table.
move.exampleZh: 请把你的椅子往桌子这边稍微移近一点。

movement.example: There is a lot of movement in the street today.
movement.exampleZh: 今天街上有很多移动和活动。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie at home last night.
movie.exampleZh: 我们昨晚在家看了一部有趣的电影。

much.example: I don't have much time to finish this work today.
much.exampleZh: 我今天没有多少时间完成这项工作。

mud.example: The children came home with mud on their shoes after the rain.
mud.exampleZh: 下雨后，孩子们回家时鞋上沾满了泥。

multiple.example: This job has multiple tasks and you must finish them today.
multiple.exampleZh: 这份工作有多项任务，你今天必须完成它们。

multiply.example: If you multiply three by four, you get twelve.
multiply.exampleZh: 如果你把三乘以四，就得到十二。

murder.example: The police are still looking for the man who committed the murder.
murder.exampleZh: 警方仍在寻找犯下这起谋杀案的那个男人。

muscle.example: Regular exercise helps you build strong muscles and keep your body healthy.
muscle.exampleZh: 经常锻炼有助于你增强肌肉力量，保持身体健康。

museum.example: We visited a small museum near the river last Saturday with our teacher.
museum.exampleZh: 上周六我们和老师一起参观了河边的一座小博物馆。

mushroom.example: Mushrooms grow quickly in warm, wet weather in the forest.
mushroom.exampleZh: 在温暖潮湿的天气里，森林里的蘑菇生长得很快。

music.example: I like to listen to music while I do my homework.
music.exampleZh: 我喜欢在做作业的时候听音乐。

musical.example: She has great musical talent and plays the piano every day.
musical.exampleZh: 她有很好的音乐天赋，每天都弹钢琴。

musician.example: My uncle is a musician and he plays the piano very well.
musician.exampleZh: 我叔叔是一位音乐家，他钢琴弹得很好。

must.example: You must finish your homework before you watch TV.
must.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业才能看电视。

mutual.example: Good friendship needs mutual trust and respect between both people.
mutual.exampleZh: 好的友谊需要两个人之间的相互信任和尊重。

my.example: My brother and I walk to school together every morning.
my.exampleZh: 我弟弟和我每天早上一起步行去上学。

myself.example: I made this cake by myself for my mother's birthday.
myself.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕是我亲自为妈妈的生日做的。

mysterious.example: Her mysterious smile made everyone wonder what she was really thinking.
mysterious.exampleZh: 她神秘的微笑让每个人都想知道她到底在想什么。

mystery.example: The old house is a mystery to everyone in our small town.
mystery.exampleZh: 那栋老房子对我们小镇上的每个人来说都是个谜。

myth.example: The story of the god is an old myth that many people still enjoy.
myth.exampleZh: 这个神的故事是一个古老的神话，许多人仍然喜欢它。

nail.example: Please use a hammer to hit the nail into the wood.
nail.exampleZh: 请用锤子把钉子敲进木头里。

naive.example: She was too naive to see that he was lying to her.
naive.exampleZh: 她太天真了，看不出他在对她撒谎。

naked.example: The little boy ran naked across the sand toward the cold sea.
naked.exampleZh: 那个小男孩光着身子跑过沙滩，奔向冰冷的海水。

name.example: Please write your name on the top of this page.
name.exampleZh: 请在这页的顶部写上你的名字。

namely.example: Only one student passed the test, namely Tom from our class.
namely.exampleZh: 只有一个学生通过了考试，也就是我们班的汤姆。

narrative.example: Her book tells a powerful narrative about life in a small village.
narrative.exampleZh: 她的书讲述了一个关于小村庄生活的有力故事。

narrow.example: The narrow street is too small for two cars to pass.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条狭窄的街道太窄了，两辆车无法同时通过。

nasty.example: That was a nasty smell coming from the old fridge.
nasty.exampleZh: 那台旧冰箱散发出一股令人不快的气味。

nation.example: The whole nation celebrated the win with music and dancing in the streets.
nation.exampleZh: 全国人民在街上载歌载舞，庆祝这场胜利。

national.example: The national team will play a big game on Saturday.
national.exampleZh: 国家队将在星期六进行一场重要的比赛。

native.example: She speaks English like a native speaker, so everyone thinks she is from London.
native.exampleZh: 她说英语像本地人一样，所以大家都以为她来自伦敦。

natural.example: She has natural beauty and a warm smile.

nature.example: It is important to protect nature for animals and plants.
nature.exampleZh: 保护自然对动物和植物很重要。

naval.example: My uncle served in the naval forces for ten years.
naval.exampleZh: 我叔叔在海军部队服役了十年。

navigation.example: The ship's navigation system helped us find the right way home.
navigation.exampleZh: 这艘船的导航系统帮助我们找到了正确的回家航线。

near.example: The small park is near my house, so we often walk there.
near.exampleZh: 那个小公园离我家很近，所以我们经常去那里散步。

nearby.example: There is a small park nearby where children often play after school.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有一个小公园，孩子们放学后常在那里玩。

nearly.example: I nearly missed the last bus home last night.
nearly.exampleZh: 我昨晚差点错过回家的末班公交车。

neat.example: Her neat room is always easy to keep clean.
neat.exampleZh: 她整洁的房间总是很容易保持干净。

necessary.example: It is necessary to drink enough water every day when you exercise.
necessary.exampleZh: 当你锻炼时，每天喝足够的水是必要的。

necessity.example: Clean water is a basic necessity of life for everyone.
necessity.exampleZh: 清洁的水是每个人生活中的基本必需品。

neck.example: She wore a warm red scarf around her neck all winter.
neck.exampleZh: 整个冬天她都在脖子上围着一条温暖的红色围巾。

need.example: We need more time to finish the work before Friday.
need.exampleZh: 我们需要更多时间在周五前完成这项工作。

negative.example: Too many negative words can make a simple idea sound bad.
negative.exampleZh: 太多否定词会让一个简单的想法听起来很糟。

neglect.example: Do not neglect your health when you are busy with work.
neglect.exampleZh: 工作忙碌时不要忽视你的健康。

negotiate.example: We need to negotiate a fair price with the seller today.
negotiate.exampleZh: 我们今天需要和卖家协商一个公平的价格。

negotiation.example: The two sides hope to reach an agreement through peaceful negotiation.
negotiation.exampleZh: 双方希望通过和平谈判达成协议。

neighbor.example: Our new neighbor next door often helps us water the plants.
neighbor.exampleZh: 隔壁的新邻居经常帮我们给植物浇水。

neighborhood.example: There is a small park in my neighborhood where children like to play.
neighborhood.exampleZh: 我家附近有一个小公园，孩子们喜欢在那里玩。

neither.example: Neither of my two brothers likes coffee, and neither do I.
neither.exampleZh: 我的两个兄弟都不喜欢咖啡，我也不喜欢。

nephew.example: My nephew is only five, but he can already read simple books.
nephew.exampleZh: 我的侄子才五岁，但他已经能读简单的书了。

nerve.example: It takes a lot of nerve to speak in front of the whole class.
nerve.exampleZh: 在全班面前讲话需要很大的勇气。

nervous.example: I feel nervous before every exam, so I breathe slowly.
nervous.exampleZh: 每次考试前我都会感到紧张，所以我会慢慢呼吸。

nest.example: The bird built a small nest in the tree near my window last spring.
nest.exampleZh: 去年春天，那只鸟在我窗边的树上筑了一个小巢。

net.example: He caught three big fish in his net and took them home.
net.exampleZh: 他用渔网捕到三条大鱼，并把它们带回了家。

network.example: The city has a large network of buses and trains.
network.exampleZh: 这座城市拥有庞大的公交和火车网络。

neutral.example: The judge stayed neutral and listened carefully to both sides of the story.
neutral.exampleZh: 法官保持中立，认真听取了双方的说法。

never.example: I never drink coffee after dinner because it keeps me awake.
never.exampleZh: 我晚饭后从不喝咖啡，因为它会让我睡不着。

nevertheless.example: The plan was difficult; nevertheless, we finished all the work on time.
nevertheless.exampleZh: 这个计划很难，然而我们还是按时完成了所有工作。

new.example: She bought a new phone and a new bag last week.
new.exampleZh: 她上周买了一部新手机和一个新包。

news.example: I watch the news every night to learn what is happening.
news.exampleZh: 我每天晚上看新闻，了解正在发生的事情。

newspaper.example: My father reads the newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
newspaper.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会看报纸。

next.example: I will see you next week at the same place.
next.exampleZh: 我下周在同一个地方见你。

nice.example: She is very nice to her new classmates.
nice.exampleZh: 她对她的新同学非常友好。

night.example: The stars look very bright in the sky at night.
night.exampleZh: 夜晚天空中星星看起来非常明亮。

nine.example: There are nine students in our small English class this year.
nine.exampleZh: 今年我们这个小英语班里有九名学生。

no.example: There is no milk in the fridge, so we need to buy some.
no.exampleZh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了，所以我们需要买一些。

noble.example: He is a noble man who always helps people in need.
noble.exampleZh: 他是一个高尚的人，总是帮助有需要的人。

nobody.example: Nobody in my class knows the answer to this easy question.
nobody.exampleZh: 我班上没有人知道这个简单问题的答案。

nod.example: She gave a small nod and smiled at me.
nod.exampleZh: 她微微点了点头，对我笑了笑。

noise.example: The loud noise from the street kept me awake all night.
noise.exampleZh: 街上响亮的噪音让我整夜无法入睡。

noisy.example: The classroom was too noisy for the students to hear the teacher.
noisy.exampleZh: 教室太吵了，学生们听不见老师说话。

nominal.example: The nominal price was so low that we bought two.
nominal.exampleZh: 名义价格太低了，我们买了两个。

nominate.example: The teacher will nominate two students for the school prize.
nominate.exampleZh: 老师将提名两名学生参评学校奖项。

none.example: None of my friends came to the party last night.
none.exampleZh: 昨晚我的朋友一个都没来参加聚会。

nonsense.example: Don't talk nonsense; tell me what really happened last night.
nonsense.exampleZh: 别胡说，告诉我昨晚到底发生了什么。

noodle.example: My mother made a big bowl of noodle soup for dinner last night.
noodle.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈做了一大碗面条汤当晚餐。

noon.example: We usually eat lunch at noon and then take a short rest.
noon.exampleZh: 我们通常中午吃午饭，然后短暂休息一下。

nor.example: She did not call me, nor did she send any message.
nor.exampleZh: 她没有给我打电话，也没有发任何消息。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day at work.
normal.exampleZh: 工作一整天后感到累是正常的。

normally.example: I normally walk to school with my sister every morning.
normally.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

north.example: The wind is blowing from the north today.

northern.example: The northern part of the country is much colder in winter.
northern.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部地区冬天要冷得多。

nose.example: The dog has a wet nose and a very good sense of smell.
nose.exampleZh: 这只狗的鼻子湿湿的，嗅觉非常灵敏。

not.example: I am not happy with my new phone.
not.exampleZh: 我对我的新手机不满意。

note.example: Please note this important number in your notebook before the meeting starts.
note.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前把这个重要的号码记在你的笔记本上。

notebook.example: I write my homework in a small notebook every evening.
notebook.exampleZh: 我每天晚上都在一个小笔记本里写作业。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the box, so we can take it.
nothing.exampleZh: 盒子里什么也没有，所以我们可以把它拿走。

notice.example: I did not notice the small notice on the door this morning.
notice.exampleZh: 今天早上我没有注意到门上的那张小布告。

noticeable.example: There was a noticeable change in her voice after the long trip.
noticeable.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，她的声音有了明显的变化。

notify.example: Please notify your teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow.
notify.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

notion.example: She had no notion of how hard the exam would be.
notion.exampleZh: 她完全不知道这场考试会有多难。

novel.example: This novel tells a new and interesting story about a small village.
novel.exampleZh: 这本小说讲述了一个关于小村庄的既新奇又有趣的故事。

now.example: Now is a good time to start learning English every day.
now.exampleZh: 现在是每天开始学英语的好时机。

nowadays.example: Nowadays, many people use their phones to read the news every morning.
nowadays.exampleZh: 现今，许多人每天早上用手机看新闻。

nowhere.example: There was nowhere to sit, so we stood by the door.
nowhere.exampleZh: 没有地方可坐，所以我们站在门边。

nuclear.example: The nuclear power plant provides clean and safe electricity for the city.
nuclear.exampleZh: 核电站为这座城市提供清洁、安全的电力。

nucleus.example: The nucleus is the central part of an atom.
nucleus.exampleZh: 原子核是原子的中心部分。

number.example: Please write your phone number at the top of the page.
number.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在这页的顶部。

numerous.example: The city has numerous parks where children can play and relax.
numerous.exampleZh: 这座城市有许多公园，孩子们可以在那里玩耍和放松。

nurse.example: The nurse looked after my grandmother every day last year.
nurse.exampleZh: 去年那位护士每天都照料我的祖母。

nursery.example: My little sister goes to a nursery near our home every morning.
nursery.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上去我们家附近的托儿所。

nut.example: The squirrel hid a nut under the old tree.
nut.exampleZh: 松鼠把一颗坚果藏在老树下。

nutrition.example: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and stay healthy.
nutrition.exampleZh: 良好的营养帮助孩子强壮成长并保持健康。

nylon.example: She wore black nylon stockings to the party last night.
nylon.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿着黑色尼龙丝袜去参加聚会。

o'clock.example: I usually get up at seven o'clock every morning.
o'clock.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上七点钟起床。

oak.example: A large oak grows in front of our old house.
oak.exampleZh: 一棵大橡树长在我们老房子前面。

oar.example: He put the oar into the water and rowed the small boat across the lake.
oar.exampleZh: 他把桨放进水里，划着小船穿过湖面。

oath.example: He made an oath to tell the truth in court.
oath.exampleZh: 他在法庭上立誓说出真相。

obedience.example: The dog showed complete obedience to its owner's simple commands.
obedience.exampleZh: 这只狗对主人简单的命令表现出完全的服从。

obedient.example: The obedient dog sat quietly when its owner told it to wait.
obedient.exampleZh: 那只听话的狗在主人让它等待时安静地坐着。

obey.example: Students must obey the school rules every day.
obey.exampleZh: 学生每天都必须遵守校规。

object.example: I object to that plan because it costs too much money.
object.exampleZh: 我反对那个计划，因为它花费太多钱。

objection.example: She has no objection to our new plan.
objection.exampleZh: 她对我们的新计划没有异议。

objective.example: Our main objective is to finish the project before Friday.
objective.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是在周五前完成这个项目。

obligation.example: Parents have an obligation to keep their children safe and healthy.
obligation.exampleZh: 父母有义务让孩子保持安全和健康。

oblige.example: The heavy rain obliged us to stay at home all day.
oblige.exampleZh: 大雨迫使我们整天待在家里。

obscure.example: The old book was written in an obscure style that few people understand.
obscure.exampleZh: 这本旧书的文笔晦涩，很少有人能看懂。

observation.example: Her careful observation of the birds helped the class learn a lot.
observation.exampleZh: 她对鸟类的仔细观察帮助全班学到了很多东西。

observe.example: We observe the birds in the park every morning.
observe.exampleZh: 我们每天早上在公园里观察鸟儿。

observer.example: The observer watched the birds from a quiet place near the lake.
observer.exampleZh: 观察者在湖边一个安静的地方观察鸟儿。

obstacle.example: The fallen tree was a big obstacle on the road to school.
obstacle.exampleZh: 倒下的树是上学路上的一个大障碍。

obtain.example: You can obtain a free map at the front desk.
obtain.exampleZh: 你可以在前台获得一张免费地图。

obvious.example: It is obvious that he does not want to go with us.
obvious.exampleZh: 很明显，他不想和我们一起去。

occasion.example: Her birthday is a special occasion for the whole family.
occasion.exampleZh: 她的生日对全家人来说是一个特别的时刻。

occasional.example: I get an occasional email from my old friend in Canada.
occasional.exampleZh: 我偶尔会收到加拿大一位老朋友的电子邮件。

occupation.example: Her occupation is teaching, but she also writes books in her free time.
occupation.exampleZh: 她的职业是教师，但她在空闲时间也写书。

occupy.example: The books and papers occupy most of the space on my desk.
occupy.exampleZh: 书和文件占据了我书桌上的大部分空间。

occur.example: Accidents often occur when people are in a hurry and not paying attention.
occur.exampleZh: 人们匆忙且不注意时，事故常常发生。

occurrence.example: The occurrence of heavy rain caused the game to stop.
occurrence.exampleZh: 这场大雨的出现使得比赛停止了。

ocean.example: The blue whale is the largest animal living in the ocean.
ocean.exampleZh: 蓝鲸是生活在海洋中的最大的动物。

odd.example: It is odd that he left without saying goodbye to us.
odd.exampleZh: 他没跟我们告别就走了，真是奇怪。

odds.example: The odds of winning the game are very small.
odds.exampleZh: 赢得这场比赛的可能性非常小。

off.example: Please turn off the light before you leave the room.
off.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with my words.
offend.exampleZh: 我不是有意用我的话冒犯你。

offense.example: He did not mean to cause any offense with his simple question.
offense.exampleZh: 他那个简单的问题并不是想冒犯任何人。

offensive.example: His offensive words made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable and angry.
offensive.exampleZh: 他那些无礼的话让房间里的每个人都感到不舒服和生气。

offer.example: She offered me a cup of tea and a warm smile.
offer.exampleZh: 她给我端来一杯茶，还露出温暖的微笑。

office.example: My mother works in an office near the city center.
office.exampleZh: 我妈妈在市中心附近的一间办公室工作。

officer.example: The police officer helped the lost child find her parents.
officer.exampleZh: 那位警官帮助走失的孩子找到了父母。

official.example: The official report was published on the government website yesterday.
official.exampleZh: 这份官方报告昨天发布在政府网站上。

often.example: I often walk to school with my sister in the morning.
often.exampleZh: 我经常早上和姐姐一起走路去学校。

oil.example: The car needs oil and water before we start the long trip.
oil.exampleZh: 开始长途旅行前，这辆车需要加机油和水。

okay.example: It is okay to ask for help when you feel lost.
okay.exampleZh: 当你感到迷茫时，寻求帮助是可以的。

old.example: My old bike is still fast, but my father's new car is faster.
old.exampleZh: 我的旧自行车仍然很快，但我爸爸的新车更快。

omit.example: Please do not omit my name from the list.
omit.exampleZh: 请不要把我的名字从名单上遗漏。

once.example: Once you start reading this book, you will not want to stop.
once.exampleZh: 一旦你开始读这本书，你就会不想停下来。

one.example: One of my friends gave me a book about this topic.
one.exampleZh: 我的一个朋友给了我一本书，就是关于这个话题的。

onion.example: My mother puts onion in the soup to make it taste better.
onion.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放洋葱，让它味道更好。

online.example: You can buy tickets online and save time.
online.exampleZh: 你可以在线买票，这样能节省时间。

only.example: She is the only person who knows the answer to this question.
only.exampleZh: 她是唯一知道这个问题答案的人。

onto.example: The cat jumped onto the table and sat down beside the lamp.
onto.exampleZh: 猫跳到桌子上，在台灯旁边坐了下来。

open.example: The shop is open, so we can go in and buy some food.
open.exampleZh: 商店开着门，所以我们可以进去买些食物。

opening.example: There is a small opening in the wall near the door.
opening.exampleZh: 门附近的墙上有一个小开口。

opera.example: My sister and I went to the opera in Beijing last winter.
opera.exampleZh: 去年冬天我和姐姐去北京看了歌剧。

operate.example: My father knows how to operate this old machine safely.
operate.exampleZh: 我父亲知道如何安全地操作这台旧机器。

operation.example: The doctor said my operation went well and I can go home soon.
operation.exampleZh: 医生说我手术很顺利，很快就能回家了。

operator.example: The operator answered my call and helped me find the right number.
operator.exampleZh: 接线员接了我的电话，并帮我找到了正确的号码。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this book is very good for beginners.
opinion.exampleZh: 依我看，这本书对初学者很有帮助。

opponent.example: My opponent in the game was very strong and fast.
opponent.exampleZh: 我在比赛中的对手非常强壮而且速度快。

opportunity.example: This job is a good opportunity for me to learn new skills.
opportunity.exampleZh: 这份工作是我学习新技能的好机会。

oppose.example: Many people oppose the plan because it is too expensive.
oppose.exampleZh: 许多人反对这个计划，因为它太昂贵了。

opposite.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street from my house.

optical.example: The doctor used an optical instrument to look closely at my eyes.
optical.exampleZh: 医生用一台光学仪器仔细检查了我的眼睛。

optimistic.example: She feels optimistic about her new job and her new friends.
optimistic.exampleZh: 她对她的新工作和新朋友感到乐观。

option.example: You have the option to take the train or the bus.
option.exampleZh: 你可以选择坐火车或者坐公交车。

optional.example: This class is optional, so you can stay home if you want.
optional.exampleZh: 这门课是可选择的，所以你想待在家里也可以。

or.example: You can have tea or coffee, but please choose one now.
or.exampleZh: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，但请现在就选一个。

oral.example: We had an oral test in English class today.
oral.exampleZh: 我们今天在英语课上做了一次口头测试。

orange.example: She put two oranges and an orange bag on the kitchen table.
orange.exampleZh: 她把两个橙子和一个橙色的包放在厨房桌子上。

orbit.example: The small satellite moves in a fixed orbit around the earth.
orbit.exampleZh: 这颗小卫星在围绕地球的固定轨道上运行。

orchestra.example: My sister plays the violin in the school orchestra every Friday.
orchestra.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周五在学校管弦乐队拉小提琴。

order.example: Please put these books in order before you leave the room.
order.exampleZh: 离开房间前，请把这些书按顺序整理好。

orderly.example: The children put their books in an orderly row on the shelf.
orderly.exampleZh: 孩子们把书整齐地排成一排放在书架上。

ordinary.example: She lives in an ordinary house with a small garden.
ordinary.exampleZh: 她住在一栋带小花园的普通房子里。

ore.example: The workers found iron ore deep under the hill last year.
ore.exampleZh: 工人们去年在山丘深处发现了铁矿石。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
organ.exampleZh: 心脏是人体内重要的器官。

organic.example: This farm grows organic vegetables without using any chemicals.
organic.exampleZh: 这个农场不使用任何化学物质来种植有机蔬菜。

organism.example: A tiny organism lives in the water and feeds on sunlight.
organism.exampleZh: 一种微小的生物生活在水里，以阳光为食。

organization.example: The organization helps poor children go to school every year.
organization.exampleZh: 这个组织每年帮助贫困儿童上学。

organize.example: We need to organize a meeting for all the new students.
organize.exampleZh: 我们需要为所有新生组织一次会议。

origin.example: The origin of this old story is still a mystery to us.
origin.exampleZh: 这个古老故事的起源对我们来说仍是个谜。

original.example: This painting is the original, and the other one is just a copy.
original.exampleZh: 这幅画是原作，另一幅只是复制品。

originality.example: Her design shows real originality and makes the whole room feel new.
originality.exampleZh: 她的设计展现出真正的独创性，让整个房间焕然一新。

originate.example: Many popular foods originate from small family kitchens.
originate.exampleZh: 许多受欢迎的食物都起源于小家庭厨房。

ornament.example: She put a small ornament on the table.
ornament.exampleZh: 她在桌子上放了一个小装饰物。

orphan.example: The orphan lives with a kind family in the small village.
orphan.exampleZh: 那个孤儿和一个小村庄里的一户善良人家住在一起。

other.example: I have one book here, and the other book is on the table.
other.exampleZh: 我这里有一本书，另一本书在桌子上。

otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we will be late for the meeting.
otherwise.exampleZh: 快点，否则我们开会就要迟到了。

ought.example: You ought to see a doctor if the pain gets worse.
ought.exampleZh: 如果疼痛加重，你应该去看医生。

ounce.example: She added four ounces of milk to the cake mix.
ounce.exampleZh: 她往蛋糕粉里加了四盎司牛奶。

our.example: Our teacher gives us a lot of homework every day.
our.exampleZh: 我们的老师每天给我们布置很多作业。

out.example: The fire is out, so we can go back inside now.
out.exampleZh: 火已经灭了，所以我们现在可以回屋里了。

outcome.example: The outcome of the game surprised everyone in our small town.
outcome.exampleZh: 比赛的结果让我们小镇上的每个人都很惊讶。

outdoor.example: We like to play outdoor games in the park on sunny days.
outdoor.exampleZh: 我们喜欢在晴天去公园玩户外游戏。

outdoors.example: The children love to play outdoors when the weather is nice.
outdoors.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。

outer.example: The outer wall of the old house is painted bright yellow.
outer.exampleZh: 这座老房子的外墙被刷成了亮黄色。

outlet.example: The factory built a new outlet to release waste water into the river.
outlet.exampleZh: 工厂建了一个新的排放口，把废水排入河中。

outline.example: Please write a short outline before you start the essay.
outline.exampleZh: 在开始写文章之前，请先写一个简短的大纲。

outlook.example: My outlook on life changed after I lived in another country.
outlook.exampleZh: 在另一个国家生活过后，我对生活的看法改变了。

output.example: The factory output increased by ten percent last year.
output.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年的产量增长了百分之十。

outset.example: From the outset, she knew the plan would be difficult.
outset.exampleZh: 从一开始，她就知道这个计划会很困难。

outside.example: The children are playing outside while their parents wait in the garden.
outside.exampleZh: 孩子们在外面玩，而他们的父母在花园里等候。

outskirts.example: We live on the outskirts of the city, near a small lake.
outskirts.exampleZh: 我们住在城市的郊区，靠近一个小湖。

oven.example: I put the cake in the oven for thirty minutes.
oven.exampleZh: 我把蛋糕放进烤箱里烤了三十分钟。

over.example: The plane flew over the mountains and then landed safely.
over.exampleZh: 飞机飞越群山，然后安全降落。

overall.example: The overall plan looks good, and overall we are ready to start.
overall.exampleZh: 总体计划看起来不错，总的来说我们已经准备好开始了。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

overhead.example: The overhead lights in the classroom are too bright for my eyes.
overhead.exampleZh: 教室里头顶的灯对我的眼睛来说太亮了。

overlook.example: Do not overlook small mistakes when you check your homework.
overlook.exampleZh: 检查作业时，不要忽略小错误。

overnight.example: The little town became famous overnight after the film was shown.
overnight.exampleZh: 电影上映后，这个小镇一夜之间出了名。

overseas.example: She has worked overseas for three years and speaks English well.
overseas.exampleZh: 她已在海外工作三年，英语说得很好。

overtake.example: A fast car can overtake us on this narrow road.
overtake.exampleZh: 在这条窄路上，一辆快车可能会超过我们。

owe.example: I still owe my friend ten dollars from last week.
owe.exampleZh: 我上周还欠朋友十美元。

owing.example: He still has twenty dollars owing on his old bike.
owing.exampleZh: 他那辆旧自行车还欠着二十美元。

own.example: She has her own room and a small garden.
own.exampleZh: 她有自己的房间和一个小花园。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop is very kind to every customer.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主对每位顾客都非常友好。

ownership.example: She has full ownership of the small house near the river.
ownership.exampleZh: 她拥有河边那栋小房子的全部所有权。

oxygen.example: Plants give off oxygen during the day when there is enough sunlight.
oxygen.exampleZh: 白天阳光充足时，植物会释放氧气。

ozone.example: The ozone layer above the earth protects us from harmful sun rays.
ozone.exampleZh: 地球上方的臭氧层保护我们免受有害太阳光线的伤害。

pace.example: He walked at a slow pace because his leg still hurt.
pace.exampleZh: 他走得步速很慢，因为他的腿还疼。

pack.example: Please pack your clothes in this bag before we leave.
pack.exampleZh: 请在我们离开前把你的衣服装进这个包里。

package.example: The package arrived at my door early this morning.
package.exampleZh: 包裹今天一早送到了我家门口。

packet.example: She gave me a small packet of cookies for the trip.
packet.exampleZh: 她给了我一小包饼干，供旅途中吃。

pad.example: She put a soft pad on the chair before sitting down.
pad.exampleZh: 她坐下前在椅子上放了一个软垫。

page.example: The waiter turned the page and wrote down my order.
page.exampleZh: 侍者翻过那一页，写下了我点的菜。

pain.example: The pain in my back is very bad today.
pain.exampleZh: 我今天背部的疼痛很厉害。

painful.example: The long walk home was painful for my tired legs.
painful.exampleZh: 走回家的漫长路程让我的双腿又累又疼。

paint.example: She likes to paint the walls in her room a light blue.
paint.exampleZh: 她喜欢把房间的墙刷成浅蓝色。

painter.example: My uncle is a painter who paints pictures of the sea.
painter.exampleZh: 我的叔叔是一位画家，他画大海的画。

painting.example: The painting on the wall is very old and beautiful.
painting.exampleZh: 墙上的那幅画很旧，也很美。

pair.example: She bought a new pair of shoes for the trip.
pair.exampleZh: 她为这次旅行买了一双新鞋。

palace.example: The king lived in a big palace with his family.
palace.exampleZh: 国王和他的家人住在一座大宫殿里。

pale.example: Her face turned pale when she heard the bad news yesterday.
pale.exampleZh: 昨天听到那个坏消息时，她的脸色变得苍白。

palm.example: She held the small stone in the palm of her hand.
palm.exampleZh: 她把那块小石头握在手心里。

pan.example: She put the eggs in a hot pan and cooked them quickly.
pan.exampleZh: 她把鸡蛋放进热平底锅里，很快就煎好了。

panel.example: The control panel is on the front of the machine.
panel.exampleZh: 控制面板在机器的前面。

panic.example: She felt a sudden panic when she could not find her keys.
panic.exampleZh: 当她找不到钥匙时，她突然感到一阵恐慌。

pants.example: He put on his new pants and a clean shirt before going out.
pants.exampleZh: 他出门前穿上了新裤子和一件干净的衬衫。

paper.example: She wrote her name on a piece of paper and gave it to me.
paper.exampleZh: 她把名字写在一张纸上，然后递给了我。

parade.example: The whole town came out to watch the parade on Sunday morning.
parade.exampleZh: 周日早上全镇的人都出来观看游行。

paragraph.example: Please read the first paragraph of the article and tell me what it means.
paragraph.exampleZh: 请读一下这篇文章的第一段，然后告诉我它是什么意思。

parallel.example: The two roads run parallel to the river for several miles.
parallel.exampleZh: 这两条路与河流平行延伸了好几英里。

parcel.example: The postman left a small parcel at the door this morning.
parcel.exampleZh: 今天早上邮递员在门口留下了一个小包裹。

pardon.example: I beg your pardon, but I did not hear your name clearly.
pardon.exampleZh: 对不起，我没有听清你的名字。

parent.example: My parents always help me with my homework after dinner.
parent.exampleZh: 我父母总是在晚饭后帮我做作业。

park.example: We often walk in the park and park our car near the gate.
park.exampleZh: 我们经常在公园里散步，并把车停在门口附近。

parliament.example: The new law was passed by parliament after a long debate.
parliament.exampleZh: 经过长时间的辩论，这项新法律由议会通过了。

part.example: She played a small part in the school play last year.
part.exampleZh: 她去年在学校的话剧里演了一个小角色。

partial.example: The team only had a partial view of the whole report before the meeting.
partial.exampleZh: 会议前，团队只看到了整份报告的一部分。

participate.example: Many students participate in sports and music clubs after school.
participate.exampleZh: 许多学生放学后参加体育和音乐社团。

particle.example: A tiny particle of dust got into my eye and made it water.
particle.exampleZh: 一小粒灰尘进了我的眼睛，让眼睛流起泪来。

particular.example: She has a particular way of making tea in the morning.
particular.exampleZh: 她早上泡茶有一套特别的方法。

particularly.example: I particularly like the small cafe near my house.
particularly.exampleZh: 我特别喜欢我家附近的那家小咖啡馆。

partly.example: The road is partly closed because of the heavy snow.
partly.exampleZh: 由于大雪，这条路部分路段封闭。

partner.example: My partner and I always share the work in the kitchen.
partner.exampleZh: 我和我的搭档总是在厨房里分担家务。

party.example: She joined the party last year and now helps with local events.
party.exampleZh: 她去年加入了该政党，现在帮忙组织当地活动。

pass.example: Please pass me the salt and the bread.

passage.example: A narrow passage leads from the kitchen to the garden.
passage.exampleZh: 一条狭窄的通道从厨房通向花园。

passenger.example: The bus stopped and every passenger got off at the last station.
passenger.exampleZh: 公交车停了，每位乘客都在最后一站下了车。

passion.example: She talks about her work with great passion and never gets tired.
passion.exampleZh: 她谈起自己的工作时充满热情，从不觉得疲倦。

passive.example: He is too passive in class and rarely asks any questions.
passive.exampleZh: 他在课堂上太被动了，很少提问。

passport.example: Please bring your passport when you travel to another country.
passport.exampleZh: 当你去另一个国家旅行时，请带上你的护照。

password.example: Please keep your password safe and do not tell anyone.
password.exampleZh: 请保管好你的密码，不要告诉任何人。

past.example: She walked past the old school and thought about her past.
past.exampleZh: 她走过那所老学校，想起了自己的过去。

paste.example: She used paste to stick the paper onto the wall.
paste.exampleZh: 她用浆糊把纸粘到墙上。

pat.example: She gave the dog a gentle pat on its head.

patch.example: The farmer planted a small patch of corn near the old barn.
patch.exampleZh: 农民在老谷仓旁的一小块地里种了玉米。

patent.example: The company applied for a patent on its new battery design last year.
patent.exampleZh: 该公司去年为其新电池设计申请了一项专利。

path.example: We followed a narrow path through the forest to the river.
path.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条穿过森林的狭窄小路走到了河边。

patience.example: Learning a new language requires patience and a lot of daily practice.
patience.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要耐心和大量的日常练习。

patient.example: The doctor is very patient with the old man in his room.
patient.exampleZh: 医生对他房间里的那位老人非常有耐心。

pattern.example: I noticed a clear pattern in the way she studies every day.
pattern.exampleZh: 我注意到她每天学习的方式有一个明显的模式。

pause.example: You can pause the video at any time and take a short break.
pause.exampleZh: 你可以随时暂停视频，短暂休息一下。

pave.example: Workers will pave the road in front of our school this week.
pave.exampleZh: 工人们这周会铺设我们学校前面的那条路。

paw.example: The little cat hurt its paw while playing in the garden.
paw.exampleZh: 小猫在花园里玩耍时伤到了爪子。

pay.example: I will pay for the coffee and you can pay me back tomorrow.
pay.exampleZh: 我来付这杯咖啡的钱，你明天还我就可以。

payment.example: I need to make the payment for my new phone today.
payment.exampleZh: 我今天需要为我的新手机付款。

pea.example: My mother cooked some green peas with rice for dinner last night.
pea.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈用米饭煮了一些青豌豆当晚餐。

peace.example: Everyone hopes that peace will come to the world soon.
peace.exampleZh: 大家都希望和平能早日降临世界。

peaceful.example: The small village is very peaceful in the early morning.
peaceful.exampleZh: 这个小村庄在清晨非常宁静。

peak.example: We climbed to the peak of the mountain before sunrise.
peak.exampleZh: 我们在日出前爬到了山峰顶端。

peanut.example: My little sister likes to eat peanuts after school every day.
peanut.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天放学后都喜欢吃花生。

pear.example: My mother bought a sweet pear at the market this morning.
pear.exampleZh: 今天早上我妈妈在市场买了一个很甜的梨。

peasant.example: The peasant works hard in the field every day to grow food for his family.
peasant.exampleZh: 这个农民每天在田里辛勤劳作，为家人种粮食。

peculiar.example: There is a peculiar smell in this old room.
peculiar.exampleZh: 这个旧房间里有一股奇怪的气味。

peer.example: She looked at her peer and smiled before the test began.
peer.exampleZh: 考试开始前，她看了看同龄人，笑了笑。

pen.example: Please give me a pen so I can write down the address.
pen.exampleZh: 请给我一支钢笔，这样我就能把地址写下来。

penalty.example: If you park here, you will have to pay a penalty.
penalty.exampleZh: 如果你在这里停车，你将不得不缴纳罚款。

pencil.example: She draws a small cat with a pencil on white paper.
pencil.exampleZh: 她在白纸上用铅笔画了一只小猫。

penetrate.example: The bright sunlight can penetrate the thin curtain in the morning.
penetrate.exampleZh: 早晨明亮的阳光能穿透薄薄的窗帘。

penny.example: I only have one penny in my pocket today.
penny.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只有一便士。

pension.example: My grandfather gets a small pension from the government every month.
pension.exampleZh: 我祖父每个月从政府领取一笔小额养老金。

people.example: Many people in my town like to walk in the park.
people.exampleZh: 我们镇上很多人都喜欢在公园里散步。

pepper.example: Please add some pepper to the soup before you serve it.
pepper.exampleZh: 上汤之前请往汤里加点胡椒。

per.example: The bus leaves every hour and costs two dollars per person.
per.exampleZh: 公共汽车每小时一班，每人两美元。

perceive.example: Many people perceive him as a kind and honest man.
perceive.exampleZh: 许多人认为他是一个善良诚实的人。

percent.example: About sixty percent of the students in our class walk to school.
percent.exampleZh: 我们班大约百分之六十的学生步行上学。

percentage.example: The percentage of students who walk to school is very small.
percentage.exampleZh: 步行上学的学生比例非常小。

perception.example: My perception of the problem changed after talking with her.
perception.exampleZh: 和她交谈后，我对这个问题的看法改变了。

perfect.example: She practiced every day to perfect her English pronunciation.
perfect.exampleZh: 她每天练习以改善自己的英语发音。

perform.example: The doctor will perform the operation early tomorrow morning.
perform.exampleZh: 医生将于明天一早执行这台手术。

performance.example: Her performance in the school play was the best part of the show.
performance.exampleZh: 她在学校话剧中的表演是整场演出中最精彩的部分。

perhaps.example: Perhaps she will come to the party with her sister tonight.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许她今晚会和姐姐一起来参加聚会。

period.example: This was an important period in our nation's long history.
period.exampleZh: 这是我们国家漫长历史上的一个重要时期。

periodical.example: The library keeps every periodical on the second floor for students to read.
periodical.exampleZh: 图书馆把每一本期刊都放在二楼供学生阅读。

permanent.example: This job can become a permanent position if you do well.
permanent.exampleZh: 如果你做得好，这份工作可能会变成一个固定的职位。

permission.example: You need permission from your parents to go on the trip.
permission.exampleZh: 你需要得到父母的允许才能参加这次旅行。

permit.example: The school does not permit students to use phones during class.
permit.exampleZh: 学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

person.example: He is a kind person who always helps other people.
person.exampleZh: 他是一个总是帮助别人的善良的人。

personal.example: I keep my personal things in a small box under the bed.
personal.exampleZh: 我把私人物品放在床底下的一个小盒子里。

personality.example: Her warm personality makes everyone feel welcome in the new class.
personality.exampleZh: 她热情的个性让每个人在新班级里都感到受欢迎。

personnel.example: The personnel in our office are very friendly and hard-working.
personnel.exampleZh: 我们办公室的人员都很友好，工作也很努力。

perspective.example: From my perspective, the new plan is simple and fair.
perspective.exampleZh: 在我看来，这个新计划简单而公平。

persuade.example: I tried to persuade my brother to study harder for the exam.
persuade.exampleZh: 我试着说服我弟弟为考试更努力学习。

pessimistic.example: My father is always pessimistic about the weather, even on sunny days.
pessimistic.exampleZh: 我父亲对天气总是很悲观，即使是大晴天也一样。

pet.example: My little sister has a pet cat and she loves it very much.
pet.exampleZh: 我妹妹养了一只宠物猫，她非常喜欢它。

petrol.example: We stopped at the station to buy petrol for the car.
petrol.exampleZh: 我们在加油站停下来给车买汽油。

petroleum.example: Many countries use petroleum to make fuel for cars and planes.
petroleum.exampleZh: 许多国家用石油来制造汽车和飞机所需的燃料。

phase.example: This phase of the project is the most important one.
phase.exampleZh: 项目的这个阶段是最重要的一个阶段。

phenomenon.example: This strange weather is a natural phenomenon that scientists still cannot explain.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的天气是一种科学家仍然无法解释的自然现象。

philosophy.example: My philosophy is to work hard and stay kind to others.
philosophy.exampleZh: 我的人生观是努力工作，并始终善待他人。

phone.example: I use my phone to call my mother every evening.
phone.exampleZh: 我每天晚上用手机给妈妈打电话。

photo.example: I took a photo of my family at the park yesterday.
photo.exampleZh: 昨天我在公园给家人拍了一张照片。

photograph.example: She showed me a photograph of her family at the beach.
photograph.exampleZh: 她给我看了一张她家人在海滩上的照片。

photographer.example: The photographer took many beautiful pictures of our family at the park.
photographer.exampleZh: 这位摄影师在公园里为我们的家人拍了许多漂亮的照片。

phrase.example: This common English phrase is easy to remember and use.
phrase.exampleZh: 这个常见的英语短语容易记住和使用。

physical.example: Regular physical activity helps children stay healthy and strong.
physical.exampleZh: 经常进行身体活动有助于孩子们保持健康和强壮。

physician.example: My physician told me to drink more water and get more sleep.
physician.exampleZh: 我的内科医生让我多喝水、多睡觉。

physicist.example: The young physicist explained how light travels through space.
physicist.exampleZh: 这位年轻的物理学家解释了光如何在太空中传播。

physics.example: He studies physics at school and enjoys learning how things move.
physics.exampleZh: 他在学校学习物理学，喜欢了解事物如何运动。

piano.example: My sister plays the piano every evening after she finishes her homework.
piano.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天傍晚做完作业后都会弹钢琴。

pick.example: You can pick any book you like from this small shelf.
pick.exampleZh: 你可以从这个小书架上挑选任何一本你喜欢的书。

picnic.example: We will have a picnic in the park this Sunday with our friends.
picnic.exampleZh: 这个星期天我们将和朋友们在公园里野餐。

picture.example: She showed me a picture of her family at the beach.
picture.exampleZh: 她给我看了一张她家人在海滩上的照片。

pie.example: My mother made a warm apple pie for us yesterday.
pie.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨天给我们做了一个热腾腾的苹果派。

piece.example: She gave me a piece of cake and a glass of milk.
piece.exampleZh: 她给了我一块蛋糕和一杯牛奶。

pier.example: We walked to the end of the pier to watch the boats.
pier.exampleZh: 我们走到码头尽头去看那些船。

pig.example: The pig is eating corn in the mud.
pig.exampleZh: 那头猪正在泥里吃玉米。

pigeon.example: A gray pigeon sat on the roof and looked down at us.
pigeon.exampleZh: 一只灰色的鸽子停在屋顶上，低头看着我们。

pile.example: There is a large pile of books on the desk.

pill.example: Please take this pill with a glass of water after dinner.
pill.exampleZh: 请晚饭后用水送服这片药。

pillar.example: The old bridge is held up by a strong stone pillar.
pillar.exampleZh: 这座老桥由一根坚固的石柱支撑着。

pillow.example: I put a soft pillow under my head and fell asleep quickly.
pillow.exampleZh: 我把一个柔软的枕头放在头下，很快就睡着了。

pilot.example: The pilot will pilot the new plane as a test flight.
pilot.exampleZh: 这位飞行员将驾驶新飞机进行试飞。

pin.example: She used a pin to hold the paper on the board.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚大头针把纸固定在板上。

pinch.example: She gave his arm a quick pinch and laughed at his surprised face.
pinch.exampleZh: 她飞快地捏了一下他的胳膊，看着他吃惊的表情笑了起来。

pine.example: The old pine tree stands by the lake, and she pines for home.
pine.exampleZh: 那棵老松树立在湖边，她渴望着回家。

pink.example: She wore a pink dress and white shoes to the party.
pink.exampleZh: 她穿了一条粉红色连衣裙和一双白鞋去参加聚会。

pint.example: He drank a pint of cold beer after work.
pint.exampleZh: 他下班后喝了一品脱冰啤酒。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in computer science and opened new paths for many women.
pioneer.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学领域的先驱，为许多女性开辟了新道路。

pipe.example: Water flows through the pipe under the old street.
pipe.exampleZh: 水从旧街道下面的管道中流过。

pistol.example: The police found a pistol hidden under the bed in his room.
pistol.exampleZh: 警方在他房间的床下发现了一把手枪。

pit.example: The workers dug a deep pit in the ground behind the old factory.
pit.exampleZh: 工人们在旧工厂后面的地上挖了一个深坑。

pitch.example: They pitched the tent near the river and cooked dinner outside.
pitch.exampleZh: 他们在河边搭起帐篷，并在外面做晚饭。

pity.example: It is a pity that she cannot come to the party tonight.
pity.exampleZh: 很可惜她今晚不能来参加聚会。

place.example: Please place your bag on the chair near the door.
place.exampleZh: 请把你的包放在门边的椅子上。

plain.example: The teacher explained the rule in plain English so everyone understood it.
plain.exampleZh: 老师用浅显的英语解释了这条规则，让每个人都听懂了。

plan.example: We plan to leave early and visit the museum before lunch.
plan.exampleZh: 我们计划早点出发，在午饭前参观博物馆。

plane.example: The plane flew high above the clouds on a sunny morning.
plane.exampleZh: 在一个阳光明媚的早晨，飞机在云层上方高高飞行。

planet.example: Earth is the only planet where people can live.
planet.exampleZh: 地球是唯一人类可以居住的行星。

plant.example: The workers built a new plant and planted many trees around it.
plant.exampleZh: 工人们建了一座新工厂，并在周围种了许多树。

plantation.example: The old plantation grows coffee and bananas on the hills.
plantation.exampleZh: 那座老种植园在山坡上种植咖啡和香蕉。

plastic.example: This cheap plastic bottle is easy to carry on a long walk.
plastic.exampleZh: 这个便宜的塑料瓶在长途散步时很容易携带。

plate.example: She put the hot soup in a big white plate on the table.
plate.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上的一只大白盘子里。

platform.example: She waited for the train on the platform with her friends.
platform.exampleZh: 她和朋友们在站台上等火车。

play.example: The children play games in the park after school.
play.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩游戏。

player.example: The player scored two goals in the second half of the game.
player.exampleZh: 这名球员在比赛下半场攻入两球。

playground.example: The children are playing happily in the playground after school.
playground.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们在操场上开心地玩耍。

pleasant.example: The weather was pleasant, so we walked in the park.
pleasant.exampleZh: 天气很宜人，所以我们在公园里散步。

please.example: Please come to my house tonight, because I want to please my parents.
please.exampleZh: 今晚请来我家，因为我想让父母高兴。

pleasure.example: Reading a good book gives me great pleasure on quiet evenings.
pleasure.exampleZh: 在安静的夜晚读一本好书给我带来极大的快乐。

pledge.example: She made a pledge to help her friend every day.
pledge.exampleZh: 她发誓每天帮助她的朋友。

plenty.example: We have plenty of fresh water and food for everyone.
plenty.exampleZh: 我们有充足的新鲜水和食物供每个人使用。

plot.example: The film has a simple plot, and the farmers grow corn on a small plot.
plot.exampleZh: 这部电影情节简单，农民们在一块小块土地上种玉米。

plow.example: The old farmer used a plow to turn the soil in his field.
plow.exampleZh: 那位老农用犁翻耕他田里的土。

plug.example: She put the plug in the sink and pulled the plug from the wall.
plug.exampleZh: 她把塞子塞进水池，又把插头从墙上拔了下来。

plunge.example: The dog plunged into the cold river and swam quickly to the other side.
plunge.exampleZh: 那只狗跳进冰冷的河里，迅速游到了对岸。

plus.example: Two plus three is five, and that is a simple sum.
plus.exampleZh: 二加三等于五，这是一道简单的加法。

pocket.example: He put the small key in his coat pocket and left the room quietly.
pocket.exampleZh: 他把小钥匙放进外套口袋，然后悄悄地离开了房间。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the rain for her class.
poem.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一首关于雨的短诗。

poet.example: The young poet writes about the sea and the quiet life of his village.
poet.exampleZh: 这位年轻的诗人描写大海以及他村庄里宁静的生活。

poetry.example: She writes poetry about the quiet fields near her home.
poetry.exampleZh: 她写关于家乡附近宁静田野的诗歌。

point.example: The teacher pointed to the key point on the map.
point.exampleZh: 老师指向地图上的关键点。

poison.example: The old man put poison on the meat to kill the rats.
poison.exampleZh: 老人在肉上下了毒来毒死老鼠。

poisonous.example: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous, so never eat them without an expert.
poisonous.exampleZh: 有些野生蘑菇是有毒的，所以没有专家指导千万不要吃。

pole.example: The flag hangs on a tall pole in front of the school.
pole.exampleZh: 旗子挂在学校前面一根高高的杆子上。

police.example: The police are looking for the man who stole the car.
police.exampleZh: 警方正在寻找偷走那辆车的人。

policy.example: The company has a clear policy about working from home.
policy.exampleZh: 公司对于居家办公有明确的政策。

polish.example: I need to polish my shoes before the meeting this morning.
polish.exampleZh: 今天上午开会前我需要把鞋子擦亮。

polite.example: She is always polite to her teachers and classmates at school.
polite.exampleZh: 她在学校对老师和同学总是很有礼貌。

political.example: The political situation in that country changes very quickly.
political.exampleZh: 那个国家的政治局势变化非常快。

politician.example: The politician spoke to the crowd about better schools and safer streets.
politician.exampleZh: 这位政治家向人群讲述了改善学校和更安全街道的问题。

politics.example: My brother studies politics at a small college near our home.
politics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在我们家附近的一所小学院学习政治学。

pollute.example: The factory pours dirty water into the river and pollutes it.
pollute.exampleZh: 这家工厂把脏水排入河中，污染了河水。

pollution.example: The pollution in this river is bad for fish and people.
pollution.exampleZh: 这条河的污染对鱼和人都不利。

pond.example: There are many small fish in the pond near our house.
pond.exampleZh: 我们家附近的池塘里有很多小鱼。

pool.example: The children swim in the small pool behind our house every summer.
pool.exampleZh: 每年夏天，孩子们都在我们屋后的小水池里游泳。

poor.example: The poor family lives in a small old house near the river.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭住在河边一座又小又旧的房子里。

pop.example: Pop music is popular with young people, and new songs pop up every day.
pop.exampleZh: 流行音乐很受年轻人欢迎，新歌每天都在涌现。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people all over the world.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌在世界各地的年轻人中非常流行。

popularity.example: The popularity of this small cafe grows every year among local students.
popularity.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆在当地学生中的人气每年都在上升。

population.example: The population of this city has grown quickly in recent years.
population.exampleZh: 这座城市的人口近年来增长很快。

porch.example: She sat on the porch and watched the children play in the yard.
porch.exampleZh: 她坐在门廊上，看着孩子们在院子里玩耍。

pork.example: My mother cooks pork with potatoes and carrots for dinner every Sunday.
pork.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚饭都用土豆和胡萝卜炖猪肉。

port.example: The ship arrived at the port early in the morning.

portable.example: This small portable radio is easy to carry on trips.
portable.exampleZh: 这台小巧的便携收音机在旅行时很容易携带。

porter.example: The porter helped us carry our heavy bags to the room.
porter.exampleZh: 搬运工帮我们把沉重的行李搬到房间里。

portion.example: I ate only a small portion of the cake and saved the rest.
portion.exampleZh: 我只吃了一小部分蛋糕，把剩下的留了起来。

portrait.example: There is a famous portrait of the queen on the wall.
portrait.exampleZh: 墙上挂着一幅著名的女王肖像。

portray.example: The movie portrays a young teacher who helps poor children learn to read.
portray.exampleZh: 这部电影描绘了一位帮助贫困孩子学习阅读的年轻教师。

pose.example: The new rule may pose a problem for small shops, so owners want to discuss it.
pose.exampleZh: 新规定可能会给小商店造成问题，所以店主们想讨论一下。

position.example: She found a comfortable position on the sofa and read for an hour.
