position.exampleZh: 她在沙发上找了个舒服的位置，读了一小时书。

positive.example: She has a positive attitude toward her new job.
positive.exampleZh: 她对这份新工作抱有积极的态度。

possess.example: She possesses a rare talent for making everyone feel welcome.
possess.exampleZh: 她拥有一种罕见的天赋，能让每个人都感到受欢迎。

possession.example: His most valuable possession is an old family watch.
possession.exampleZh: 他最珍贵的财产是一块祖传的旧手表。

possibility.example: There is a real possibility that it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
possibility.exampleZh: 明天下午确实有可能下雨。

possible.example: It is possible to finish this work before Friday.
possible.exampleZh: 在周五之前完成这项工作是有可能的。

possibly.example: She will possibly come to the party with her brother tonight.
possibly.exampleZh: 她今晚也许会和她哥哥一起来参加聚会。

post.example: Please post this letter at the post office near my office.
post.exampleZh: 请在我办公室附近的邮局把这封信寄出去。

postage.example: The postage for this heavy package is more than I expected.
postage.exampleZh: 这个重包裹的邮费比我预想的要高。

postman.example: The postman brings our letters every morning before eight.
postman.exampleZh: 邮递员每天早上八点前把我们的信送来。

postpone.example: We had to postpone the meeting because our manager was sick.
postpone.exampleZh: 因为经理病了，我们不得不推迟会议。

pot.example: She put the hot soup in a large pot on the stove.
pot.exampleZh: 她把热汤倒进了炉子上的一口大锅里。

potato.example: I like to eat a baked potato with butter for lunch.
potato.exampleZh: 我午饭喜欢吃加黄油的烤土豆。

potential.example: Every student has the potential to do well if teachers give them enough support.
potential.exampleZh: 如果老师给予足够的支持，每个学生都有取得好成绩的潜力。

pound.example: He hit the box hard and it fell with a loud pound.
pound.exampleZh: 他用力打那个箱子，箱子砰的一声掉了下来。

pour.example: She poured the hot water into the cup and smiled.
pour.exampleZh: 她把热水倒进杯子里，笑了笑。

poverty.example: Many families in this small village still live in poverty today.
poverty.exampleZh: 这个小村庄里的许多家庭如今仍然生活在贫困之中。

powder.example: She mixed the white powder with water to make a simple drink.
powder.exampleZh: 她把白色粉末和水混合，做成了一种简单的饮品。

power.example: The new power station gives clean electricity to thousands of homes.
power.exampleZh: 这座新发电站为数千个家庭提供清洁电力。

powerful.example: This is a powerful car that can go very fast.
powerful.exampleZh: 这是一辆速度非常快的强劲汽车。

practical.example: Her advice is practical and easy to follow.
practical.exampleZh: 她的建议很实际，而且容易照着做。

practice.example: Daily practice is the best way to improve your English.
practice.exampleZh: 每天练习是提高英语的最佳方式。

practise.example: You need to practise speaking English every day to get better.
practise.exampleZh: 你需要每天练习说英语才能进步。

praise.example: The teacher praised her students for their hard work and kind help.
praise.exampleZh: 老师表扬了学生们的努力学习和热心帮助。

pray.example: Every night she prays for her family's health and happiness.
pray.exampleZh: 每天晚上她都祈祷家人健康幸福。

prayer.example: She said a quiet prayer before going to bed each night.
prayer.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会做一次简短的祈祷。

precaution.example: As a precaution, she locked the door before going to bed.
precaution.exampleZh: 为了预防起见，她上床睡觉前把门锁上了。

preceding.example: The preceding chapter explains the basic rules of the game.
preceding.exampleZh: 前面一章解释了游戏的基本规则。

precious.example: Time with family is precious and we should enjoy every minute.
precious.exampleZh: 与家人共度的时光是珍贵的，我们应该享受每一分钟。

precise.example: Her precise instructions made the whole job much easier for us.
precise.exampleZh: 她那精确的指示让我们整个工作轻松了许多。

precision.example: The doctor measured the drug with great precision so no patient got too much.
precision.exampleZh: 医生非常精确地测量了药物，以免任何病人用药过量。

predict.example: Scientists cannot always predict when a big earthquake will happen.
predict.exampleZh: 科学家并不总能预测大地震会在什么时候发生。

predominant.example: Blue is the predominant color in this painting.
predominant.exampleZh: 蓝色是这幅画中占主导地位的颜色。

prefer.example: I prefer tea in the morning, but my brother likes coffee.
prefer.exampleZh: 我早上更喜欢喝茶，但我弟弟喜欢咖啡。

preferable.example: This plan is preferable because it is cheaper and easier for everyone.
preferable.exampleZh: 这个方案更可取，因为它对每个人来说都更便宜、更容易。

preference.example: She has a strong preference for tea over coffee in the morning.
preference.exampleZh: 她早上更偏爱喝茶而不是咖啡。

pregnant.example: She is pregnant and very happy about the good news.
pregnant.exampleZh: 她怀孕了，对这个好消息感到非常高兴。

prejudice.example: People should judge others by their actions, not by prejudice.
prejudice.exampleZh: 人们应该根据行为而不是偏见来评判他人。

preliminary.example: The preliminary results look good, so we will start the main test next week.
preliminary.exampleZh: 初步结果看起来不错，所以我们下周将开始主要测试。

premier.example: The premier gave a short speech to the nation last night.
premier.exampleZh: 总理昨晚向全国发表了简短的演讲。

preparation.example: Good preparation is important before you start a long trip.
preparation.exampleZh: 开始长途旅行前，做好准备工作很重要。

prepare.example: We need to prepare the food before our friends arrive.
prepare.exampleZh: 我们需要在朋友们到来之前准备好食物。

prescription.example: The doctor wrote a prescription for my cough and told me to rest.
prescription.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一张治咳嗽的处方，并让我休息。

presence.example: Her quiet presence made everyone in the room feel calm.
presence.exampleZh: 她安静的存在让房间里的每个人都感到平静。

present.example: She gave me a nice present on my birthday last week.
present.exampleZh: 上周我生日时她送了我一份很好的礼物。

presently.example: The bus will arrive presently, so please wait here for a few minutes.
presently.exampleZh: 公交车不久就会到，请在这里等几分钟。

preserve.example: We must preserve the old trees in our town for future generations.
preserve.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护好我们镇上的老树。

president.example: The president spoke to the students at the school this morning.
president.exampleZh: 今天上午，总统在学校对学生们讲了话。

press.example: She pressed the button and waited for the door to open.
press.exampleZh: 她按下按钮，等着门打开。

pressure.example: Students often feel great pressure before important exams and need enough rest.
pressure.exampleZh: 学生们在重要考试前常常感到很大压力，需要足够的休息。

presumably.example: He is not here, so he is presumably still at work.
presumably.exampleZh: 他不在这里，所以大概还在上班。

pretend.example: He likes to pretend he is a superhero when he plays with friends.
pretend.exampleZh: 他和朋友玩耍时喜欢假装自己是超级英雄。

pretty.example: She looks pretty in that blue dress and she speaks English quite well.
pretty.exampleZh: 她穿那条蓝裙子很漂亮，而且她英语说得相当好。

prevail.example: This old custom still prevails in many small villages today.
prevail.exampleZh: 这一古老习俗如今在许多小村庄里依然盛行。

prevent.example: Wearing a mask can help prevent the spread of germs.
prevent.exampleZh: 戴口罩有助于防止细菌传播。

prevention.example: Good sleep and clean water are important for the prevention of many diseases.
prevention.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠和清洁的水对预防许多疾病很重要。

previous.example: Her previous job was in a small bookshop near the station.
previous.exampleZh: 她先前的工作是在车站附近的一家小书店。

price.example: The price of this small car is too high for me.
price.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车的价格对我来说太高了。

pride.example: Her parents felt great pride when she finished the long race.
pride.exampleZh: 当她跑完那场长跑比赛时，她的父母感到非常自豪。

priest.example: The priest spoke kindly to the children after the morning service.
priest.exampleZh: 晨间礼拜结束后，神父和蔼地对孩子们说话。

primarily.example: This book is primarily for students who want to learn English.
primarily.exampleZh: 这本书主要是为想学英语的学生写的。

primary.example: Our primary goal this year is to improve students' reading skills.
primary.exampleZh: 我们今年的首要目标是提高学生的阅读能力。

prime.example: My prime goal this year is to pass the math exam.
prime.exampleZh: 我今年的首要目标是通过数学考试。

primitive.example: This primitive tool was made of stone and wood.
primitive.exampleZh: 这件原始工具是用石头和木头制成的。

prince.example: The young prince lived in a large castle with his family.
prince.exampleZh: 这位年轻的王子与家人住在一座大城堡里。

princess.example: The young princess wore a beautiful dress to the party.
princess.exampleZh: 年轻的公主穿了一条漂亮的裙子去参加聚会。

principal.example: The principal reason she came to school today was to meet her new teacher.
principal.exampleZh: 她今天来学校的主要原因是想见她的新老师。

principle.example: She never lies because honesty is an important principle in her life.
principle.exampleZh: 她从不撒谎，因为诚实是她生活中一项重要的原则。

print.example: She used a small machine to print the report for her teacher.
print.exampleZh: 她用一台小机器为老师打印了这份报告。

printer.example: The printer in our office is broken, so we cannot print anything today.
printer.exampleZh: 我们办公室的打印机坏了，所以今天没法打印任何东西。

prior.example: She had a prior meeting, so we started the class later.
prior.exampleZh: 她之前有个会议，所以我们晚一点才开始上课。

priority.example: Safety is our top priority at work every day.
priority.exampleZh: 安全是我们每天工作中的首要优先事项。

prison.example: He spent three years in prison for stealing a car.
prison.exampleZh: 他因偷车在监狱里待了三年。

prisoner.example: The prisoner was allowed to see his family once a month.
prisoner.exampleZh: 这名囚犯被允许每月见家人一次。

private.example: This is a private road, so only the people who live here can use it.
private.exampleZh: 这是一条私人的路，所以只有住在这里的人才能使用。

privilege.example: Good education is a privilege that not every child can enjoy.
privilege.exampleZh: 良好的教育是一种并非每个孩子都能享有的特权。

prize.example: She won first prize for her science project at school last year.
prize.exampleZh: 去年她在学校凭借科学项目赢得了一等奖。

probability.example: There is a high probability that it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
probability.exampleZh: 明天下午下雨的可能性很大。

probable.example: It is probable that he will arrive before noon.
probable.exampleZh: 他很可能会在中午之前到达。

probably.example: It will probably rain this afternoon, so take your umbrella with you.
probably.exampleZh: 今天下午很可能会下雨，所以带上你的雨伞。

problem.example: We must solve this problem before the meeting starts tomorrow.
problem.exampleZh: 我们必须在明天会议开始前解决这个问题。

procedure.example: Please follow the correct procedure before you use this machine.
procedure.exampleZh: 在使用这台机器之前，请遵循正确的程序。

proceed.example: After a short break, we proceeded with the meeting.
proceed.exampleZh: 短暂休息后，我们继续进行会议。

process.example: Learning a new language is a slow process, so please be patient.
process.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是个缓慢的过程，所以请耐心一些。

produce.example: The factory can produce many cheap goods for local people.
produce.exampleZh: 这家工厂能为当地人生产许多便宜的商品。

product.example: This new product is very popular with young people.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品很受年轻人欢迎。

production.example: The factory increased its production of cars last year.
production.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年提高了汽车的产量。

profession.example: My father is a doctor, and he loves his profession very much.
profession.exampleZh: 我父亲是一名医生，他非常热爱自己的职业。

professional.example: She is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
professional.exampleZh: 她是一位有多年经验的专业教师。

professor.example: My professor asked us to read two books before the next class.
professor.exampleZh: 我的教授让我们在下节课前读两本书。

profile.example: The police kept a detailed profile of every suspect in the case.
profile.exampleZh: 警方为案件中的每名嫌疑人保存了详细的档案。

profit.example: Small shops can make a good profit during the holiday season.
profit.exampleZh: 小商店在节假日期间能获得可观的利润。

program.example: The new program on TV teaches children how to draw small animals.
program.exampleZh: 电视上的这个新节目教孩子们怎样画小动物。

progress.example: She has made great progress in learning English this year.
progress.exampleZh: 她今年在学英语方面取得了很大进步。

progressive.example: Our school has a progressive plan to add more computers each year.
progressive.exampleZh: 我们学校有一个循序渐进的计划，每年增加更多电脑。

prohibit.example: The school prohibits students from using phones during class.
prohibit.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

project.example: Our team will start a new project next week.
project.exampleZh: 我们团队下周将开始一个新项目。

prominent.example: She is a prominent writer in our city.
prominent.exampleZh: 她是我们城市里一位著名的作家。

promise.example: She made a promise to help her little brother with his homework.

promising.example: The young singer is very promising and has many fans.
promising.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手很有前途，有很多粉丝。

promote.example: The company will promote her to manager next month.
promote.exampleZh: 公司下个月将把她提升为经理。

prompt.example: The teacher gave a prompt answer to every question the students asked.
prompt.exampleZh: 老师对学生们提出的每一个问题都给出了及时的回答。

pronoun.example: In the sentence she likes him, the word him is a pronoun.
pronoun.exampleZh: 在句子 she likes him 中，单词 him 是一个代词。

proof.example: The police found no proof that he had taken the money.
proof.exampleZh: 警方没有找到他拿了那笔钱的证据。

proper.example: It is important to wear proper clothes for the job interview.
proper.exampleZh: 为求职面试穿上得体的衣服很重要。

properly.example: Please do the work properly so we can finish it on time.
properly.exampleZh: 请把这项工作做好，这样我们才能按时完成。

property.example: The old house is the most valuable property his family owns.
property.exampleZh: 这栋老房子是他家拥有的最有价值的财产。

proportion.example: A large proportion of students walk to school every morning.
proportion.exampleZh: 很大一部分学生每天早上步行上学。

proposal.example: She agreed to his proposal for a new plan.
proposal.exampleZh: 她同意了他提出的新计划建议。

propose.example: I propose that we meet again next Monday morning.
propose.exampleZh: 我提议我们下周一上午再见面。

prospect.example: The young man sees a good prospect for his future career.
prospect.exampleZh: 这个年轻人看到了自己未来职业的良好前景。

prosperity.example: The small town found peace and prosperity after the new road was built.
prosperity.exampleZh: 新路修好后，这个小镇迎来了安宁与繁荣。

prosperous.example: This small town became prosperous after the new factory opened.
prosperous.exampleZh: 新工厂开业后，这个小镇变得繁荣起来。

protect.example: Parents should protect their children from danger when they are young.
protect.exampleZh: 父母应该在孩子年幼时保护他们免受危险。

protein.example: You need protein in your meals to grow strong and healthy.
protein.exampleZh: 你的膳食中需要蛋白质，才能长得强壮健康。

protest.example: Many students gathered outside the town hall to protest against the new school rules.
protest.exampleZh: 许多学生聚集在市政厅外抗议新的学校规定。

proud.example: My parents are very proud of me because I work hard.
proud.exampleZh: 我的父母为我感到非常骄傲，因为我工作努力。

prove.example: The new test results prove that his idea is right.
prove.exampleZh: 新的测试结果证明他的想法是对的。

provide.example: Our school will provide free lunch for all students this year.
provide.exampleZh: 我们学校今年将为所有学生提供免费午餐。

provided.example: You can go out provided you finish your homework first.
provided.exampleZh: 只要你先把作业做完，就可以出去。

province.example: She has worked in this province for over ten years.
province.exampleZh: 她在这个省工作已经超过十年了。

provision.example: The provision of clean water is important for every village.
provision.exampleZh: 清洁水的供应对每个村庄都很重要。

provoke.example: His rude words provoked her, so she left the room without a word.
provoke.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她，于是她一声不吭地离开了房间。

psychological.example: The accident left him with serious psychological problems that lasted for years.
psychological.exampleZh: 那场事故给他留下了持续多年的严重心理问题。

psychologist.example: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid of school.
psychologist.exampleZh: 这位心理学家帮助那个孩子不再那么害怕上学。

psychology.example: She is studying psychology at university because she wants to understand human behavior.
psychology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习心理学，因为她想理解人类的行为。

pub.example: After work, we met at a small pub near the station for a drink.
pub.exampleZh: 下班后，我们在车站附近的一家小酒吧碰面喝了点东西。

public.example: The public should know the truth about this serious problem.
public.exampleZh: 公众应该知道这个严重问题的真相。

publication.example: The publication of her first book made her very happy.
publication.exampleZh: 她的第一本书的出版让她非常高兴。

publish.example: The writer will publish his new book next month.
publish.exampleZh: 这位作家下个月将出版他的新书。

publisher.example: The publisher sent her a letter about the new book.
publisher.exampleZh: 出版商就这本新书给她寄了一封信。

pull.example: Please pull the heavy box across the floor to the door.
pull.exampleZh: 请把那个沉重的箱子从地板上拖到门口。

pulse.example: The doctor felt his pulse and said he was fine.
pulse.exampleZh: 医生摸了摸他的脉搏，说他没事。

pump.example: The farmer used a pump to bring water from the well.
pump.exampleZh: 农夫用抽水机从井里抽水。

punch.example: He gave the ticket to the man and watched him punch a hole in it.
punch.exampleZh: 他把票递给那个人，看着他在票上打了一个孔。

punctual.example: She is always punctual for class and never arrives late.
punctual.exampleZh: 她上课总是很准时，从不迟到。

punish.example: The teacher will punish students who cheat on the exam.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚考试作弊的学生。

punishment.example: The teacher gave him a punishment for talking in class.
punishment.exampleZh: 老师因为他在课堂上讲话而惩罚了他。

pupil.example: The pupil is reading a book near the window.
pupil.exampleZh: 那个小学生正在窗边看书。

purchase.example: She went to the store to purchase some milk and bread for her family.
purchase.exampleZh: 她去商店为家人购买了一些牛奶和面包。

pure.example: The water in this mountain spring is pure and safe to drink.
pure.exampleZh: 这条山泉里的水是纯净的，可以安全饮用。

purple.example: She wore a purple dress to the party last night.
purple.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条紫色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

purpose.example: What is the purpose of this small room in your house?
purpose.exampleZh: 你房子里这个小房间的用途是什么？

purse.example: She opened her purse and found only a few coins inside.
purse.exampleZh: 她打开钱包，发现里面只有几枚硬币。

pursue.example: She moved to the city to pursue her dream of becoming a doctor.
pursue.exampleZh: 她搬到这座城市，追求成为医生的梦想。

pursuit.example: Her pursuit of a better life led her to a new city.
pursuit.exampleZh: 她对更好生活的追求促使她来到了一座新城市。

push.example: She helped push the heavy box into the room.
push.exampleZh: 她帮忙把那个沉重的箱子推进了房间。

put.example: Please put your books on the desk before you leave the room.
put.exampleZh: 离开房间前，请把你的书放在桌子上。

puzzle.example: The strange letter puzzled me, so I asked my teacher for help.
puzzle.exampleZh: 这封奇怪的信让我感到困惑，所以我向老师求助。

pyramid.example: The ancient pyramid in Egypt is very famous around the world.
pyramid.exampleZh: 埃及的古老金字塔在全世界都非常有名。

qualification.example: She has the right qualifications for this teaching job.
qualification.exampleZh: 她具备这份教学工作所需的资格。

qualify.example: She worked hard to qualify as a doctor in that city.
qualify.exampleZh: 她努力工作，以便在那座城市取得医生资格。

quality.example: The quality of this coffee is very good, so it costs more.
quality.exampleZh: 这种咖啡的品质很好，所以价格更高。

quantify.example: It is hard to quantify the value of good sleep.
quantify.exampleZh: 良好睡眠的价值很难量化。

quantity.example: We need a large quantity of water for the whole team.
quantity.exampleZh: 我们需要为整个团队准备大量的水。

quarrel.example: They had a quarrel about money, but they are friends again.
quarrel.exampleZh: 他们因为钱吵了一架，但现在已经和好如初了。

quarter.example: I have to finish the report before the end of this quarter.
quarter.exampleZh: 我必须在这个季度结束前完成这份报告。

quarterly.example: We have a quarterly meeting and send a quarterly report to all staff.
quarterly.exampleZh: 我们每季度开一次会，并向全体员工发送季度报告。

queen.example: The queen smiled and waved to the people from the palace window.
queen.exampleZh: 女王微笑着从宫殿窗口向民众挥手。

queer.example: It felt queer to walk home alone in the dark.
queer.exampleZh: 一个人在黑暗中走回家，感觉怪怪的。

query.example: She asked a question, but the teacher did not answer her query.
query.exampleZh: 她问了一个问题，但老师没有回答她的疑问。

quest.example: Their quest for clean water took them across the desert.
quest.exampleZh: 他们对清洁水源的探寻带他们穿越了沙漠。

question.example: I have a question about this lesson, so please ask the teacher.
question.exampleZh: 我对这节课有一个疑问，所以请问老师。

queue.example: We stood in a long queue to buy tickets for the show.
queue.exampleZh: 我们排了很长的队买演出票。

quick.example: He is quick at math and always answers first.
quick.exampleZh: 他数学反应很快，总是第一个回答。

quiet.example: The library is very quiet in the morning, so I can read there.
quiet.exampleZh: 图书馆早上非常安静，所以我可以在这里看书。

quit.example: He decided to quit his job and leave the city.
quit.exampleZh: 他决定辞掉工作，离开这座城市。

quite.example: The movie was quite good, and we all enjoyed it.
quite.exampleZh: 这部电影相当不错，我们都看得很开心。

quiz.example: Our teacher gave us a short quiz on the new words today.
quiz.exampleZh: 老师今天给我们做了一次关于新单词的小测验。

quota.example: Each worker must meet a daily quota of twenty parts.
quota.exampleZh: 每个工人必须完成每天二十个零件的定额。

quotation.example: He put a quotation from the old book at the top of his page.
quotation.exampleZh: 他在页面顶部放了一段摘自那本旧书的引语。

quote.example: She likes to quote her teacher in every class discussion.
quote.exampleZh: 她喜欢在每次课堂讨论中引用她老师的话。

rabbit.example: The white rabbit is eating a carrot in the garden.
rabbit.exampleZh: 那只白兔正在花园里吃胡萝卜。

race.example: Many people from different races ran in the race today.
race.exampleZh: 今天有许多不同种族的人参加了这场赛跑。

racial.example: She said racial differences should never be a reason to treat people badly.
racial.exampleZh: 她说种族差异绝不应成为不善待他人的理由。

rack.example: He put his wet coat on the rack and sat down.
rack.exampleZh: 他把湿外套放在架子上，然后坐了下来。

radar.example: The pilot used radar to find the airport in the heavy rain.
radar.exampleZh: 飞行员用雷达在大雨中找到了机场。

radiation.example: The sun sends out radiation that can harm your skin.
radiation.exampleZh: 太阳发出的辐射会伤害你的皮肤。

radical.example: The new teacher made a radical change to the way we learn English.
radical.exampleZh: 新老师对我们学习英语的方式做出了根本性的改变。

radio.example: My grandfather listens to the radio every morning while he eats breakfast.
radio.exampleZh: 我爷爷每天早上吃早饭时都会听收音机。

rag.example: She cleaned the dirty window with an old rag.
rag.exampleZh: 她用一块旧抹布擦干净了那扇脏窗户。

rail.example: Hold the rail when you walk down the stairs.

railroad.example: The new railroad connects the small town to the big city.
railroad.exampleZh: 这条新铁路把小镇和这座城市连接起来。

railway.example: The new railway connects the small town with the big city.
railway.exampleZh: 这条新铁路把小城镇和大城市连接起来。

rain.example: The rain stopped before we left home.
rain.exampleZh: 我们离开家之前雨停了。

raise.example: She raised her hand in class to ask a question.

rally.example: The coach called a rally to encourage the team after the game.
rally.exampleZh: 教练召集了一次集会，在比赛后鼓励球队。

range.example: The prices range from ten dollars to fifty dollars.
range.exampleZh: 价格从十美元到五十美元不等。

rank.example: He holds a high rank in the army and ranks among the best soldiers.
rank.exampleZh: 他在军中军衔很高，位列最优秀的士兵之中。

rapid.example: The rapid growth of the city brought many new jobs.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速发展带来了许多新工作。

rare.example: It is rare to see snow in this warm city.
rare.exampleZh: 在这座温暖的城市里看到雪是很罕见的。

rarely.example: She rarely goes to the movies because she is very busy.
rarely.exampleZh: 她很少去看电影，因为她非常忙。

rat.example: The rat ran across the kitchen floor and hid behind the old box.
rat.exampleZh: 那只老鼠跑过厨房地板，躲到了旧箱子后面。

rate.example: The hotel charges a low rate in winter and a high rate in summer.
rate.exampleZh: 这家酒店冬天收费低，夏天收费高。

rather.example: I would rather stay home tonight than go out in the rain.
rather.exampleZh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里，也不想冒雨出门。

ratio.example: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is about two to one.
ratio.exampleZh: 我们班男生和女生的比例大约是二比一。

raw.example: The raw fish was too cold and salty for the children to eat.
raw.exampleZh: 那条生鱼太凉也太咸，孩子们吃不下去。

ray.example: A ray of sunlight came through the window and lit the room.
ray.exampleZh: 一缕阳光透过窗户照进来，照亮了房间。

reach.example: She reached the top of the hill before the sun went down.
reach.exampleZh: 太阳下山前，她到达了山顶。

react.example: People react to bad news in different ways.
react.exampleZh: 人们对坏消息的反应方式各不相同。

reaction.example: My first reaction to the news was complete surprise.
reaction.exampleZh: 我对这个消息的第一反应是完全惊讶。

read.example: I like to read a book before going to sleep.
read.exampleZh: 我喜欢在睡觉前读一本书。

reader.example: The writer was happy to meet a reader who loved his book.
reader.exampleZh: 这位作家很高兴见到一位喜欢他书的读者。

reading.example: My reading of the map shows two small rivers near the town.
reading.exampleZh: 我对这张地图的解读显示，镇子附近有两条小河。

ready.example: I am ready to go to school now.
ready.exampleZh: 我现在准备好去上学了。

real.example: This is a real diamond, not a cheap fake one.
real.exampleZh: 这是一颗真钻石，不是廉价的假货。

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan that we can finish this week.
realistic.exampleZh: 我们需要一个现实可行的计划，能在这周内完成。

reality.example: We must accept the reality of our situation and move on.
reality.exampleZh: 我们必须接受我们处境的现实，并继续前行。

realize.example: I did not realize how late it was until I saw the clock.
realize.exampleZh: 直到看到钟，我才意识到时间已经这么晚了。

really.example: I really like this small book because it is easy to read.
really.exampleZh: 我真的很喜欢这本小书，因为它读起来很容易。

realm.example: In the realm of science, small discoveries can lead to great changes.
realm.exampleZh: 在科学领域，小小的发现也能带来巨大的变化。

rear.example: The children sat in the rear of the bus and laughed.
rear.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在公共汽车的后部，笑着。

reason.example: There is no reason to be afraid of making mistakes.

reasonable.example: It is reasonable to ask for more time to finish the work.
reasonable.exampleZh: 要求更多时间来完成这项工作是合理的。

rebel.example: The young rebel refused to follow the old rules of the village.
rebel.exampleZh: 那个年轻的反叛者拒绝遵守村子里古老的规矩。

recall.example: I cannot recall the name of the hotel we stayed in last summer.
recall.exampleZh: 我想不起去年夏天我们住的那家酒店的名字了。

receipt.example: Please keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
receipt.exampleZh: 请保留收据，以备你需要退鞋时使用。

receive.example: I was happy to receive a letter from my old friend today.
receive.exampleZh: 今天收到老朋友的来信，我很高兴。

receiver.example: She picked up the receiver and waited for him to speak.
receiver.exampleZh: 她拿起听筒，等着他开口说话。

recent.example: My recent trip to the mountains was full of fun and surprises.
recent.exampleZh: 我最近的山中之旅充满了乐趣和惊喜。

recently.example: I have been very busy at work recently, so I have little free time.
recently.exampleZh: 我最近工作很忙，所以几乎没有空闲时间。

reception.example: We had a small reception after the wedding with all our friends.
reception.exampleZh: 婚礼结束后，我们和所有朋友举办了一个小型招待会。

reckon.example: I reckon it will rain this afternoon.
reckon.exampleZh: 我估计今天下午会下雨。

recognize.example: I did not recognize him at first because he had changed so much.
recognize.exampleZh: 我一开始没认出他，因为他变化太大了。

recommend.example: I recommend this book to anyone who likes simple stories.
recommend.exampleZh: 我把这本书推荐给任何喜欢简单故事的人。

recommendation.example: My teacher wrote a good recommendation for my college application.
recommendation.exampleZh: 我的老师为我的大学申请写了一封很好的推荐信。

record.example: She kept a record of all the money she spent last month.
record.exampleZh: 她记录了自己上个月花掉的所有钱。

recorder.example: The recorder wrote down everything the teacher said during the meeting.
recorder.exampleZh: 记录员写下了老师在会上说的每一句话。

recover.example: It took him two weeks to recover from the bad cold.
recover.exampleZh: 他花了两周时间才从重感冒中恢复过来。

recovery.example: His recovery after the long illness was slow but steady.
recovery.exampleZh: 他久病之后的康复缓慢但稳定。

red.example: The red coat on the bed is very old.
red.exampleZh: 床上的那件红衣服很旧了。

reduce.example: We must reduce the amount of water we use every day.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们必须减少每天用水量。

reduction.example: The shop offered a small reduction in price for students.
reduction.exampleZh: 这家商店给学生提供了一点价格上的优惠。

refer.example: Please refer to the book if you want more information.
refer.exampleZh: 如果你想了解更多信息，请参考这本书。

reference.example: She gave me a useful reference for my new job.
reference.exampleZh: 她为我的新工作提供了一份有用的推荐信。

reflect.example: The lake reflects the trees and the sky very clearly.
reflect.exampleZh: 湖面非常清晰地映出了树木和天空。

reflection.example: The calm lake gave a clear reflection of the tall trees.
reflection.exampleZh: 平静的湖面清晰地映出了高高的树木。

reform.example: The new leader promised to reform the old tax system quickly.
reform.exampleZh: 新领导人承诺迅速改革旧的税收制度。

refresh.example: A cold drink will refresh you after a long walk in the sun.
refresh.exampleZh: 在太阳下走了很久之后，一杯冷饮会让你恢复精力。

refugee.example: The refugee family arrived at the camp late at night.
refugee.exampleZh: 这个难民家庭在深夜抵达了营地。

refusal.example: His refusal to help surprised everyone in the office.
refusal.exampleZh: 他拒绝帮忙，这让办公室里的每个人都很惊讶。

refuse.example: She refused to eat the food and threw the refuse into the bin.
refuse.exampleZh: 她拒绝吃那些食物，并把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。

regard.example: I regard her as a good friend and often ask for her advice.
regard.exampleZh: 我把她看作好朋友，经常向她请教。

regarding.example: I have a question regarding your homework for tomorrow.
regarding.exampleZh: 关于明天的作业，我有一个问题。

regardless.example: He went out to play football regardless of the heavy rain.
regardless.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，他还是出去踢足球了。

region.example: This region is famous for its fresh fruit and warm weather.
region.exampleZh: 这个地区以新鲜水果和温暖的天气而闻名。

regional.example: This regional food is very popular with people in the south.
regional.exampleZh: 这种地方美食在南方很受人们欢迎。

register.example: Please register your name at the front desk before you enter the hall.
register.exampleZh: 进入大厅前，请在前台登记你的姓名。

regret.example: I regret not saying goodbye to her before she left.
regret.exampleZh: 我后悔在她离开前没有跟她道别。

regular.example: He keeps a regular sleep schedule and goes to bed early.
regular.exampleZh: 他保持规律的睡眠时间，并且早早上床睡觉。

regularly.example: I regularly walk to school with my sister every morning.
regularly.exampleZh: 我每天早上经常和妹妹一起走路去学校。

regulate.example: The government makes new rules to regulate how companies use water.
regulate.exampleZh: 政府制定新规则来管理公司如何使用水。

regulation.example: The school has new regulations about using mobile phones in class.
regulation.exampleZh: 学校制定了关于课堂上使用手机的新规定。

reinforce.example: The teacher used games to reinforce the new words we learned today.
reinforce.exampleZh: 老师用游戏来强化我们今天学的新单词。

reject.example: The manager decided to reject our plan because it cost too much.
reject.exampleZh: 经理决定驳回我们的计划，因为它的成本太高。

relate.example: She likes to relate stories about her childhood to her young students.
relate.exampleZh: 她喜欢向年幼的学生们讲述自己童年的故事。

relation.example: The relation between the two countries has become much better in recent years.
relation.exampleZh: 近年来，这两个国家之间的关系已大大改善。

relationship.example: The relationship between my parents and me is very close and happy.
relationship.exampleZh: 我和父母之间的关系非常亲密、幸福。

relative.example: My relatives came to visit us during the summer holiday.
relative.exampleZh: 暑假期间，我的亲戚们来看望我们。

relatively.example: This test is relatively easy, so most students can finish it quickly.
relatively.exampleZh: 这次考试相对容易，所以大多数学生能很快做完。

relax.example: After work, I like to relax on the sofa and listen to music.
relax.exampleZh: 下班后，我喜欢躺在沙发上听音乐放松一下。

release.example: The band will release a new album next month.
release.exampleZh: 这个乐队下个月将发行一张新专辑。

relevant.example: Please give me all the relevant information about this job.
relevant.exampleZh: 请给我所有关于这份工作的相关信息。

reliability.example: The reliability of this old car is why we kept it.
reliability.exampleZh: 这辆旧车很可靠，所以我们一直留着它。

reliable.example: My old car is not very reliable, so I take the bus.
reliable.exampleZh: 我的旧车不太可靠，所以我坐公交车。

relief.example: The medicine gave her some relief from the pain.
relief.exampleZh: 这药让她的疼痛有所减轻。

relieve.example: The doctor gave him some medicine to relieve the pain in his back.
relieve.exampleZh: 医生给了他一些药来减轻他背部的疼痛。

religion.example: Her religion gives her strength and comfort in difficult times.
religion.exampleZh: 她的宗教信仰在困难时期给了她力量和安慰。

religious.example: My grandmother is very religious and goes to church every Sunday morning.
religious.exampleZh: 我奶奶非常虔诚，每个星期天早上都去教堂。

rely.example: You can rely on him to help you with your work.
rely.exampleZh: 你可以依靠他帮你做你的工作。

remain.example: Few old houses remain in this small town today.
remain.exampleZh: 如今这座小镇上剩下的老房子很少了。

remark.example: Her remark about the weather made everyone at the table laugh.
remark.exampleZh: 她对天气的评论让桌上的每个人都笑了。

remarkable.example: It is remarkable how quickly the small team finished the project.
remarkable.exampleZh: 这个小团队完成项目的速度之快令人惊叹。

remedy.example: The doctor gave him a simple remedy for his cough.
remedy.exampleZh: 医生给了他一个治疗咳嗽的简单方法。

remember.example: Please remember to bring your notebook to class tomorrow morning.
remember.exampleZh: 请记得明天早上把笔记本带到教室。

remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother tomorrow morning.
remind.exampleZh: 请提醒我明天早上给妈妈打电话。

remote.example: He works in a remote village far from the city.
remote.exampleZh: 他在一个远离城市的偏远村庄工作。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you enter the house.

render.example: The doctor's quick action rendered the injury much less serious.
render.exampleZh: 医生的迅速处理使伤势轻了很多。

renew.example: I need to renew my library books before Friday.
renew.exampleZh: 我需要在周五前续借我的图书馆书籍。

rent.example: We pay the rent on the first day of every month.
rent.exampleZh: 我们每个月一号交房租。

repair.example: My father will repair the old radio this afternoon.
repair.exampleZh: 我父亲今天下午会修理那台旧收音机。

repeat.example: Please repeat the question slowly so everyone can understand it.
repeat.exampleZh: 请慢慢重复这个问题，好让每个人都能听懂。

repeatedly.example: She repeatedly asked him to close the door quietly.
repeatedly.exampleZh: 她再三要求他轻轻地关上门。

replace.example: Please replace the old battery with a new one.

reply.example: She did not reply to my email until the next morning.
reply.exampleZh: 直到第二天早上她才回复我的邮件。

report.example: She will report the news to her teacher tomorrow.
report.exampleZh: 她明天会向老师报告这个消息。

reporter.example: The reporter asked the teacher several questions after the school meeting.
reporter.exampleZh: 那名记者在学校会议后向老师问了几个问题。

represent.example: The red rose represents love in many old stories.
represent.exampleZh: 在许多古老的故事中，红玫瑰象征爱情。

representative.example: She is a good representative of our team and speaks for all of us.
representative.exampleZh: 她是我们团队的好代表，为我们所有人发声。

reproduce.example: Some animals can reproduce quickly when there is enough food.
reproduce.exampleZh: 有些动物在食物充足时能迅速繁殖。

republic.example: The people voted to make their country a republic last year.
republic.exampleZh: 去年人们投票决定让他们的国家成为共和国。

reputation.example: This small shop has a good reputation for fresh bread.
reputation.exampleZh: 这家小店因面包新鲜而享有良好声誉。

request.example: The manager agreed to our request for an extra day off.
request.exampleZh: 经理同意了我们要多休一天假的请求。

require.example: This job requires good English and strong computer skills.
require.exampleZh: 这份工作需要良好的英语和较强的电脑技能。

requirement.example: Meeting the basic requirements is necessary before you can apply for this job.
requirement.exampleZh: 在申请这份工作之前，满足基本要求是必要的。

rescue.example: Firefighters rescued the old man from the burning house last night.
rescue.exampleZh: 消防员昨晚从着火的房子里救出了那位老人。

research.example: She did a lot of research before writing her report on climate change.
research.exampleZh: 她在写关于气候变化的报告之前做了大量研究。

researcher.example: The researcher studied how young children learn new words at home.
researcher.exampleZh: 这位研究人员研究了幼儿在家中如何学习新词。

resemble.example: The little boy does resemble his father around the eyes.
resemble.exampleZh: 这个小男孩的眼睛确实像他父亲。

reserve.example: We reserve a table for two every Friday night.
reserve.exampleZh: 我们每周五晚上都预订一张双人桌。

reservoir.example: The city gets its water from a large reservoir in the hills.
reservoir.exampleZh: 这座城市的水来自山中的一座大水库。

residence.example: Their new residence is a small house near the river.
residence.exampleZh: 他们的新住宅是河边的一栋小房子。

resident.example: The new resident next door often helps us take care of the garden.
resident.exampleZh: 隔壁新搬来的居民常常帮我们照看花园。

resign.example: She decided to resign from her job after ten years.
resign.exampleZh: 她决定在工作十年后辞去这份工作。

resist.example: She could not resist the sweet smell of fresh bread.
resist.exampleZh: 她抵挡不住新鲜面包的香甜气味。

resistance.example: The small town showed strong resistance to the plan for a new factory.
resistance.exampleZh: 小镇对新建工厂的计划表现出强烈的抵制。

resistant.example: This new plant is resistant to cold weather and grows well here.
resistant.exampleZh: 这种新植物耐寒，在这里长得很好。

resolve.example: She resolved to study harder after she failed the test.
resolve.exampleZh: 考试失利后，她决心更努力学习。

resort.example: When the problem got worse, he had to resort to asking his teacher for help.
resort.exampleZh: 当问题变得更糟时，他不得不求助他的老师。

resource.example: We must use our limited natural resources wisely and share them fairly.
resource.exampleZh: 我们必须明智地使用有限的自然资源，并公平地分享它们。

respect.example: Students should respect their teachers and follow the school rules every day.
respect.exampleZh: 学生应当尊敬老师，并且每天遵守校规。

respective.example: The students went back to their respective homes after the meeting ended.
respective.exampleZh: 会议结束后，学生们各自回到了自己的家。

respond.example: She did not respond to my email, so I called her.
respond.exampleZh: 她没有回复我的邮件，所以我给她打了电话。

response.example: Her quick response to my email made the whole process much easier.
response.exampleZh: 她对我邮件的快速答复让整个过程轻松了许多。

responsibility.example: It is my responsibility to take care of my younger sister.

responsible.example: She is responsible for the new project and works very hard.
responsible.exampleZh: 她负责这个新项目，工作非常努力。

rest.example: You need to rest after a long day of work.
rest.exampleZh: 工作了一整天之后，你需要休息一下。

restaurant.example: We had dinner at a small Italian restaurant near our hotel.
restaurant.exampleZh: 我们在酒店附近一家小的意大利餐馆吃了晚饭。

restore.example: The workers will restore the old bridge next year.
restore.exampleZh: 工人们明年将修复这座旧桥。

restrain.example: The police tried to restrain the crowd from entering the burning building.
restrain.exampleZh: 警察试图阻止人群进入那栋燃烧的建筑。

restraint.example: She showed great restraint and did not answer him angrily.
restraint.exampleZh: 她表现出极大的克制，没有生气地回应他。

restrict.example: The new rules restrict children from playing outside during school hours.
restrict.exampleZh: 新规定限制孩子们在上课时间到外面玩耍。

result.example: The result of the test was good for all students.
result.exampleZh: 这次考试的结果对所有学生来说都很好。

resume.example: She will resume her work after a short break.
resume.exampleZh: 短暂休息后她将重新开始工作。

retain.example: She still retains many happy memories of her childhood in the small town.
retain.exampleZh: 她仍然保留着许多在那个小镇度过的快乐童年回忆。

retire.example: My father plans to retire from his job next year.
retire.exampleZh: 我父亲计划明年从工作岗位上退休。

retirement.example: After forty years of hard work, he is finally looking forward to retirement.
retirement.exampleZh: 辛苦工作四十年后，他终于盼望着退休生活。

retreat.example: The soldiers had to retreat when the enemy attacked from the hills.
retreat.exampleZh: 当敌人从山上进攻时，士兵们不得不撤退。

return.example: Please return the book to the library before Friday.
return.exampleZh: 请在星期五之前把书还给图书馆。

reunion.example: Our family reunion is a happy time for everyone.
reunion.exampleZh: 我们的家庭团聚对每个人来说都是快乐的时光。

reveal.example: The report reveals how the company lost a large amount of money last year.
reveal.exampleZh: 这份报告揭示了该公司去年如何损失了一大笔钱。

reverse.example: The reverse side of the coin shows a small star.
reverse.exampleZh: 硬币的背面有一颗小星星。

review.example: I need to review my notes before the exam tomorrow.
review.exampleZh: 我需要在明天考试前复习我的笔记。

revise.example: I need to revise my essay before I give it to the teacher.
revise.exampleZh: 在把文章交给老师之前，我需要修改一下。

revolution.example: The invention of the internet caused a revolution in how people communicate.
revolution.exampleZh: 互联网的发明引发了人们沟通方式的一场革命。

revolutionary.example: The revolutionary idea changed how people travel to work.
revolutionary.exampleZh: 这个革新的想法改变了人们上班出行的方式。

revolve.example: The moon revolves around the Earth once every month.
revolve.exampleZh: 月球每个月绕地球转一圈。

reward.example: She got a small reward for helping the old man find his way home.
reward.exampleZh: 她因为帮助那位老人找到回家的路而得到了一份小小的奖励。

rhythm.example: I love the steady rhythm of the drums in this song.
rhythm.exampleZh: 我喜欢这首歌里稳定有力的鼓点节奏。

rib.example: He broke a rib while playing football last week.
rib.exampleZh: 他上周踢足球时摔断了一根肋骨。

ribbon.example: She tied a red ribbon around the box of cookies.
ribbon.exampleZh: 她用一条红色缎带把饼干盒系了起来。

rice.example: We eat rice with vegetables and fish every day.
rice.exampleZh: 我们每天吃米饭配蔬菜和鱼。

rich.example: The rich man owns a big house, a new car and many beautiful gardens.
rich.exampleZh: 这个富有的男人拥有一栋大房子、一辆新车和许多美丽的花园。

rid.example: We must rid the house of rats before winter comes.
rid.exampleZh: 我们必须在冬天来临前把屋子里的老鼠清除掉。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every day because it is faster.
ride.exampleZh: 我每天骑自行车上学，因为这样更快。

ridge.example: We walked along the narrow ridge and saw the whole valley below.
ridge.exampleZh: 我们沿着狭窄的山脊行走，看到了下方的整个山谷。

ridiculous.example: It is ridiculous to wear a coat on such a hot day.
ridiculous.exampleZh: 在这么热的天穿大衣真是荒谬。

rifle.example: The soldier cleaned his rifle carefully before the long march began.
rifle.exampleZh: 士兵在长途行军开始前仔细擦拭他的步枪。

right.example: You are right, and I should correct my mistake right now.
right.exampleZh: 你是对的，我现在就应该纠正我的错误。

rigid.example: The rules of this old school are too rigid for young students.
rigid.exampleZh: 这所老学校的规矩对年轻学生来说太死板了。

ring.example: She wears a gold ring and often rings me after work.
ring.exampleZh: 她戴着一枚金戒指，下班后常给我打电话。

riot.example: The riot started after the game and spread quickly through the streets.
riot.exampleZh: 比赛结束后爆发了骚乱，并迅速蔓延到街头。

rip.example: The strong wind will rip the old flag into small pieces.
rip.exampleZh: 强风会把那面旧旗撕成小块。

rise.example: The sun rises early in summer and the temperature goes up.
rise.exampleZh: 夏天太阳升得早，气温也随之上升。

risk.example: Smoking can increase the risk of serious heart disease.
risk.exampleZh: 吸烟会增加患严重心脏病的风险。

river.example: The river is very wide and many boats go up and down it every day.
river.exampleZh: 这条河很宽，每天都有许多船只在上面来往。

road.example: The road to the small village is narrow but very quiet.
road.exampleZh: 通往那个小村庄的路很窄，但非常安静。

roar.example: The lion began to roar loudly when it saw the strangers.
roar.exampleZh: 狮子看到陌生人时开始大声吼叫。

roast.example: My mother will roast a chicken with potatoes for our family dinner.
roast.exampleZh: 我妈妈会为我们家的晚餐烤一只鸡和土豆。

rob.example: Two men tried to rob the small bank near my house yesterday.
rob.exampleZh: 昨天两名男子试图抢劫我家附近的那家小银行。

robot.example: This robot can clean the floor and wash the dishes for us.
robot.exampleZh: 这个机器人能为我们扫地、洗碗。

rock.example: The children like to rock the small boat on the calm water.
rock.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在平静的水面上摇晃那条小船。

rod.example: He used a long rod to reach the ball under the bed.
rod.exampleZh: 他用一根长杆够到了床底下的球。

role.example: Teachers play an important role in the lives of their students.
role.exampleZh: 老师在学生的生活中扮演着重要的角色。

roll.example: The ball rolled down the hill and stopped near the old tree.
roll.exampleZh: 球滚下山坡，停在那棵老树附近。

romantic.example: She likes romantic movies about love and happy endings.
romantic.exampleZh: 她喜欢关于爱情和美好结局的浪漫电影。

roof.example: The cat sat on the roof and looked at the birds.
roof.exampleZh: 猫坐在屋顶上看着鸟儿。

room.example: There is not enough room in this small car for all of us.
room.exampleZh: 这辆小车里没有足够的空间容纳我们所有人。

root.example: The tree has deep roots and grows well in this soil.
root.exampleZh: 这棵树根很深，在这片土壤里长得很好。

rope.example: He tied the boat to the tree with a strong rope.
rope.exampleZh: 他用一根结实的绳子把船拴在树上。

rose.example: He gave her a red rose on her birthday last week.
rose.exampleZh: 上周她生日时，他送了她一朵红玫瑰。

rotate.example: We rotate the tires on our car every year to keep them safe.
rotate.exampleZh: 我们每年轮换汽车的轮胎，以保证它们安全。

rough.example: The road is rough and hard to walk on.
rough.exampleZh: 这条路很粗糙，走起来很难。

round.example: The children sat round the table and shared a round cake.
round.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在桌旁，分享一个圆蛋糕。

rouse.example: The loud noise will rouse him from a deep sleep.
rouse.exampleZh: 那声巨响会把他从熟睡中唤醒。

route.example: The bus route from my home to school takes about twenty minutes.
route.exampleZh: 从我家到学校的公交路线大约需要二十分钟。

routine.example: My morning routine helps me start every day in a calm way.
routine.exampleZh: 我的早晨例行公事帮助我每天平静地开始新的一天。

row.example: There is a row of books on the desk, and the children row the boat.
row.exampleZh: 桌上有一排书，孩子们在划船。

royal.example: The royal family lives in a big palace in the city.
royal.exampleZh: 王室成员住在这座城市的一座大宫殿里。

rub.example: She likes to rub her hands together when she feels cold.
rub.exampleZh: 她感到冷的时候喜欢搓手。

rubber.example: These boots are made of rubber and are very good for wet weather.
rubber.exampleZh: 这双靴子是橡胶做的，在潮湿天气里非常实用。

rude.example: It is rude to talk loudly on the phone in a quiet room.
rude.exampleZh: 在安静的房间里大声打电话是不礼貌的。

ruin.example: The heavy rain could ruin our trip to the beach tomorrow.
ruin.exampleZh: 大雨可能会毁掉我们明天的海滩之旅。

rule.example: Every player must follow the rules of the game.
rule.exampleZh: 每位玩家都必须遵守游戏规则。

ruler.example: The ruler of the small country built a new school for children.
ruler.exampleZh: 这个小国的统治者给孩子们建了一所新学校。

run.example: She likes to run in the park every morning before breakfast.
run.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早晨早饭前去公园跑步。

rural.example: Life in rural areas is often quieter and slower than in big cities.
rural.exampleZh: 农村地区的生活往往比大城市更安静、更缓慢。

rush.example: I rush to the bus stop every morning before work.
rush.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都匆忙赶到公交车站。

rust.example: The old bike was left outside for years, so rust covered the wheels.
rust.exampleZh: 那辆旧自行车在外面放了很多年，所以车轮上生满了锈。

sabotage.example: The workers were accused of sabotage after the machines stopped working.
sabotage.exampleZh: 机器停止运转后，工人们被指控蓄意破坏。

sack.example: They put the fresh apples in a large sack and carried it home.
sack.exampleZh: 他们把新鲜的苹果装进一个大麻袋里，然后把它搬回了家。

sacred.example: The old temple is a sacred place for many people.
sacred.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙对许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

sacrifice.example: She made a big sacrifice to help her family.
sacrifice.exampleZh: 为了帮助家人，她做出了很大的牺牲。

saddle.example: He put the saddle on the horse and then rode away.
saddle.exampleZh: 他给马装上马鞍，然后骑马走了。

safe.example: Keep your money in a safe place at home.
safe.exampleZh: 把您的钱放在家里安全的地方。

safeguard.example: The new law is a safeguard for workers' rights and safety.
safeguard.exampleZh: 这项新法律是对工人权利和安全的保障。

sail.example: Every morning the old boat sets sail for the small island across the bay.
sail.exampleZh: 每天早晨，这条旧船扬帆驶向海湾对面的小岛。

sailor.example: The sailor tied the boat to the dock before the storm came.
sailor.exampleZh: 水手在暴风雨来临前把小船拴在码头上。

saint.example: She is a saint who helps poor children every day.
saint.exampleZh: 她是一位圣人，每天帮助穷苦的孩子。

sake.example: He moved to the countryside for the sake of his health.
sake.exampleZh: 为了健康，他搬到了乡下。

salad.example: I like to eat a fresh salad with tomatoes for lunch.
salad.exampleZh: 午餐时我喜欢吃配有西红柿的新鲜色拉。

salary.example: He saves part of his salary every month for a new car.
salary.exampleZh: 他每个月都存下一部分薪水，用来买一辆新车。

sale.example: The shop is having a big sale on all winter clothes this week.
sale.exampleZh: 这家商店本周所有冬装大减价。

salt.example: Please add a little salt to the soup before you serve it.
salt.exampleZh: 上汤之前请往汤里加一点盐。

same.example: My brother and I wear the same size shoes.
same.exampleZh: 我和我弟弟穿同样尺码的鞋。

sample.example: The doctor took a small sample of my blood for the test.
sample.exampleZh: 医生取了我一小份血样用于化验。

sanction.example: The government decided to sanction the company for breaking the trade rules.
sanction.exampleZh: 政府决定因违反贸易规则而对该公司实施制裁。

sandwich.example: I put a cheese sandwich and an apple in my bag.
sandwich.exampleZh: 我在包里放了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果。

sandy.example: The beach near our hotel is long and sandy, and the children love playing there.
sandy.exampleZh: 我们酒店附近的海滩又长又多沙，孩子们很喜欢在那里玩。

sarcastic.example: He gave a sarcastic answer that made everyone at the table laugh.
sarcastic.exampleZh: 他给了一个讽刺的回答，让桌边所有人都笑了。

satellite.example: The satellite sends pictures of Earth back to scientists every day.
satellite.exampleZh: 这颗卫星每天把地球的照片传回给科学家。

satisfaction.example: Her face showed great satisfaction after she finished the hard work.
satisfaction.exampleZh: 完成那项艰苦的工作后，她脸上露出了极大的满足感。

satisfy.example: The new plan should satisfy all the students in our class.
satisfy.exampleZh: 这个新计划应该能满足我们班所有学生的要求。

saturate.example: Heavy rain began to saturate the dry soil in the garden.
saturate.exampleZh: 大雨开始浸透花园里干燥的土壤。

saturday.example: I often go to the library with my friends on Saturday morning.
saturday.exampleZh: 我经常在星期六上午和朋友们去图书馆。

sauce.example: She put some tomato sauce on her pasta and ate it quickly.
sauce.exampleZh: 她在意大利面上放了些番茄酱，然后很快吃完了。

sausage.example: I had two eggs and a sausage for breakfast this morning.
sausage.exampleZh: 今天早上我吃了两个鸡蛋和一根香肠。

savage.example: The savage dog barked loudly at the stranger near the gate.
savage.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗在门边对着陌生人大声吠叫。

saving.example: Her monthly saving helped the family pay for a new car.
saving.exampleZh: 她每月的储蓄帮助家里买了一辆新车。

saw.example: I used a saw to cut the old tree into small pieces.
saw.exampleZh: 我用锯子把那棵老树锯成了小块。

say.example: She likes to say what she thinks, but she also listens to others.
say.exampleZh: 她喜欢说出自己的想法，但也会倾听别人。

scale.example: The fish has small scales, and we scale it before cooking.
scale.exampleZh: 这条鱼有细小的鳞，我们在烹饪前刮掉鱼鳞。

scan.example: She scanned the letter quickly to find her name.
scan.exampleZh: 她快速浏览了这封信，想找到自己的名字。

scandal.example: The scandal damaged the mayor's reputation and forced him to leave office.
scandal.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻损害了市长的声誉，迫使他离职。

scar.example: The old scar on his arm still hurts when it rains.
scar.exampleZh: 他手臂上的旧伤疤下雨时还会疼。

scarce.example: Clean water is scarce in many parts of the world.
scarce.exampleZh: 世界上许多地方都缺乏干净的水。

scarcely.example: I could scarcely see the road in the heavy rain.
scarcely.exampleZh: 下大雨时我几乎看不清路。

scare.example: The loud noise scared the little boy and he started to cry loudly.
scare.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音吓到了小男孩，他开始大声哭起来。

scarf.example: She wears a warm scarf around her neck in winter.
scarf.exampleZh: 冬天她脖子上围着一条暖和的围巾。

scatter.example: The wind helped scatter the seeds across the empty field.
scatter.exampleZh: 风把种子吹散到空旷的田野上。

scenario.example: We need a plan for every possible scenario.
scenario.exampleZh: 我们需要为每一种可能的情况都制定一个方案。

scene.example: The police arrived at the scene of the accident very quickly.
scene.exampleZh: 警察很快到达了事故现场。

scent.example: The dog followed the scent of the rabbit across the field.
scent.exampleZh: 那只狗循着兔子的气味穿过田野。

schedule.example: My work schedule is very busy this week.
schedule.exampleZh: 我这周的工作日程安排很满。

scheme.example: The company has a new scheme to help young people find jobs.
scheme.exampleZh: 这家公司有一个帮助年轻人找工作的新方案。

scholar.example: The old scholar wrote many books about ancient Chinese history.
scholar.exampleZh: 这位老学者写了许多关于中国古代历史的书。

scholarship.example: She won a scholarship to study music at a big university.
scholarship.exampleZh: 她获得了一份奖学金，去一所大型大学学习音乐。

science.example: Science helps us understand the world and make better choices every day.
science.exampleZh: 科学帮助我们理解世界，并每天做出更好的选择。

science-fiction.example: My brother loves science-fiction and reads a new book every week.
science-fiction.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢科幻小说，每周都读一本新书。

scientific.example: Scientific research needs careful records and simple, clear questions.
scientific.exampleZh: 科学研究需要细致的记录和简单清晰的问题。

scissors.example: Please pass me the scissors so I can cut this paper.
scissors.exampleZh: 请把剪刀递给我，我要剪这张纸。

scold.example: My mother scolded me for coming home late last night.
scold.exampleZh: 昨晚我回家晚了，妈妈责骂了我。

scope.example: This job gives you scope to learn new skills.
scope.exampleZh: 这份工作给了你学习新技能的机会。

score.example: She got a high score on her math test last week.
score.exampleZh: 她上周的数学考试得了高分。

scorn.example: She looked at his cheap gift with scorn and walked away.
scorn.exampleZh: 她轻蔑地看了一眼他那廉价的礼物，然后走开了。

scout.example: The scout looked for a safe path through the forest.
scout.exampleZh: 侦察员在森林中寻找一条安全的路径。

scrap.example: He wrote the phone number on a scrap of paper.
scrap.exampleZh: 他把电话号码写在一小片纸上。

scrape.example: He fell off his bike and scraped his knee on the road.
scrape.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，膝盖在路面上擦伤了。

scratch.example: The cat likes to scratch the old sofa with its sharp claws.
scratch.exampleZh: 这只猫喜欢用锋利的爪子抓那张旧沙发。

scream.example: She screamed when she saw the snake in the garden.
scream.exampleZh: 她在花园里看到那条蛇时尖叫了起来。

screen.example: The nurse used a screen to block the light from the patient's bed.
screen.exampleZh: 护士用一扇屏风挡住病人床边的光。

screw.example: Please use a screw to fix the shelf to the wall.
screw.exampleZh: 请用一颗螺丝把架子固定在墙上。

script.example: The writer finished the script for the new film last night.
script.exampleZh: 这位作家昨晚完成了这部新电影的剧本。

scrutiny.example: The plan is under close scrutiny by the city council.
scrutiny.exampleZh: 该计划正受到市议会的仔细审查。

sea.example: The sea is very blue and calm today.
sea.exampleZh: 今天的大海非常蓝，也很平静。

seal.example: The worker used a seal to close the box tightly before shipping.
seal.exampleZh: 工人在发货前用封条把箱子紧紧封好。

seam.example: The tailor sewed the seam of my jacket very carefully.
seam.exampleZh: 裁缝非常仔细地缝了我夹克的接缝。

search.example: I often search for information on the internet before I buy something.
search.exampleZh: 我买东西前经常在网上搜索信息。

season.example: We add salt and pepper to season the soup in winter.
season.exampleZh: 冬天我们加盐和胡椒给汤调味。

seat.example: Please take your seat before the show starts.

second.example: This is my second time here, so please wait a second.
second.exampleZh: 这是我第二次来这里，所以请稍等片刻。

secondary.example: This is a secondary school, and it is not the main one.
secondary.exampleZh: 这是一所中学，它不是主要的那一所。

secret.example: She told me a secret about her birthday party plans.
secret.exampleZh: 她告诉了我一个关于她生日派对计划的秘密。

secretary.example: The secretary answered the phone and wrote down the message for her boss.
secretary.exampleZh: 秘书接了电话，并给她的老板写下了留言。

section.example: The first section of the book is easy to read.
section.exampleZh: 这本书的第一部分很容易读。

sector.example: The service sector creates many new jobs in big cities.
sector.exampleZh: 服务业在大城市创造了许多新工作岗位。

secure.example: Please keep your passport in a secure place at home.
secure.exampleZh: 请把护照放在家里安全的地方。

security.example: The bank uses cameras and guards to keep your money safe and provide good security.
security.exampleZh: 银行用摄像头和保安来保护你的钱安全，并提供良好的安全保障。

see.example: I can see the tall trees from my window.
see.exampleZh: 我从窗户能看到那些高大的树。

seed.example: She planted a small seed in the wet garden soil.
seed.exampleZh: 她在潮湿的花园土壤里种下了一颗小种子。

seek.example: She went to the city to seek a better job.
seek.exampleZh: 她去城里寻找一份更好的工作。

seem.example: You seem very tired today, so please go home and rest.
seem.exampleZh: 你今天似乎很累，所以请回家休息吧。

segment.example: Cut the orange into four segments and share them with your friends.
segment.exampleZh: 把橙子切成四瓣，和你的朋友们一起分享。

seize.example: The police seized the bag and took the man to jail.
seize.exampleZh: 警察没收了那个包，并把那名男子送进了监狱。

seldom.example: She seldom drinks coffee at night because it keeps her awake.
seldom.exampleZh: 她很少在晚上喝咖啡，因为咖啡会让她睡不着。

select.example: Please select one book from the list for your class.
select.exampleZh: 请从书单中为你的班级挑选一本书。

selection.example: She made a careful selection of books for the long trip.
selection.exampleZh: 她为长途旅行精心挑选了一些书。

self.example: He is slowly learning to accept his true self.
self.exampleZh: 他正在慢慢学着接受真实的自己。

selfish.example: He is too selfish to share his toys with other children.
selfish.exampleZh: 他太自私了，不肯把玩具分给别的孩子。

sell.example: They sell fresh fruit and vegetables at the small shop near my home.
sell.exampleZh: 他们在我家附近的小店里卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

semester.example: I will take four classes this semester and study hard every day.
semester.exampleZh: 这个学期我将上四门课，并且每天努力学习。

semiconductor.example: This small semiconductor helps the computer run faster and use less power.
semiconductor.exampleZh: 这种小型半导体帮助电脑运行得更快，并减少用电。

seminar.example: I attended a seminar on climate change at my university last week.
seminar.exampleZh: 上周我在大学参加了一场关于气候变化的研讨会。

senate.example: The senate voted on the new law yesterday and most people agreed with it.
senate.exampleZh: 参议院昨天对这项新法律进行了投票，大多数人都表示赞同。

senator.example: The senator spoke to the crowd about the new school plan.
senator.exampleZh: 这位参议员向人群讲述了这个新建学校的计划。

send.example: I will send this letter to my mother tomorrow morning.
send.exampleZh: 我明天早上会把信寄给我的母亲。

senior.example: My senior colleague helps new staff learn the job quickly.
senior.exampleZh: 我那位资深的同事帮助新员工快速学会这项工作。

sensation.example: The news caused a great sensation among the people in the small town.
sensation.exampleZh: 这条新闻在小镇居民中引起了极大的轰动。

sense.example: Dogs have a very good sense of smell and can find missing people.
sense.exampleZh: 狗有非常灵敏的嗅觉，能找到失踪的人。

sensible.example: It is sensible to take an umbrella when the sky looks dark.
sensible.exampleZh: 天色暗下来时，带把伞是明智的。

sensitive.example: She is very sensitive to cold weather and always wears a warm coat.
sensitive.exampleZh: 她对寒冷的天气很敏感，总是穿着暖和的外套。

sentence.example: The judge gave him a light sentence and he went home.
sentence.exampleZh: 法官判了他轻刑，然后他就回家了。

sentiment.example: She shared her true sentiment about the plan with the whole team.
sentiment.exampleZh: 她向整个团队分享了她对这个计划的真实看法。

separate.example: Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones before washing.
separate.exampleZh: 洗衣服前请把白色衣物和彩色衣物分开。

sequence.example: Please put these photos in the right sequence.
sequence.exampleZh: 请把这些照片按正确的顺序排列。

series.example: This book is the first in a new series about animals.
series.exampleZh: 这本书是关于动物的新系列中的第一本。

serious.example: This is a serious problem, so we must talk about it carefully.
serious.exampleZh: 这是一个严重的问题，所以我们必须仔细讨论它。

servant.example: The old servant opened the door and welcomed the guests into the warm house.
servant.exampleZh: 那位老仆人打开门，把客人们迎进温暖的屋子里。

serve.example: This small café serves good coffee to students every morning.
serve.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆每天早上为学生供应好咖啡。

service.example: The bus service to the airport runs every thirty minutes.
service.exampleZh: 开往机场的巴士服务每三十分钟一班。

session.example: The morning session of the meeting lasted about two hours.
session.exampleZh: 上午的会议部分持续了大约两个小时。

set.example: Please set the cups on the table before the guests arrive.
set.exampleZh: 请在客人到达前把杯子摆到桌上。

setting.example: The old castle is a perfect setting for a scary movie.
setting.exampleZh: 这座古堡是恐怖电影的绝佳背景。

settle.example: They decided to settle in a small town near the river.
settle.exampleZh: 他们决定在河边的一个小镇定居。

settlement.example: After long talks, the two sides reached a peaceful settlement of the problem.
settlement.exampleZh: 经过长时间的谈判，双方和平解决了这个问题。

seven.example: There are seven days in a week.

several.example: Several students in our class joined the school football team this year.
several.exampleZh: 我们班有几个学生今年加入了学校足球队。

severe.example: The storm was severe and many trees fell down in the wind.
severe.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨非常猛烈，许多树被风吹倒了。

sew.example: My mother taught me how to sew a button onto a shirt.
sew.exampleZh: 我妈妈教我怎么把扣子缝到衬衫上。

sex.example: Please write your name, age and sex on the form.
sex.exampleZh: 请在表格上填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

shabby.example: The old man wore a shabby coat and walked slowly down the street.
shabby.exampleZh: 那位老人穿着一件破旧的外套，慢慢走在街上。

shade.example: The old tree gives cool shade on hot summer days.
shade.exampleZh: 那棵老树在炎热的夏日里提供凉爽的阴凉处。

shadow.example: The little boy laughed at his shadow on the wall.
shadow.exampleZh: 那个小男孩看着墙上的影子笑了。

shake.example: She gave the bottle a good shake and then opened it.
shake.exampleZh: 她用力摇了摇瓶子，然后打开了它。

shall.example: You shall finish your homework before you go out to play.
shall.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业，然后才能出去玩。

shallow.example: The river is shallow here, so the children can walk across it.
shallow.exampleZh: 这条河在这里很浅，所以孩子们可以走过去。

shame.example: It is a shame that he never said sorry for his mistake.
shame.exampleZh: 他从未为自己的错误道歉，真是件遗憾的事。

shape.example: The old table has an unusual shape and is hard to move.
shape.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子的形状很特别，搬起来很费劲。

share.example: We all share the food and the work at home.
share.exampleZh: 我们在家里分享食物，也分担家务。

sharp.example: Be careful with that sharp knife; it cuts meat very quickly.
sharp.exampleZh: 小心那把锋利的刀，它切肉非常快。

shatter.example: The loud noise shattered the quiet morning and shocked everyone in the house.
shatter.exampleZh: 巨大的声响打破了清晨的宁静，震惊了屋里的每个人。

she.example: She lives with her family in a small house near the river.
she.exampleZh: 她和家人住在河边的一所小房子里。

shear.example: Farmers shear their sheep every spring before the weather gets too hot.
shear.exampleZh: 农民每年春天在天气变得太热之前剪羊毛。

shed.example: The old tree sheds its leaves in autumn, and the farmer keeps his tools in a shed.
shed.exampleZh: 老树在秋天落叶，农夫把工具存放在棚子里。

sheep.example: The farmer keeps many sheep on his small farm.
sheep.exampleZh: 这位农民在他的小农场里养了许多绵羊。

sheer.example: It was sheer luck that we found the small house.
sheer.exampleZh: 我们找到那所小房子纯属运气。

sheet.example: She put a clean sheet on the bed before the guests arrived.
sheet.exampleZh: 客人到来之前，她在床上铺了一条干净的被单。

shelf.example: Please put the books back on the top shelf.
shelf.exampleZh: 请把书放回最上层的架子上。

shell.example: The child found a small shell on the beach and put it in his pocket.
shell.exampleZh: 孩子在沙滩上发现了一个小贝壳，把它放进了口袋里。

shelter.example: The old church became a shelter for families during the storm.
shelter.exampleZh: 暴风雨期间，这座古老的教堂成了家庭的避难所。

shield.example: He used a large shield to protect himself from the falling rocks.
shield.exampleZh: 他用一块大盾牌保护自己免受落石伤害。

shift.example: She had to shift her plans and work the night shift instead.
shift.exampleZh: 她不得不改变计划，改为上夜班。

shine.example: The sun begins to shine brightly on the quiet lake every morning.
shine.exampleZh: 每天早晨，太阳开始明亮地照耀着平静的湖面。

ship.example: The ship carries food and water to the small island every week.
ship.exampleZh: 这艘船每周向这个小岛运送食物和水。

shirt.example: He wears a clean white shirt to work every day.
shirt.exampleZh: 他每天穿一件干净的白衬衫去上班。

shiver.example: She began to shiver in the cold wind and pulled her coat tight.
shiver.exampleZh: 她在寒风中开始发抖，把外套裹紧了。

shock.example: The sudden news of the accident gave everyone a great shock.
shock.exampleZh: 事故的突然消息让每个人都大为震惊。

shoe.example: I put on my shoes before I leave the house.

shoot.example: He likes to shoot the ball into the basket after school every day.
shoot.exampleZh: 他每天放学后都喜欢把球投进篮筐。

shop.example: I often shop at the small store near my home with my sister.
shop.exampleZh: 我经常和妹妹在我家附近的那家小商店购物。

shore.example: We walked along the shore and watched the small boats.
shore.exampleZh: 我们沿着岸边散步，看着那些小船。

short.example: The red pen is short, so it does not reach the bottom.
short.exampleZh: 这支红笔很短，所以够不到底部。

shortage.example: There is a serious shortage of clean water in this small village.
shortage.exampleZh: 这个小村庄严重缺乏干净的饮用水。

shortly.example: The bus will arrive shortly, so please wait here.
shortly.exampleZh: 公交车很快就会到，请在这里等候。

shot.example: He took a shot from the corner and scored.
shot.exampleZh: 他在角落投篮命中得分。

should.example: You should see a doctor if the pain gets worse.
should.exampleZh: 如果疼痛加重，你应该去看医生。

shoulder.example: She carried the heavy bag on her shoulder and walked home.
shoulder.exampleZh: 她把沉重的包扛在肩上走回家。

shout.example: He had to shout to be heard over the noise.
shout.exampleZh: 他不得不大声喊叫才能在噪音中被听见。

shove.example: He shoved his clothes into the bag and ran out.
shove.exampleZh: 他把衣服塞进包里就跑了出去。

show.example: Please show me the photos from your trip last week.
show.exampleZh: 请给我看看你上周旅行时拍的照片。

shower.example: I take a quick shower every morning before I go to work.
shower.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会快速冲个澡。

shrink.example: The wool sweater may shrink if you wash it in hot water.
shrink.exampleZh: 这件羊毛衫如果用热水洗可能会缩水。

shrug.example: She shrugged her shoulders and said nothing about the question.
shrug.exampleZh: 她耸了耸肩，对这个问题什么也没说。

shut.example: Please shut the door quietly because the baby is sleeping now.
shut.exampleZh: 请轻轻地关上门，因为宝宝现在在睡觉。

shutter.example: He closed the shutters before the sun got too hot.
shutter.exampleZh: 太阳变得太热之前，他关上了百叶窗。

shuttle.example: The shuttle takes passengers from the airport to the city center every hour.
shuttle.exampleZh: 穿梭巴士每小时把乘客从机场送到市中心。

sick.example: I felt sick after lunch, so I stayed home from school today.
sick.exampleZh: 午饭后我觉得恶心，所以今天留在家里没去上学。

side.example: She sat on the left side of the table and smiled.
side.exampleZh: 她坐在桌子的左边，微笑着。

sideways.example: He turned his head sideways to look at the painting on the wall.
sideways.exampleZh: 他把头转向侧面，去看墙上的那幅画。

siege.example: The old city was under siege for three long months.
siege.exampleZh: 这座古城被围困了漫长的三个月。

sigh.example: She gave a deep sigh and closed the old book.
sigh.exampleZh: 她深深叹了口气，合上了那本旧书。

sight.example: The old man lost his sight, but he still knows the city well.
sight.exampleZh: 那位老人失明了，但他仍然很熟悉这座城市。

sightseeing.example: We spent the whole afternoon sightseeing around the old city.
sightseeing.exampleZh: 我们用了一整个下午在老城区观光。

sign.example: Please sign your name at the bottom of the page.
sign.exampleZh: 请在页面底部签上你的名字。

signal.example: He gave me a signal to start the car and drive away.
signal.exampleZh: 他给我一个信号，让我发动汽车开走。

signature.example: Please write your signature at the bottom of this form.
signature.exampleZh: 请在这份表格的底部写上你的签名。

significance.example: The teacher explained the significance of the old letter to her students.
significance.exampleZh: 老师向学生们解释了这封旧信的重要意义。

significant.example: This is a significant change for our small town.
significant.exampleZh: 这对我们的小镇来说是一个重大的变化。

silence.example: The teacher asked for silence so the students could hear the soft music.
silence.exampleZh: 老师要求大家安静，好让学生们能听到轻柔的音乐。

silent.example: The old library was silent except for the sound of turning pages.
silent.exampleZh: 老图书馆里很安静，只有翻书的声音。

silicon.example: Silicon is used to make computer chips and many other electronic parts.
silicon.exampleZh: 硅被用来制造电脑芯片和许多其他电子部件。

silly.example: It was silly of me to forget my umbrella on a rainy day.
silly.exampleZh: 下雨天忘了带伞，我真是糊涂。

silver.example: She wore a silver ring on her finger and a silver necklace.
silver.exampleZh: 她的手指上戴着一枚银戒指，还戴着一条银项链。

similar.example: My sister and I have similar hair and eyes.
similar.exampleZh: 我妹妹和我有相似的头发和眼睛。

similarity.example: There is a strong similarity between the two sisters' voices.
similarity.exampleZh: 这两个姐妹的声音之间有很大的相似之处。

simple.example: The answer is simple, so even young children can understand it.
simple.exampleZh: 这个答案很简单，连小孩子都能听懂。

simplicity.example: The simplicity of her design makes the room feel calm and bright.
simplicity.exampleZh: 她设计的简洁让房间显得平静而明亮。

simplify.example: We can simplify the plan by removing the last two steps.
simplify.exampleZh: 我们可以通过去掉最后两个步骤来简化这个计划。

simply.example: You can simply ask him for help if you need it.
simply.exampleZh: 如果你需要帮助，直接问他就行了。

simulate.example: Scientists use computers to simulate the weather and predict coming storms.
simulate.exampleZh: 科学家用计算机模拟天气并预测即将到来的风暴。

simultaneous.example: The two events were simultaneous, so we watched both on different screens.
simultaneous.exampleZh: 这两个事件是同时发生的，所以我们在不同的屏幕上同时观看。

sin.example: In the story, he says sorry for his sin.
sin.exampleZh: 在故事中，他为自己的罪过表示道歉。

since.example: I have not seen him since he moved to another city last year.
since.exampleZh: 自从他去年搬到另一个城市后，我就没见过他了。

sincere.example: Her sincere words made everyone in the room feel calm and happy.
sincere.exampleZh: 她真诚的话语让房间里的每个人都感到平静和快乐。

sing.example: She likes to sing in the classroom every morning.
sing.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上在教室里唱歌。

singe.example: Be careful with the iron, or you will singe your new shirt.
singe.exampleZh: 小心熨斗，不然你会把新衬衫烫焦。

single.example: I bought a single ticket and traveled alone to the small town.
single.exampleZh: 我买了一张单程票，独自一人去了那个小镇。

singular.example: The word children is plural, but child is singular and takes a different verb.
singular.exampleZh: children 这个词是复数，而 child 是单数，并且搭配不同的动词。

sink.example: The old boat began to sink slowly in the cold water.
sink.exampleZh: 那条旧船在冷水中开始慢慢下沉。

sir.example: Excuse me, sir, could you please tell me where the train station is?
sir.exampleZh: 打扰一下，先生，请问火车站在哪里？

sister.example: My sister and I walk to school together every morning.
sister.exampleZh: 我姐姐和我每天早上一起走路去学校。

sit.example: Please sit down and wait for your name to be called.
sit.exampleZh: 请坐下，等候叫到你的名字。

site.example: The old church is built on the site of a Roman village.
site.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建在一个罗马村庄的遗址上。

situation.example: The situation in the small town is getting better this year.
situation.exampleZh: 这个小镇今年的情况正在好转。

six.example: My little sister is six years old and she starts school this year.
six.exampleZh: 我妹妹六岁，今年开始上学。

size.example: What size shoes do you usually wear when you go running?
size.exampleZh: 你去跑步时通常穿多大尺码的鞋？

skate.example: She got a new pair of skates and went skating with her friends.
skate.exampleZh: 她得到了一双新溜冰鞋，然后和朋友们去滑冰了。

skeptical.example: She is skeptical about the plan because it sounds too good.
skeptical.exampleZh: 她对这个计划持怀疑态度，因为它听起来太好了。

sketch.example: He drew a quick sketch of the house before building it.
sketch.exampleZh: 他在建造房子之前画了一张房子的草图。

ski.example: We go to the mountains every winter to ski with our friends.
ski.exampleZh: 我们每年冬天都和朋友们去山里滑雪。

skilful.example: She is a skilful driver and handles the car well in heavy traffic.
skilful.exampleZh: 她是个娴熟的司机，在拥堵的车流中也能把车开得很好。

skill.example: Learning a new skill takes time and a lot of practice.
skill.exampleZh: 学习一项新技能需要时间和大量的练习。

skilled.example: He is a skilled worker and can fix many kinds of machines.
skilled.exampleZh: 他是一名熟练的工人，能修理多种机器。

skim.example: She skimmed the article quickly before the meeting began.
skim.exampleZh: 会议开始前，她快速略读了那篇文章。

skin.example: Be careful with that sharp knife, or you may cut your skin.
skin.exampleZh: 小心那把锋利的刀，否则你可能会割伤皮肤。

skirt.example: The road skirts the edge of the lake and leads to a small village.
skirt.exampleZh: 这条路沿着湖边绕行，通向一个小村庄。

sky.example: The sky is blue and clear today.

slam.example: She slammed the door when she heard the bad news.
slam.exampleZh: 她听到坏消息时砰地关上了门。

slap.example: She slapped him lightly on the arm and laughed.
slap.exampleZh: 她轻轻拍了一下他的手臂，笑了起来。

slave.example: The old man worked like a slave to feed his family.
slave.exampleZh: 那位老人像奴隶一样辛苦劳作来养活家人。

sleep.example: I try to sleep eight hours every night before work.
sleep.exampleZh: 我尽量每晚在工作前睡八个小时。

sleeve.example: He rolled up his sleeve and washed his hands in the cold water.
sleeve.exampleZh: 他卷起袖子，用冷水洗了洗手。

slender.example: The tall girl has a slender figure and long dark hair.
slender.exampleZh: 那个高个子女孩身材苗条，留着乌黑的长发。

slice.example: She cut the cake into a thin slice for each child.
slice.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕切成薄片，分给每个孩子一片。

slide.example: The children love to slide down the big slide in the park.
slide.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢从公园的大滑梯上滑下来。

slight.example: She felt slight pain in her knee after the long walk.
slight.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，她感到膝盖有轻微的疼痛。

slim.example: She looks slim and healthy after a few months of simple exercise.
slim.exampleZh: 经过几个月的简单锻炼，她看上去苗条又健康。

slip.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor near the door.
slip.exampleZh: 小心别在门附近的湿滑地板上滑倒。

slippery.example: The wet floor was slippery, so we walked slowly and carefully.
slippery.exampleZh: 湿地板很滑，所以我们走得又慢又小心。

slit.example: He made a small slit in the paper with his knife.
slit.exampleZh: 他用刀在纸上划了一个小口子。

slogan.example: The company put a short slogan on every poster in the city.
slogan.exampleZh: 公司在城里的每张海报上都印了一句简短的广告语。

slope.example: The children ran down the grassy slope behind their house.
slope.exampleZh: 孩子们跑下屋后的草坡。

slot.example: Please put the coin into the slot and wait for your turn.
slot.exampleZh: 请把硬币投入狭缝，然后等待轮到你。

slow.example: The old bus is slow, so we walk to school.
slow.exampleZh: 这辆旧公交车很慢，所以我们步行去学校。

slum.example: Many poor families live in a crowded slum near the river.
slum.exampleZh: 许多贫困家庭住在河边一个拥挤的贫民窟里。

sly.example: That sly cat hid my socks under the bed again.
sly.exampleZh: 那只顽皮的猫又把我的袜子藏到床底下了。

small.example: This small room is warm and quiet in winter.
small.exampleZh: 这个小房间在冬天里温暖又安静。

smart.example: She is smart and always finds quick answers to hard questions.
smart.exampleZh: 她很聪明，总能很快找到难题的答案。

smash.example: The angry man tried to smash the old chair with a heavy stick.
smash.exampleZh: 那个生气的人试图用一根粗棍子把旧椅子砸碎。

smell.example: The kitchen smells good because my mother is cooking soup.
smell.exampleZh: 厨房闻起来很香，因为我妈妈正在煮汤。

smile.example: She gives me a warm smile every time we meet.
smile.exampleZh: 每次见面她都会给我一个温暖的微笑。

smoke.example: Smoke from the kitchen filled the small room and made us cough.
smoke.exampleZh: 厨房里冒出的烟充满了小房间，让我们都咳嗽起来。

smooth.example: The road is smooth, so the car moves along it very easily.
smooth.exampleZh: 这条路很平坦，所以汽车在上面行驶非常轻松。

snack.example: I often eat a small snack after school before I go home.
snack.exampleZh: 放学后我常常在回家前吃点小吃。

snake.example: My little brother is afraid of a snake in the garden.
snake.exampleZh: 我弟弟害怕花园里的一条蛇。

snap.example: The dry branch will snap if you pull it too hard.
snap.exampleZh: 如果你用力过猛，那根干树枝就会啪地折断。

snow.example: White snow covered the whole garden last night, and the children played outside all morning.
snow.exampleZh: 昨夜白雪覆盖了整个花园，孩子们在外面玩了一上午。

so.example: I was so tired that I went to bed early last night.
so.exampleZh: 我太累了，所以昨晚很早就睡了。

soak.example: Please soak the dirty clothes in warm water for ten minutes.
soak.exampleZh: 请把脏衣服在温水里浸泡十分钟。

soap.example: Please wash your hands with soap and warm water before dinner.
soap.exampleZh: 晚饭前请用肥皂和温水洗手。

soar.example: The birds soar high above the lake on warm summer days.
soar.exampleZh: 温暖的夏日里，鸟儿在湖面上空高高翱翔。

sob.example: She began to sob quietly when she heard the sad news.
sob.exampleZh: 听到那个悲伤的消息时，她开始轻声啜泣。

soccer.example: My brother plays soccer with his friends every Saturday morning.
soccer.exampleZh: 我哥哥每个星期六早上都和他的朋友们踢足球。

social.example: Social life is important for students because they need friends and fun.
social.exampleZh: 社交生活对学生很重要，因为他们需要朋友和乐趣。

socialism.example: Many people believe socialism can help reduce the gap between rich and poor.
socialism.exampleZh: 许多人认为社会主义有助于缩小贫富差距。

society.example: He wants to help people in our society who are poor.
society.exampleZh: 他想帮助我们社会中的穷人。

sociology.example: She studies sociology at university because she wants to understand how people live together.
sociology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习社会学，因为她想了解人们如何共同生活。

sock.example: He put on a clean sock before his shoes this morning.
sock.exampleZh: 今天早上他先穿上一只干净的短袜，再穿鞋。

soda.example: I would like a cold glass of soda with my lunch today.
soda.exampleZh: 今天午餐我想喝一杯冰汽水。

sofa.example: The cat is sleeping on the old sofa in the living room.
sofa.exampleZh: 那只猫正睡在客厅里的旧沙发上。

soft.example: Her voice is soft and kind, and everyone likes her.
soft.exampleZh: 她的声音柔和又温柔，每个人都很喜欢她。

software.example: The new software helps students finish their homework more quickly and easily.
software.exampleZh: 这款新软件帮助学生更快、更轻松地完成作业。

soil.example: The farmer planted seeds in the rich soil near his house.
soil.exampleZh: 农民在他家附近肥沃的土壤里播下了种子。

solar.example: Solar energy can give us clean power on sunny days.
solar.exampleZh: 太阳能可以在晴朗的日子里为我们提供清洁的电力。

soldier.example: The young soldier wrote a letter to his family every week.
soldier.exampleZh: 这位年轻的士兵每周都给家人写一封信。

solid.example: This table is very solid and strong enough for heavy books.
solid.exampleZh: 这张桌子非常结实，承重足够放很重的书。

solidarity.example: The workers showed solidarity by helping each other during the long strike.
solidarity.exampleZh: 工人们在漫长的罢工中互相帮助，展现了团结。

solitary.example: The old man lives a solitary life in the small house on the hill.
solitary.exampleZh: 那位老人独自住在山上的小房子里，过着孤独的生活。

solution.example: The teacher showed us an easy solution to the math problem.
solution.exampleZh: 老师给我们展示了一个解决这道数学题的简单方法。

solve.example: We must solve this problem before the meeting starts today.
solve.exampleZh: 我们必须在今天的会议开始前解决这个问题。

some.example: I need to buy some apples and bread for breakfast tomorrow.
some.exampleZh: 我明天早餐需要买一些苹果和面包。

somebody.example: Somebody left a message for you at the front desk this morning.
somebody.exampleZh: 今天早上有人在前台给你留了一条消息。

somehow.example: Somehow she found my lost key on the way home.
somehow.exampleZh: 不知怎么地，她在回家的路上找到了我丢失的钥匙。

someone.example: Someone is knocking at the door, so please go and see who it is.
someone.exampleZh: 有人在敲门，请去看看是谁。

something.example: I have something important to tell you before the meeting starts.
something.exampleZh: 在会议开始之前，我有件重要的事要告诉你。

sometime.example: Please come to see me sometime next week.
sometime.exampleZh: 请下周找个时间来见我。

sometimes.example: Sometimes I walk to school with my sister when the weather is nice.
sometimes.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我有时和妹妹一起走路去学校。

somewhat.example: The soup is somewhat hot, so let it cool for a minute.
somewhat.exampleZh: 这汤有点烫，让它凉一分钟再喝。

somewhere.example: I think I left my keys somewhere in the living room.
somewhere.exampleZh: 我想我把钥匙落在客厅的某个地方了。

son.example: Their son is only six years old but he can already read simple books.
son.exampleZh: 他们的儿子才六岁，但已经能读简单的书了。

song.example: The bird sings a sweet song every morning outside my window.
song.exampleZh: 那只鸟每天早晨在我窗外唱着动听的歌。

soon.example: The bus will come soon, so please wait here.
soon.exampleZh: 公交车很快就要来了，请在这里等候。

sophisticated.example: She is a sophisticated woman who knows how to handle difficult situations.
sophisticated.exampleZh: 她是一位老练的女性，懂得如何处理棘手的情况。

sore.example: My throat is sore today, so I will drink warm water.
sore.exampleZh: 我今天喉咙痛，所以我会喝温水。

sorry.example: I am sorry to hear that your dog is sick.
sorry.exampleZh: 听说你的狗生病了，我很难过。

sort.example: This sort of book is easy to read and good for beginners.
sort.exampleZh: 这类书容易读，适合初学者。

soul.example: She believes that music can touch a person's soul deeply.
soul.exampleZh: 她相信音乐能深深触动一个人的灵魂。

sound.example: The sound of the rain made me feel calm and sleepy.
sound.exampleZh: 雨声让我感到平静和困倦。

soup.example: My mother makes hot soup for us on cold days.
soup.exampleZh: 天冷的时候，妈妈会给我们做热汤。

sour.example: The milk in the fridge has gone sour, so please throw it away.
sour.exampleZh: 冰箱里的牛奶已经变酸了，请把它扔掉。

source.example: The river's source is a small spring high in the mountains.
source.exampleZh: 这条河的源头是高山上一处小小的泉水。

south.example: We live in the south of the city near a large park.
south.exampleZh: 我们住在城市南部，靠近一个大公园。

southern.example: My uncle lives in a small southern town near the sea.
southern.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在海边一个南方小镇上。

space.example: There is not enough space in this room for another table.
space.exampleZh: 这个房间里没有足够的空间再放一张桌子了。

spacecraft.example: The spacecraft flew to the moon and came back safely last year.
spacecraft.exampleZh: 这艘宇宙飞船去年飞往月球并安全返回。

spacious.example: The new living room is spacious and full of light.

spade.example: He used a spade to dig a big hole in the garden.
spade.exampleZh: 他用铁锹在花园里挖了一个大坑。

span.example: Our project spans three months and covers two cities.
span.exampleZh: 我们的项目持续三个月，涵盖两个城市。

spare.example: Can you spare a few minutes to help me move this table?
spare.exampleZh: 你能抽出几分钟帮我搬这张桌子吗？

spark.example: A single spark can start a big fire in a dry forest.
spark.exampleZh: 一颗火花就能在干燥的森林里引发一场大火。

sparkle.example: The stars sparkle in the clear night sky above the quiet town.
sparkle.exampleZh: 星星在安静小镇上方晴朗的夜空中闪耀。

spatial.example: Good spatial skills help children read maps and build things more easily.
spatial.exampleZh: 良好的空间能力能帮助孩子更轻松地看地图和搭东西。

speak.example: She can speak three languages and often speaks at school events.
speak.exampleZh: 她会说三种语言，并且经常在学校活动上演讲。

speaker.example: The speaker stood quietly at the front of the room and smiled.
speaker.exampleZh: 演讲者静静地站在房间前面，微笑着。

spear.example: The old farmer used a long spear to protect his sheep from wolves.
spear.exampleZh: 那位老农夫用一根长矛保护他的羊群免受狼的侵害。

special.example: This is a special day for our whole family.
special.exampleZh: 这对我们全家来说是特殊的一天。

specialist.example: She is a heart specialist at the local hospital.
specialist.exampleZh: 她是当地医院的心脏专科医生。

specialize.example: She wants to specialize in children's medicine after she finishes school.
specialize.exampleZh: 她希望完成学业后专攻儿科医学。

species.example: This species lives only in the cold waters of the north.
species.exampleZh: 这个物种只生活在北方的寒冷水域中。

specific.example: Please give me a specific example so I can understand your plan.
specific.exampleZh: 请给我一个具体的例子，这样我才能理解你的计划。

specify.example: Please specify the time and place of the meeting.
specify.exampleZh: 请明确说明会议的时间和地点。

specimen.example: The doctor sent a blood specimen to the lab for testing.
specimen.exampleZh: 医生把一份血液样本送到实验室做化验。

spectacular.example: The view from the top of the mountain is truly spectacular.
spectacular.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色真是壮观。

spectator.example: A spectator in the front row caught the ball at the game.
spectator.exampleZh: 比赛时，前排的一名观众接住了球。

speculate.example: We can only speculate about why she left the company so suddenly.
speculate.exampleZh: 我们只能猜测她为什么突然离开了公司。

speech.example: Her speech at the meeting was short but very clear.
speech.exampleZh: 她在会上的演讲简短但非常清晰。

speed.example: The car was going at high speed when it passed the school.
speed.exampleZh: 那辆车经过学校时正以高速行驶。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me, please?
