spell.exampleZh: 你能拼一下你的姓给我听吗？

spelling.example: Please check the spelling of your name on this form.
spelling.exampleZh: 请检查这张表格上你名字的拼写。

spend.example: I spend an hour reading English every morning before breakfast.
spend.exampleZh: 我每天早晨早饭前花一小时读英语。

sphere.example: The moon looks like a bright white sphere in the night sky.
sphere.exampleZh: 月亮在夜空中看起来像一个明亮的白色球体。

spherical.example: The Earth is almost spherical, but it is slightly flatter at the poles.
spherical.exampleZh: 地球几乎是球形的，但在两极处略微扁平。

spicy.example: This food is too spicy for me, so I will drink some water.
spicy.exampleZh: 这食物对我来说太辣了，所以我要喝点水。

spider.example: A small spider is making a web in the corner of the room.
spider.exampleZh: 一只小蜘蛛正在房间的角落里结网。

spill.example: Be careful not to spill hot coffee on your new shirt.
spill.exampleZh: 小心别把热咖啡洒在你的新衬衫上。

spin.example: The children love to spin around in the garden until they feel dizzy.
spin.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在花园里转圈，直到感到头晕。

spine.example: The old book's spine was broken, so the pages fell out.
spine.exampleZh: 那本旧书的书脊坏了，所以书页都掉了下来。

spiral.example: Smoke began to spiral up slowly from the old chimney.
spiral.exampleZh: 烟雾开始从旧烟囱里缓缓盘旋上升。

spirit.example: She has a strong spirit and never gives up when life is hard.
spirit.exampleZh: 她有坚强的精神，生活艰难时从不放弃。

spiritual.example: She finds spiritual peace by walking alone in the quiet forest.
spiritual.exampleZh: 她独自在安静的森林里散步，找到了心灵的平静。

spit.example: Please do not spit on the street or in the park.
spit.exampleZh: 请不要在街道上或公园里吐痰。

spite.example: She said those words out of spite and later felt sorry.
spite.exampleZh: 她说那些话是出于怨恨，后来感到很后悔。

splash.example: The kids splash water on each other in the pool all afternoon.
splash.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在泳池里互相泼水。

splendid.example: We saw a splendid view of the mountains from our hotel room.
splendid.exampleZh: 从我们的酒店房间可以看到壮丽的山景。

split.example: They decided to split the bill and go their separate ways.
split.exampleZh: 他们决定分摊账单，然后各走各的路。

spoil.example: Too much sugar can spoil the taste of fresh fruit.
spoil.exampleZh: 太多糖会破坏新鲜水果的味道。

spokesman.example: The company spokesman answered questions from reporters after the meeting.
spokesman.exampleZh: 会议结束后，公司发言人回答了记者的提问。

sponge.example: She used a wet sponge to clean the dirty kitchen table.
sponge.exampleZh: 她用湿海绵擦干净了脏兮兮的厨房桌子。

sponsor.example: The company is the main sponsor of the local football team this year.
sponsor.exampleZh: 这家公司今年是当地足球队的主要赞助商。

spontaneous.example: Her laughter was spontaneous and made everyone in the room feel happy.
spontaneous.exampleZh: 她的笑声很自然，让房间里的每个人都感到开心。

spoon.example: Please give me a clean spoon for my hot soup.
spoon.exampleZh: 请给我一把干净的勺子来喝热汤。

sport.example: My favorite sport is basketball, and I play it with friends every weekend.
sport.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的运动是篮球，我每个周末都和朋友们一起打。

sportsman.example: The young sportsman trains hard every day and hopes to join the national team.
sportsman.exampleZh: 这位年轻的运动员每天刻苦训练，希望进入国家队。

spot.example: I found a small spot on my shirt this morning.
spot.exampleZh: 今天早上我在衬衫上发现了一个小污点。

spray.example: She used a spray to water the small plants on her desk.
spray.exampleZh: 她用喷雾器给桌上的小植物浇水。

spread.example: The news spread quickly across the small town before noon.
spread.exampleZh: 消息在中午前迅速传遍了整个小镇。

spring.example: The water in this spring is very cold even in summer.
spring.exampleZh: 这处泉水即使在夏天也非常冰凉。

sprinkle.example: Please sprinkle a little salt on the eggs before you eat them.
sprinkle.exampleZh: 吃鸡蛋之前请在上面撒一点盐。

spur.example: The teacher's praise was a spur to her students' hard work.
spur.exampleZh: 老师的表扬是对学生努力学习的激励。

spy.example: The spy watched the old house from a dark car.
spy.exampleZh: 那名间谍从一辆深色汽车里监视着那栋老房子。

square.example: The old square in our town is always full of people on weekends.
square.exampleZh: 我们镇上的那个老广场周末总是挤满了人。

squeeze.example: She had to squeeze the lemon hard to get enough juice for the cake.
squeeze.exampleZh: 她不得不使劲挤柠檬，好挤出足够的汁来做蛋糕。

squirrel.example: A little squirrel ran up the tree and hid behind a branch.
squirrel.exampleZh: 一只小松鼠跑上树，躲在树枝后面。

stab.example: He tried to stab the meat with a sharp knife.
stab.exampleZh: 他试图用一把锋利的刀刺那块肉。

stable.example: The old wooden stable is clean and very safe for the horses.
stable.exampleZh: 那座旧木马厩很干净，对马来说也非常安全。

stack.example: There is a large stack of old books on the desk.

staff.example: The hotel will staff the front desk with two new workers.
staff.exampleZh: 酒店将安排两名新员工在前台值班。

stage.example: The singer walked onto the stage and began to sing.
stage.exampleZh: 歌手走上舞台，开始唱歌。

stagger.example: The news did stagger her, but she walked on without a word.
stagger.exampleZh: 这个消息确实让她震惊，但她一言不发地继续往前走。

stain.example: There is a dark stain on your shirt, so wash it soon.
stain.exampleZh: 你的衬衫上有一块深色污渍，所以赶快洗掉它。

stair.example: She walked up the stairs to her room on the second floor.
stair.exampleZh: 她走上楼梯，回到二楼自己的房间。

stake.example: He has a big stake in the company and works there every day.
stake.exampleZh: 他在这家公司有很大股份，每天都在那里工作。

stale.example: The bread on the table is stale, so please buy some fresh one.
stale.exampleZh: 桌上的面包不新鲜了，请买些新鲜的。

stalk.example: The cat stalked the bird through the tall grass and then stopped.
stalk.exampleZh: 那只猫在高高的草丛中悄悄追踪那只鸟，然后停了下来。

stall.example: The old horse stood quietly in its stall near the market stall.
stall.exampleZh: 那匹老马静静地站在市场摊位旁的厩里。

stamp.example: He put a stamp on the letter and dropped it in the mailbox.
stamp.exampleZh: 他在信封上贴了张邮票，然后把它投进了邮箱。

stand.example: She can stand the noise from the busy street outside her window.
stand.exampleZh: 她能忍受窗外繁忙街道传来的噪音。

standard.example: This phone meets the standard for safety and is easy to use.
standard.exampleZh: 这款手机符合安全标准，而且使用方便。

standpoint.example: From my standpoint, this plan is simple and easy to follow.
standpoint.exampleZh: 从我的立场来看，这个计划简单易懂。

star.example: She became a star after her first movie.
star.exampleZh: 她拍完第一部电影后成了明星。

stare.example: She stared at the painting for a long time and said nothing.
stare.exampleZh: 她盯着那幅画看了很久，什么也没说。

start.example: We will start the meeting at nine and finish it before lunch.
start.exampleZh: 我们将在九点开始会议，并在午饭前结束。

startle.example: The loud noise may startle the baby and wake her up.
startle.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音可能会惊吓到婴儿，把她吵醒。

starve.example: Many people in the world still starve because they have no food.
starve.exampleZh: 世界上仍有许多人因为缺少食物而挨饿。

state.example: The report clearly states the current state of the local schools.
state.exampleZh: 这份报告清楚地说明了当地学校的现状。

statement.example: The bank sends me a statement every month.
statement.exampleZh: 银行每个月给我寄一份结算单。

statesman.example: The old statesman gave a short speech to the young students.
statesman.exampleZh: 这位年长的政治家向年轻学生作了简短的演讲。

static.example: The old television screen showed static after the station stopped broadcasting.
static.exampleZh: 电台停止播出后，那台旧电视屏幕上出现了静电噪点。

statistic.example: One statistic shows that most students walk to school every day.
statistic.exampleZh: 一项统计数据显示，大多数学生每天步行上学。

statue.example: There is a large stone statue in the middle of the park.
statue.exampleZh: 公园中央有一座大型石雕。

status.example: His status in the company has grown a lot this year.
status.exampleZh: 他在公司的地位今年提升了很多。

stay.example: We plan to stay at a small hotel near the beach for three nights.
stay.exampleZh: 我们打算在海滩附近的一家小旅馆住三个晚上。

steady.example: His steady hands helped the old man walk across the busy street.
steady.exampleZh: 他沉稳的双手帮助那位老人走过了繁忙的街道。

steak.example: My father cooks a thick steak on the grill every Sunday.
steak.exampleZh: 我父亲每个星期天都在烤架上烤一块厚牛排。

steal.example: Someone tried to steal my bike outside the station last night.
steal.exampleZh: 昨晚有人试图在车站外偷走我的自行车。

steam.example: Hot steam from the boiling water filled the small kitchen very quickly.
steam.exampleZh: 沸水产生的热蒸汽很快充满了小厨房。

steel.example: This bridge is made of strong steel and it looks very safe.
steel.exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的钢铁制成，看起来很安全。

steep.example: The hill behind our house is too steep for young children to climb.
steep.exampleZh: 我们家后面的山太陡了，小孩子爬不上去。

steer.example: He steered the small boat carefully toward the quiet harbor.
steer.exampleZh: 他小心地把小船驶向安静的港口。

stem.example: The tall flower has a strong green stem and many small leaves.
stem.exampleZh: 这朵高高的花有一根粗壮的绿色茎和许多小叶子。

step.example: Please take one step forward and then stop at the line.
step.exampleZh: 请向前走一步，然后在界线处停下。

stereo.example: The old car has a good stereo and everyone enjoys music on long trips.
stereo.exampleZh: 这辆旧车有一套不错的立体声音响，长途旅行时大家都很享受音乐。

stereotype.example: We should not judge people by stereotype but get to know them.
stereotype.exampleZh: 我们不应凭刻板印象评判他人，而应去了解他们。

stern.example: The stern teacher told us to be quiet in class.
stern.exampleZh: 那位严厉的老师让我们在课堂上保持安静。

stick.example: He tried to stick the broken pieces of the old wooden stick together.
stick.exampleZh: 他试着把那根旧木棍的碎片粘在一起。

sticky.example: The floor is sticky because someone spilled juice on it.
sticky.exampleZh: 地板很粘，因为有人把果汁洒在上面了。

stiff.example: My neck felt stiff after I slept on the hard floor.
stiff.exampleZh: 我睡在硬地板上之后，脖子感觉很僵硬。

still.example: The old man sat still and listened to the birds in the quiet garden.
still.exampleZh: 老人一动不动地坐着，听着安静花园里的鸟鸣。

stimulate.example: Good teachers stimulate students to ask questions and think for themselves.
stimulate.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生提问并独立思考。

sting.example: A bee can sting you if you touch it, and the sting hurts.
sting.exampleZh: 如果你碰蜜蜂，它可能会蜇你，而且被蜇的地方会很痛。

stir.example: She used a spoon to stir the hot soup in the pot.
stir.exampleZh: 她用勺子搅拌锅里滚烫的汤。

stitch.example: The doctor put three stitches in the cut on my hand.
stitch.exampleZh: 医生在我手上的伤口缝了三针。

stock.example: The shop keeps a large stock of winter clothes for the coming season.
stock.exampleZh: 这家店为即将到来的季节备了大量冬装库存。

stocking.example: She wore a pair of red stockings to the party last night.
stocking.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一双红色长袜去参加聚会。

stomach.example: My stomach hurts after I ate too much cold food.
stomach.exampleZh: 我吃了太多凉的食物后胃疼。

stone.example: The old wall was built with large stone blocks.
stone.exampleZh: 那堵老墙是用大石块砌成的。

stoop.example: He had to stoop down to pick up the small toy from the floor.
stoop.exampleZh: 他不得不俯下身，从地板上捡起那个小玩具。

stop.example: Please stop the car at the next bus stop so we can rest.
stop.exampleZh: 请把车停在下一个公交站，这样我们可以休息一下。

storage.example: We keep our winter clothes in storage until it gets cold.
storage.exampleZh: 我们把冬装收起来存放，直到天气变冷。

store.example: She went to the store to buy some milk and bread.
store.exampleZh: 她去商店买了一些牛奶和面包。

storm.example: The storm broke the windows of our small house last night.
storm.exampleZh: 昨晚的暴风雨打碎了我们小房子的窗户。

story.example: My grandmother tells me a funny story before I go to bed.
story.exampleZh: 我睡觉前，奶奶会给我讲一个有趣的故事。

stove.example: She put the pot on the stove and waited for the water to boil.
stove.exampleZh: 她把锅放在炉子上，等着水烧开。

straight.example: The road is straight, so you can walk straight to the park.
straight.exampleZh: 这条路是直的，所以你可以直接走到公园。

straightforward.example: Her answer was straightforward, so everyone understood the plan right away.
straightforward.exampleZh: 她的回答直截了当，所以大家马上就明白了这个计划。

strain.example: The heavy load strained the old rope and nearly broke it.
strain.exampleZh: 沉重的负荷拉紧了那根旧绳子，差点把它弄断。

strange.example: There was a strange noise coming from the old house last night.
strange.exampleZh: 昨晚从那座老房子里传来一阵奇怪的声音。

stranger.example: My mother told me never to open the door to a stranger.
stranger.exampleZh: 我妈妈告诉我绝不要给陌生人开门。

strap.example: He used a leather strap to tie the box on his bike.
strap.exampleZh: 他用一根皮带把箱子绑在自行车上。

strategic.example: The company made a strategic plan to enter the new market.
strategic.exampleZh: 公司制定了进入新市场的战略计划。

strategy.example: We need a better strategy to solve this problem.
strategy.exampleZh: 我们需要一个更好的策略来解决这个问题。

stray.example: The little dog strayed from home and could not find its way back.
stray.exampleZh: 那只小狗走失了，找不到回家的路。

streak.example: A bright streak of lightning moved quickly across the dark sky.
streak.exampleZh: 一道明亮的闪电快速划过黑暗的天空。

stream.example: A small stream flows through the green field behind our old house.
stream.exampleZh: 一条小溪流过我们老房子后面的绿色田野。

street.example: Children often play football on our quiet street after school.
street.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们常在我们这条安静的街道上踢足球。

strength.example: Reading is one of her greatest strengths, and she practices it every day.
strength.exampleZh: 阅读是她最大的长处之一，她每天都练习。

strengthen.example: We do exercise every morning to strengthen our bodies and stay healthy.
strengthen.exampleZh: 我们每天早上锻炼，以增强体质、保持健康。

stress.example: My teacher put great stress on the importance of daily reading.
stress.exampleZh: 我的老师着重强调了每日阅读的重要性。

stretch.example: We stretch our arms before running, and the road stretches far ahead.
stretch.exampleZh: 我们跑步前伸展手臂，这条路向前延伸得很远。

strict.example: Our teacher is very strict about homework and never accepts late work.
strict.exampleZh: 我们老师对家庭作业要求很严格，从不接受迟交的作业。

stride.example: She took a long stride and crossed the small stream easily.
stride.exampleZh: 她大步一跨，轻松地跨过了那条小溪。

strike.example: The workers decided to strike for better pay and safer working conditions.
strike.exampleZh: 工人们决定罢工，争取更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

striking.example: There is a striking difference between the two pictures on the wall.
striking.exampleZh: 墙上的两幅画之间有显著的差别。

string.example: He tied the box with a long piece of string.
string.exampleZh: 他用一根长绳子把箱子捆了起来。

strip.example: He had to strip the old paint off the wooden door before painting it again.
strip.exampleZh: 他得先把木门上的旧漆剥掉，然后才能重新刷漆。

stripe.example: The zebra has black and white stripes on its body.
stripe.exampleZh: 斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

strive.example: We strive to do our best every day at school.
strive.exampleZh: 我们在学校每天都努力做到最好。

stroke.example: My grandfather had a stroke last year but he is much better now.
stroke.exampleZh: 我爷爷去年中风了，但他现在好多了。

stroll.example: We took a slow stroll along the river after dinner.
stroll.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

strong.example: He stays strong even when life becomes hard for him.
strong.exampleZh: 即使生活变得艰难，他依然保持坚强。

structure.example: The teacher explained the structure of the sentence with a simple example.
structure.exampleZh: 老师用一个简单的例子讲解了句子的结构。

struggle.example: She had to struggle hard to finish the work on time.
struggle.exampleZh: 她不得不努力奋斗才能按时完成这项工作。

stubborn.example: My stubborn little brother refuses to wear a coat in cold weather.
stubborn.exampleZh: 我那倔强的小弟弟在寒冷天气里拒绝穿外套。

student.example: Every student in my class works hard and helps each other.
student.exampleZh: 我班上的每个学生都很努力，并且互相帮助。

studio.example: She paints every morning in a small studio near her house.
studio.exampleZh: 她每天早上在家附近的一间小画室里画画。

study.example: She likes to study English in her quiet study every evening.
study.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天晚上在她安静的书房里学习英语。

stuff.example: Please put your stuff in the bag before we leave.
stuff.exampleZh: 我们出发前请把你的东西放进包里。

stumble.example: The tired hiker stumbled on a rock and almost fell.
stumble.exampleZh: 那位疲惫的徒步者被石头绊了一下，差点摔倒。

stupid.example: It was a stupid mistake to leave my phone in the taxi.
stupid.exampleZh: 把手机落在出租车里是个愚蠢的错误。

sturdy.example: This sturdy wooden table has lasted for many years.
sturdy.exampleZh: 这张结实的木桌已经用了很多年。

style.example: Her writing style is simple and clear.
style.exampleZh: 她的写作风格简洁明了。

subject.example: Which subject do you like best at school this year?
subject.exampleZh: 今年你在学校最喜欢哪门科目？

subjective.example: My opinion about the movie is very subjective.
subjective.exampleZh: 我对这部电影的看法非常主观。

submerge.example: The heavy rain began to submerge the small road near our school.
submerge.exampleZh: 大雨开始淹没我们学校附近的那条小路。

submit.example: You must submit your homework to the teacher by Friday.
submit.exampleZh: 你必须在星期五之前把作业交给老师。

subsequent.example: The first meeting was short, and the subsequent talks went much better.
subsequent.exampleZh: 第一次会议很短，随后的会谈进行得好多了。

substance.example: Water is a simple substance that every living thing needs.
substance.exampleZh: 水是一种简单的物质，每个生物都需要它。

substantial.example: The company made a substantial profit last year.
substantial.exampleZh: 这家公司去年获得了大量利润。

substitute.example: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar in this cake.
substitute.exampleZh: 在这个蛋糕里你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subtract.example: Please subtract ten from the total to get your final score.
subtract.exampleZh: 请从总数中减去十，得到你的最终得分。

suburb.example: They moved to a quiet suburb after their first child was born.
suburb.exampleZh: 他们的第一个孩子出生后，他们搬到了一个安静的郊区。

subway.example: I take the subway to work every morning.
subway.exampleZh: 我每天早上乘地铁上班。

succeed.example: If you work hard every day, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力，你最终会成功。

success.example: Her hard work and patience finally led to great success in the new job.
success.exampleZh: 她的努力和耐心最终让她在新的工作中取得了巨大成功。

successful.example: She worked very hard and became a successful doctor in her small town.
successful.exampleZh: 她非常努力，最终成了她那个小镇上一名成功的医生。

succession.example: The team won three games in succession last week.
succession.exampleZh: 这支队伍上周连续赢了三场比赛。

successive.example: The team won three successive games last week and moved to first place.
successive.exampleZh: 这支队伍上周连续赢了三场比赛，升到了第一名。

such.example: I have never seen such a beautiful garden in my life.
such.exampleZh: 我这辈子从没见过这么漂亮的花园。

suck.example: The baby likes to suck milk from a small bottle.
suck.exampleZh: 婴儿喜欢用小奶瓶吸牛奶。

sudden.example: A sudden noise outside the window made everyone stop talking.
sudden.exampleZh: 窗外突然传来的一声响让大家都停止了说话。

suddenly.example: The rain stopped suddenly and the sun came out.
suddenly.exampleZh: 雨突然停了，太阳出来了。

suffer.example: Many people suffer from headaches when they work too long.
suffer.exampleZh: 很多人在工作时间太长时会头痛。

sufficient.example: We have sufficient time to finish the work today.
sufficient.exampleZh: 我们今天有足够的时间完成这项工作。

sugar.example: Too much sugar in drinks is bad for young children.
sugar.exampleZh: 饮料里糖分过多对幼儿有害。

suggest.example: Her red face suggests that she is very nervous about the test.
suggest.exampleZh: 她通红的脸表明她对这次考试非常紧张。

suggestion.example: Her suggestion about the new plan was very helpful to everyone.
suggestion.exampleZh: 她关于新计划的建议对大家很有帮助。

suicide.example: He felt very sad and thought about suicide, but his friends helped him.
suicide.exampleZh: 他非常难过，曾想过自杀，但朋友们帮助了他。

suit.example: This dark suit is perfect for the interview tomorrow.
suit.exampleZh: 这套深色西装很适合明天的面试。

suitable.example: This movie is not suitable for young children because it is too scary.
suitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合年幼的孩子，因为它太吓人了。

suitcase.example: I packed my clothes into a suitcase and left for the airport.
suitcase.exampleZh: 我把衣服装进手提箱，然后出发去机场。

sum.example: The sum of these two numbers is ten.
sum.exampleZh: 这两个数字的总和是十。

summarize.example: Please summarize the main ideas of this article in two sentences.
summarize.exampleZh: 请用两句话概括这篇文章的主要观点。

summary.example: She wrote a short summary of the book for her class.
summary.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一篇关于这本书的简短摘要。

summer.example: We swim in the lake every summer with our friends.
summer.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都和朋友在湖里游泳。

summit.example: The leaders met at the summit to discuss climate change and world peace.
summit.exampleZh: 各国领导人在峰会上会面，讨论气候变化和世界和平。

summon.example: She had to summon all her courage before she spoke to the crowd.
summon.exampleZh: 她不得不鼓起全部勇气，才开口对人群讲话。

sun.example: The sun is very bright today, so please wear a hat.
sun.exampleZh: 今天太阳很亮，所以请戴一顶帽子。

sunlight.example: The plant needs plenty of sunlight to grow well.
sunlight.exampleZh: 这株植物需要充足的阳光才能长得好。

sunny.example: It is a sunny day, and the children are playing happily outside.
sunny.exampleZh: 今天阳光充足，孩子们在外面开心地玩耍。

sunrise.example: We got up early to watch the sunrise over the quiet lake.
sunrise.exampleZh: 我们早早起床，去看宁静湖面上的日出。

sunset.example: We took beautiful photos of the sunset from the top of the hill.
sunset.exampleZh: 我们在山顶拍了许多美丽的日落照片。

sunshine.example: The children played in the warm sunshine all afternoon.
sunshine.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在温暖的阳光下玩耍。

super.example: This soup is super tasty and my kids love it.
super.exampleZh: 这汤非常好喝，我的孩子们很喜欢。

superficial.example: His knowledge of the subject is superficial, so he often makes mistakes.
superficial.exampleZh: 他对这个主题的了解很肤浅，所以他经常犯错。

superior.example: She believes this new phone is superior to her old one.
superior.exampleZh: 她认为这部新手机比她的旧手机更好。

supermarket.example: I go to the supermarket every Saturday to buy food for the week.
supermarket.exampleZh: 我每周六都去超市买一周的食物。

supersonic.example: The supersonic plane flies faster than the speed of sound.
supersonic.exampleZh: 这架超音速飞机的飞行速度比声速还快。

supper.example: We usually have supper at seven in the evening.
supper.exampleZh: 我们通常晚上七点吃晚饭。

supplement.example: She takes vitamins to supplement her diet.
supplement.exampleZh: 她服用维生素来补充饮食。

supply.example: The farmer supplies fresh vegetables to the local market every morning.
supply.exampleZh: 这位农民每天早上向当地市场供应新鲜蔬菜。

support.example: My parents always support me when I try something new.
support.exampleZh: 当我尝试新事物时，父母总是支持我。

suppose.example: I suppose he is still at home now.
suppose.exampleZh: 我猜想他现在还在家里。

supreme.example: The king has supreme power over all the people in his country.
supreme.exampleZh: 国王对他国家的所有人民拥有至高无上的权力。

sure.example: I am sure this is the right way to the station.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信这是去车站的正确路线。

surface.example: The surface of the lake was calm and quiet in the early morning.

surge.example: There was a sudden surge in demand for electric cars this year.
surge.exampleZh: 今年电动汽车的需求突然激增。

surgeon.example: The surgeon washed his hands carefully before the operation began.
surgeon.exampleZh: 手术开始前，外科医生仔细地洗了手。

surgery.example: The doctor said I need surgery on my knee next week.
surgery.exampleZh: 医生说我下星期需要做膝盖手术。

surplus.example: The farm had a surplus of corn and sold the extra grain.
surplus.exampleZh: 农场玉米过剩，把多余的粮食卖掉了。

surprise.example: To my surprise, the small team won the big game.
surprise.exampleZh: 令我惊讶的是，这个小团队赢下了那场大赛。

surrender.example: He refused to surrender even when his team was losing badly.
surrender.exampleZh: 即使他的队伍落后得很厉害，他也拒绝放弃。

surround.example: Tall trees surround the small lake near our school.
surround.exampleZh: 我们学校附近的小湖被高大的树木环绕着。

surroundings.example: The hotel is clean and the surroundings are very quiet at night.
surroundings.exampleZh: 这家酒店很干净，周围的环境在夜晚非常安静。

survey.example: The team will survey the land before they build the new road.
survey.exampleZh: 团队会在修建新路之前测量这片土地。

survival.example: Clean water is very important for survival in the desert.
survival.exampleZh: 在沙漠中，干净的水对生存非常重要。

survive.example: Only two people survived the terrible accident on the mountain last winter.
survive.exampleZh: 去年冬天那场山上的可怕事故中只有两个人幸存下来。

suspect.example: The police suspect that the quiet man is hiding something important.
suspect.exampleZh: 警方怀疑那个安静的男人隐藏着重要的事情。

suspend.example: The school suspended two students for fighting in the classroom yesterday.
suspend.exampleZh: 学校昨天因两名学生在教室里打架而让他们停课。

suspicion.example: I have a strong suspicion that he is not telling the truth.
suspicion.exampleZh: 我强烈怀疑他没有说实话。

suspicious.example: The police found a suspicious bag near the busy train station this morning.
suspicious.exampleZh: 今天早上，警方在繁忙的火车站附近发现了一个可疑的包。

sustain.example: We need enough water to sustain life on the farm.
sustain.exampleZh: 我们需要足够的水来维持农场上的生命。

swallow.example: The bird is a swallow, and it can swallow small insects quickly.
swallow.exampleZh: 这只鸟是一只燕子，它能很快地吞下小昆虫。

swamp.example: Heavy rain may swamp the small town near the dark swamp.
swamp.exampleZh: 大雨可能会淹没那座位于黑暗沼泽附近的小镇。

swap.example: Let us swap our books for a day and read something new.
swap.exampleZh: 我们把书交换一天，读点新东西吧。

swarm.example: A swarm of bees flew over the garden and landed on a tree.
swarm.exampleZh: 一大群蜜蜂飞过花园，落在了一棵树上。

sway.example: The tall trees sway gently in the wind on a quiet afternoon.
sway.exampleZh: 在一个安静的下午，高高的树木在风中轻轻摇摆。

swear.example: I swear I will never tell anyone your secret.
swear.exampleZh: 我发誓绝不把你的秘密告诉任何人。

sweat.example: Hard work makes him sweat, but he never gives up.
sweat.exampleZh: 辛苦的工作让他出汗，但他从不放弃。

sweater.example: She wore a warm sweater to school on a cold morning.
sweater.exampleZh: 在一个寒冷的早晨，她穿着一件暖和的毛衣去上学。

sweep.example: She used a broom to sweep the kitchen floor after dinner.
sweep.exampleZh: 晚饭后她用扫帚扫了厨房的地。

sweet.example: This sweet candy makes my little sister very happy every day.
sweet.exampleZh: 这颗甜糖果让我妹妹每天都很快乐。

swell.example: After the long flight, her ankles began to swell and felt very sore.
swell.exampleZh: 长途飞行后，她的脚踝开始肿胀，而且感到很酸痛。

swerve.example: The driver had to swerve quickly to avoid a dog on the road.
swerve.exampleZh: 司机不得不迅速转向以避开路上的狗。

swift.example: The swift runner reached the finish line before everyone else.
swift.exampleZh: 那位敏捷的跑者比所有人都先到达终点线。

swim.example: I can swim in the pool near my house.
swim.exampleZh: 我可以在我家附近的游泳池里游泳。

swing.example: The children like to swing on the old swing in the park.
swing.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里那个旧秋千上荡来荡去。

switch.example: Please switch off the lights before you leave the room.
switch.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

sword.example: The old king gave the young knight a sharp sword.
sword.exampleZh: 年老的国王把一把锋利的剑赐给了那位年轻的骑士。

symbol.example: The white dove is a symbol of peace in many cultures.
symbol.exampleZh: 白鸽在许多文化中是和平的象征。

sympathetic.example: My teacher was very sympathetic when I told her about my problem.
sympathetic.exampleZh: 当我告诉老师我的问题时，她非常同情我。

sympathy.example: I feel great sympathy for the family after their sad loss.
sympathy.exampleZh: 在他们痛失亲人后，我对这个家庭深感同情。

symptom.example: A cough is a common symptom of a cold.
symptom.exampleZh: 咳嗽是感冒的常见症状。

system.example: The new computer system helps our school work much faster.
system.exampleZh: 新的电脑系统帮助我们学校工作快得多。

systematic.example: She takes a systematic approach to learning new words every day.
systematic.exampleZh: 她每天用有条理的方法学习新单词。

table.example: Please put the books on the table before the meeting starts.
table.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前把书放在桌子上。

tablet.example: The doctor told me to take one tablet after dinner every day.
tablet.exampleZh: 医生让我每天晚饭后吃一片药。

tackle.example: The team worked hard to tackle the problem before the deadline.
tackle.exampleZh: 团队努力在截止日期前处理这个问题。

tactics.example: The coach changed his tactics after the team lost the first game.
tactics.exampleZh: 球队输掉第一场比赛后，教练改变了战术。

tag.example: She put a name tag on her bag before the trip.
tag.exampleZh: 旅行前她在包上挂了一个名牌标签。

tail.example: The dog ran after the ball and wagged its tail happily.
tail.exampleZh: 狗追着球跑，高兴地摇着尾巴。

tailor.example: The tailor made a new suit for me last week.
tailor.exampleZh: 裁缝上周为我做了一套新西装。

take.example: Please take this bag to the office for me.
take.exampleZh: 请帮我把这个包带到办公室。

tale.example: My grandfather told us a funny tale about his old dog.
tale.exampleZh: 我爷爷给我们讲了一个关于他那只老狗的搞笑故事。

talent.example: She has a real talent for drawing and loves to paint every day.
talent.exampleZh: 她有真正的绘画天赋，喜欢每天画画。

talk.example: We need to talk about our plan for the trip next week.
talk.exampleZh: 我们需要谈一谈下周旅行的计划。

tall.example: My brother is very tall and plays basketball well.
tall.exampleZh: 我哥哥个子很高，篮球打得很好。

tame.example: The once wild bird is now tame and eats from my hand.
tame.exampleZh: 这只曾经野生的鸟现在很温顺，会从我手里吃东西。

tank.example: The farmer keeps a large tank of water behind his small house.
tank.exampleZh: 农夫在他的小房子后面放着一个大水箱。

tap.example: She gave the door a quick tap and waited for an answer.
tap.exampleZh: 她轻轻敲了敲门，等着有人应答。

tape.example: I used tape to fix the broken box and it looks good now.
tape.exampleZh: 我用胶带把破箱子粘好了，现在看起来不错。

target.example: Our team set a clear target for sales this year.
target.exampleZh: 我们团队为今年的销售设定了一个明确的目标。

task.example: My first task today is to clean the kitchen.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是打扫厨房。

taste.example: I can taste the fresh lemon in this simple cake.
taste.exampleZh: 我能在这款简单的蛋糕里尝到新鲜柠檬的味道。

tax.example: The new tax on imported cars makes them more expensive for ordinary families.
tax.exampleZh: 对进口汽车征收的新税使它们对普通家庭来说更贵了。

taxi.example: I took a taxi to the airport early this morning.
taxi.exampleZh: 我今天一早坐出租车去了机场。

tea.example: My mother drinks a cup of hot tea every morning before work.
tea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上班前都会喝一杯热茶。

teach.example: My mother teaches English at a small school near our home.
teach.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一所小学校教英语。

teacher.example: My English teacher helps us read and write every day.
teacher.exampleZh: 我的英语老师每天帮助我们读和写。

team.example: Our team works hard every day to finish the project on time.
team.exampleZh: 我们的团队每天努力工作，以按时完成这个项目。

tear.example: She had a tear in her eye as she tore the letter.
tear.exampleZh: 她眼里含着泪水，撕开了那封信。

technical.example: The technical problem was hard, but our team fixed it quickly.
technical.exampleZh: 这个技术问题很难，但我们的团队很快解决了它。

technician.example: The technician repaired our computer in less than an hour.
technician.exampleZh: 技术员在不到一小时里就修好了我们的电脑。

technique.example: Learning a new technique takes time and a lot of practice.
technique.exampleZh: 学习一项新技巧需要时间和大量练习。

technology.example: Modern technology makes it easy for people to work from home.
technology.exampleZh: 现代技术让人们在家工作变得很容易。

tedious.example: The meeting was so tedious that I almost fell asleep at my desk.
tedious.exampleZh: 这个会议冗长乏味，我差点在办公桌前睡着了。

telegram.example: My grandfather sent a telegram to our family when he arrived in the city.
telegram.exampleZh: 我祖父到达城里后给我们家发了一封电报。

telephone.example: I called her on the telephone to say good night.

telescope.example: He used a telescope to look at the stars last night.
telescope.exampleZh: 昨晚他用望远镜观察星星。

television.example: My children watch television for one hour after dinner every evening.
television.exampleZh: 我的孩子们每天晚上晚饭后看一小时电视。

tell.example: Please tell me the truth about what happened last night.
tell.exampleZh: 请告诉我昨晚发生事情的真相。

temper.example: He lost his temper when the train was late again.
temper.exampleZh: 火车又晚点时，他发了脾气。

temperature.example: The temperature outside is very high today, so we stay inside.
temperature.exampleZh: 今天外面温度很高，所以我们待在室内。

temple.example: The old temple stands quietly on the hill near our village.
temple.exampleZh: 那座古老的庙静静地坐落在我们村庄附近的小山上。

temporary.example: This is only a temporary job for the summer holidays.
temporary.exampleZh: 这只是一份暑假期间的临时工作。

tempt.example: The smell of fresh bread tempted me to buy a second loaf.
tempt.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味引诱我又买了一条。

temptation.example: I could not resist the temptation to eat one more piece of cake.
temptation.exampleZh: 我抵挡不住再吃一块蛋糕的诱惑。

ten.example: There are ten apples in the basket on the table.
ten.exampleZh: 桌子上方的篮子里有十个苹果。

tend.example: People who sleep well tend to feel happier during the day.
tend.exampleZh: 睡眠充足的人往往在白天感觉更快乐。

tendency.example: He has a tendency to talk too much when he is nervous.
tendency.exampleZh: 他紧张时总有一种说话过多的倾向。

tender.example: She gave the scared child a tender smile and held his hand.
tender.exampleZh: 她给了那个受惊的孩子一个温柔的微笑，并握住他的手。

tennis.example: My sister plays tennis with her friends every Saturday morning.
tennis.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周六早上和朋友们打网球。

tense.example: The rope was tense before the race began, and everyone felt nervous.
tense.exampleZh: 比赛开始前绳子绷得很紧，每个人都感到紧张。

tension.example: The tension in the room grew as everyone waited for the final result.
tension.exampleZh: 随着每个人都在等待最终结果，房间里的紧张气氛越来越浓。

tent.example: We put up a tent by the river and slept there all night.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在河边搭了一个帐篷，在那里睡了一整夜。

term.example: We learned many new terms in class this term.
term.exampleZh: 这学期我们在课堂上学了许多新术语。

terminal.example: The train stopped at the terminal, and all the passengers got off.
terminal.exampleZh: 火车停在了终点站，所有乘客都下了车。

terminate.example: The company may terminate your contract if you break the rules.
terminate.exampleZh: 如果你违反规定，公司可能会终止你的合同。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed at home and watched a movie.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们待在家里看了一部电影。

terrific.example: The new restaurant in our town serves terrific food at low prices.
terrific.exampleZh: 我们镇上那家新餐厅以低价提供极好的食物。

terrify.example: The loud thunder at night terrified the little dog and the children.
terrify.exampleZh: 夜里的雷声很大，吓坏了小狗和孩子们。

territory.example: The small island is part of our country's territory.
territory.exampleZh: 这座小岛是我国领土的一部分。

terror.example: The loud scream filled the dark house with terror.
terror.exampleZh: 那声尖叫让黑暗的房子里充满了恐惧。

test.example: Our teacher will give us a short test on Friday morning.
test.exampleZh: 我们老师星期五上午会给我们做一个小测验。

testify.example: Her happy face can testify that the plan is working well.
testify.exampleZh: 她开心的表情可以证明这个计划奏效了。

testimony.example: Her testimony in court helped the police find the missing car.
testimony.exampleZh: 她在法庭上的证词帮助警方找到了那辆失踪的汽车。

text.example: The teacher asked us to read the text aloud in class today.
text.exampleZh: 老师今天让我们在课堂上朗读课文。

textbook.example: I forgot my math textbook at home today.
textbook.exampleZh: 我今天把数学课本忘在家里了。

than.example: I am taller than my sister.

thank.example: You should thank your teacher for all her help today.
thank.exampleZh: 你应该感谢老师今天给你的所有帮助。

that.example: I think that book on the desk is mine.
that.exampleZh: 我觉得桌上那本书是我的。

the.example: The book on the table is mine.

theater.example: We watched a funny play at the new theater near our school last night.
theater.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在学校附近的新剧院看了一场有趣的戏。

their.example: Their house is near the park and the school.
their.exampleZh: 他们的房子在公园和学校附近。

them.example: I saw them at the park yesterday and we played together.
them.exampleZh: 我昨天在公园看到他们，我们一起玩了。

theme.example: The theme of the party is the sea, so everyone wore blue.
theme.exampleZh: 这次聚会的主题是海洋，所以大家都穿了蓝色。

themselves.example: The children made the cake themselves and cleaned the kitchen after.
themselves.exampleZh: 孩子们自己做了蛋糕，之后还打扫了厨房。

then.example: We ate dinner and then watched a movie at home.
then.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，然后在家看了一部电影。

theory.example: In theory, the plan sounds simple, but real life is often harder.
theory.exampleZh: 理论上这个计划听起来很简单，但现实生活中往往更难。

therapy.example: My sister needs therapy for her back pain every week.
therapy.exampleZh: 我姐姐每周都需要接受背部疼痛的治疗。

there.example: Please put the box over there next to the window.
there.exampleZh: 请把箱子放到那边窗户旁边。

thereby.example: He left early, thereby avoiding the heavy traffic on the way home.
thereby.exampleZh: 他提早离开，从而避开了回家路上的拥堵。

therefore.example: It was raining hard, and therefore we stayed at home all day.
therefore.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

thermometer.example: The nurse used a thermometer to check if the child had a fever.
thermometer.exampleZh: 护士用体温计检查孩子是否发烧。

these.example: These books on the desk are for my younger sister.
these.exampleZh: 桌上的这些书是给我妹妹的。

thick.example: The ice on the lake is very thick in winter.
thick.exampleZh: 冬天湖面上的冰非常厚。

thief.example: The police caught the thief near the bank last night.
thief.exampleZh: 警察昨晚在银行附近抓住了那个小偷。

thin.example: The ice on the lake is too thin to walk on safely.
thin.exampleZh: 湖上的冰太薄了，走上去不安全。

thing.example: I have many things to do at home today.
thing.exampleZh: 我今天在家有很多事情要做。

think.example: I think we should go home now.
think.exampleZh: 我想我们现在应该回家了。

third.example: She lives on the third floor of that old building.
third.exampleZh: 她住在那栋旧楼的三楼。

thirst.example: After the long run, his thirst for water was very strong.
thirst.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他对水的渴望非常强烈。

thirsty.example: After the long run, I felt very thirsty and drank two glasses of water.
thirsty.exampleZh: 长跑之后我感到非常口渴，喝了两杯水。

thirteen.example: My little sister is thirteen years old and she loves to read books.
thirteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十三岁，她喜欢读书。

thirty.example: My mother is thirty years old in this old photo.
thirty.exampleZh: 在这张旧照片里，我妈妈三十岁。

this.example: This book is very good, and I want to read it again.
this.exampleZh: 这本书很好，我想再读一遍。

thorough.example: She did a thorough check of the report before the meeting.
thorough.exampleZh: 会议前她对报告做了彻底的检查。

those.example: Those are my books on the desk near the window.
those.exampleZh: 那些是我在窗边桌子上的书。

though.example: Though it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
though.exampleZh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去散步了。

thought.example: Her kind thought for others made everyone in the room feel warm.
thought.exampleZh: 她对他人的关怀让房间里的每个人都感到温暖。

thoughtful.example: She is a thoughtful friend who always remembers my birthday.
thoughtful.exampleZh: 她是个体贴的朋友，总是记得我的生日。

thousand.example: There are more than a thousand students in our school this year.
thousand.exampleZh: 今年我们学校有一千多名学生。

thread.example: She pulled a loose thread from the edge of her old blue sweater.
thread.exampleZh: 她从旧蓝毛衣的边缘拉出一根松掉的线。

threat.example: The dark clouds are a threat to our picnic this afternoon.
threat.exampleZh: 这些乌云对我们今天下午的野餐是个威胁。

threaten.example: Dark clouds threaten rain, so we should go home now.
threaten.exampleZh: 乌云预示着要下雨，所以我们现在应该回家。

three.example: My little sister is three years old and she loves to sing.
three.exampleZh: 我的小妹妹三岁了，她喜欢唱歌。

threshold.example: The noise level crossed the threshold and the alarm went off.
threshold.exampleZh: 噪音水平超过了阈值，警报响了起来。

thrift.example: Her thrift helped the family save enough money for a new house.
thrift.exampleZh: 她的节俭帮助家里攒够了买新房的钱。

thrill.example: The children felt a great thrill when they saw the snow.
thrill.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时感到非常兴奋。

thrive.example: Small businesses thrive when the local government keeps taxes low and simple.
thrive.exampleZh: 当当地政府保持低税率和简化的税制时，小企业就会兴旺发展。

throat.example: I have a sore throat and cannot speak loudly today.
throat.exampleZh: 我喉咙痛，今天没法大声说话。

throne.example: The young prince sat on the throne after his father died.
throne.exampleZh: 父亲去世后，年轻的王子登上了王位。

through.example: We walked through the park and then went home.
through.exampleZh: 我们穿过公园，然后回家了。

throughout.example: The museum is free for students throughout the year.
throughout.exampleZh: 这座博物馆全年对学生免费。

throw.example: He likes to throw the ball to his dog in the park.
throw.exampleZh: 他喜欢在公园里把球扔给他的狗。

thrust.example: He thrust the key into the lock and pushed the door open.
thrust.exampleZh: 他把钥匙插进锁里，然后推开了门。

thumb.example: He hurt his thumb while playing basketball with his friends yesterday.
thumb.exampleZh: 他昨天和朋友们打篮球时伤了拇指。

thunder.example: The loud thunder woke the baby and scared the dog.
thunder.exampleZh: 响亮的雷声吵醒了婴儿，也吓到了狗。

thus.example: The road was closed, and thus we had to take a longer way home.
thus.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们不得不绕远路回家。

tick.example: I heard the clock tick all night and could not sleep.
tick.exampleZh: 我听见钟整夜滴答作响，怎么也睡不着。

ticket.example: I bought a ticket for the train to Beijing this morning.
ticket.exampleZh: 我今天早上买了一张去北京的火车票。

tide.example: The tide comes in twice every day along this beach.
tide.exampleZh: 这片海滩每天有两次涨潮。

tidy.example: Please tidy your room before your friends come over today.
tidy.exampleZh: 请在你朋友今天来之前整理好你的房间。

tie.example: He likes to wear a blue tie to work every day.
tie.exampleZh: 他喜欢每天上班系一条蓝色领带。

tiger.example: The tiger walked slowly through the tall grass and looked at us.
tiger.exampleZh: 那只老虎慢慢地穿过高高的草丛，看着我们。

tight.example: The lid is too tight, so I cannot open the jar.
tight.exampleZh: 盖子太紧了，所以我打不开这个罐子。

tile.example: The workers put a broken tile back on the roof before the rain came.
tile.exampleZh: 工人们在雨来之前把一块破瓦片重新放回屋顶上。

till.example: Please wait here till I come back.

timber.example: The old house was built entirely of strong timber.
timber.exampleZh: 这座老房子完全是用结实的木材建成的。

time.example: I do not have much time to finish my work today.
time.exampleZh: 我今天没有太多时间完成我的工作。

tin.example: The old tin box on the shelf is full of small buttons.
tin.exampleZh: 架子上那个旧锡盒里装满了小纽扣。

tiny.example: A tiny bird sat on the branch and sang a sweet song.
tiny.exampleZh: 一只小鸟停在树枝上，唱着甜美的歌。

tip.example: She gave the waiter a small tip and thanked him for his help.
tip.exampleZh: 她给了服务员一点小费，并感谢他的帮助。

tire.example: After the long trip, my tires felt tired and I wanted to rest.
tire.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，我的轮胎也让我感到疲惫，我想休息了。

tired.example: After a long day at work, I felt very tired.
tired.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，我感到非常疲劳。

tissue.example: The doctor used a tissue to clean the small cut on my arm.
tissue.exampleZh: 医生用一张纸巾清理我手臂上的小伤口。

title.example: The title of her new book is very easy to remember.
title.exampleZh: 她那本新书的标题很容易记住。

to.example: I walk to school with my sister every morning.
to.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

toast.example: We raised a toast to the bride and groom at dinner.
toast.exampleZh: 我们在晚宴上举杯祝福新郎新娘。

tobacco.example: My grandfather grew tobacco on a small farm many years ago.
tobacco.exampleZh: 我祖父多年前在一个小农场里种植烟草。

today.example: I have a lot of work to do today.
today.exampleZh: 我今天有很多工作要做。

toe.example: He hurt his toe when he kicked the ball in the park.
toe.exampleZh: 他在公园里踢球时伤到了脚趾。

together.example: We often cook dinner together and talk about our day.
together.exampleZh: 我们常常一起做晚饭，聊聊各自的一天。

toilet.example: Please tell me where the toilet is on this floor.
toilet.exampleZh: 请告诉我这一层的厕所在哪里。

tolerance.example: Her tolerance for noise helped her live near the busy road.
tolerance.exampleZh: 她对噪音的忍耐力使她能住在繁忙的马路边。

tolerate.example: I can tolerate noise, but I cannot tolerate rudeness from anyone.
tolerate.exampleZh: 我能忍受噪音，但我无法容忍任何人的无礼。

tomato.example: I put a red tomato in my salad for lunch today.
tomato.exampleZh: 我今天午餐在沙拉里放了一个红色的西红柿。

tomorrow.example: I will finish my homework tomorrow and then we can play outside.
tomorrow.exampleZh: 我明天会完成作业，然后我们就可以到外面玩了。

ton.example: This box weighs one ton and is too heavy to lift.
ton.exampleZh: 这个箱子有一吨重，太重了，抬不起来。

tone.example: Her tone was calm and friendly, so everyone relaxed during the meeting.
tone.exampleZh: 她的语气平静而友好，所以大家在会议上都放松了。

tongue.example: The doctor asked me to open my mouth and put out my tongue.
tongue.exampleZh: 医生让我张开嘴，伸出舌头。

tonight.example: We will watch a movie at home tonight after dinner.
tonight.exampleZh: 今晚晚饭后我们会在家看一部电影。

too.example: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.
too.exampleZh: 这个包太重了，我拿不动。

tool.example: A good dictionary is a useful tool for learning English.
tool.exampleZh: 一本好词典是学习英语的有用工具。

tooth.example: The dentist said I have one bad tooth that needs to be filled.
tooth.exampleZh: 牙医说我有一颗蛀牙需要补。

top.example: We finally reached the top of the hill after two hours.
top.exampleZh: 两个小时后我们终于到达了山顶。

topic.example: The topic of today's class is how to stay healthy.
topic.exampleZh: 今天这节课的话题是如何保持健康。

torch.example: She used a torch to find her way in the dark forest.
torch.exampleZh: 她在黑暗的森林里用手电筒照路。

torment.example: Years of torment made her afraid to trust anyone again.
torment.exampleZh: 多年的痛苦折磨让她不敢再信任任何人。

torrent.example: A torrent of rain poured down and flooded the small street.
torrent.exampleZh: 一场倾盆大雨倾泻而下，淹没了那条小街。

torture.example: The prisoner said the long nights of waiting were a kind of torture.
torture.exampleZh: 那名囚犯说，漫长的等待之夜就是一种折磨。

toss.example: He tossed the ball to his little sister and she caught it.
toss.exampleZh: 他把球扔给妹妹，她接住了。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was more than we expected.
total.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用超出了我们的预期。

touch.example: Please don't touch the hot pan on the stove.
touch.exampleZh: 请不要碰炉子上那个烫的锅。

tough.example: It was a tough job, but he never gave up.
tough.exampleZh: 这是份艰难的工作，但他从未放弃。

tour.example: We took a tour of the old city and learned a lot.
tour.exampleZh: 我们游览了老城区，学到了很多。

tourist.example: The tourist took many photos of the old bridge.
tourist.exampleZh: 这位游客给那座古老的桥拍了很多照片。

toward.example: She walked slowly toward the door with a smile.
toward.exampleZh: 她带着微笑慢慢走向门口。

towel.example: Please pass me a clean towel to dry my hands.
towel.exampleZh: 请递给我一条干净的毛巾擦手。

tower.example: The old tower stands at the top of the hill.
tower.exampleZh: 那座古老的塔矗立在山顶上。

town.example: The small town has one school, a church and a few shops.
town.exampleZh: 这个小镇有一所学校、一座教堂和几家商店。

toy.example: The little boy got a new toy car for his birthday.
toy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩生日时得到了一辆新的玩具车。

trace.example: The police can trace the missing car through this small mark.
trace.exampleZh: 警方可以通过这个小痕迹追踪到那辆失踪的汽车。

track.example: The train runs on a long track beside the river.
track.exampleZh: 火车在河边的一条长长的轨道上行驶。

tractor.example: My uncle uses a tractor to pull heavy machines on his farm.
tractor.exampleZh: 我叔叔用拖拉机在农场里牵引重型机器。

trade.example: My father works in the trade of buying and selling old cars.
trade.exampleZh: 我父亲从事买卖旧汽车的行业。

tradition.example: It is a family tradition to eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
tradition.exampleZh: 除夕夜一起吃饺子是我们家的传统。

traditional.example: My grandmother still cooks traditional food every Sunday for the family.
traditional.exampleZh: 我奶奶每个星期天仍然为家人做传统食物。

traffic.example: The traffic in the city is very heavy during the morning rush hour.
traffic.exampleZh: 早高峰时，城市里的交通非常拥堵。

tragedy.example: The fire was a great tragedy for the whole small town.
tragedy.exampleZh: 这场大火对整个小镇来说是一场巨大的灾难。

trail.example: The dog followed the trail of the little boy through the snow.
trail.exampleZh: 那只狗沿着小男孩在雪地里留下的踪迹一路跟随。

train.example: Every morning he takes the train to work and trains new staff.
train.exampleZh: 每天早上他坐火车去上班，并培训新员工。

training.example: The new workers get two weeks of training before they start.
training.exampleZh: 新员工在开始工作前会接受两周的培训。

transfer.example: I need to transfer money to my sister's bank account today.
transfer.exampleZh: 我今天需要把钱转到姐姐的银行账户里。

transform.example: The old factory was transformed into a bright art museum last year.
transform.exampleZh: 这座旧工厂去年被改造成了一座明亮的艺术博物馆。

transformation.example: The city has seen a great transformation in the last ten years.
transformation.exampleZh: 这座城市在过去十年里发生了巨大的转变。

transformer.example: The transformer near our school broke down, so the lights went out.
transformer.exampleZh: 我们学校附近的变压器坏了，所以灯都灭了。

transistor.example: This old radio still works because every transistor inside it is in good condition.
transistor.exampleZh: 这台旧收音机还能用，因为里面每一个晶体管都状况良好。

translate.example: Please translate this short letter into Chinese for me.
translate.exampleZh: 请帮我把这封短信翻译成中文。

translation.example: She read the English translation of the novel and found it easy to understand.
translation.exampleZh: 她读了这部小说的英文译本，觉得很容易理解。

transmission.example: The transmission of the disease is faster in crowded places.
transmission.exampleZh: 这种疾病在拥挤的地方传播得更快。

transmit.example: Mosquitoes can transmit this disease to people through their bites.
transmit.exampleZh: 蚊子可以通过叮咬把这种病传染给人类。

transparent.example: The water in the glass was so transparent that we could see the bottom.
transparent.exampleZh: 玻璃杯里的水非常透明，我们能看到杯底。

transport.example: The company uses trucks to transport goods to other cities every day.
transport.exampleZh: 这家公司每天用卡车把货物运送到其他城市。

transportation.example: Public transportation in this city is cheap and easy to use.
transportation.exampleZh: 这座城市的公共交通便宜又方便。

trap.example: The fox was trapped in a trap near the old farm.
trap.exampleZh: 那只狐狸被困在旧农场附近的陷阱里。

travel.example: I want to travel to Japan with my family next summer.
travel.exampleZh: 我想明年夏天和家人一起去日本旅行。

tray.example: She put the cups on a tray and carried them to the table.
tray.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在托盘上，端到了桌边。

treason.example: He was arrested and charged with treason against the king.
treason.exampleZh: 他遭到逮捕，并被指控犯有叛国罪，背叛了国王。

treasure.example: She treasures the old letters from her grandmother.
treasure.exampleZh: 她珍视祖母写给她的那些旧信。

treat.example: She treats her students kindly and often brings them small treats.
treat.exampleZh: 她善待学生，还常常给他们带些小零食。

treatment.example: The doctor gave him a new treatment for his back pain.
treatment.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种治疗背痛的新疗法。

treaty.example: The two countries signed a peace treaty last year.
treaty.exampleZh: 这两个国家去年签署了一项和平条约。

tree.example: There is a big tree in front of my house.

tremble.example: Her hands tremble with cold as she waits for the bus.
tremble.exampleZh: 她在等公交车时，双手冻得发抖。

tremendous.example: The new bridge is a tremendous help to people in our small town.
tremendous.exampleZh: 这座新桥对我们小镇上的人来说是极大的帮助。

trend.example: The trend of working from home is becoming more common these days.
trend.exampleZh: 如今，居家办公的趋势正变得越来越普遍。

trial.example: The new medicine is still in a trial and doctors watch every patient closely.
trial.exampleZh: 这种新药仍在试验中，医生密切观察每一位病人。

triangle.example: The teacher asked us to draw a triangle on the paper.
triangle.exampleZh: 老师让我们在纸上画一个三角形。

trick.example: He used a clever trick to open the locked door quickly.
trick.exampleZh: 他用了一个巧妙的窍门很快打开了那扇锁着的门。

trifle.example: Do not waste your time on such a trifle today.
trifle.exampleZh: 今天不要把时间浪费在这样的小事上。

trigger.example: The loud noise can trigger a headache in some people.
trigger.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音可能会让一些人头痛。

trim.example: She used small scissors to trim the paper flowers for the party.
trim.exampleZh: 她用一把小剪刀把纸花修剪好，准备用于聚会。

trip.example: We took a long trip to the mountains last summer.
trip.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们去山里进行了一次长途旅行。

triple.example: The company plans to triple its sales in the next five years.
triple.exampleZh: 公司计划在未来五年内将销售额增至三倍。

triumph.example: After years of hard work, she finally achieved a great triumph.
triumph.exampleZh: 经过多年的努力，她终于取得了巨大的成功。

trolley.example: He put the heavy boxes on a trolley and pushed it to the door.
trolley.exampleZh: 他把沉重的箱子放在手推车上，推到了门口。

troop.example: The troop marched slowly along the dusty road toward the small town.
troop.exampleZh: 部队沿着尘土飞扬的道路缓慢地向小镇行进。

tropic.example: The sun is very hot in the tropics all year round.
tropic.exampleZh: 热带地区一年到头阳光都很强烈。

tropical.example: Tropical fruit like mangoes and bananas grow well in hot, wet places.
tropical.exampleZh: 芒果和香蕉等热带水果在炎热潮湿的地方生长得很好。

trouble.example: I have trouble with my old computer, so I asked my friend for help.
trouble.exampleZh: 我的旧电脑出了问题，所以我向朋友求助。

troublesome.example: This old computer is troublesome and often stops working during class.
troublesome.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑很麻烦，上课时经常停止工作。

trousers.example: He put on his new black trousers and a clean white shirt before work.
trousers.exampleZh: 上班前，他穿上了他的新黑色长裤和一件干净的白衬衫。

truck.example: The truck is full of boxes for the new store.
truck.exampleZh: 这辆卡车上装满了给新商店的箱子。

true.example: It is true that she works very hard every day.
true.exampleZh: 她每天都非常努力地工作，这是真的。

truly.example: She is truly happy to see her old friends again.
truly.exampleZh: 再次见到老朋友，她真的非常高兴。

trumpet.example: He plays the trumpet in the school band every Friday.
trumpet.exampleZh: 他每周五在学校乐队里吹小号。

trunk.example: The old tree has a thick trunk and many green leaves.
trunk.exampleZh: 这棵老树有一个粗壮的树干和许多绿叶。

trust.example: I trust my best friend with all my secrets.
trust.exampleZh: 我把我所有的秘密都托付给我最好的朋友。

truth.example: She always tells the truth, even when it is hard.
truth.exampleZh: 她总是说真话，即使这很难。

try.example: I will try my best to finish the work today.
try.exampleZh: 我会尽最大努力今天完成这项工作。

tube.example: The scientist put a few drops of water into a glass tube.
tube.exampleZh: 科学家把几滴水滴入一根玻璃试管中。

tuck.example: She tucked the small note into her coat pocket.
tuck.exampleZh: 她把那张小纸条塞进了大衣口袋里。

tuesday.example: We will have a math test next Tuesday morning.
tuesday.exampleZh: 我们下星期二上午将有一场数学考试。

tuition.example: Her parents pay the tuition so she can study at a good school.
tuition.exampleZh: 她的父母支付学费，好让她能在一所好学校读书。

tulip.example: She planted red tulips in her garden last spring.
tulip.exampleZh: 去年春天她在花园里种了红色的郁金香。

tumble.example: He lost his balance and tumbled down the stairs.
tumble.exampleZh: 他失去平衡，从楼梯上摔了下来。

tune.example: The singer changed the tune of the song to make it happier.
tune.exampleZh: 歌手改变了这首歌的曲调，让它听起来更欢快。

tunnel.example: The train goes through a long tunnel under the mountain.
tunnel.exampleZh: 火车穿过山下一段长长的隧道。

turkey.example: We cooked a big turkey for dinner on Thanksgiving Day.
turkey.exampleZh: 我们在感恩节晚餐时煮了一只大火鸡。

turn.example: Please turn left at the next corner and wait for me.
turn.exampleZh: 请在下一个拐角左转，然后等我。

turnover.example: The company's annual turnover grew by ten percent last year.
turnover.exampleZh: 公司去年的年营业额增长了百分之十。

tutor.example: She asked her tutor to help with the difficult math homework.
tutor.exampleZh: 她请她的导师帮忙做那道难的数学作业。

twelve.example: My sister is twelve years old and she loves to read books.
twelve.exampleZh: 我妹妹十二岁，她喜欢读书。

twenty.example: There are twenty students in my class this year.
twenty.exampleZh: 今年我们班有二十名学生。

twice.example: I read the letter twice before I answered it.
twice.exampleZh: 我把信读了两遍才回复。

twin.example: My twin sister and I look the same, but we like different things.
twin.exampleZh: 我的双胞胎姐姐和我长得一样，但我们喜欢不同的东西。

twist.example: She had to twist the lid hard to open the jar.
twist.exampleZh: 她不得不使劲拧盖子才能打开罐子。

two.example: The table has two chairs and a small lamp on it.
two.exampleZh: 桌子上有两把椅子和一盏小灯。

type.example: What type of music do you like to listen to?
type.exampleZh: 你喜欢听哪种类型的音乐？

typewriter.example: My grandfather still keeps an old typewriter on his desk.
typewriter.exampleZh: 我爷爷的书桌上还放着一台旧打字机。

typhoon.example: The typhoon hit the small island and destroyed many houses.
typhoon.exampleZh: 台风袭击了这座小岛，摧毁了许多房屋。

typical.example: This is a typical day in the life of a busy teacher.
typical.exampleZh: 这是一位忙碌教师生活中典型的一天。

typist.example: The typist finished the long report before lunch.
typist.exampleZh: 打字员在午饭前完成了那份长报告。

tyranny.example: The people rose up against the tyranny of the old king.
tyranny.exampleZh: 人民奋起反抗旧国王的暴政。

ugly.example: That old building looks very ugly next to the new park.
ugly.exampleZh: 那座旧楼在新公园旁边显得很难看。

ultimate.example: Winning the gold medal was her ultimate goal after years of hard training.
ultimate.exampleZh: 经过多年刻苦训练，赢得金牌是她最终的目标。

ultraviolet.example: Too much ultraviolet light from the sun can hurt your skin.
ultraviolet.exampleZh: 来自太阳的过多紫外线会伤害你的皮肤。

umbrella.example: I took my umbrella with me because the sky looked very dark.
umbrella.exampleZh: 我带上了雨伞，因为天空看起来很暗。

uncle.example: My uncle lives in a small town and often visits us.
uncle.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在一个小镇上，他经常来看我们。

uncover.example: The police worked for months to uncover the truth about the missing money.
uncover.exampleZh: 警方花了几个月时间，才揭开了那笔失踪钱款的真相。

under.example: The cat is sleeping under the table in the kitchen.
under.exampleZh: 猫正在厨房的桌子下面睡觉。

undergo.example: She had to undergo surgery after the accident last year.
undergo.exampleZh: 去年那场事故后，她不得不接受手术。

undergraduate.example: My brother is an undergraduate at a large university in Beijing.
undergraduate.exampleZh: 我哥哥是北京一所大型大学的本科生。

underground.example: The underground train is fast and cheap, so many people take it to work.
underground.exampleZh: 地铁又快又便宜，所以很多人乘它上班。

underline.example: Please underline the important words in this short text.
underline.exampleZh: 请在这篇短文中给重要的词划线。

underneath.example: The cat is hiding underneath the old wooden table in the kitchen.
underneath.exampleZh: 那只猫正躲在厨房里那张旧木桌下面。

understand.example: I understand the question, but I need more time to answer it.
understand.exampleZh: 我理解这个问题，但我需要更多时间来回答。

understanding.example: Her understanding of the problem helped the whole team find a simple solution.
understanding.exampleZh: 她对问题的理解帮助整个团队找到了一个简单的解决办法。

undertake.example: She agreed to undertake the difficult task alone this year.
undertake.exampleZh: 她同意今年独自承担这项艰难的任务。

undo.example: He had to undo the buttons on his coat before sitting down.
undo.exampleZh: 他坐下前不得不解开外套上的扣子。

undoubtedly.example: She is undoubtedly the best player on our team this year.
undoubtedly.exampleZh: 她无疑是我们队今年最好的球员。

uneasy.example: She felt uneasy about walking home alone in the dark.
uneasy.exampleZh: 她独自在黑暗中走回家感到不安。

unemployment.example: The unemployment rate in our city rose last year.
unemployment.exampleZh: 我们城市的失业率去年上升了。

unexpected.example: The unexpected rain ruined our picnic in the park.
unexpected.exampleZh: 这场突如其来的雨毁了我们在公园的野餐。

unfair.example: It is unfair to blame him for the mistake.
unfair.exampleZh: 因为这个错误而责怪他是不公平的。

unfit.example: He is unfit for this job because he has no experience.
unfit.exampleZh: 他不胜任这份工作，因为他没有经验。

unfold.example: She began to unfold the old map on the table.
unfold.exampleZh: 她开始在桌上展开那张旧地图。

unfortunate.example: It is unfortunate that we lost the game on the last minute.
unfortunate.exampleZh: 很遗憾，我们在最后一分钟输掉了比赛。

unhappy.example: She was unhappy because her best friend moved to another city.
unhappy.exampleZh: 她很不快乐，因为她最好的朋友搬到了另一座城市。

uniform.example: Every student in our school wears a uniform on Monday.
uniform.exampleZh: 我们学校的每个学生星期一都穿校服。

union.example: The workers formed a union to ask for better pay.
union.exampleZh: 工人们成立了一个工会，要求更好的薪酬。

unique.example: Every person has a unique story to tell.
unique.exampleZh: 每个人都有自己独特的故事要讲。

unit.example: Each unit of the book has a short test at the end.
unit.exampleZh: 这本书的每个单元末尾都有一个简短的测验。

unite.example: The two small teams will unite to finish the big project on time.
unite.exampleZh: 两个小团队将联合起来按时完成这个大项目。

unity.example: The team showed great unity during the difficult project.
unity.exampleZh: 团队在这个困难的项目中表现出了极大的团结。

universal.example: Music is a universal language that brings people together.
universal.exampleZh: 音乐是一种把人们联系在一起的通用语言。

universe.example: Scientists study the universe to understand how stars and planets form.
universe.exampleZh: 科学家研究宇宙，以了解恒星和行星是如何形成的。

university.example: She studies English at a large university near her home.
university.exampleZh: 她在家附近的一所大型大学学习英语。

unless.example: You cannot go out unless you finish your homework first.
unless.exampleZh: 除非你先完成作业，否则不能出去。

unlike.example: Unlike her sister, she likes quiet books and long walks.
unlike.exampleZh: 和她姐姐不同，她喜欢安静的书和长时间的散步。

unlikely.example: It is unlikely that he will come to school today.
unlikely.exampleZh: 他今天不太可能来学校了。

unload.example: The workers will unload the boxes from the truck at noon.
unload.exampleZh: 工人们将在中午从卡车上卸下这些箱子。

until.example: Wait here until I come back with the keys.
until.exampleZh: 在这里等着，直到我拿着钥匙回来。

unusual.example: It is unusual to see snow in this city in summer.
unusual.exampleZh: 在这座城市，夏天看到雪是很不寻常的。

up.example: The little boy looked up and saw a bird in the sky.
up.exampleZh: 小男孩抬起头，看到天空中有一只鸟。

up-to-date.example: This website keeps its news up-to-date every morning.
up-to-date.exampleZh: 这个网站每天早上都会更新它的新闻。

update.example: Please update your address on the form before you send it to us.
update.exampleZh: 寄给我们之前，请先在表格上更新你的地址。

upgrade.example: The company plans to upgrade its computer system next month.
upgrade.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月升级其计算机系统。

upon.example: She placed the book upon the small wooden table by the window.
upon.exampleZh: 她把书放在窗边那张小木桌上。

upper.example: The books are on the upper shelf near the window.
upper.exampleZh: 书在靠窗的上层架子上。

upset.example: The bad news made her very upset, and she could not sleep last night.
upset.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让她非常心烦，昨晚她睡不着觉。

upstairs.example: My bedroom is upstairs, and I go upstairs to sleep every night.
upstairs.exampleZh: 我的卧室在楼上，我每天晚上都上楼睡觉。

upward.example: She looked upward at the tall tree and smiled.
upward.exampleZh: 她向上望着那棵高树，笑了。

urban.example: The urban area has many shops and buses for people to use.
urban.exampleZh: 城区里有许多商店和公交车供人们使用。

urge.example: I urge you to call your parents tonight and tell them the good news.
urge.exampleZh: 我劝你今晚给父母打个电话，告诉他们这个好消息。

urgent.example: The doctor said this is urgent, so we must act now.
urgent.exampleZh: 医生说这很紧急，所以我们必须马上行动。

us.example: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework today.
us.exampleZh: 老师今天给我们布置了很多作业。

use.example: We use this small room as a study.
use.exampleZh: 我们把这个小房间用作书房。

used.example: I am used to getting up early for school every day.
used.exampleZh: 我习惯了每天早起上学。

useful.example: This small dictionary is very useful for learning new English words.
useful.exampleZh: 这本小词典对学习新的英语单词非常有用。

useless.example: This old phone is useless because it cannot connect to the internet.
useless.exampleZh: 这部旧手机毫无用处，因为它无法连接网络。

user.example: Every user must create a password before using the new system.
user.exampleZh: 每位用户在使用新系统前都必须创建一个密码。

usual.example: I took the usual bus to school this morning.
usual.exampleZh: 今天早上我坐了平时那班公交车去学校。

usually.example: I usually walk to school with my best friend.
usually.exampleZh: 我通常和我最好的朋友一起走路去学校。

utility.example: This simple tool has great utility for daily household repairs.
utility.exampleZh: 这个简单的工具在日常家居修理中很有实用价值。

utilize.example: We can utilize the old boxes to store our books.
utilize.exampleZh: 我们可以利用这些旧箱子来存放我们的书。

utmost.example: She listened to the doctor with the utmost care and asked several questions.
utmost.exampleZh: 她极其认真地听医生说话，并问了几个问题。

utter.example: She did not utter a single word during the whole meeting.
utter.exampleZh: 整个会议期间她一句话也没说。

vacant.example: The seat next to me was vacant, so I sat there alone.
vacant.exampleZh: 我旁边的座位是空的，所以我就一个人坐在那里。

vacation.example: We plan to take a long vacation after the busy season.
vacation.exampleZh: 忙碌的季节过后，我们打算休一个长假。

vacuum.example: The vacuum in space is silent and cold.
vacuum.exampleZh: 太空中的真空是寂静而寒冷的。

vague.example: His answer was vague and did not help us at all.
vague.exampleZh: 他的回答很含糊，对我们一点帮助也没有。

vain.example: He was too vain to admit that his hard work was in vain.
vain.exampleZh: 他太自负了，不肯承认自己的努力是徒劳的。

valid.example: Your ticket is valid for one week after the day you buy it.
valid.exampleZh: 你的票在购买当天之后一周内有效。

valley.example: A small river runs through the valley near our village.
valley.exampleZh: 一条小河穿过我们村庄附近的山谷。

valuable.example: This old watch is very valuable to my family.
valuable.exampleZh: 这块旧手表对我的家人来说非常珍贵。

value.example: She knows the value of hard work and saves her money carefully.
value.exampleZh: 她懂得努力的重要价值，也很小心地存钱。

van.example: The workers loaded the boxes into a white van and drove away.
van.exampleZh: 工人们把箱子装进一辆白色厢式货车，然后开走了。

vanish.example: The dark clouds vanished quickly and the bright sun came out.
vanish.exampleZh: 乌云很快散去，明亮的太阳出来了。

vanity.example: Her vanity made her spend hours looking in the mirror every day.
vanity.exampleZh: 她的虚荣心让她每天花好几个小时照镜子。

vapor.example: Thick white vapor rose from the hot water and filled the small room.
vapor.exampleZh: 浓浓的白雾从热水中升起，弥漫了整个小房间。

variable.example: The weather here is variable, so bring a jacket and an umbrella.
variable.exampleZh: 这里的天气变化无常，所以带上一件夹克和一把伞。

variation.example: There is a small variation in the price each week.
variation.exampleZh: 每周价格都会有一点小幅变动。

variety.example: This shop sells a wide variety of fresh fruit and vegetables.
variety.exampleZh: 这家商店出售种类繁多的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

various.example: The store sells various kinds of fruit, such as apples and oranges.
various.exampleZh: 这家店卖各种各样的水果，比如苹果和橙子。

vary.example: Prices vary from store to store, so you should compare them.
vary.exampleZh: 各个商店的价格各不相同，所以你应该比较一下。

vast.example: The vast desert stretches for miles and has no trees at all.
vast.exampleZh: 这片广阔的沙漠绵延数英里，完全没有树木。

vegetable.example: My mother buys fresh vegetables at the market every Sunday morning.
vegetable.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天早上都在市场买新鲜蔬菜。

vehicle.example: His car is the only vehicle on this quiet country road.
vehicle.exampleZh: 他的车是这条安静的乡间小路上唯一的车辆。

venture.example: He decided to venture into a new business last year.
venture.exampleZh: 去年他决定冒险进入一个新的行业。

verb.example: In this sentence, the word "run" is a verb.
verb.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，单词“run”是一个动词。

verify.example: Please verify the number before you call him.
verify.exampleZh: 打电话给他之前，请核实一下这个号码。

version.example: This new version of the app is faster and easier to use.
version.exampleZh: 这个新版本的应用程序更快，也更易于使用。

vertical.example: The tall tree has a long vertical line down its trunk.
vertical.exampleZh: 那棵高树的树干上有一条长长的垂直线。

very.example: This is the very book I need for my class.
very.exampleZh: 这正是我上课需要的那本书。

vessel.example: The small vessel sailed across the calm sea this morning.
vessel.exampleZh: 今天早上，那艘小船驶过了平静的海面。

veteran.example: The veteran told us stories about his life in the army.
veteran.exampleZh: 这位老兵给我们讲了他军旅生活的故事。

via.example: We sent the letter to her via email yesterday.
via.exampleZh: 我们昨天通过电子邮件把那封信寄给了她。

vibrate.example: The phone began to vibrate loudly on the wooden table.
vibrate.exampleZh: 手机在木桌上开始大声振动起来。

vice.example: Greed is a common vice that can hurt the people around you.
vice.exampleZh: 贪婪是一种常见的恶习，会伤害你身边的人。

vicinity.example: There are several small shops in the vicinity of our new house.
vicinity.exampleZh: 我们新房子附近有几家小商店。

vicious.example: The vicious dog chased the children away from the gate.
vicious.exampleZh: 那只凶恶的狗把孩子们从大门边赶走了。

victim.example: The victim of the accident was taken to the hospital by ambulance.
victim.exampleZh: 事故的受害者被救护车送往医院。

victory.example: The whole team celebrated a great victory after the long game.
victory.exampleZh: 比赛结束后，全队庆祝了一场伟大的胜利。

video.example: She watched a short video about wild animals on her phone.
video.exampleZh: 她在手机上观看了一段关于野生动物的短视频。

view.example: From the top of the hill, we enjoyed a beautiful view of the lake.
view.exampleZh: 从山顶上，我们欣赏到了湖泊的美丽景色。

viewpoint.example: From my viewpoint, this plan is simple and easy to follow.
viewpoint.exampleZh: 在我看来，这个计划简单易懂。

vigorous.example: He is a vigorous old man who walks five miles every morning.
vigorous.exampleZh: 他是个精力充沛的老人，每天早上走五英里。

village.example: The small village is quiet and peaceful in the early morning.
village.exampleZh: 这个小村庄在清晨安静而平和。

vinegar.example: She added a little vinegar to the salad for a sour taste.
vinegar.exampleZh: 她往沙拉里加了一点醋，增添酸味。

violate.example: Drivers who violate traffic rules may lose their license.
violate.exampleZh: 违反交通规则的司机可能会被吊销驾照。

violence.example: The school teaches children to solve problems without violence.
violence.exampleZh: 学校教导孩子们不用暴力解决问题。

violent.example: The violent storm broke many windows in our small town last night.
violent.exampleZh: 昨晚这场猛烈的暴风雨打破了我们小镇上的许多窗户。

violet.example: She put a small violet in the glass and smiled at me.
violet.exampleZh: 她把一朵小紫罗兰放进玻璃杯里，对我笑了笑。

violin.example: My sister plays the violin every day after school.
violin.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天放学后拉小提琴。

virtual.example: She has become the virtual leader of the team, but she has no official title.
virtual.exampleZh: 她实际上已经成了团队的领导者，但并没有正式的职位头衔。

virtually.example: The two pictures look virtually the same to me.
virtually.exampleZh: 这两张图片在我看来几乎一模一样。

virtue.example: Her greatest virtue is that she is always honest with everyone.
virtue.exampleZh: 她最大的美德是总是对每个人都很诚实。

virus.example: The virus made many people in our town very sick last winter.
virus.exampleZh: 去年冬天，这种病毒让我们镇上很多人病得很重。

visible.example: The mountain is clearly visible from my bedroom window every morning.
visible.exampleZh: 每天早上从我家卧室窗户都能清楚地看到那座山。

vision.example: His vision is very poor, so he must wear thick glasses every day.
vision.exampleZh: 他的视力很差，所以他每天都必须戴厚厚的眼镜。

visit.example: I visit my grandmother every Sunday, and we walk in the park.
visit.exampleZh: 我每个星期天都去看望我的祖母，然后我们在公园里散步。

visual.example: The museum has a strong visual design that children love.
visual.exampleZh: 这家博物馆有强烈的视觉设计，孩子们很喜欢。

vital.example: Clean water is vital for every living thing on Earth.
vital.exampleZh: 干净的水对地球上每一个生物都至关重要。

vitamin.example: Oranges and carrots are good sources of vitamin C for your body.
vitamin.exampleZh: 橙子和胡萝卜是你身体获取维生素C的良好来源。

vivid.example: She gave a vivid description of the small village where she grew up.
vivid.exampleZh: 她生动地描述了自己长大的那个小村庄。

vocabulary.example: Reading every day is a good way to build your vocabulary.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 每天阅读是扩大词汇量的好方法。

voice.example: She has a soft voice and always speaks kindly to everyone.
voice.exampleZh: 她的嗓音很轻柔，总是对每个人都很友善地说话。

volume.example: Please turn down the volume of the music a little.
volume.exampleZh: 请把音乐的音量调小一点。

voluntary.example: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter every Saturday morning.
voluntary.exampleZh: 她每周六上午在动物收容所做志愿工作。

volunteer.example: Many volunteers help clean the park every Sunday morning.
volunteer.exampleZh: 许多志愿者每周日早上帮忙打扫公园。

vote.example: In the end, most people voted for the younger candidate.
vote.exampleZh: 最后，大多数人投票给了那位较年轻的候选人。

voyage.example: The voyage across the ocean took three long weeks.
voyage.exampleZh: 这次横渡大洋的航行花了整整三个星期。

vulgar.example: He told a vulgar joke that made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
vulgar.exampleZh: 他讲了一个粗俗的笑话，让在座的每个人都感到不舒服。

wage.example: The workers asked for a higher wage and better working conditions.
wage.exampleZh: 工人们要求更高的工资和更好的工作条件。

waist.example: The water came up to her waist as she walked across the river.
waist.exampleZh: 她走过河时，水没到了她的腰部。

wait.example: We have to wait for the bus every morning.
wait.exampleZh: 我们每天早上都得等公交车。

waiter.example: The waiter brought us two cups of hot coffee.
waiter.exampleZh: 那位男服务员给我们端来了两杯热咖啡。

wake.example: I usually wake at six, but my alarm often wakes the whole family.
wake.exampleZh: 我通常六点醒来，但我的闹钟常把全家人都吵醒。

walk.example: We walk to school together every morning.
walk.exampleZh: 我们每天早上一起步行去学校。

wall.example: There is a small picture on the wall next to my bed.
wall.exampleZh: 我床边的墙上挂着一张小图片。

wallet.example: I left my wallet on the table in the kitchen this morning.
wallet.exampleZh: 今天早上我把钱包落在了厨房的桌子上。

wander.example: I like to wander along the river after dinner.
wander.exampleZh: 我喜欢晚饭后沿着河边漫步。

want.example: I want a cup of hot tea after work today.
want.exampleZh: 今天下班后我想要一杯热茶。

war.example: The long war finally ended and the people went home.
war.exampleZh: 这场漫长的战争终于结束，人们回到了家中。

warm.example: Her warm smile made everyone feel welcome at the party.
warm.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑让派对上的每个人都感到亲切。

warmth.example: Her warmth made every new student feel at home.
warmth.exampleZh: 她的热情让每一位新生都感到宾至如归。

warn.example: The teacher warned the students to stay away from the busy road.
warn.exampleZh: 老师警告学生们远离那条繁忙的马路。

warning.example: The weather service issued a warning about the coming storm.
warning.exampleZh: 气象部门发布了关于即将到来的暴风雨的警告。

warrant.example: The police had a warrant to search his house for stolen goods.
warrant.exampleZh: 警方持有一张搜查令，要搜查他的房子以寻找赃物。

wash.example: I need to wash my hands before I eat dinner.

waste.example: Don't waste your time on things you cannot change.
waste.exampleZh: 不要把时间浪费在你无法改变的事情上。

watch.example: I like to watch the birds in the park after school.
watch.exampleZh: 放学后我喜欢在公园里观看鸟儿。

water.example: Please give me a glass of water, and water the plants before you go.
water.exampleZh: 请给我一杯水，走之前给植物浇浇水。

waterproof.example: This waterproof jacket keeps you dry even in heavy rain.
waterproof.exampleZh: 这件防水夹克即使在暴雨中也能让你保持干爽。

watt.example: This small lamp only needs a ten watt bulb to give enough light.
watt.exampleZh: 这盏小灯只需要一个十瓦的灯泡就能提供足够的光。

wave.example: She gave me a friendly wave and walked toward the door.
wave.exampleZh: 她友好地朝我挥了挥手，然后朝门口走去。

wax.example: She put wax on the old wooden table to make it shine.
wax.exampleZh: 她给那张旧木桌打蜡，让它发亮。

way.example: Can you show me the way to the train station?
way.exampleZh: 你能告诉我去火车站的路吗？

we.example: We go to school together every morning by bus.
we.exampleZh: 我们每天早上一起坐公交车去学校。

weak.example: He felt weak after the long walk in the hot sun.
weak.exampleZh: 在烈日下走了很久之后，他感到虚弱。

weaken.example: Too much worry can weaken your body and make you tired.
weaken.exampleZh: 过多的忧虑会削弱你的身体，让你感到疲惫。

weakness.example: Everyone has a weakness, and mine is sweet food after dinner.
weakness.exampleZh: 每个人都有弱点，而我的弱点是晚饭后爱吃甜食。

wealth.example: His wealth comes from years of hard work and careful saving.
wealth.exampleZh: 他的财富来自多年的辛勤工作和谨慎储蓄。

wealthy.example: The wealthy man bought a big house for his family.
wealthy.exampleZh: 这位富有的男士为家人买了一座大房子。

weapon.example: The police found a weapon hidden in the man's car.
weapon.exampleZh: 警方在该男子的车里发现了一件藏起来的武器。

wear.example: She likes to wear a blue dress to work every day.
wear.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天穿一条蓝色连衣裙去上班。

weather.example: The weather is nice today, so we can go outside and play.
weather.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，我们可以出去玩了。

weave.example: She can weave a beautiful basket from dry grass in one afternoon.
weave.exampleZh: 她能用干草在一个下午编出一个漂亮的篮子。

web.example: The spider made a web between two trees in the garden.
web.exampleZh: 蜘蛛在花园里的两棵树之间结了一张网。

wedding.example: Their wedding was small, but all of their closest friends came.
wedding.exampleZh: 他们的婚礼很小，但所有最亲近的朋友都来了。

wednesday.example: We have a math test next Wednesday morning at nine.
wednesday.exampleZh: 我们下周三上午九点有一场数学考试。

week.example: I will visit my grandmother next week.
week.exampleZh: 我下周会去看望我的祖母。

weekday.example: I get up early on every weekday to catch the bus.
weekday.exampleZh: 每个工作日我都早起去赶公交车。

weekend.example: I usually visit my grandparents on the weekend.
weekend.exampleZh: 我通常在周末去看望我的祖父母。

weekly.example: She reads a weekly magazine and goes to a weekly meeting every Monday.
weekly.exampleZh: 她读一本周刊，并且每周一参加一次每周例会。

weep.example: She began to weep when she heard the sad news about her old friend.
weep.exampleZh: 当她听到关于老朋友的悲伤消息时，她开始哭泣。

weigh.example: Please weigh the bag before you take it on the plane.
weigh.exampleZh: 上飞机前请称一下这个包的重量。

weight.example: The weight of this box is too heavy for me to lift.
weight.exampleZh: 这个箱子的重量太重了，我搬不动。

welcome.example: We always give a warm welcome to new students at our school.
welcome.exampleZh: 我们学校总是热情欢迎新同学。

weld.example: The workers weld the metal parts together to make a strong frame.
weld.exampleZh: 工人们把金属零件焊接在一起，做成一个坚固的框架。

welfare.example: The government should spend more money on the welfare of children.
welfare.exampleZh: 政府应该在儿童福利上投入更多资金。

well.example: He sings well, feels well today, and gets water from the old well.
well.exampleZh: 他歌唱得好，今天身体感觉不错，还从老井里打水。

well-known.example: This well-known writer has many young readers around the world.
well-known.exampleZh: 这位著名的作家在世界各地有很多年轻读者。

west.example: The sun goes down in the west every evening.
west.exampleZh: 太阳每天傍晚在西方落下。

western.example: Western food is quite different from Chinese food, but many people enjoy it.
western.exampleZh: 西餐与中国菜很不一样，但很多人喜欢西餐。

wet.example: Her hair is still wet because she hurried out in the rain.
wet.exampleZh: 她的头发还是湿的，因为她冒雨匆匆出门了。

whale.example: We saw a big whale swimming slowly near the boat this morning.
whale.exampleZh: 今天早上我们看到一头大鲸鱼在船边慢慢地游。

what.example: What do you want to eat for lunch today?

whatever.example: Whatever you choose, I will support you all the way.
whatever.exampleZh: 无论你选择什么，我都会一路支持你。

wheat.example: My mother buys wheat flour to make bread for our family.
wheat.exampleZh: 我妈妈买小麦面粉来为我们家做面包。

wheel.example: The front wheel of my bike is flat, so I must walk home.
wheel.exampleZh: 我自行车的前轮瘪了，所以我只能走回家。

when.example: I called her when I got home from work.
when.exampleZh: 我下班回到家时给她打了个电话。

whenever.example: You can call me whenever you need help with your homework.
whenever.exampleZh: 每当你做作业需要帮助时，都可以给我打电话。

where.example: I don't know where my keys are.
where.exampleZh: 我不知道我的钥匙在哪里。

whereas.example: I like tea, whereas my brother prefers coffee.
whereas.exampleZh: 我喜欢茶，而我弟弟更喜欢咖啡。

wherever.example: You can sit wherever you like in this big room.
wherever.exampleZh: 在这个大房间里，你想坐哪里就坐哪里。

whether.example: I don't know whether he will come to the party tonight.
whether.exampleZh: 我不知道他今晚是否会来参加聚会。

which.example: Which color do you like best, the blue one or the red one?
which.exampleZh: 你最喜欢哪一个颜色，蓝色的还是红色的？

whichever.example: You can take whichever of these two books you like.
whichever.exampleZh: 这两本书中你喜欢哪一本就拿哪一本。

while.example: I read a book while my mother cooked dinner in the kitchen.
while.exampleZh: 我妈妈在厨房做晚饭的时候，我在看书。

whip.example: The farmer used a long whip to drive the cows home.
whip.exampleZh: 农夫用一条长鞭子把奶牛赶回家。

whisper.example: She leaned over to whisper a secret in my ear.
whisper.exampleZh: 她俯身在我耳边低语了一个秘密。

whistle.example: The referee blew his whistle and the players stopped running.
whistle.exampleZh: 裁判吹响了哨子，球员们停止了奔跑。

white.example: She wore a white dress and carried a small white bag.
white.exampleZh: 她穿了一条白裙子，还拿着一个白色的小包。

who.example: I want to know who will help us with this work today.
who.exampleZh: 我想知道今天谁会帮我们做这项工作。

whoever.example: Whoever wants to join the game should sign their name here.
whoever.exampleZh: 无论是谁想参加这个游戏，都应该在这里签名。

whole.example: She ate the whole cake by herself last night.
whole.exampleZh: 她昨晚一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。

whom.example: Whom did you meet at the station yesterday morning?
whom.exampleZh: 你昨天早上在车站见到了谁？

whose.example: I have a friend whose father works in a big hospital.
whose.exampleZh: 我有一个朋友，他的父亲在一家大医院工作。

why.example: I do not know why she is so sad today.
why.exampleZh: 我不知道她今天为什么这么难过。

wicked.example: The wicked witch in the story tried to steal the children's magic map.
wicked.exampleZh: 故事里那个邪恶的女巫想偷走孩子们的魔法地图。

wide.example: The river is very wide here, so we cannot swim across it.
wide.exampleZh: 这条河在这里非常宽，所以我们游不过去。

widen.example: They plan to widen the road next year.
widen.exampleZh: 他们计划明年加宽这条路。

widespread.example: The use of smartphones is widespread among young people today.
widespread.exampleZh: 如今，智能手机的使用在年轻人中非常普遍。

width.example: The width of the table is one meter.
width.exampleZh: 这张桌子的宽度是一米。

wife.example: My wife cooks dinner for our family every evening after work.
wife.exampleZh: 我妻子每天下班后都为家人做晚饭。

wild.example: The wild horses run across the open field every morning.
wild.exampleZh: 那些野马每天早上都跑过开阔的田野。

wildlife.example: We must protect the wildlife in this forest and keep it safe.
wildlife.exampleZh: 我们必须保护这片森林里的野生动物，让它们安全生活。

will.example: I will call you tomorrow, but my will is not strong.
will.exampleZh: 我明天会给你打电话，不过我的意志并不坚定。

willing.example: I am willing to help you with your homework tonight.
willing.exampleZh: 我愿意今晚帮你做作业。

win.example: Our team hopes to win the game and make everyone happy.
win.exampleZh: 我们队希望赢得这场比赛，让每个人都开心。

wind.example: The strong wind blew my hat off while I was walking home.
wind.exampleZh: 我走回家时，一阵大风吹掉了我的帽子。

window.example: She opened the window to let some fresh air into the room.
window.exampleZh: 她打开窗户，让新鲜空气进入房间。

wine.example: My father drinks a glass of red wine with dinner every evening.
wine.exampleZh: 我父亲每天晚上吃饭时喝一杯红葡萄酒。

wing.example: The bird hurt one wing and could not fly for a few days.
wing.exampleZh: 这只鸟伤了一只翅膀，好几天不能飞。

winner.example: The winner of the race smiled and thanked all his friends.
winner.exampleZh: 比赛的获胜者微笑着感谢他所有的朋友。

winter.example: I wear a warm coat and gloves every winter.
winter.exampleZh: 每年冬天我都穿暖和的外套，戴手套。

wipe.example: Please wipe the table after you finish eating your lunch.
wipe.exampleZh: 吃完午饭后请把桌子擦一下。

wire.example: The worker used a long piece of wire to tie the box.
wire.exampleZh: 工人用一根长金属丝把箱子捆了起来。

wisdom.example: My grandmother's wisdom helped me solve the problem.
wisdom.exampleZh: 奶奶的智慧帮我解决了这个问题。

wise.example: It is wise to check the weather before you go hiking.
wise.exampleZh: 在去远足之前查看天气是明智的。

wish.example: I wish you good luck with your new job.
wish.exampleZh: 我祝你在新工作中一切顺利。

wit.example: Her quick wit made the long meeting feel much shorter.
wit.exampleZh: 她的机智让漫长的会议感觉短了许多。

with.example: I often go to the park with my best friend.
with.exampleZh: 我经常和最好的朋友一起去公园。

withdraw.example: He decided to withdraw his money from the bank.
withdraw.exampleZh: 他决定从银行取出他的钱。

within.example: Please finish the report within three days.
within.exampleZh: 请在三天之内完成这份报告。

without.example: I cannot start my day without a cup of hot coffee.
without.exampleZh: 没有一杯热咖啡，我就无法开始新的一天。

witness.example: The witness told the police what he saw that night.
witness.exampleZh: 那名目击者把那天晚上看到的情况告诉了警察。

wolf.example: The wolf lives in the forest and hunts small animals at night.
wolf.exampleZh: 这只狼住在森林里，夜里捕猎小动物。

woman.example: The woman next door often helps my mother in the garden.
woman.exampleZh: 隔壁的那位妇女经常在花园里帮我母亲。

wonder.example: I wonder why the sky turns red at night.
wonder.exampleZh: 我想知道为什么天空在夜里会变红。

wonderful.example: It was a wonderful day, and we all had fun.
wonderful.exampleZh: 那是精彩的一天，我们都玩得很开心。

wood.example: The old table is made of wood from a big tree.
wood.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子是用一棵大树的木头做的。

wooden.example: The old man sat on a wooden chair and read the newspaper.
wooden.exampleZh: 那位老人坐在木制椅子上看报纸。

wool.example: This warm sweater is made of soft wool from our sheep.
wool.exampleZh: 这件暖和的毛衣是用我们养的羊身上的柔软羊毛做的。

word.example: I do not know the meaning of this word.
word.exampleZh: 我不知道这个单词的意思。

work.example: I work in a small office near my home.
work.exampleZh: 我在家附近的一间小办公室工作。
