worker.example: The worker in the factory starts his job at eight every morning.
worker.exampleZh: 这家工厂的工人每天早上八点开始工作。

workshop.example: Our teacher held a small workshop on how to write good stories.
workshop.exampleZh: 我们老师举办了一个关于如何写好故事的小型研讨会。

world.example: She wants to travel around the world after she finishes school.
world.exampleZh: 她想在完成学业后环游世界。

worldwide.example: The company sells its products worldwide and has offices in many countries.
worldwide.exampleZh: 这家公司在全世界销售产品，并在许多国家设有办事处。

worm.example: The early bird catches the worm every single morning.
worm.exampleZh: 早起的鸟儿每天早上都能捉到虫子。

worry.example: Don't worry about the test; you have studied hard all week.
worry.exampleZh: 别担心考试，你这一整周都很用功。

worse.example: My cold got worse last night, so I stayed home from school today.
worse.exampleZh: 昨晚我的感冒加重了，所以今天我待在家里没去上学。

worship.example: Many people go to the old temple to worship every Sunday morning.
worship.exampleZh: 许多人每个星期天早上都去那座古老的寺庙敬神。

worst.example: The worst part of the trip was the long wait at the airport.
worst.exampleZh: 这次旅行最糟糕的部分是在机场漫长的等待。

worth.example: This old book is worth much more than you might think.
worth.exampleZh: 这本旧书的价值比你可能想象的要高得多。

worthwhile.example: It is worthwhile to spend time with your family every weekend.
worthwhile.exampleZh: 每个周末花时间陪伴家人是值得的。

worthy.example: He is a worthy winner because he worked hard every day.
worthy.exampleZh: 他是一个配得上的赢家，因为他每天都努力付出。

would.example: I would like to visit your new house this weekend.
would.exampleZh: 这个周末我想去看看你的新房子。

wound.example: The doctor cleaned the wound on his leg and put a bandage on it.
wound.exampleZh: 医生清洗了他腿上的伤口，并给它缠上了绷带。

wrap.example: She will wrap the gift in red paper before the party.
wrap.exampleZh: 她会在聚会前用红纸把礼物包起来。

wreck.example: The storm wrecked the small boat near the rocks.
wreck.exampleZh: 暴风雨在岩石附近摧毁了那艘小船。

wrestle.example: The two boys wrestle with each other after school every day.
wrestle.exampleZh: 这两个男孩每天放学后都互相摔跤。

wretched.example: The wretched dog sat in the cold rain and waited for someone kind.
wretched.exampleZh: 那只可怜的狗坐在冷雨中，等待一个善良的人。

write.example: Please write your name at the top of the page.
write.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面顶部。

writer.example: The writer spent three years working on her first novel.
writer.exampleZh: 这位作家花了三年时间写她的第一部小说。

writing.example: Her writing is clear and easy to read.

wrong.example: It is wrong to tell lies to your friends.

x-axis.example: The graph shows time on the x-axis and money on the vertical line.
x-axis.exampleZh: 这张图的X轴表示时间，竖线表示金额。

x-ray.example: The doctor took an x-ray of my leg to see the broken bone.
x-ray.exampleZh: 医生给我的腿拍了X光片，看看骨折的地方。

xenon.example: The bright light in this lamp comes from xenon gas.
xenon.exampleZh: 这盏灯里的强光来自氙气。

xylene.example: The workers cleaned the paint brushes with xylene before starting the next job.
xylene.exampleZh: 工人们在开始下一项工作前用二甲苯清洗了油漆刷。

yacht.example: They took the yacht out on the lake for the whole afternoon.
yacht.exampleZh: 他们整个下午都开着游艇在湖上玩。

yam.example: My grandmother cooked yam soup for us on a cold winter night.
yam.exampleZh: 在一个寒冷的冬夜，奶奶为我们煮了山药汤。

yard.example: The children are playing football in the yard after school.
yard.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后在院子里踢足球。

yawn.example: The long meeting made everyone yawn and stretch in their chairs.
yawn.exampleZh: 漫长的会议让每个人都在椅子上打哈欠、伸懒腰。

year.example: My sister is ten years old and she likes to read books.
year.exampleZh: 我妹妹今年十岁，她喜欢读书。

yearly.example: We have a yearly meeting to talk about our work and plans.
yearly.exampleZh: 我们每年开一次会，讨论工作和计划。

yearn.example: After years abroad, she still yearns to see her family.
yearn.exampleZh: 在国外多年后，她仍然渴望见到家人。

yell.example: The coach began to yell at the players when they missed the easy shot.
yell.exampleZh: 当球员们错失那个简单的投篮时，教练开始对他们大喊。

yellow.example: The yellow flowers in our small garden look very beautiful in spring.
yellow.exampleZh: 我们小花园里的黄色花朵在春天看起来非常漂亮。

yes.example: Yes, I would like to have a cup of tea.

yesterday.example: My brother came to visit us yesterday and stayed for dinner.
yesterday.exampleZh: 我哥哥昨天来看我们，并留下来吃了晚饭。

yet.example: I have not finished my homework yet, yet I want to play outside.
yet.exampleZh: 我还没有完成作业，然而我想出去玩。

yield.example: The farm yields enough corn to feed all the animals in winter.
yield.exampleZh: 这个农场出产的玉米足够在冬天喂养所有牲畜。

yogurt.example: I eat yogurt with fresh fruit every morning before I go to work.
yogurt.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会吃酸奶配新鲜水果。

yoke.example: The two companies were joined under a common yoke of shared goals.
yoke.exampleZh: 这两家公司在共同目标的纽带下结合在了一起。

yolk.example: The yolk of the egg is bright yellow and full of vitamins.
yolk.exampleZh: 这个鸡蛋的蛋黄是亮黄色的，富含维生素。

you.example: You can learn English well if you practice a little every day.
you.exampleZh: 如果你每天练习一点，你就能把英语学好。

young.example: The young teacher helps her students after school every day.
young.exampleZh: 这位年轻的老师每天放学后帮助学生。

your.example: Please put your books on the desk before the class starts.
your.exampleZh: 请在开始上课前把你的书放在桌子上。

yours.example: This book is mine, and the one on the desk is yours.
yours.exampleZh: 这本书是我的，桌上那本是你的。

yourself.example: Please take care of yourself when you travel alone.
yourself.exampleZh: 你独自旅行时请照顾好你自己。

youth.example: She spent her youth in a small village near the sea.
youth.exampleZh: 她的青年时期是在海边的一个小村庄里度过的。

zeal.example: His zeal for teaching made every class lively and fun.
zeal.exampleZh: 他对教学的热忱让每堂课都生动有趣。

zealous.example: She is a zealous fan of this small local football team.
zealous.exampleZh: 她是这支本地小足球队的热心球迷。

zebra.example: We saw a zebra standing quietly beside the tall tree.
zebra.exampleZh: 我们看到一只斑马静静地站在那棵高树旁边。

zero.example: The temperature fell to zero last night, so the lake froze.
zero.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到了零度，所以湖面结冰了。

zinc.example: Zinc is a metal that helps keep our bodies healthy.
zinc.exampleZh: 锌是一种有助于保持身体健康的金属。

zip.example: She opened the zip on her bag and took out a small notebook.
zip.exampleZh: 她拉开包上的拉链，拿出一个小笔记本。

zombie.example: In the movie, a zombie walks slowly through the empty street.
zombie.exampleZh: 在电影里，一个僵尸慢慢地走过空荡荡的街道。

zone.example: The city has a quiet zone near the hospital where cars cannot honk.
zone.exampleZh: 这座城市在医院附近有一个安静区域，车辆不得鸣笛。

zoo.example: My little sister loves to see the pandas at the zoo.
zoo.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢在动物园看熊猫。

zoom.example: The camera can zoom in on the bird in the tree.
zoom.exampleZh: 相机可以拉近镜头，对准树上的那只鸟。
